text.body:
yatpādāmbhojasevāruciśucimanasāṃ prātibhaṃ tattiraścāṃ cakrāṅgānāmapi drāgvilasati militakṣīranīraprabhede| uddāmājñānarūpaprabalatamatamaḥstomasomasvabhāvāṃ devīmānandakandāṃ vidhumaṇiviśadāṃ śāradāṃ tāṃ namāmi|| 1
janayatu natibhājāmeṣa saṃtoṣapoṣaṃ kuvalayadalakāntiḥ kālikāyāḥ kaṭākṣaḥ| prakaṭayati purāreḥ ketakīgarbhapatratviṣi vapuṣi lipiṃ yaḥ pañcabāṇapraśasteḥ|| 2
lasanmṛṇālāṅkurakomalāni sphuratsudhādhāmakalāmalāni| pīyūṣasāraikaniketanāni jayanti sūktāni mahākavīnām|| 3
gīrvāṇāsuramauliratnanikarapreṅkhanmayūkhāmbhasaḥ saṃsekādiva pādamūlakalitaiḥ snigdhaiḥ prabhāpallavaiḥ| āśvāsaṃ kṛpayaiva śaśvadakaronmugdhaiṇasārthasya yaḥ so 'bhūdvatsamuniḥ pavitracaraṇanyāsena pūtāvaniḥ|| 4
tasyānvaye 'bhūtkarivṛndanātho dādāḥ sadā dānanidānabhūtaḥ yasyekṣaṇādvijjaṇabhūpasainyaṃ dainyaṃ gataṃ saṃyati vikrameṇa| catvārastasya saṃjātāstanayā nayaśālinaḥ bhujā iva hareḥ śaśvadvikramaśrīvibhūṣitāḥ|| 5
caturmukhamukhodgīrṇā nigamā iva te babhuḥ| khyāto mahīdharo jalhaḥ sāmbagaṅgādharāvapi|| 6
upāyairiva taiḥ kāle caturbhiḥ suprayojitaiḥ| maulugikṣoṇipālasya rājyaṃ jātaṃ sadonnatam|| 7
vijjaṇabalajalarāśiṃ vimathya bhujamandareṇa yaḥ kṛtavān| vīraśriyamaṅkasthāṃ sa na kasya mahīdharaḥ stutyaḥ|| 8
kiṃ citraṃ yadi bhogīndro 'nantastattanayo 'bhūt| ānīya balisadmasthānnāgānsvasvāmine dadau|| 9
vijitya bijjaṇaṃ yāte suralokaṃ mahīdhare| nināya bhillamaṃ jalho rājatāṃ kṣayavarjitām|| 10
dhūrjarabhūbhṛtkaṭake kaṇṭakaviṣame 'tidurgame yena| bhagadattakīrtibhājā duṣṭagajaḥ svecchayā nītaḥ|| 11
mallaḥ pallavitorubhītirabhitastrasyadbalo mailugiḥ muñjaḥ khañjitavikramastribhuvanabrahmā kila brāhmaṇaḥ| anno nunnaparākramo vijitabhūrbabhrū raṇaprāṅgaṇe yenākāri murārivikramabhṛtā kiṃ kiṃ na tasyorjitam|| 12
hāraṃ hāraṃ ripūṇāṃ samiti gajaghaṭā bhillamāyāditāsau āśāmāśāgajānāmapi haraṇavidhau sāmprataṃ hī vidhatte| smāraṃ smāraṃ surāṇāmadhipatiriti yadvikramāṇāṃ sma bhītaḥ śaṅke saṃketabhūmau niyamayati nijaṃ kuñjaraṃ kuñjarandhre|| 13
yadasinihatadantivrātaraktāktamuktāphalavihitavibhūṣā mattavetālayoṣāḥ| ripunṛpatikabandhānnṛtyato 'dyāpi dṛṣṭvā karakalitakapālāstālamudghaṭṭayanti|| 14
āsīdgaṅgādharastasya bhrātā gaṅgādharopamaḥ| ekānbabandha yo vyālānmumocaikānyadṛcchayā|| 15
saṅgaṃ dvijihvairna cakāra duṣṭairuvāha mūrdhnā na jaḍaṃ kadācit| dadāha kāmaṃ na janasya ruṣṭastathāpi gaṅgādhara eva so 'bhūt|| 16
tasyābhavatsūnuranūnasattvo janārdanāhvaḥ karivāhinīśaḥ| samudravadyo bhuvanaṃ babhāra saha śriyā citramaśeṣametat|| 17
utpannaṃ sudhiyāṃ kule yadakhilaistyaktaṃ budhairna kṣaṇaṃ yanno vismṛtamekadāpi sujanairyadyanna yuktaṃ khalaiḥ| daurgatyasya tathāvidhasya mahatastasyāpi kenāpi no yaddānāmbusaritpravāhapatitasyākāri hastārpaṇam|| 18
sihmo 'pyadhyāpitastena gajaśikṣāṃ tadadbhutam| yayārjunaṃ lasatpatraṃ samūlamudamūlayat|| 19
viśvatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ sphuradurusvarṇārcitārthivrajaḥ tasmādadbhutavikramaḥ samabhavacchrīlakṣmadevaḥ sudhīḥ| mantrairnirjitadevamantridhiṣaṇairjāgrannayopakramaiḥ rājyaṃ kṛṣṇamahīpateravikalaṃ dattvā sthiraṃ yo vyadhāt|| 20
agastya iva yasyāsirnyañcitakṣitibhṛdbabhau| citraṃ so 'pyakaronnṛtyatkabandhaṃ samarārṇavam|| 21
yadracitodyānaśrīḥ paripākasphuṭitadāḍimavyājāt| vihasatyanekarambhā prakaṭitadaśaneva nandanaṃ vipinam|| 22
jaṭotkaṭaṃ lasatkulyaṃ nīlakaṇṭhopaśobhitam| bhāti yadracitodyānamuttamāṅgamivaiśvaram|| 23
tatkṣāratvaṃ parihṛtamaho dūramūrīkṛtā drāk pīyūṣasya prakṛtisubhagā mādhurī sā dhurīṇā| itthaṃ yātaḥ saridadhipatirluptaveṣo 'nyadeśaṃ bhītyāgastyāditi janapadaistarkyate yattaḍāgaḥ|| 24
tasyāste tanayo nayodadhividhurbandhurbudhānāṃ sudhīḥ| sārāsāravicāraṇāsu caturaḥ śrījalhaṇākhyaḥ kṣitau| yaddānodakavāhinībhavanavāmbhodheryaśaścandramāḥ jāto 'nyaḥ satatodito dhavalayatyuccairjagantyulbaṇaḥ|| 25
matpitrā dattamasmai pratihatabalavaddveṣivargopasargaṃ rājyaṃ prājyaprabhāvaprathitaguṇabhṛtā kṛṣṇarājāya bhaktyā| tannirvāhyaṃ mayeti dviguṇitadhiṣaṇāśaktibhaktirvidhatte sarvaṃ yaḥ svāmikāryaṃ hitamanayahṛtā bhāvukenānujena|| 26
dhruvaṃ yasyāsti hastābje madāndhā karivāhinī| dānodakapravāho 'tra dṛśyate kathamanyathā|| 27
yadguṇairgrathitaḥ śuddhairamitairbrahmagolakaḥ| vidhatte kīrtikanyāyāḥ krīḍākandukavibhramam|| 28
brūmahe kimagādhatvaṃ yatkṛpāṇapayonidheḥ| magnā yatrārivāhinyo na lakṣyante paraḥśatāḥ|| 29
nirdalitarājamāṣairārdrakakhaṇḍaiḥ sasaindhavakṣodaiḥ| yadasiguṇo rasavatyāṃ saṃyati bhakṣyaṃ karoti kālasya|| 30
nyañcadbhūvalayaṃ calatkṣitidharaṃ kṣubhyatsamastārṇavaṃ trasyadvairivadhūvilocanajalaprārabdhavarṣodgamam| prodañcatturagāvalīkhurapuṭavyādhūtadhūlīpaṭacchannādityapathaṃ kathaṃ na viditaṃ yajjaitrayātrādinam|| 31
yadvairivīrairasikhaṇḍitāṅgaiḥ samutsukābhiḥ surasundarībhiḥ| vaśīkriyācūṛnamiva prakīrṇamābhāti dhūlīpaṭalaṃ samīke|| 32
kṣaṇaṃ kāntārāgaprakaṭitamanovaikṛtayutaḥ kṣaṇaṃ śālotsaṅge dvijakularavākṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ| kṣaṇaṃ patradhvānaśrutipulakito yadbhayabharāt vasanprāpto 'raṇye ripuravanipālasthitimiva|| 33
yāñcādainyalaghūkṛtāstṛṇamiva kṣipraṃ nirālambanāḥ nīyante pratisadma mārgaṇagaṇā dairgatyavātena ye| teṣāṃ yena tathākṛto 'tigarimā svarṇoccapuñjārpaṇaiḥ yasmātsamprati te 'pi citrakaṭakairbhūbhṛttulāṃ bibhrati|| 34
ko 'pyanyaḥ kalpavṛkṣo 'yaṃ cakāsti vasudhātale| yatpāṇipallavo 'pyekaḥ kurute 'dhaḥ suradrumam|| 35
kīrtyā yasya jagattraye dhavalite sahyācale mandare vindhye hemagirau harakṣitidhare no bhāti rūpāntaram| no cedarthijanāya tena dadatā svarṇaṃ jagatyūrjitaṃ vikhyātaḥ kanakācalaḥ kathamiva svairaṃ na viśrāṇitaḥ|| 36
teneyaṃ kriyate vīkṣya satsubhāṣitasaṃgrahān| sūktimuktāvalī kaṇṭhakadalībhūṣaṇaṃ satām|| 37
vibudhaiḥ sanniveśajñaiḥ saṃgṛhītānyanekaśaḥ| sudhārasasanābhīni santi sūktāni yadyapi|| 38
tathāpi kharvatāṃ nītvā vibudhairgarvaparvatam| śaśvadālokanīyo 'yaṃ matsaraḥ kiṃ guṇeṣvapi|| 39
sāhityavidyāhṛdayaṃ jñātumicchasi cetsukham| tatpaśya jalhaṇakṛtāṃ sūktimuktāvalīmimām|| 40
nāṅgulīyairna keyūrairna graiveyairna kaṅkaṇaiḥ| tathā bhāti yathā vidvānkaṇṭhasaṃgatayānayā|| 41 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasyaite
ādau namaskṛtiḥ paścādāśaṃsāvacanāni ca| subhāṣitapraśaṃsā ca kavikāvyastutistataḥ|| 42
kukavīnāṃ tato nindā sanmanasvikhalāstataḥ| kadaryapaddhatiratho dvividhānyoktipaddhatiḥ|| 43
kṛtāḥ khecarabhūcāribhedāsteṣvādito raviḥ| khecareṣu tataścandravātameghāstataḥ khagāḥ|| 44
teṣu prākkokilo haṃsaḥ śikhidhvāṃkṣabakādayaḥ| khadyotaścātakaḥ paścādityuktāḥ khecarāstataḥ|| 45
bhūcarāsteṣu siṃhaḥ prāktataḥ kuñjarapaddhatiḥ| dāserakabalīvardamṛgapaddhatayaḥ pṛthak|| 46
jaladhimaṇiśaṅkhataṭinīsarasīpadmadrumāśca śikhimaravaḥ| saṃkīrṇavastuvarṇanamityanyoktirdvidhātha śṛṅgāraḥ|| 47
prathamo 'tra vipralambhastadanu ca sambhogaśṛṅgāraḥ| tatra viyogaḥ prathamaṃ priyasaṅgaḥ strīṣu madanajāvasthā|| 48
praśnaḥ sakhīnāṃ vividhāḥ pralāpā viyoginīnāmatha dūtikāyāḥ| sampreṣaṇaṃ manmathajāpyavasthā saha pralāpena viyoginaśca|| 49
dūtīvacaḥ priyaṃ prati saṃdeśo virahiṇaḥ priyatamāyāḥ| tasyā virahāvasthā kathanaṃ dūtyā priyāpraśnaḥ|| 50
dūtyupahāsastadanu priyasya kāntāvalokane vācaḥ| bālyaṃ vayasaḥ sandhiryauvanamakhilāṅgavarṇanaṃ kramaśaḥ|| 51
māne māninyavasthā tu nāyikātithyapūrvikā| sakhyā cānunayaḥ paścāduktipratyuktayastataḥ|| 52
prasādo 'tha ca sambhoge ṛtavaḥ kusumoccayaḥ| kandukodakayoḥ krīḍā raveścāstamayastataḥ|| 53
pralāpāḥ kāmināmādāvabhisāre 'bhisārikā| candrodayaḥ pānagoṣṭhī priyācāṭurataḥ param|| 54
surateṣu tatpraśaṃsā navayoṣitsaṃgame sakhīvākyam| nidhuvanamatha navavadhvā ratikelī rativiparyāsaḥ|| 55
nivṛttiḥ suratasyādau kalahaḥ praṇayasya ca| nāyikānunayaḥ paścātprabhātaṃ tatsamīraṇaḥ|| 56
kalahāntaritāpralapanamataḥ paraṃ nāyakasya śikṣā ca| sambhogāviṣkaraṇaṃ kulaṭā saṃkīrṇamiti ca śṛṅgāraḥ|| 57
rasā hāsyādayo jātistato bhūpativarṇanam| kriyāguptyādicitrāṇi tathā vakroktipaddhatiḥ|| 58
rathakarigirivāridhinadīsaronagaravarṇanaṃ kramaśaḥ| kūrmādīnāṃ stavanamatha sarvapadārthasaṃstutirvividhā|| 59
[bhairavakūrmādināṃ stavanaṃ mṛgayādivarṇanaṃ cātha|]
nītirvidyā daivaṃ sapuruṣakāraṃ ca sāhasaṃ lakṣmīḥ| dānaṃ kulajā nārī tadvṛttamapatyakaṃ ca mitraguṇau|| 60
kalā sevātha dharmārthau tṛṣṇādāridryapaddhatī| saṃtoṣakṣāntikaruṇā vairāgyaṃ tadanu stutiḥ|| 61
harīśayostrayastriṃśatpaddhatīnāmidaṃ śatam| śrīmatā bhagadattena jalhaṇena vyaracyata|| 62
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāmanukramaṇikāprakaraṇam||
namastuṅgaśiraścumbicandracāmaracārave| trailokyanagarārambhamūlastambhāya śambhave|| 1|| Bhaṭṭabāṇasya
suptadruhiṇagovindacandrendradhanadādiṣu| kalpāntarātriṣu namo yāmikāya yamāraye|| 2|| Rājaśekharasya
ādāya cāpamacalaṃ kṛtvāhīnaṃ guṇaṃ viṣamadṛṣṭiḥ| yaścitramacyutaśaro lakṣyamabhāṅkṣīnnamastasmai|| 3|| "Srībhojadevasya
bāṇībhūtapurāṇapūruṣadhṛtipratyāśayā dhāvite vidrātīkṣaṇagāśuśukṣaṇikaṇaklānte śakunteśvare| namronnamrabhujaṅgapuṅgavaguṇavyākṛṣṭabāṇāsanakṣiptāstrasya puradruho vijayate saṃdhānasīmāśramaḥ|| 4||
namastubhyaṃ devāsuramakuṭamāṇikyakiraṇapraṇālīsambhedasnapitacaraṇāya smarajite| mahākalpasvāhākṛtabhuvanacakre 'pi nayane niroddhuṃ bhūyastatprasavamiva kāmaṃ hutavate|| 5|| etau śrīmurāreḥ|
cūḍottaṃsitacārucandrakalikācañcacchikhābhāsuraḥ līlādagdhavilolakāmaśalabhaḥ śreyodaśāgre sphuran| antargūḍhadurantamohatimiraprāgbhāramucchedayan cetaḥsadmani yogināṃ vijayate bodhapradīpo haraḥ|| 6||
sandhyānatau natapurandhritanoḥ saroṣamutsārite girijayā nijapāṇipadme| utsarpikaṅkaṇaphaṇīndraphaṇārpaṇena pūrṇo 'ñjalirjayati bālamṛgāṅkamauleḥ|| 7||
vande tadekaṃ śivayoḥ śarīraṃ yadvāmabhāge kucakumbhadambhāt| avāptamṛtyuḥ kila liṅgarūpī vīraḥ svayambhūrabhavanmanobhūḥ|| 8||
karasparśārambhātpulakitapṛthūrojakalaśe śramāmbho vāmārdhe vamati madanākūtisulabham| vibhorvāraṃ vāraṃ kṛtasamadhikoddhūlanavidheḥ tanau bhasmasnānaṃ kathamapi samāptaṃ vijayate|| 9||
maunādastamitaiva cāṭubhaṇitiḥ srastaikahastādgataṃ dūre 'pyañjalibandhanaṃ praṇamanaṃ stabdhārdhamūrdhnaḥ kutaḥ| itthaṃ saṃghaṭitaikavigrahatayā vyagro girigrāmaṇījātāṃ jātaruṣaṃ jayatyanunayandevastrilokīguruḥ|| 10|| kasyāpi|
dehārdhaṃ kuru pārvati sthirapadaṃ haste dhanurdhāraya svedārdraṃ yadi mṛjyatāṃ karatalaṃ bhasmāṅgarāgeṇa me| evaṃ jalpata eva bāṇaśikhini proḍḍīya śiñjāphaṇi śvāsaiḥ prajvalite pureṣu jayati smeraṃ purārermukham|| 11|| Bilhaṇasya
kaṇa iva purāṃ vahnerbhasmāvadhūlanasaṃgataḥ jayati bahalālokasphārāvadhūtaniśodayaḥ| smaraharajaṭābandhagranthirbhujaṃgaphaṇāmaṇiḥ tridaśataṭinīpūrānītaḥ sphuranniva tārakaḥ|| 12||
uccairuttālakheladbhujavanapavanoddhūtaśailaughapātasphārodañcatpayodhiprakaṭitamakuṭasvardhunīsaṃgamāni| jīyāsustāṇḍavāni sphuṭavikaṭajaṭākoṭisaṃghaṭṭabhūribhraśyannakṣatracakravyavahitasumanovṛṣṭipātāni śambhoḥ|| 13|| Bherībhāṅkārasya
nīlalohitalalāṭalāñchane locane jayati ko 'pi pāvakaḥ| rakṣitasya jagadantahetave yasya saṃjvalanamātmabhūrabhūt|| 14|| Murāreḥ
jayati harajaṭābharo yadantarvahati nirākulameva devasindhuḥ| lahariṣu taralendurājahaṃsā vitataviriñcikapālaphenamālā|| 15||
praṇamata nayane harasya pūjākamalakulaṃ padayoḥ kṛtaṃ kṛtārthaiḥ| vikasanavinimīlane vicitraṃ yugapadupaiti yayorvilokanena|| 16|| Sūktisahasrādetau
sa jayati himakaralekhā cakāsti yasyomayonmukhī vihitā| nayanapradīpakajjalajighṛkṣayā rajataśuktiriva|| 17|| Subandhoḥ
lasallīlācandraścaraṇagatamauleḥ smarajitaḥ kiradbhiḥ sujyotsnāṃ nakhamaṇibhirāpūritakalaḥ| vyalīke pārvatyāḥ parilaghulavairañjanajuṣaḥ patadbhirbāṣpasya kramalikhitalakṣmā vijayate|| 18|| kasyāpi
śrīkaṇṭhasya kapardabandhanapariklāntoragagrāmaṇīsaṃdaṣṭāṃ makuṭāvataṃsakalikāṃ vande kalāmaindavīm| yā bimbapratipūraṇāya parito niṣpīḍya saṃdaṃśikāyantreṇeva lalāṭalocanaśikhijvālābhirāvartyate|| 19|| Murāreḥ
harakaṇṭhagrahānandamīlitākṣīṃ namāmyumām| kālakūṭaviṣasparśajātamūrcchāgamāmiva|| 20|| Bāṇasya
krīḍāsaroṣagirijācaraṇāravindaṃ vande yadagrapatitā hariṇāṅkalekhā| kāmāpahastitavṛṣadhvajadhairyalakṣmīpātāvabhagnavalayārdhanibhā vibhāti|| 21|| Gotrānandasya
prātaḥ kālāñjanaparicitaṃ vīkṣya jāmāturoṣṭhaṃ kanyāyāśca stanamukulayoraṅgulībhasmamudrām| premollāsājjayati madhuraṃ sasmitābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ gaurīmātuḥ kimapi kimapi vyāhṛtaṃ karṇamūle|| 22|| kasyāpi
uccairbrahmāṇḍakhaṇḍadvitayasahacaraṃ kumbhayugmaṃ dadhānaḥ preṅkhannāgāripakṣapratibhaṭavikaṭaśrotratālābhirāmaḥ| devaḥ śambhorapatyaṃ bhujagapatitanuspardhivardhiṣṇuhastaḥ trailokyāścaryamūrtiḥ sa jayati jagatāmīśvaraḥ kuñjarāsyaḥ|| 23|| Vidyeśvarasya
gaurīvibhajyamānārdhasaṃkīrṇe haramūrdhani| amba dviguṇagambhīre bhāgīrathi namo 'stu te|| 24||
kulagururabalānāṃ kelidīkṣāpradāne paramasuhṛdanaṅgo rohiṇīvallabhasya| api kusumapṛṣatkairdevadevasya jetā jayati suratalīlānāṭikāsūtradhāraḥ|| 25|| Rājaśekharasya
sa eṣa bhuvanatrayaprathitasaṃyamaḥ śaṃkaraḥ bibharti vapuṣādhunā virahakātaraḥ kāminīm| anena kila nirjitā vayamiti priyāyāḥ karaṃ kareṇa paritāḍayañjayati jātahāsaḥ smaraḥ|| 26| kasyāpi|
devī ratirvijayate mṛganābhicitrapatrāvalī pṛthupayodharasīmni yasyāḥ| bhāti trilokavijayopanatasvakāntaprakrāntasāyakaniśātanakālikeva|| 27|| Madanasya
lakṣmīlatāsamāśliṣṭaṃ kaustubhastabakojjvalam| svargāpavargaphaladaṃ harikalpadrumaṃ numaḥ|| 28|| kasyāpi
jayati sa nābhisaroruhamadhukarapaṭalairivāsitākāraḥ| śauriḥ śrīmukhacandre yatkāntirlāñchanacchāyā|| 29|| Kṣemendrasya
ativipulaṃ kucayugalaṃ rahasi karairāmṛśa/llakṣmyāḥ| tadapahṛtaṃ nijahṛdayaṃ jayati harirmṛgayamāṇa iva|| 30|| Arasiṭhakkurasya
kanakakalaśasvacche rādhāpayodharamaṇḍale navajaladharaśyāmāmātmadyutiṃ pratibimbitām| asitasicayaprāntabhrāntyā muhurmuhurutkṣipan jayati janitavrīḍāhāsaḥ priyāhasito hariḥ|| 31||
dṛkpātaḥ kamalāsāne 'stu bhavatu jñānaṃ manāṅmārute śrīkaṇṭho 'yamitaḥ surāniti natāṃstārkṣyeṇa vijñāpitaḥ| preyasyāḥ kva tadāsanaṃ kva ca rutaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ kva cetyullapan lakṣmyāvāsitamānaso vijayate suptaprabuddho hariḥ|| 32|| kasyāpi
viramati mahākalpe nābhīpathaikaniketanaḥ tribhuvanapurīśilpī yasya pratikṣaṇamātmabhūḥ| kimadhikaraṇaṃ kīdṛkkasya vyavasthitirityasau udaramaviśaddraṣṭuṃ tasmai jagannidhaye namaḥ|| 33|| Murāreḥ
jīyāsuḥ śakulākṛterbhagavataḥ pucchacchaṭācchoṭanāt udyantaḥ śatacandritāmbaratalāste bindavaḥ saindhavāḥ| yairutpatya patadbhiraurvaśikhinastejojaṭālaṃ vapuḥ pānādhmānavaśādarocakarujāṃ cakre cirāyāspadam|| 34||
na paṅkairālepaṃ kalayati dharitrīvyayavaśāt na mustāmanviṣyatyuraganagarabhraṃśacakitaḥ| na dhatte brahmāṇḍasphuṭanabhayato ghurghuraravaṃ varāho māhātmyāditi jayati saṃkocitavapuḥ|| 35|| etau Hanūmataḥ
jayanti narasiṃhasya sphurannakhaśikhāṅkurāḥ| hariṇakrodhakṛṣṭendukalākhaṇḍairivāṅkitāḥ|| 36|| kasyāpi
daityānāmadhipe nakhāṅkurakuṭīkoṇapratiṣṭhātmani sphārībhūtakaḍārakesarasaṭāsaṃghātaghorākṛteḥ| sakrodhaṃ ca savismayaṃ ca saguruvrīḍaṃ ca sāntasmitaṃ krīḍākesariṇo harervijayate tatkālamālokitam|| 37|| Indrakaveḥ
vapurdalanasambhramātsvanakharaṃ praviṣṭe ripau kva yāta iti vismayātprahitalocanaḥ sarvataḥ| vṛtheti karadhūtibhirnipatitaṃ punardānavaṃ nirīkṣya bhuvi reṇuvajjayati jātahāso hariḥ|| 38|| kasyāpi
lakṣmīpāṇidvayaparicitaṃ mūlamūrdhvaśrutīnāṃ vyaktaṃ vande kamalacaraṇadvandvamādyasya puṃsaḥ| yatraikasya vyadhita balinā pādyatoyairvitīrṇaiḥ ārdrasyaiva praṇatitaralaḥ kṣālanaṃ padmayoniḥ|| 39|| Sūktisahasrāt
diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭā mahī sādhyate siddhā sā ca vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata| viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namaḥ yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃgatam|| 40|| kasyāpi
khinno 'si muñca bhāraṃ bibhṛmo vayamiti vadatsu śithilabhujaḥ| bharabhugnavitathabāhuṣu gopeṣu hasanharirjayati|| 41|| Hariharasya
kva yāsi khalu caurike pramuṣitaṃ sphuṭaṃ dṛśyate dvitīyamiha māmakaṃ vahasi kañcuke kandukam| tyajeti navagopikākucayugaṃ nimathnanbalāt lasatpulakapañjaro jayati gokule keśavaḥ|| 42|| Dīpakasya
helodastamahīdharasya tanutāmālokya doṣṇo hareḥ hastenāṃsataṭe 'valambya caraṇādhārotpatatpādakam| śailoddhārasahāyatāṃ jigamiṣoraspṛṣṭagovardhanāḥ rādhāyā gagane jayanti suciraṃ vandhyāḥ karabhrāntayaḥ|| 43||
taṃ vande padmasadmānamupavītacchaṭācchalāt| gaṅgāsrotastrayeṇeva yaḥ sadaivābhiṣicyate|| 44|| rājaśekharasya
mūrtiḥ smartṛtamoharā sahacarī vācāṃ parā devatā vyāhārāḥ śrutayaḥ kuṭumbakamidaṃ viśvaṃ carasthāvaram| yasyaitacchrutimūlamūlakatayā saṃdarśitaprakriyaṃ svārambhaṃ bhagavantamantarahitaṃ brahmāṇāmīḍāmahe|| 45||
sūkṣmāya śucaye tasmai namo vāktattvatantave| vicitro yasya vinyāso vidadhāti jagatpaṭīm|| 46|| ayaṃ jayatuṅgodayāt|
jyotistamoharamalocanagocaraṃ tajjihvādurāsadarasaṃ madhunaḥ pravāham| dūraṃ tvacaḥ pulakabandhi paraṃ prapadye sārasvataṃ kimapi kāmadughaṃ prapadyam|| 47|| sūktisahasrāt
\Colo iti sūktimuktāvalyāṃ namaskārapaddhatiḥ|
jagajjīvanamavyādvaḥ śambhorambhomayaṃ vapuḥ| brahmāṇḍamapi yasyāntastarattumbīphalāyate|| 1|| kasyāpi
sa dhūrjaṭijaṭājūṭo jāyatāṃ vijayāya vaḥ| yatraikapalitabhrāntiṃ karotyadyāpi jāhnavi|| 2|| śivasvāminaḥ|
himagiritanayāmayārdhamūrtistuhinaśilāsṛtasindhubaddhamauliḥ| śiśirakarakalākṛtāvataṃso haratu śivaḥ paritāpamāntaraṃ vaḥ|| 3|| umāpatidharasya
asoḍhā tatkālollasadasahabhāvasya tapasaḥ kathānāṃ visrambheṣvatha ca rasikaḥ śailaduhituḥ| pramodaṃ vo diśyātkapaṭavaṭuveṣāpanayane tvarāśaithilyābhyāṃ yugapadabhiyuktaḥ smaraharaḥ|| 4|| kasyāpi
pāṇau kaṅkaṇamutphaṇaḥ phaṇipatirnetraṃ jvalatpāvakaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ kuṇṭhitakālakūṭakuṭilo vastraṃ gajendrājinam| gaurīlocanalobhanāya subhago veṣo harasyeti me gaṇḍollāsavibhāvitaḥ paśupaterhāsodgamaḥ pātu vaḥ|| 5|| rudrasya
śailendrapratipādyamānagirijāhastagrahaprollasadromāñcādivisaṃsthulākhilavidhivyāsaṅgabhaṅgākulaḥ| hā śaityaṃ tuhinācalasya karayorityūcivānsarvataḥ śailāntaḥpuramātramaṇḍalagaṇairdṛṣṭo 'vatādvaḥ śivaḥ|| 6|| kasyāpi
cūḍābhasmakaṇāṅkitāviva jaṭāpatrāñcalenāmṛśan netrāgnidyutitāpitāviva karaiḥ siñcansudhādīdhiteḥ| nāgaśvāsakalaṅkitāviva muhurgaṅgājalaiḥ kṣālayaṃ māninyāścaraṇau girīndraduhiturbhūtyai girīśo 'stu vaḥ|| 7|| umāpatidharasya
dūre dāruvanābhisāraka vṛthācāṭūni muñcādhunā bhūyastvaṃ punarapyahaṃ yadi tadā candraḥ kṣitiṃ yāsyati| ityuktaḥ śaśimauliradrisutayā cūḍendubhūlambanavyājavyañjitapādapadmapatanaprītapriyaḥ pātu vaḥ|| 8|| harṣapaṇḍitasya
sahasrākṣairaṅgairnamasitari nīlotpalamayīṃ ivātmānaṃ mālāmupanayati patyau diviṣadām| jighṛkṣau ca krīḍārabhasini kumāre saha gaṇaiḥ hasanvo bhadrāṇi draḍhayatu mṛḍānīparivṛdhaḥ|| 9|| murāreḥ
viśliṣṭe 'bhinaye ruṣaṃ racayataḥ sampādite śaṃsataḥ romāñcaṃ vahataḥ svahastaracitasthānakriyāsparśajam| khinnāṃ śvāsayataśca śailatanayāṃ gāḍhaiḥ samāliṅganaiḥ nānābhāvarasātmakaṃ paśupaterācāryakaṃ pātu vaḥ|| 10||
maulisraggṛhiṇāṃ dṛgarcirudayasvinnārdhacandrāmṛtapratyujjīvitadevadaityaśirasāmanyonyavidveṣiṇām| jāte vākkalahe prahāsanapare tandrāyitāre paraṃ kiṃ kuryāditi tadvacaḥsmitamukhaḥ pāyātsa vaḥ śaṃkaraḥ|| 11|| kayorapyetau
bhūtyai vo 'stu kapāladāma jagatāṃ patyuryadīyāṃ lipiṃ kvāpi kvāpi gaṇāḥ paṭhanti padaśo nātiprasiddhākṣarām| viśvaṃ srakṣyati vakṣyati kṣitimapāmīśiṣyate śiṣyate bhāgai rāśiṣu raṃsyate 'tsyati jagannirvekṣyati dyāmiti|| 12|| chittapasya
pāyātkṛtānaṅgapataṅgadāhaḥ khaṭvāṅgino netraśikhipradīpaḥ| yasyāntike śubhrudaśāniveśaśriyaṃ kirīṭendukalāḥ śrayante|| 13|| maṅkhaṇasya
ekaṃ dhyānanimīlanānmukulitaṃ cakṣurdvitīyaṃ punaḥ pārvatyā vadanāmbujastanataṭe śṛṅgārabhārālasam| anyaddūravikṛṣṭacāpamadanakrodhānaloddīpitaṃ śambhorbhinnarasaṃ samādhisamaye netratrayaṃ pātu vaḥ|| 14||
pāyādvaḥ śitikaṇṭhasya kaṇṭhaḥ śyāmāmbudopamaḥ| gaurībhujalatā yatra vidyullekheva rājate|| 15|| kayorapyetau
ṛkṣāṇāṃ bhūridhāmnāṃ śritamadhipatinā prasphuradbhīmatāraṃ sphāraṃ netrānalena prasabhaniyamitoccāpamīnadhvajena| rāmāyattaṃ purāreḥ kumudaśuci lasannīlasugrīvamaṅgaṃ plāvaṅgaṃ sainyamanyaddṛśavadanaśiracchedahetu śriyai vaḥ|| 16|| dhanapālasya (haravānarasainyayoḥ śleṣaḥ )
tadvaḥ punātu śivayorardhanārīśvaraṃ vapuḥ| bhavediva yadadya śvaḥ śiva eva śivaiva vā|| 17
ardhāṅganāpuṃvapuṣaḥ purārermūrtiḥ śriyaṃ nauriva vastanotu| premātibhārādaparaṃ yadardhaṃ mamajja śṛṅgārarasāmburāśau|| 18|| vairandhasya
kalyāṇamāvahatu vaḥ śivayoḥ śarīramekaṃ yadīyamasitacchavikaṇṭhamūlam| vāmetare 'pi kurute sitabhāsi bhāge prārabdhaśailatanayāpariṇāmaśaṅkām|| 19|| utprekṣāvallabhasya
svedārdravāmakucamaṇḍanapatrabhaṅgasaṃśoṣidakṣiṇakarāṅgulibhasmareṇuḥ| strīpuṃnapuṃsakapadavyatilaṅghanī vaḥ śambhostanuḥ sukhayatu prakṛtiścaturthī|| 20||
svacchandaikastanaśrīrubhayamatamilanmaulicandraḥ phaṇīndraprācīnāvītavāhī sukhayatu bhagavānardhanārīśvaro vaḥ| yasyārdhe viśvadāhavyasanavisṛmarajyotirardhe kṛpodyadbāṣpaṃ cānyonyavegaprahatisimisimākāri cakṣustṛtīyam|| 21|| murāreretau
āśleṣādharabimbacumbanasukhālāpasmitānyāsatāṃ dūre tāvadidaṃ mitho na sulabhaṃ jātaṃ mukhālokanam| itthaṃ vyarthakṛtaikadehaghaṭanāvinyāsayorāvayoḥ keyaṃ premaviḍambanetyavatu vaḥ smero 'rdhanārīśvaraḥ|| 22|| śūravarmaṇaḥ
giritanayaikapayodharanihitakaraḥ pātu vaściraṃ giriśaḥ| viśvāsayituṃ manasijamiva spṛśankāñcanaṃ liṅgam|| 23|| jayadevasya
kalpānte śamitatrivikramamahākaṅkālabaddhasphuraccheṣasyūtanṛsiṃhapāṇinakharaprotādikolāmiṣaḥ| viśvaikārṇavatāviśeṣamuditau tau matsyakūrmāvubhau karṣandhīvaratāṃ gato 'syatu satāṃ mohaṃ mahābhairavaḥ|| 24|| chittapasya
spaṣṭavyākṛṣṭadraṃṣṭrāvikaṭamukhataṭottāladaṃṣṭrāntarālanyastabrahmāṇḍakhaṇḍagrasanaghanaḍhaṇātkārakolāhalinyaḥ| caṇḍīnāthasya yuṣmānaviralavilasajjaitralālāṭanetrajvālāhelānipītapralayajaladhayaḥ pāntu kalpāntalīlāḥ|| 25||
kalpāntakrodhanasya tripuravijayinaḥ krīḍayā saṃcariṣṇoḥ kṛtvāpi prāṇijātairnijamukhakuharātithyamaprāptatṛpteḥ| digbhittīḥ prekṣya śūnyāḥ pralayajalanidhiprekṣitātmīyamūrtigrāsavyāsaktimoghaśramajanitaruṣaḥ pāntu vo garjitāni|| 26|| etau bherībhāṅkārasya
asthīnyasthīnyajinamajinaṃ bhasma bhasmendurinduḥ gaṅgā gaṅgoraga uraga ityullasatsambhramāṇām| bhūṣāveṣopakaraṇakaraṇaprāpaṇavyāpṛtānāṃ nṛttārambhapraṇayini śive pāntu vāco gaṇānām|| 27|| dhanapālasya
indoḥ kiṃ druhiṇasya vā surapateḥ kiṃ vā kṛtānasya vā kiṃ bhūteśa diśāsthi bhūṣaṇagaṇeṣvākṛṣya deyaṃ mayā| itthaṃ maṇḍanamandirodaracaravyāhārato bhīkarāt bhītā yasya surāḥ prasādhanavidhau pāyātsa vaḥ śaṃkaraḥ|| 28||
ārdrāṃ kaṇṭhe mukhābjasrajamupanayatyambikā jānulambāṃ sthāne kṛtvendulekhāṃ nibiḍayati jaṭāḥ pannagendreṇa nandī| kālaḥ kṛttiṃ nibadhnātūpanayati kare kālarātriḥ kapālaṃ śambhornṛttāvatāre pariṣaditi pṛthagvyāpṛtā vaḥ punātu|| 29|| kayorapyetau|
bho bho dikpatayaḥ prayāta parataḥ khaṃ muñcatāmbhomucaḥ pātālaṃ vraja medini praviśata kṣoṇītalaṃ bhūdharāḥ| brahmannunnaya dūramātmabhavanaṃ nāthasya no nṛtyataḥ śambhoḥ saṃkaṭametadityavatu vaḥ protsāraṇā nandinaḥ|| 30|| mahānāṭakāt|
sandhyātāṇḍavaḍambarapraṇayino bhargasya caṇḍabhramavyāvṛttodbhujadaṇḍamaṇḍalabhuvo jañjhānilāḥ pāntu vaḥ| yeṣāmuccalatāṃ javena jhaṭiti vyūheṣu bhūmībhṛtāṃ uḍḍīneṣu biḍaujasā punarasau dambholirālokitaḥ|| 31 somanāthapraśasteḥ
uddāmabhramivegavistṛtajaṭāvallīpraṇālīpatatsvargaṅgājaladaṇḍikāvalayitaṃ nirmāya tatpañjaram| sambhrāmyadbhujaṣaṇḍapakṣapaṭaladvandvena haṃsāyitaḥ trailokyavyayanāṭikānavanaṭasvāmī jagattrāyatām|| 32
yannāṭyabhramighūrṇamānavasudhācakrādhirūḍhe bhṛśaṃ merau pārśvaniveśivāsaraniśācakre paribhrāmyati| taijasyastaḍito bhavanti śataśo dṛṣṭā hi jātāḥ kathaṃ tāmasyo 'pi sa vaḥ punātu jagatāmanteṣṭiyajvā vibhuḥ|| 33 etau murāreḥ
saṃrambhādavibhāvitatribhuvanāyāsasya kāmadviṣaḥ nṛttārambhavijṛmbhitairavayavairbrahmāṇḍamudbhindataḥ| niryanmauli vinirgatāgracaraṇaṃ prollāsidoḥpallavaṃ pāyādvo bahirambhasaḥ pravicalatkūrmāyamāṇaṃ vapuḥ|| 34 kūrmabārhatasya
bhadraṃ candrakale śivaṃ suranadi śreyaḥ kapālāvale kalyāṇaṃ bhujagendravalli kuśalaṃ viṣvagjaṭāsantate| ityāhurmilitāḥ parasparamamū yasminpraśāntiṃ gate kalpāntārabhaṭīnaṭasya bhavatāttadvaḥ śriyai tāṇḍavam|| 35 kasyāpi
gonāsāya niyojitāgadarajāḥ sarpāya baddhauṣadhiḥ kaṇṭhasthāya viṣāya vīryamahataḥ pāṇau maṇīnbibhratī| bharturbhūtagaṇāya gotrajaratīsaṃdiṣṭamantrākṣarā rakṣatvadrisutā vivāhasamaye prītā ca bhītā ca vaḥ|| 36 rājaśekharasya
pratyāsannavivāhamaṇḍanavidhau devārcanavyagrayā dṛṣṭvāgre pariṇetureva likhitāṃ gaṅgādharasyākṛtim| unmādasmitaroṣalajjitadhiyā gauryā kathaṃciccirāt vṛddhastrīvacanātpriye vinihitaḥ puṣpāñjaliḥ pātu vaḥ|| 37
pādāgrasthitayā muhuḥ stanabhareṇānītayā namratāṃ śambhoḥ saspṛhalocanatrayapathaṃ yāntyā tadārādhane| hrīmatyā śirasīhitaḥ sapulakasvedodgamotkampayā viśliṣyankusumāñjalirgirijayā kṣipto 'ntare pātu vaḥ|| 38
autsukyena kṛtatvarā sahabhuvā vyāvartamānā hriyā taistairbandhuvadhūjanasya vacanairnītābhimukhyaṃ punaḥ| dṛṣṭvāgre dhavamāttasādhvasarasā gaurī nave saṃgame saṃrohatpulakā hareṇa hasatā śliṣṭā sukhāyāstu vaḥ|| 39 śrīharṣasyaitau
vyānamrā dayitānane mukulitā śārdūlacarmāmbare sotkampā bhujage nimeṣarahitā candre 'mṛtasyandini| mīladbhrūḥ surasindhudarśanavidhau mlānā kapālodare pārvatyā navasaṃgamapraṇayinī dṛṣṭiḥ śivāyāstu vaḥ|| 40 bhāsasya
bhrūlāsyotsavinī savibhramagatirmūrchannitambasthalī saṃkīrṇe vayasi smitārdraphaṇitiḥ sā pārvatī pātu vaḥ| yasyāḥ karṇataṭaṃ dṛśāvagamatāṃ tūrṇaṃ tadantaḥpathe gatvā draṣṭumiveśvaraṃ hṛdi kṛtādhiṣṭhānamutkaṇṭhitam|| 41 madanasya
arciṣmanti vidārya vaktrakuharāṇyāsṛkkvato vāsukeḥ tarjanyā viṣakarburāngaṇayataḥ saṃspṛśya dantāṅkurān| ekaṃ trīṇi navāṣṭa sapta ṣaḍiti pradhvastasaṃkhyākramāḥ vācaḥ krauñcaripoḥ śiśitvavikalāḥ śreyāṃsi puṣṇantu vaḥ|| 42
svecchāramyaṃ luṭhitvā pitururasi citābhasmadhūlīsitāṅgaḥ gaṅgāvāriṇyagādhe jhaṭiti pṛthujaṭājūṭato dattajhampaḥ| sadyaḥ sītkārakārī jalajaḍimaraṇaddantapaṅktirguho vaḥ kampī pāyādapāyājjvalitaśikhiśikhe cakṣuṣi nyastahastaḥ|| 43 bāṇasyaitau
vikasadamaranārīnetranīlābjaṣaṇḍānyadhivasati sadā yaḥ saṃyamādhaḥkṛtāni| navarucirakalāpe vartate yo mayūre vitaratu sa kumāro brahmacaryaśriyaṃ vaḥ|| 44
pāyādgajendravadanaḥ sa imāṃ vilokīṃ yasyodgatena gagane mahatā kareṇa| mūlāvalagnasitadantabisāṅkureṇa nālāyitaṃ tapanabimbasaroruhasya|| 45 gaṇapateḥ
suvarṇagirikarṇike taralatārakākesare calajjaladaṣaṭpade sphuṭadigantapatrāṣṭake| sa vaḥ prathamanāyakaḥ pradiśatu śriyaṃ yatkaraḥ karoti jagadambuje valitanālalīlāyitam|| 46 kṣemendrasya
dānasrotaḥsahasrairdaśanarucicayaiḥ kumbhasindūrapūraiḥ udbhūtairekakālaṃ prakaṭitarajanīghasrasandhyāvilāsāḥ| āsphālasphāraghaṇṭābahalakalakalavyākulāhīndradārāḥ herambasyāṅgahārapracaladavanayaḥ pāntu vo nṛttalīlāḥ|| 47
kumbhopāntātpatadbhirmadajalanivahairlabdhasekātirekā pronmīladbālacandrākṛtidaśanamiṣādaṅkuraṃ dhārayantī| ālolatkarṇatālapracalamadhukarā śīkarāsārapuṣpā vistīrṇā hastavallī diśatu gaṇapateḥ prārthyamānaṃ phalaṃ vaḥ|| 48
te dūroddaṇḍaśuṇḍākuharakabalitotkṣiptasaptābdhilabdhasvecchāsekapramodaprabhavanavaravadrāvitāśāgajendrāḥ| devasyākāṇḍakaṇḍūkarakaraṭataṭāṭopasaṃghaṭṭabhagnakṣoṇībhṛttuṅgaśṛṅgāḥ puramathanaśiśoḥ pāntu vo durvilāsāḥ|| 49 viśveśvarasyaite
vighneśo vaḥ sa pāyādvihṛtiṣu jaladhīnpuṣkarāgreṇa pītvā yasminnuddhṛtya toyaṃ vamati bahutaraṃ dṛśyate vyomni devaiḥ| kvāpyambhaḥ kvāpi viṣṇuḥ kvacana kamalabhūḥ kvāpyanantaḥ kvacicchrīḥ kvāpyaurvaḥ kvāpi śailāḥ kvacana maṇigaṇāḥ kvāpi nakrādisattvāḥ|| 50
candrakalā
diśyāddhūrjaṭijūṭakoṭisariti jyotsnālavodbhāsinī cāndrī vaḥ kalikā jalabhramivaśādākṛṣṭanaṣṭā mudam| yāṃ cañcacchapharībhrameṇa mukulīkurvanphaṇālīṃ muhuḥ muhyallakṣamahirjighṛkṣatitamāmākuñcanaproñcanaiḥ|| 51
dehapraviṣṭādrisutāmukhendudvitīyakhaṇḍārghamivāgato yaḥ| avāptukāmaḥ paripūrṇabhāvaṃ sa pātu vaḥ śambhujaṭārdhacandraḥ|| 52 bilhaṇasya
gaṅgā
muktābhā nṛkapālaśuktiṣu jaṭāvallīṣu mallīnibhā vahnau lājanibhā dṛśo maṇinibhā bhogotkare bhoginām| nṛttāvartavivartaneritapayaḥsaṃmūrchanoccāritāḥ khelanto haramūrdhni pāntu bhavato gaṅgāpayobindavaḥ|| 53 kṛṣṇamiśrasya
jaṅghālasphūrjadūrjasvalakarimakaraprauḍhasaṃmardakhelatkallolotphullabindustabakatilakitavyomakukṣimbharīṇi| vārīṇi svargasindhostripuraharajaṭājūṭarathyādhvanīnānyuccairuccaṇḍajāgratkalikaluṣamaṣīśoṣamutpoṣayantu|| 54 vedavyāsasya
caṇḍikābhṛṅgiriṭī
devī sūnumasūta nṛtyata gaṇāḥ kiṃ tiṣṭhatetyudbhuje harṣādbhṛṅgiriṭāvavāñcitagirā cāmuṇḍayāliṅgite| avyādvo hatadevadundubhighanadhvānātiriktastayoḥ anyonyapracalāsthipañjarajaratkaṅkālajanmā ravaḥ|| 55
sūryaḥ
sindūraspṛhayā spṛśanti kariṇāṃ kumbhasthamādhoraṇāḥ bhillī pallavaśaṅkayā vicinute sāndraṃ drumadroṇiṣu| kāntāḥ kuṅkumavāṅkṣayā karatale mṛdnanti lagnaṃ ca yat tattejaḥ prathamodbhavaṃ bhramakaraṃ sauraṃ ciraṃ pātu vaḥ|| 56 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
ekasminnayane bhṛśaṃ tapati yaḥ kāle sa dāhakramaḥ yenātanyata yatprakāśasamaye naiśaṃ padaṃ durlabham| savyomāvayavasya yasya viditā loke prakāśasthitiḥ śrīsūryaḥ kṣaṇasevito 'pi hi mahādevaḥ sa vastrāyatām|| 57 harasūryayoḥ śleṣaḥ| kasyāpi
khaṃ ye 'tyujjvalayanti lūnatamaso ye cānakhodbhāsinaḥ ye puṣṇanti saroruhaśriyamadhikṣiptābjabhāsaśca ye| ye mūrdhasvavabhāsinaḥ kṣitibhṛtāṃ ye cāmarāṇāṃ śirāṃsi ākrāmantyubhaye 'pi te dinapateḥ pādāḥ śriyai santu naḥ|| 58 ānandavardhanasya
avatu vaḥ savitusturagāvalī sphurati madhyagatāruṇanāyakā| samabhilambhitatuṅgapayodharā marakataikalateva nabhaḥśriyaḥ|| 59 kasyāpi
pṛthvī
bhāgīrathīhāralata akālindīkabarībharā| sameruśekharā pṛthvī pātu naḥ sāgarāmbarā|| 60 rājaśekharasya
viṣṇorāśiṣaḥ
hṛdayaṃ kaustubhodbhāsi hareḥ puṣṇātu vaḥ śriyam| rādhāpraveśarodhāya dattamudramiva śriyā|| 61 kumudasya
pratyagronmeṣajihmā kṣaṇamanabhimukhī ratnadīpaprabhāṇāṃ ātmavyāpāragurvī janitajalalavā jambhaṇaiḥ sāṅgabhaṅgaiḥ| nāgāṅkaṃ moktumicchoḥ śayanamuruphaṇācakravālāpadhānaṃ nidrācchedātitāmrā ciramavatu harerdṛṣṭirākekarā vsa|| 62 viśākhadevasya
pāthodheḥ parimathyamānasalilādardhotthitāyāḥ śriyaḥ sānandollasitabhruvā kuṭilayā dṛṣṭyaiva pītānanaḥ| ajñātasvakaradvayīvigalitavyalaolamanthoragaḥ śūnye bahaugatāgatāni racayannārāyaṇaḥ pātu vaḥ|| 63
bhaktiprahvavilokanapraṇayinī nilotpalaspardhinī dhyānālambanatāṃ samādhiniratairnīte hitaprāptaye| lāvaṇyasya mahānidhī rasikatāṃ lakṣmīdṛśostanvatī yuṣmākaṃ kurutāṃ bhavārtiśamanaṃ netre tanurvā hareḥ|| 64 vacanaśleṣaḥ| bhāgavatāmṛtadattasya
vatse mā gā viṣādaṃ śvasanamurujavaṃ saṃtyajordhvapravṛttaṃ kampaḥ ko vā guruste bhavatu balabhidā jṛmbhitenātra yāhi| pratyākhyānaṃ surāṇāmiti bhayaśamanacchadmanā kārayitvā yasmai lakṣmīmadādvaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ manthamūḍhāṃ payodhiḥ|| 65 kasyāpi
matsyaḥ
ādimatsyasya jayatādyaḥ śvāsollāsitairjalaiḥ| vidadhe gagane 'mbhodhiṃ gaganaṃ ca mahodadhau|| 66 kṣemendrasya
kūrmaḥ
yanniḥśvāsasamīrameduratayā dūraṃ samullāsitā dhatte śeṣabhujaṅgabhogakalitā bhūrātapatraśriyam| stotre yasya caturmukhī śrutikaveḥ kuṇṭhatvamabhyasyati krīḍākūrmatanurjaganti sa vibhuḥ pāyādapāyāddhariḥ|| 67
medhībhūya mahābdhimanthanavidhau pṛṣṭhe nije bhrāmyataḥ mā bhūnmandaraparvatasya ca paribhraṃśaḥ samudrasya ca| ityaṅgaiḥ saha saṃjahāra kila yaḥ śvāsānsa vo rakṣatāt svecchāvartitakacchapāyitatanustrailokyarakṣyo hariḥ|| 68 kayorapyetau
pṛṣṭhabhrāmyadamandamandaragirigrāvāgrakaṇḍūyanāt nidrāloḥ kamaṭhākṛterbhagavataḥ śvāsānilāḥ pāntu vaḥ| yatsaṃskārakalānuvartanavaśādvelācchalenāmbhasā yātāyātamatandritaṃ jalanidhernādyāpi viśrāmyati|| 69 hanūmataḥ
varāhaḥ
harerlīlāvarāhasya daṃṣṭrādaṇḍaḥ sa pātu vaḥ| hemādrikalaśā yatra dhātrī chataraśriyaṃ dadhau|| 70 vādīśvarakāñcanasya
muktairyāsyati kutracidvasumatī daṃṣṭrāṅkurastheyasī kukṣau kṣobhamavāpsyati tribhuvanaṃ ruddhairamībhiḥ kila| ityasvalpavikalpamīlitamateḥ kaṇṭhe luṭhanto jvalatkolākāradharasya kaiṭabhajitaḥ śvāsormayaḥ pāntu vaḥ|| 71
bibhrāṇo 'bhinavendukoṭikuṭilaṃ daṃṣṭrāṅkuraṃ līlayā kroḍākāradharo hariḥ sa bhavatāṃ bhūyādvibhūtipradaḥ| yasyotkṣiptavataḥ kṣamākamalinīmālambamānaḥ kṣaṇaṃ loladbālamṛṇālatantutulanāṃ bheje bhujaṅgeśvaraḥ|| 72
pātu trīṇi jaganti santatamakūpārātsamabhyuddharan dhātrīṃ kolakalevaraḥ sa bhagavānyasyaikadaṃṣṭrāṅkure| kūrmaḥ kandati nālati dvirasanaḥ patranti digdantinaḥ meruḥ kośati medinī jalajati vyomāpi lolambati|| 73 hanūmataḥ
līne śrotraikadeśe nabhasi nayanayostejasi kvāpi yāti śvāsagrāsopabhukte maruti jalanidhau pādarandhrārdhapīte| potraprāntaikaromāntaravivaragatāṃ mārgataḥ śārṅgapāṇeḥ| kroḍākārasya pṛthvīmavikalavibhavaṃ vaibhavaṃ vaḥ punātu|| 74 varāhamihirasya
nṛsiṃhaḥ
candrārdhāyitariṣvayānadaśano vyomāyitāntarmukhaḥ bālārkāyitalocanaḥ suradhanurlīlāyitabhrūlataḥ| antarnādanirodhapīvaragalanyakkāpaniryattaḍittārasphārasaṭāvaruddhagaganaḥ pāyānnṛsiṃho jagat| |75 hanūmataḥ
kiṃ kiṃ siṃhastataḥ kiṃ narasadṛśavapurdeva citraṃ grahītaḥ naivādyāpi pracaṇḍo drutamupanayatāyaṃ nanu prāpta eva| cāpaṃ cāpaṃ nakhāgraṃ tvaritamahahahā karkaśatvaṃ nakhānāṃ ityevaṃ daityarājaṃ nijanakhakuliśairjaghnivānyaḥ sa vo 'vyāt|| 76
caṭiccaṭiti carmaṇi cchamiti coccalacchoṇite dhagiddhagiti medasi sphuṭarave 'sthini ṣṭhāditi| punātu bhavato hareramaravairināthorasi kvaṇatkarajapañjarakrakacakopajanmā ravaḥ|| 77 vākpatināthasyaitau
kvedaṃ garjitameṣa kiṃ nu dalati stambho nṛsiṃhastataḥ so 'trādhāvati ko 'tra bho dhanurasī huṃheti daityeśvaram| jalpantaṃ nijagarjitena balavatstambhānnirīyāvadhīt ekasminkṣaṇa eva hā naraharistrātā sa evāstu vaḥ|| 78 sūktisahasrāt
sandhyārañjitaśītadīdhitikalāsaundaryabhājo nakhāḥ prītiṃ pīvarayantu kaiṭabharipoḥ krīḍānṛsiṃhasya vaḥ| daityorasthalapīṭhakuṇṭhitatayā dīnena dambholinā sāsūyaṃ sakutūhalaṃ savinayaṃ sāścaryamālokitāḥ|| 79 bālasarasvatyāḥ
pūryante jalarāśayo vasumatī majjatyadho lupyate pātālaṃ śatadhā gataṃ nipatati brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ divaḥ| nikṣiptena suradviṣo 'sya vapuṣā matveti manye vahat utsaṅgena hataṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ siṃho hariḥ pātu vaḥ|| 80 kasyāpi
vāmanaḥ
aparasara pṛthivi samudrāḥ saṃvṛṇutāmbūni bhūdharā namata| vāmanaharilaghutunde jagatāṃ kalahaḥ sa vaḥ pāyāt|| 81 kasyāpi
ākṛṣṭaḥ śikhayā nakhairvilikhitaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ kapolasthale maulau dāmabhirāhataḥ pratidiśaṃ krāmansalīlaṃ pathi| itthaṃ vāravilāsinīkṛtaparīhāsasya daityādhvare viṣṇorvāmanaveṣavibhramabhṛto hāsormayaḥ pāntu vaḥ|| 82
kastvaṃ brahmannapūrvastvadanucarajano nāstyanātho 'hamekaḥ kiṃ dadyāmīpsitaṃ te tripadaviharaṇasthānametatkiyatte| trailokyaṃ taddvijātermama śamaniratasyeti saṃmūḍhabhāvāḥ viṣṇorvācaḥ surārau kṛtakapaṭapadanyāsamugdhāḥ punantu|| 83 etau hanūmataḥ|
trivikramaḥ
haripādaḥ sa vaḥ pāyāllambhito yaḥ svayambhuvā| yasyāsannaraverāsītsvedarekheva jāhnavī|| 84 rājaśekharasya
kiṃ chatraṃ kiṃ nu ratnaṃ tilakamuta tathā kuṇḍalaṃ kaustubho vā cakraṃ kiṃ vārijaṃ vetyamarayuvatibhiryadbalidveṣidehe| ūrdhvaṃ maulau lalāṭe śravasi hṛdi kare nābhideśe ca dṛṣṭaṃ pāyāttadvo 'rkabimbaṃ sa ca danujaripurvardhamānaḥ krameṇa|| 85 hanūmataḥ
brahmāṇḍacchatradaṇḍaḥ śatadhṛtibhavanāmbhoruho nāladaṇḍaḥ kṣoṇīnaukūpadaṇḍaḥ kṣaradamarasaritpaṭṭikāketudaṇḍaḥ| jyotiścakrākṣadaṇḍastribhuvanabhavanastambhadaṇḍo 'ṅghridaṇḍaḥ śreyastraivikramaste vitaratu vibudhadveṣiṇāṃ kāladaṇḍaḥ|| 86 daṇḍinaḥ
candrārkau yāvadaṅghryudbhavadamarasarittoyatāmyattrilokīkedāre devalakṣmīupnarudayavidhau bījabhāvaṃ bhajantyaḥ| vitrasyadbhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥkramaṇakutukino niṣpatantyaḥ samantāddīyāsurdānavārero maṅgalaṃ vaḥ|| 87 devabodheḥ
paraśurāmaḥ
līlonmūlitamaulimastacaraṇaṃ mūrdhasvapi kṣmābhṛtāṃ āskandhādapabāhuśākhamabhitaḥ kṛtvā sahasrārjunam| yaścakre bhuvane tameva vijayastambhaṃ kuṭhārāyudhaḥ dattaṃ vaḥ śivamāhavaikarasiko rāmaḥ sa rājāntakaḥ|| 88
dāśarathī rāmaḥ
kūrmo mūlavadālavālavadapāṃ nātho latāvaddiśaḥ meghāḥ pallavavatprasūnaphalavannakṣatrasūryādayaḥ| svāminvyomataruṃ mamākramavataḥ śrutveti gāṃ māruteḥ sītānveṣaṇamādiśandiśatu vo rāmaḥ salajjaḥ śriyam|| 89
kṛṣṇaḥ
gītīrvaiṇavamandragānamadhurāḥ sambhāvayannirbharasvedāmbusnapitaṃ vilopaya purato rādhāmukhāmbhoruham| utkampaskhaladaṅguliḥ parigaladveṇurnimīladhvaniḥ svidyatpāṇirapākarotu duritaṃ gopālaveṣo hariḥ|| 90 mādhavaśīlasya
rāmo nāma babhūva huṃ tadabalā sīteti huṃ tāṃ pituḥ vācā pañcavaṭīvane viharatastasyāharadrāvaṇaḥ| kṛṣṇeneti purātanīṃ nijakathāmākarṇya mātreritāṃ saumitre kva dhanurdhanurdhanuriti vyagrā giraḥ pāntu naḥ|| 91 vasundharasya
yāminyāṃ parivṛttibhāji carite cārāya vṛnde gavāṃ gopānāṃ ca viṣāṇaveṇutumuladhvāne samutsarpati| gāḍhāliṅgitarādhikābhujalatābaddhasya kaṃsadviṣaḥ yātuṃ sthātumanīśvarasya manaso ḍolāyitaṃ pātu vaḥ|| 92 madanasya
dṛṣṭyā keśava goparāgabhṛtayā kiṃcinna dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tenaiva skhalitāsmi nātha patitāṃ kiṃ nāma nālambase| ekastvaṃ viṣameṣu khinnamanasāṃ sarvābalānāṃ gatiḥ gopyaivaṃ gaditaḥ saleśamavatādgoṣṭhe harirvaściram|| 93
aparādhaṃ na śṛṇumo na cāsatyaṃ tvayoditam| gopyeti gaditaḥ kṛṣṇastūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhanpunātu vaḥ|| 94 kayorapyetau
buddhaḥ
dhyānavyājamupetya cintayasi kāmunmīlya cakṣuḥ kṣaṇaṃ paśyānaṅgaśarāturaṃ janamimaṃ trātāpi no rakṣasi| mithyākāruṇiko 'si nirghṛṇatarastvattaḥ kuto 'nyaḥ pumān itthaṃ māravadhūbhirityabhihito buddho hariḥ pātu vaḥ|| 95 śrīharṣasya
nemirjināśca
prājyaprabhāvaprabhavo dharmasyāstarajastamāḥ| muktātmānaḥ śivaṃ nemiranye 'pi dadatāṃ jināḥ|| 96 vacanaśleṣaḥ| dhanapālasya
lakṣmīḥ
pāyātpayodhiduhituḥ kapolāmalacandramāḥ| yatra saṃkrāntabimbena hariṇā hariṇāyitam|| 97 kasyāpi
yuktaṃ mānada māmananyamanasaṃ vakṣaḥsthalasthāyinīṃ bhaktāmapyavadhūya kartumadhunā kāntāsahasraṃ tava| ityuktvā phaṇabhṛtphaṇāmaṇigatāṃ svāmeva matvā tanuṃ nidrāchedakaraṃ hareravatu vo lakṣmyā vilakṣasmitam|| 98
pīnaśroṇi gabhīranābhinibhṛtaṃ bhūbhṛdbhṛśoccastanaṃ pāyādvaḥ parirabdhamabdhiduhituḥ kāntena kāntaṃ vapuḥ| svāvāsānupaghātanirvṛtamanāstatkālamīladdṛśe yasmai so 'cyutanābhipadmavasatirvedhāḥ śriyaṃ dhyāyati|| 99 keṣāmapyete
rukmiṇī
ślāghyāśeṣatanuṃ sudarśanakaraḥ sarvāṅgalilājitatrailokyāṃ caraṇāravindacalitenākrāntaloko hariḥ| bibhrāṇāṃ mukhamindusundararucaṃ candrārdhatulyālikaḥ sthāne yāṃ svatanorapaśyadadhikāṃ sā rukmiṇī vo 'vatāt|| 100 ānandavardhanasya
rādhā
rādhā punātu jagadacyutadattadṛṣṭirmanthānikāṃ vidadhatī dadhiriktapātre| tasyāḥ stanastabakacūcukaloladṛṣṭirdevo 'pi dohanadhiyā vṛṣabhaṃ nirundhan|| 101 līlāśukasya
devakī
avyātsvarlokacūḍāmaṇipaṭalaśikhāśreṇiśoṇīkṛtāṅghriḥ kṣoṇībhāraṃ vinetuṃ jaṭharajuṣi jagadbāndhave devakī vaḥ| rājñāmuddāmadoṣṇāṃ raṇaśirasi raṇatkīkasacchedabhīmāḥ sastrāṇāṃ khaṇṇakārāḥ pratihatiguravo yacchruterdohado 'bhūt|| 101 kayorapyetau
śaṅkhaḥ
gṛhītakhaṇḍaḥ śaśiśekhareṇa prāptaḥ śaśīvodarapūraṇāya| bhujena lakṣmīmukhacandrabhāsāṃ sa pātu vaḥ śrīpatipāñcajanyaḥ|| 102
hariharau
sphaṭikamarakataśrīhāriṇoḥ prītiyogāt tadavatu vapurekaṃ kāmakaṃsadviṣorvaḥ| bhavati girisutāyāḥ sārdhamabdherduhitrā sadṛśamahasi kaṇṭhe yatra sīmāvivādaḥ|| 103 kaviratnasya
yena dhvastamanobhavena balijitkāyaḥ purā strīkṛtaḥ yaścodvṛttabhujaṅgahāravalayo gaṅgāṃ ca yo 'dhārayat| yasyāhuḥ śaśimacchiro hara iti stutyaṃ ca nāmāmarāḥ pāyātsa svayamandhakakṣayakarastvāṃ sarvado mādhavaḥ|| 104 candrakasya
brahmāśiṣaḥ
jātaste 'dharakhaṇḍanātparibhavaḥ kāpālikādamba yat tadbrahmādiṣu kathyatāmiti vaco bālyācchiśau jalpati| gaurīṃ pāṇiyugena ṣaṇmukhavaco roddhuṃ nirīkṣyākṣamāṃ vailakṣyāccaturānanasya vadanāvṛttiściraṃ pātu vaḥ|| 105
āgaskāriṇi kaiṭabhapramathane tattāḍanārthaṃ ruṣā nābhīpaṅkajamastratāṃ gamayituṃ jāte prayatne śriyaḥ| svāvāsonmathanopapāditabhayabhrāntātmanastatkṣaṇāt abrahmaṇyaparāḥ purātanamunervāgvṛttayaḥ pāntu vaḥ|| 106
sarasvatī
vacāṃsi vācaspatimatsareṇa sārāṇi labdhuṃ grahamaṇḍalīva| muktākṣasūtratvamupaiti yasyāḥ sā saprasādāstu sarasvatī vaḥ|| 107 bilhaṇasya
vāraṇaḥ
kumbhadvayaṃ tadamaradviradasya vo 'vyādudbhidyamānamudadhermathanāvasāne| prodyaddvitīyakamalākucaśaṅkinībhiḥ serṣyaṃ yadaikṣata surāsurasundarībhiḥ|| 108 bhaṭṭendurājasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāmāśīḥpaddhatiḥ samāptā
subhāṣitarasāsvādajātaromāñcakañcukāḥ| vināpi kāminīsaṅgaṃ kavayaḥ sukhamāsate|| 1 kasyāpi
klāntamapojjhati svedaṃ taptaṃ nirvāti budhyate mūḍham| sthiratāmeti ca saṃkulamupayuktasubhāṣitaṃ cetaḥ|| 2
kathamiha manuṣyajanmā sampraviśatu sadasi vibudhagaṇanāyām| yena na subhāṣitāmṛtamāhlādi nipītamā tṛpteḥ|| 3
tuṣṭirna rājño dhanasaṃcayena tṛptirna mīnasya mahājalena| tṛptirna sūreśca subhāṣitena tṛptirna dṛṣṭyoḥ priyadarśanena|| 4
puṃsāṃ tadeva bhūṣaṇamupakārakamavasare dhanaṃ mukhyam| sūktaṃ dadhati suvarṇaṃ kalyāṇamanarghamiha dhanyāḥ|| 5
nṛpasabhasarasī paritaḥ pūrṇāpi jaḍairna kāntimudvahati| mukhakamalāni na yasyāṃ sūktālikvaṇitamadhurāṇi|| 6 vallabhadevasyaite
kiṃ hāraiḥ kimu kaṅkaṇaiḥ kimasamaiḥ karṇāvataṃsairalaṃ keyūrairmaṇikuṇḍalairalamalaṃ sāḍambarairambaraiḥ| puṃsāmekamakhaṇḍitaṃ punaridaṃ manyāmahe maṇḍanaṃ yanniṣpīḍitapārvaṇāmṛtakarasyandopamāḥ sūktayaḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
\Colo iti bhagadattajalhaṇaracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ subhāṣitapraśaṃsāpaddhatiḥ||
kaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ surāḥ svarge nivasāmo vayaṃ bhuvi| kiṃ vā kāvyarasaḥ svāduḥ kiṃ vā svādīyasī sudhā|| 1 kasyāpi
tebhyo namaḥ kavibhyo yeṣāṃ vimalāni padmāni| śrutimadhirohanti satāṃ kaṇṭhe 'pi guṇaiḥ padaṃ dadhati|| 2 vallabhadevasya
kavīnāṃ mānasaṃ naumi taranti pratibhāmbhasi| yatra haṃsavayāṃsīva bhavanāni caturdaśa|| 3 rājaśekharasya
laṅkāpateḥ saṃkucitaṃ yaśo yadyatkīrtipātraṃ raghurājaputraḥ| sa sarva evādikaveḥ prabhāvo na kopanīyāḥ kavayaḥ kṣitīndraiḥ|| 4
mahīpateḥ santi na yasya pārśve kavīśvarāstasya kuto yaśāṃsi| bhūpāḥ kiyanto na babhūvururvyāṃ nāmāpi jānāti na ko 'pi yeṣām|| 5 bilhaṇasyaitau
śramaṃ caṇḍābhyāse dadhati kavayaḥ kevalamamī narendrāṇāṃ vṛttaiḥ śucibhirupayogaḥ sa tu girām| asau voḍhuṃ kaṇṭhaḥ paramadhikṛtaḥ pakṣmaladṛśāṃ alaṃkāro hāraḥ kucakalaśayoreva bhavati|| 6 śrīmurāreḥ
śrutasampadaḥ kavīnāmuktibhireva prakāśatāṃ yānti| sindhorapārajalabharamudgārā eva kathayanti|| 7
vaktāra eva kavayaḥ sūktāni mahārghatāṃ nayantyanye| prabhavaḥ payodhirupacitirīśvarabhavaneṣu ratnānām|| 8
anavahitaḥ kimaśakto vibudhairabhyarthitaḥ kimatirasikaḥ| sarvaṃkaṣo 'pi kālastirayati sūktāni na kavīnām|| 9 vallabhadevasyaite
saṃspardhinaḥ pīnapayodharāṇāṃ jayanti te satkavayaḥ suvṛttāḥ| antarmukhatvena samullasanto haranti ye sarvajanasya cetaḥ|| 10
asau rasaucityaguṇojjvalo 'pi gumpho na kāvyavyapadeśayogyaḥ| dhatte khalasyāpi na durviṣahyadveṣagrahotsāraṇamantratāṃ yaḥ|| 11 bilhaṇasya
kartavyā cārthasāre 'pi kāvye śabdavicitratā| vinā ghaṇṭāṭaṇatkāraṃ gajo gacchanna śobhate|| 12 rājaśekharasya
aviditaguṇāpi sukaverbhaṇitiḥ karṇeṣu vamati madhudhārām| anadhigataparimalāpi hi harati dṛśaṃ mālatīmālā|| 13 subandhoḥ
padavihvalatā kvāpi spṛhaṇīyā bhavati sakavīndrāṇām| ghanajaghanastanamaṇḍalabhārālasakāminīnāṃ ca|| 14 madanasya
parituṣyanti mahāntaḥ kāvyaiḥ sukumāramadhurasuśliṣṭaiḥ| kapaṭabakoṭakavīkaṭabhaṭanaṭatulyodbhaṭairapare|| 15
kāvyaṃ cārvapi rasikaprītikaraṃ bhavati naikarasabaddham| suratamanāhitakalahaṃ hariṇadṛśo nābhinandayati|| 16
sukaviśramānabhijñe śrotari vacanāni viphalatāṃ yānti| bhartari mugdhe prauḍhapramadāratavilasitānīva|| 17
dattā tena kavibhyaḥ pṛthivī sarvaiva kanakasampūrṇā| anavadyasūktiracanāśramameṣāṃ yo vijānāti|| 18 vallabhadevasyaite
vipulahṛdayābhiyogye khidyati kāvye jaḍo na maurkhye sve| nindati kañcukameva prāyaḥ śuṣkastanī nārī|| 19 argaṭasya
vyākaraṇādadhigatamapi kavivadane śabdavṛndamanyādṛk| naṭaśikṣitamapi karaṇaṃ taruṇīkaraṇe tadanyadiva|| 20 mālatīmādhavasya
jugupsitamidaṃ dhātrā kṛtaṃ dvitayameva hi| khalopasargaḥ kāvyānāṃ padmānāṃ ca himāgamaḥ|| 21 sūktisahasrāt
kāvye bhāvyaṃ guṇaistatra durjanā dūṣayanti yat| na durgatagṛhe sandhirdīyate jātu dasyubhiḥ|| 22 rājaśekharasya
jaḍeṣu jātapratibhābhimānāḥ khalāḥ kavīndroktiṣu ke varākāḥ| prāptāgninirvāpaṇagarbhamambu ratnāṅkurajyotiṣi kiṃ karoti|| 23 bilhaṇasya
priyāmukhaṃ kopakaṣāyitaṃ ca jalāvamṛṣṭaśca maṇipradīpaḥ| khalābhiyuktāpi kavīndravāṇī saundaryamevādhikamudvahanti|| 24 sihmalakaveḥ
santyeva sūktirasikā bahavo manuṣyāḥ svargaukaso navasudhārasanirvṛtāśca| tau durlabhau kavivacaḥskhalitasya soḍhā martyeṣu sāgaragarasya ca yaḥ sureṣu|| 25 utprekṣāvallabhasya
satkāvyapīyūṣasamudramadhye na vāḍavāgnirna ca kālakūṭaḥ| tasyāvagāhena tathāpi citraṃ khalasya tāpaḥ paramo 'bhyudeti|| 26 vatsarājasya
karṇāmṛtaṃ sūktirasaṃ vihāya doṣeṣu yatnaḥ sumahānkhalasya| avekṣate kelivanaṃ praviṣṭaḥ kramelakaḥ kaṇṭakijālameva|| 27
kuṇṭhatvamāyānti guṇāḥ kavīnāṃ sāhityavidyāśramavarjiteṣu| kuryādanārdreṣu kimaṅganānāṃ keśeṣu kṛṣṇāgurudhūpavāsaḥ|| 28 bilhaṇasyaitau
niravadyāni padyāni yadyanāryasya kā kṣatiḥ| bhikṣukakṣavinikṣiptaḥ kimikṣurnīraso bhavet|| 29 mālatīmādhavasya
kvacidvastu sphāraṃ katipayapadairarpitaguṇaṃ kvacitsaṃkṣipte 'rthe pracuravacanaireva racanā| yathāvācyaṃ śabdāḥ kvacidapi tulāyāmiva dhṛtāḥ tribhiḥ kalpairevaṃ kaviṣu khalu śabdārthaniyamaḥ|| 30 kasyāpi
yeṣāṃ komalakāvyakauśalakalā līlāvatī bhāratī teṣāṃ karkaśatarkavakravacanodgāreṇa kiṃ hīyate| yaiḥ kāntākucamaṇḍale kararuhāḥ sānandamāropitāḥ taiḥ kiṃ mattakarīndrakumbhaśikhare nāropaṇīyāḥ śarāḥ|| 31
api mudamupayānto vāgvilāsaiḥ svakīyais parabhaṇitiṣu toṣaṃ yānti santaḥ kiyantaḥ| nijarasamakarandasyandapūrṇālavālaḥ kalaśasalilasekaṃ nehate kiṃ rasālaḥ|| 32 jayadevasyaitau
śāṇotkīrṇamivojjvaladyuti padaṃ bandho 'rdhanārīśvaraślāghālaṅghanajāṅghiko divi latodbhinneva cārthodgamaḥ| kiṃcitkhaṇḍitacandramaṇḍalagalatpīyūṣahṛdyo rasastatkiṃcitkavikarmamarma na punarvākḍiṇḍimāḍambaraḥ|| 33 madanasya
yadetadvāgarthavyatikaramayaṃ kiṃcidamṛtaṃ pramodaprasyandaiḥ sahṛdayamanāṃsi snapayati| idaṃ kāvyaṃ śrāvyaṃ sphurati tu yadatrāṇu paramaṃ tadantarbuddhīnāṃ sphuṭamatha ca vācāmaviṣayaḥ|| 34
padavyaktivyaktīkṛtasahṛdayānandasaraṇau kavīnāṃ kāvye na sphurati budhamātrasya dhiṣaṇā| navavrīḍāveśavyasanapiśuno yaḥ kulavadhūkaṭākṣāṇāṃ panthāḥ sa khalu gaṇikāṇāmaviṣayaḥ|| 35 hariharasya
anudghuṣṭaḥ śabdairatha ghaṭanataśca sphuṭataraḥ padānāmarthātmā sukhayati na tūttānitarasaḥ| yathā kiṃcitkiṃcitpavanacalacīnāṃśukatayā kucābhogaḥ strīṇāṃ sukhayati na tūdghāṭitamuraḥ|| 36 dharmāśokasya
yā kevalaṃ sarasatā tadapaṇḍitatvaṃ vyutpattireva yadi nīrasatā tadā syāt| yogastayostu ghanasārakuraṅganābhimelāpavatparimalaṃ kamapi prasūte|| 37 vidyāpateḥ
vanajaladhimahībhṛtsiṃhamātaṅgapūrvaḥ bhavati puruṣabhīmaḥ prekṣito bhāvavargaḥ| nanu bhavati sa eva prītihetuḥ kuto 'pi śrutipathamupanītaḥ sūktibhiḥ satkavīnām|| 38 sūktisahasrāt
\Colo iti sāmānyakavikāvyapraśaṃsā
yasmādiyaṃ prathamataḥ paramāmṛtaughanirghoṣiṇī sarasasūktitaraṅgabhaṅgiḥ| gaṅgeva dhūrjaṭijaṭāñcalataḥ pravṛttā vṛttena vāktaṃ (?)ahamādikaviṃ prapadye|| 39 vāmananāgasya
vyāsādibhiḥ kavivarairavasādito 'pi śūnyatvamāpa kalayāpi na vākprapañcaḥ| ānandanirbharacakorasahasrapītaṃ cāndraṃ mahaḥ kṣayamupaiti na mātrayāpi|| 40 bhaṭṭasomeśvarasya
carcābhiścāraṇānāṃ kṣitiramaṇa parāṃ prāpya saṃmodalīlāṃ mā kīrteḥ sauvidallānavagaṇaya kavivrātavāṇīvilāsān| gītaṃ khyātaṃ na nāmnā kimapi raghupateradya yāvatprasādāt vālmīkereva dhātrīṃ dhavalayati yaśomudrayā rāmabhadraḥ|| 41
tamṛṣiṃ manuṣyalokapraveśaviśrāmaśākhinaṃ vācām| suralokādavatāraprāntarasvedacchidaṃ vande|| 42 etau śrīmurāreḥ
bhāsvadvaṃśavataṃsakīrtiramaṇīraṅgaprasaṅgasvanadvāditraprathamadhvanirvijayate valmīkajanmā kaviḥ| pītvā yadvadanendumaṇḍalagalatkāvyāmṛtābdheḥ kimapyākalpaṃ kavinūtanāmbudamayī kādambinī varṣati|| 43 jayadevasya
yadānandendoramṛtapravāhinī viniḥsṛtā pañcamavedacandrikā| tamaśca tāpaṃ ca nihanti dehināṃ nanu śrutīnāṃ vyasitā sa naikaśaḥ|| 44 sūktisahasrāt
svasti pāṇinaye tasmai yasya rudraprasādataḥ| ādau vyākaraṇaṃ kāvyamanu jāmbavatījayaḥ|| 45
yathārthatā kathaṃ nāma na syādvararuceriha| vyadhatta kaṇṭhābharaṇaṃ yaḥ sadārohaṇapriyaḥ|| 46 rājaśekharasyaitau
sūtradhārakṛtārambhairnāṭakairbahubhūmikaiḥ| sapatākairyaśo lebhe bhāso devakulairiva|| 47 bāṇabhaṭṭasya
bhasanāṭakacakre 'pi cchekaiḥ kṣipte parīkṣitum| svapnavāsavadattasya dāhako 'bhūnna pāvakaḥ|| 48
tau śūdrikakathākārau ramyau rāmilasomilau| kāvyaṃ yayordvayorāsīdardhanārīśvaropamam|| 49
samyagbāṇadvitīyena namadākāradhāriṇā| dhanuṣeva guṇāḍhyena niḥśeṣo rañjito janaḥ|| 50 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
manye bṛhatkathāmbhodherbindumādāya nirmitā| tenetarakathākanthā na vibhānti tadagrataḥ|| 51 dhanapālasya
hutā śikhini gauṇāḍhyā stokaśeṣāpi sā kathā| suralīḍhendulekheva loke pūjyatamābhavat|| 52
jagatyāṃ grathitā gāthāḥ śātvāhanabhūbhujā| vyadhurdhṛte 'stu vistāramaho citraparamparā|| 53 rājaśekharasyaitau
kavīnāmagaladdarpo nūnaṃ vāsavadattayā| śaktyeva pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ gatayā karṇagocaram|| 54 bāṇasya
śrotretarāṇi bhuvane karaṇānyasaṃkhyaiḥ catvāri tṛptimahatāṃ viṣayairlabhante| śrotrāya pakvasukṛtasya janasya puṇyāḥ śrīkālidāsagira eva diśanti tṛptim|| 55
antaraṃ kiyadākhyānti santo raghukirātayoḥ| antaraṃ tāvadākhyānti santo raghukirātayoḥ|| 56
śūraḥ śāstravidherjñātā sāhasāṅkaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ| sevyaṃ sakalalokasya vidadhe gandhamādanam|| 57 kasyāpi
kṛtsnaprabodhakṛdvāṇī bhā raveriva bhāraveḥ| māgheneva ca māghena kampaḥ kasya na jāyate|| 58
māghena vighnitotsāhā na sahante padakramam| smaranti bhāravereva kavayaḥ kapayo yathā|| 59
eko 'pi jīyate hanta kālidāso na kenacit| śṛṅgāre lalitodgāre kālidāsatrayī kimu|| 60 rājaśekharasyaite
vakroktyā bhartṛmeṇṭhasya vahantyā sṛṇirūpatām| āviddhā iva dhūnvanti mūrdhānaṃ kavikuñjarāḥ|| 61 dhanapālasya
kīrtiḥ pravarasenasya prayātā kumodojjvalā| sāgarasya paraṃ pāraṃ kapiseneva setunā|| 62 bāṇasya
dṛṣṭvā vākpatirājasya śaktiṃ gauḍhavadoddhurām| buddhiḥ śvāsoparuddheva vācaṃ na pratipadyate|| 63 dhanapālasya
avantiḥ kāvyamānarca bharcormaukhariśekharaḥ (?)| śiṣyo bāṇaśca saṃkrāntakāntavedyavacāḥ kaviḥ|| 64
saharṣacaritā śaśvaddhṛtakādambarīsyadā| bāṇasya vāṇyanāryeva svacchandā carati kṣitau|| 65 rājaśekharasyaitau
kevalo 'pi sphuranbāṇaḥ karoti vimadānkavīn| kiṃ punaḥ kḷptasandhānaḥ pulindakṛtasannidhiḥ|| 66 dhanapalasya
bāṇena hṛdi lagnena yanmando 'pi padakramaḥ| prāyaḥ kavikuraṅgāṇāṃ cāpalaṃ tatra kāraṇam|| 67
darpaṃ kavibhujaṅgānāṃ gatā śravaṇagocaram| viṣavidyeva māyūrī māyūrī vāṅnikṛntati|| 68
sarasvatīpavitrāṇāṃ jātistantraṃ na dehinām| vyāsaspardhī kulālo 'bhūdyaddhroṇo bhārate kaviḥ|| 69
aho prabhāvo vāgdevyā yaccaṇḍāladivākaraḥ| śrīharṣasyābhavatsabhyaḥ samo bāṇamayūrayoḥ|| 70
kartuṃ trilocanādanyo na pārthavijayaṃ kṣamaḥ| tadarthaḥ śakyate draṣṭuṃ locanadvayibhiḥ katham|| 71
atho gaṇapatiṃ vande mahāmodavidhāyinam| vidyādharagaṇairyasya pūjyate kaṇṭhagarjitam|| 72
pradyumnānnāparasyeha nāṭake paṭavo giraḥ| pradyumnānnāparasyeha pauṣpā api śarāḥ kharāḥ|| 73
trayo 'gnayastrayo devāstrayo vedāstrayo guṇāḥ| trayo daṇḍiprabandhāśca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ|| 74 rājaśekharasyaitau
jāte jagati vālmīkau śabdaḥ kaviriti sthitaḥ| vyāse jāte kavī ceti kavayaśceti daṇḍini|| 75 kālidāsasya
jānakīharaṇaṃ kartuṃ raghuvaṃśe sthite sati| kaviḥ kumāradāsaśca rāvaṇaśca yadi kṣamaḥ|| 76
mā sma santi hi catvāraḥ prāyo ratnākarā ime| itīva sa kṛto dhātrā kavī ratnākaro 'paraḥ|| 77
dhvaninātigabhīreṇa kāvyatattvaniveśinā| ānandavardhanaḥ kasya nāsīdānandavardhanaḥ|| 78 rājaśekharasyaite
ratnāvalīpūrvakamanyadāstāmāsīmabhogasya vacomayasya| payodharasyeva himādrijāyāḥ paraṃ vibhūṣā bhavabhūtireva|| 79
vākyaṃ ca dvipadīśatānyatha mahākāvyāni sapta kramāt tryakṣaprayahanirmitastutikathālakṣāṇi caikādaśa| sūtvā nāṭakanāṭikāprakaraṇaprāyānprabandhānbahūn viśrāmyatyadhunāpi nātiśayitā vāṇī śivaśvāminaḥ|| 80 kayorapyetau
kālañjarapatiścakre bhīmaṭaḥ pañcanāṭakīm| prāpa prabandharājatvaṃ teṣu svapnadaśānanam|| 81
māyūrājasamo jajñe nānyaḥ kalacuriḥ kaviḥ| udanvataḥ samuttasthuḥ kati vā tuhināṃśavaḥ|| 82
akālajaladendoḥ sā hṛdyā vadanacandrikā| nityaṃ kavicakorairyā pīyate na ca hīyate|| 83
akālajaladaślokaiścitramātmakṛtairiva| jātaḥ kādambarīrāmo nāṭake pravaraḥ kaviḥ|| 84
anuprāsini saṃdarbhe gonandanasamaḥ kutaḥ| yathārthanāmataivāsya yadvā vadati cārutām|| 85
dūrādapi satāṃ citte likhitvāścaryamañjarīm| kulaśekharavarmāḍhyāṃ cakārāścaryamañjarīm|| 86
dviḥsaṃdhāne nipuṇatāṃ sa tāṃ cakre dhanaṃjayaḥ| yayā jātaṃ phalaṃ tasya satāṃ cakre dhanaṃ jayaḥ|| 87
nadīnāṃ mekhalasutā nṛpāṇāṃ raṇavigrahaḥ| kavīnāṃ ca surānandaścedimaṇḍalamaṇḍanam|| 88
yāyāvarakulaśreṇermuktāyaṣṭeśca maṇḍanam| suvarṇabandharucirastaralastaralo yathā||| 89
sthitā mādhvīkapākatvānnisargamadhurāpi hi| kimapi svadate vāṇī keṣāṃcidyadi śāṅkarī|| 90
śabdārthayoḥ samo gumphaḥ pāñcālī rītirucyate| śīlābhaṭṭārikāvāci bāṇoktiṣu ca sā yadi|| 91
ke vaikaṭanitambena girāṃ gumphena rañjitāḥ| nindanti nijakāntānāṃ na maugdhyamadhuraṃ vacaḥ|| 92
sarasvatīva karnāṭī vijayāṅkā jayatyasau| yā vaidarbhagirāṃ vāsaḥ kālidāsādanantaram|| 93
sūktīnāṃ smarakelīnāṃ kalānāṃ ca vilāsabhūḥ| prabhurdevī kavirlāṭīgatāpi hṛdi tiṣṭhati|| 94
pārthasya manasi sthānaṃ lebhe laghu subhadrayā| kavīnāṃ ca vacovṛtticāturyeṇa subhadrayā|| 95 rājaśekharasyaite
nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ vijjākāṃ tāmajānatā| vṛthaiva daṇḍināpyuktaṃ sarvaśuklā sarasvatī|| 96
kaviramaraḥ kaviracalaḥ kavirabhinandaśca kālidāsaśca| anye kavayaḥ kapayaścāpalamātraṃ padaṃ dadhati|| 97
yadyogaḥ paravigrahe nija iva svecchāpraveśāvadhiḥ yaddhyānaṃ vyapanidracinmayarasajyotiḥprabodhāvadhi| yadvāgbandhaghanodayo rasanadīkallolalīlāvadhiḥ tasyāsminyadi devabodhiyaminaḥ ko vā guṇasyāvadhiḥ|| 98
pātuṃ śrotrarasāyanaṃ racayituṃ vācaḥ satāṃ saṃmatāḥ vyutpattiṃ paramāmavāptumavadhiṃ labdhuṃ rasasrotasi| bhoktuṃ svādu phalaṃ ca jīvitataroryadyasti te kautukaṃ tadbhrātaḥ śṛṇu rājaśekharakaveḥ sūktīḥ sudhāsyandinīḥ|| 99 śrīśaṃkaravarmaṇaḥ
bhavabhūtimanādṛtya nirvāṇamatinā mayā| murāreḥ padacintāyāmidamādhīyate manaḥ|| 100 kasyacit
amarukakavitvaḍamarukanādena vinihnutā na saṃcarati| śṛṅgārabhaṇitiranyā dhanyānāṃ śravaṇavivareṣu|| 101 arjunadevasya
vapuryāmāvāsaḥ kucaparivṛtaścedinṛpatiḥ (?) paribhrāntā ratnākaraparidhireṣā vasumatī| na muktvā rāmāṇāṃ padamiha śiro 'nyasya namitaṃ kavīndrai rājendrairlalitamiyatī bilhaṇakathā|| 102
vāsaḥ śubhramṛturvasantasamayaḥ puṣpaṃ śaranmallikā dhānuṣkaḥ kusumāyudhaḥ parimalaḥ kāstūriko 'straṃ dhanuḥ| vācastarkarasojjvalāḥ priyatamā śyāmā vapurnūtanaṃ mārgaḥ saugata eva pañcamalayā gītiḥ kavirbilhaṇaḥ|| 103
sāhitye sukumāravastuni dṛḍhanyāyagrahagranthile tarke vā mayi sannidhātari samaṃ līlāyate bhāratī| śayyā vāstu mṛdūttaracchadavatī darbhāṅkurairāstṛtā bhūmirvā hṛdayaṃgamo yadi patistulyā ratiḥ subhruvaḥ|| 104 somakaveḥ
kiṃ vīṇakvaṇitena kiṃ madhukarījhaṃkāritenāpi kiṃ kandarpāyudhaśiñjitena taruṇīhuṃkāritenāpi kim| śrīmaccitapasatkaveryadi vaco herambakumbhasthalīmuktāmbhaḥ subhagaṃ sudhāsahacaraṃ karṇodaraṃ gāhate|| 105
bindudvandvataraṅgitāgrasaraṇiḥ kartā śirobindukaṃ karmeti kramaśikṣitānvayakathā ye ke 'pi tebhyo namaḥ| ye tu granthasahasraśāṇakaṣaṇatruṭyatkalaṅkairgirāṃ ullekhaiḥ kavayanti ralhaṇakavisteṣveva sannahyate|| 106
prakṛtyaivātivakreṇa guṇadairghyaṃ vitanvatā| mayā śarāsaneneva bāṇo dūraṃ nirasyate|| 107
kecidgarvagalagraheṇa viṣamadveṣajvareṇāpare kecinmaurkhyamalena santatamamī mīlanti śāntottarāḥ| tadbho mandirabhittayo bhavata naḥ sūkteṣu sabhyāḥ punaḥ tatpāṭhe varamasti vo ghamughamuprāyaṃ kimapyuttaram|| 108 loṣṭasarvajñasyaitau
navyā na vyākaraṇasaraṇiryasya mādhuryadhuryaṃ no saundaryaṃ navanavarasasrotaso na pravāhaḥ| yādṛkprītyā kathayati girāṃ devatā deva tādṛk kāvyaṃ śrāvyaṃ kavayati bhiṣagbhānunāmā sa eṣaḥ|| 109
itthaṃ kavikuṭumbasya vacāṃsi vicinoti yaḥ| aniddhavacanasyāpi tasya vaśyā sarasvatī|| 110
bhāso rāmilasomilau vararuciḥ śrīsāhasāṅkaḥ kaviḥ meṇṭho bhāravikālidāsataralāḥ skandaḥ subandhuśca yaḥ| daṇḍī bāṇadivākarau gaṇapatiḥ kāntaśca ratnākaraḥ siddhā yasya sarasvatī yadi bhavetke tasya sarve 'pi te|| 111
yasyāścauraścikuranikaraḥ karṇapūro mayūraḥ hāso bhāsaḥ kavikulaguruḥ kālidā vilāsaḥ| harṣo harṣo hṛdayavasatiḥ pañcabāṇastu bāṇaḥ keṣāṃ naiṣā kaviṣu kavitākāminī kautukāya|| 112 jayadevasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ viśeṣakavipraśaṃsā
drāghīyasā dhārṣṭyaguṇena yuktāḥ kairapyapūrvaiḥ parakāvyakhaṇḍaiḥ| āḍambaraṃ ye vacasāṃ vahanti te ke 'pi kanthākavayo jayanti|| 1 kṣemendrasya
dhiktvāṃ re kalikāla yāhi vilayaṃ keyaṃ viparyastatā hā kaṣṭaṃ śrutiśālināṃ vyavahṛtirmlecchocitā dṛśyate| ekairvāṅmayadevatā bhagavatī vikretumānīyate niḥśaṅkairaparaiḥ parīkṣaṇavidhau sarvāṅgamudghāṭyate|| 2 ralhaṇasya
śiśirayati vastravasatī kaścitsukumārapadasudhāsyandaiḥ| takṣṇotīva tathānyo 'bhīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇākṣarakṣāraiḥ|| 3 vallabhadevasya
kāvyaṃ karoṣi kimu te suhṛdo na santi ye tvāmudīrṇapavanaṃ vinivārayanti| gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ piba nivātagṛhaṃ praviśya vātādhikā hi puruṣāḥ kavayo bhavanti|| 4 kasyāpi
gāhante kavicakravartipadavīmeke budhāḥ pañcaṣaiḥ ślokaireva mahāśrameṇa ghaṭitairyattallaghīyaḥ padam| tādṛgvā manaso varodhakalayā dhyāyanti cedīśvaraṃ tatteṣāṃ kara eva kiṃ na vilasantyaṣṭau mahāsiddhayaḥ|| 5 hariharasya
vyāsādīnkavipuṅgavānanucitākṣepaṃ salīlaṃ hasan uccairjalpa nimīlya locanayugaṃ ślokānsagarvaṃ paṭha| kāvyaṃ svīkuru yatparairviracitaṃ spardhasva sārdhaṃ budhaiḥ yadyabhyarthayase śrutena rahitaḥ pāṇḍityamāptuṃ balāt|| 6 kasyāpi
grīvāstambhabhṛtaḥ paronnatikathāmātre śiraḥśūlinaḥ sodvegabhramaṇapralāpavipulakṣobhābhibhūtākṛteḥ| antardveṣaviṣapraveśaviṣamakrodhoṣṇaniḥśvāsinaḥ kaṣṭā nūnamapaṇḍitasya vikṛtirbhīmajvarārambhabhūḥ|| 7
ye saṃsatsu vivādinaḥ parayaśaḥśalyena śūlākulāḥ kurvanti svaguṇastavena guṇināṃ yatnādguṇācchādanam| teṣāṃ roṣakaṣāyitodaradṛśāṃ kopoṣṇaniḥśvāsināṃ dīptā ratnaśikheva kṛṣṇaphaṇināṃ vidyā janodvejinī|| 8 kṣemendrasyaitau
svādhīno rasanāñcalaḥ paricitāḥ śabdāḥ kiyantaḥ kvacit kṣoṇīndro na niyāmakaḥ pariṣadaḥ śāntāḥ svatantraṃ jagat| tadyūyaṃ kavayo vayaṃ vayamiti prastāvanāhaṃkṛtisvacchandaṃ pratisadma garjata vayaṃ maunavratālambinaḥ|| 9 umāpatidharasya
uktaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca bhartsanaṃ tiryagīkṣaṇam| kvacidyathārthakathanaṃ vyākhyātantrasya ṣaḍvidhāḥ|| 10
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ kukavinindā||
candanaṃ candrikācakraṃ vipañcī campakasrajaḥ| pañcamaḥ pañcamaśceti pañcabhyo 'jani sajjanaḥ|| 1
nūnaṃ dugdhābdhimadhyotthāvimau sajjanadurjanau| kiṃ tvindoḥ sodaraḥ pūrvaḥ kālakūṭasya cetaraḥ|| 2 rājaśekharasyaitau
gotrasthitiṃ na muñcanti sadā sannatimāśritāḥ| udanvantaśca santaśca mahāsattvatayānayā|| 3
añjalisthāni puṣpāṇi vāsayanti karadvayam| prāyaḥ sumanasāṃ vṛttirvāmadakṣiṇayoḥ samā|| 4 kayorapyetau
sthityatikrāntibhīrūṇi svacchānyākulitānyapi| toyāni toyarāśīnāṃ manāṃsi ca manasvinām|| 5 bhāraveḥ
jaḍātmāpi bhavatyuccairāśrayanmahatāṃ padam| gaṅgaughaḥ śambhumūrdhānamāpa viṣṇupadāśrayāt|| prahlādanasya
na mukhenodgiratyūrdhvaṃ hṛdayānna nayatyadhaḥ| jarayatyantare sādhurdoṣaṃ viṣamiveśvaraḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
mahātmāno 'nugṛhṇanti bhajamānānripūnapi| sapatnīḥ prāpayantyabdhiṃ sindhavo naganimnagāḥ|| 8 māghasya
apakurvannapi prāyaḥ prāpnoti mahataḥ phalam| aurvaṃ dahantamevāgniṃ santarpayati sāgaraḥ|| 9
sūcīdaṇḍa ivāsau kupitaḥ sujano mukhe paraṃ tīkṣṇaḥ| chidrapidhānaikaparaḥ praguṇaḥ paścātparaṃ bhavati|| 10
anukurutaḥ khalasujanāvagrimapāścātyabhāgayoḥ sūcyāḥ| ekaḥ kurute chidraṃ guṇavānanyaśca pidadhāti|| 11 gobhaṭasyaitau
sujano na yāti vikṛtiṃ parahitanirato vināśakāle 'pi| chede 'pi candanataruḥ surabhayati mukhaṃ kuṭhārasya|| 12
aṇvapi guṇāya mahatāṃ mahadapi doṣāya doṣiṇāṃ sukṛtam| tṛṇamapi dugdhāya gavāṃ dugdhamapi viṣāya sarpāṇām|| 13 raviguptasyaitau
saiva paraṃ na vinaśyati tanurapi yā śrīrniveśitā satsu| avaśiṣyate himāṃśoḥ saiva kalā śirasi yā śambhoḥ|| 14
nivasannapi samamitarairabhijātaḥ śikṣate na durvacanam| dhvāṃkṣavirāvī na pikaḥ sthitavānapi balibhujāṃ bhavane|| 15
jagadupakṛtiṣu satāṃ ratiritarajano vibhavamātrasaṃtuṣṭaḥ| bhramati bhuvanāni bhāsvāndhanapatiradhivasati kailāsam|| 16
tarumūlānyanu nihitaṃ jalamāvirbhavati pallavāgreṣu| nibhṛtaṃ yadupakriyate tadapi mahānto vahantyuccaiḥ|| 17 vallabhadevasyaite
yadamī daśanti daśanā rasanā tatsvāduphalamavāpnoti| prakṛtiriyaṃ dhavalānāṃ kliśyanti yadanyakāryeṣu|| 18 naimeyasya
yadvañcanāhitamatirbahu cāṭugarbhaṃ kāryonmukhaḥ khalajanaḥ kṛtakaṃ bravīti| tatsādhavo na na vidanti vidanti kiṃ tu kartuṃ vṛthā praṇayamasya na pārayanti|| 19 ārogyasya
dānonnatā śrīḥ śrutamapramādaṃ śaktirdayārdrā vinayī prabhāvaḥ| nirvyājavaidagdhyanidhiḥ satāṃ dhīḥ paropakārābharaṇasvabhāvā|| 20 kṣemendrasya
te sādhavo bhuvanamaṇḍalamaulibhūtā ye sādhutāmanupakāriṣu darśayanti| ātmaprayojanavaśīkṛtakhinnadehaḥ pūrvopakāriṣu khalo 'pi hi sānukampaḥ|| 21 ratnākarasya
hṛṣyanti cārucaritaiḥ sujanasya santaḥ kṣudratvamāśu piśunādapi saṃtyajanti| ratnaṃ na kevalamalaṃkaraṇāya loke krūragrahādiśamakaṃ ca bhavetprabhāvaiḥ|| 22 trilocanasya
vipadi dhairyamathābhyudaye kṣamā sadasi vākpaṭutā yudhi vikramaḥ| yaśasi cābhiratirvyasanaṃ śrutau prakṛtisiddhamidaṃ hi mahātmanām|| 213 bhartṛmeṇṭhasya
na ca bhavati viyogaḥ snehavicchedaheturjagati guṇanidhīnāṃ sajjanānāṃ kadācit| ghanapaṭalaniruddho dūrasaṃstho 'pi candraḥ kimu kumudavanānāṃ premabhaṅgaṃ karoti|| 24
kathamapi hi bhavantikṣetrasadbījayogājjagadupakṛtihetornātmavṛttyau phalanti| dadhati phalasamṛddhyā dūramānamrabhāvaṃ nanu jagatisuśūkāḥ sādhavaḥ śālayaśca|| 25 maṅgalārjunasya
vyapagatajaḍimānaḥ kṣiptadoṣābhiṣaṅgāḥ parigalitakalaṅkā vakrabhāvā na jātu| samudayamapi mitreṇaiva sārdhaṃ dadhānāḥ tuhinakiraṇabimbādanya ete mahāntaḥ|| 26
antaḥ kopakaṣāyite 'pi hṛdaye sādhorasacceṣṭitaiḥ bhadrāṇyeva bahiḥ kriyāsu vacanānyāvirbhavantyarthataḥ| madhye 'tyantakarālavāḍavaśikhāśoṣe 'pi vārāṃnidheḥ kallolāḥ prakaṭībhavanti satataṃ muktāphalodgāriṇaḥ|| 27 kayorapyetau
abhedenopāste kumudamudare vā sthitavataḥ vipakṣādambhojādupagatavato vā madhulihaḥ| aparyāptaḥ ko 'pi svaparaparicaryāparicayaprabandhaḥ sādhūnāmayamanabhisandhānarasikaḥ|| 28 śrīmurāreḥ
majjanto 'pi vipatpayodhigahane niḥsaṅgavīravratāḥ kurvantyeva paropakārakaraṇaṃ santo yathāśaktitaḥ| rāhorugrakarālavaktrakuharagrāsābhibhūto 'pyalaṃ candraḥ kiṃ na janaṃ karoti sukhinaṃ grastāvaśeṣaiḥ karaiḥ|| 29
ye dīneṣu dayālavaḥ spṛśati yānalpo 'pi na śrīmadaḥ vyagrā ye ca paropakārakaraṇe hṛṣyanti ye yācitāḥ| svasthāḥ santi ca yauvanodayamahāvyādheḥ prakope 'pi ye taiḥ stambhairiva susthiraiḥ kalibharakrāntā dharā dhāryate|| 30
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ sujanapaddhatiḥ
brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalīmātraṃ kiṃ lobhāya manasvinaḥ| śapharīsphuritairnābdheḥ kṣudhatā jātu jāyate|| 1
kusumastabakasyeva dvayī vṛttirmanasvinaḥ| mūrdhni vā sarvalokasya viśīryeta vane 'thavā|| 2 bhartṛhareretau
brūta nūtanakūśmāṇḍaphalānāṃ ke bhavantyamī| aṅgulīdarśanādyena na jīvanti manasvinaḥ|| 3 kasyāpi
atyantavimukhe daive vyarthayatyeva pauruṣam| manasvino daridrasyavanādanyatkutaḥ sukham|| 4
puṃsāmunnatacittānāṃ sukhāvahamidaṃ dvayam| sarvasaṅganivṛttirvā vibhūtirvā suvistṛtā|| 5 bhagavato vyāsasyaitau
nālpīyasi nibadhnanti padamunnatacetasaḥ| yeṣāṃ bhuvanalābhe 'pi niḥsīmāno manorathāḥ|| 6 kasyāpi
grasamānamivaujāṃsi sabhāyāṃ gauraveritam| nāma yasyābhinandanti dviṣo 'pi sa pumānpumān|| 7 kasyāpi
abhimānavato manasvinaḥ priyamuccaiḥpadamārurukṣataḥ| vinipātanivartanakṣamaṃ matamālambanamātmapauruṣam|| 8
abhimānadhanasya gatvarairasubhiḥ sthāsnu yaśaścikīṣataḥ| acirāṃśuvilāsacañcalā nanu lakṣmīḥ phalamānuṣaṅgikam|| 9 bhāraveretau
kvacitkanthādhārī kvacidapi ca divyāmbaradharaḥ kvacidbhūmau śete kvacidapi ca paryaṅkaśayanaḥ| kvacicchākāhāraḥ kvacidapi ca mṛṣṭāśanaruciḥ manasvī kālajño gaṇayati na duḥkhaṃ na ca sukham|| 10 kasyāpi
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ manasvipaddhatiḥ
yathā yathaiva snehena bhūyiṣṭhamupacaryate| dhatte tathā tathā tāpamaho vaiśvānaraḥ khalaḥ|| 1 kasyāpi
apavādādabhītasya samasya guṇadoṣayoḥ| asadvṛtteraho vṛttaṃ durvibhāvyaṃ vidheriva|| 2 bhāraveḥ
nauśca durjanajihvā ca pratikūlavisarpiṇī| parapratāraṇāyaiva nirmitā kena dāruṇā|| 3 risukasya
chidravṛndāvṛte 'pyantaḥśūnye 'pi khalacetasi| citrameko 'pi mātsaryaṃ na guṇāvayavo 'pi hi|| 4 bhaṭṭagovindarājasya
bibheti durjanāllokaḥ saujanye 'pi kṣaṇaṃ sthitāt| kaḥ saunikasya pratyeti krīṇato dogdhumapyajām|| 5
nīcaḥ samutthito 'vaśyamanavāpya parāśrayam| chidraṃ na ratimāpnoti dṛṣṭānto 'tra kaṭībhavaḥ|| 6
svabhāvakaṭhinasyāsya kṛtrimāṃ bibhrato natim| guṇo 'pi parahiṃsāyai cāpasya ca khalasya ca|| 7 keṣāmapyete
apakāramasamprāpya tuṣyetsādhurasādhutaḥ| eṣa lābho bhujaṅgena veṣṭito yanna daśyate|| 8 bhagavadvyāsamuneḥ
savarṣāśanirākāśaḥ sasajjanakhalā mahī| guṇā doṣāśca vidyante hanta bho mahatāmapi|| 9 sūktisahasrāt
vandito 'pyeṣa doṣāya tadvaraṃ ninditaḥ khalaḥ| stuto 'pyahirdaśatyeva na dṛḍhaṃ pīḍitānanaḥ|| 10
apūrvaḥ ko 'pi kopāgniḥ sajjanasya khalasya ca| ekasya śāmyati snehādvardhate 'nyasya vāritaḥ|| 11 gobhaṭasya
vairasyaikanidheḥ krūrasattvasya ca jaḍātmanaḥ| payo 'pyapeyaṃ bhavati kṣārāmbhodheḥ khalasya ca|| 12 kasyāpi
paścādanyatpuraścānyatpunaruktabhayādiva| parāpavādavidvāṃso vadantyavikalāḥ khalāḥ|| 13 punaruktapadasya
pīḍanaṃ bahudhānyasya vidhātuṃ labdhajanmanām| khalānāmucitaṃ grāmādbahireva niveśanam|| 14
ye vardhayanti pāpardhikautukaṃ pṛthivīpateḥ| viśeṣaḥ katarasteṣāṃ piśunānāṃ śunāmiva|| 15 śrutadhararāmasyaitau
khalaḥ satkriyamāṇo 'pi dadhāti kalahaṃ satām| dugdhadhauto 'pi kiṃ yāti vāyassaḥ kalahaṃsatām|| 16
snehena bhūtidānena kṛtasvaccho 'pi durjanaḥ| darpaṇaścāntike tiṣṭhankarotyekamapi dvidhā|| 17
darpaṇasya khalu durjanasya ca brūta hanta sujanāḥ kimantaram| yāvadeva purato vasejjanastāvadeva hṛdaye 'sya vartate|| 18 keṣāmapyete
anyasmāllabdhoṣmā kṣudraḥ prāyeṇa duḥsaho bhavati| ravirapi tapati na tādṛgyādṛksantaptasikataughaḥ|| 19
durvacanamanabhijātāḥ svajanaṃ pratyutsṛjantyupetyāpi| aśvatarāstīrthāmbhasi dūrādāgatya mehanti|| 20 vallabhadevasyaitau
apyātmano vināśaṃ gaṇayati na khalaḥ paravyasanahṛṣṭaḥ| prāyaḥ sahasranāśe samaramukhe nṛtyati kabandhaḥ|| 21
svaguṇāniva paradoṣānvaktuṃ na sato 'pi śaknuvanti budhāḥ| svaguṇāniva paradoṣānasato 'pi khalāstu kathayanti|| 22 raviguptasyaitau
ujjvalaguṇamapyuditaṃ kṣudro draṣṭuṃ na kathamapi kṣamate| hitvā tanumapi śalabhaḥ śubhraṃ dīpārcirapaharati|| 23 vallabhadevasya
ṛjureṣa pakṣavāniti kāṇḍe prītiṃ khale ca mā kārṣīḥ| prāyeṇa tyaktaguṇaḥ phalena hṛdayaṃ vidārayati|| 24
ete snigdhāmā iti mā mā kṣudreṣu yāta viśvāsam| siddhārthānāmeṣāṃ sneho 'pyaśrūṇi pātayati|| 25 sacigobhaṭasyaitau
vidhvastaparaguṇānāṃ bhavati khalānāmatīva malinatvam| antaritaśaśirucāmapi salilamucāṃ malinimābhyadhikaḥ|| 26
viṣadharato 'pyativiṣamaḥ khala iti na mṛṣā vadanti vidvāṃsaḥ| yadayaṃ nakuladveṣī sa kuladveṣī punaḥ piśunaḥ|| 27
hasta iva bhūtimalino laṅghayati yathā yathā khalaḥ sujanam| darpaṇamiva taṃ kurute tathā tathā nirmalacchāyam|| 28 subandhorete
śirasi nihito 'pi nityaṃ yatnādapi sevito bahusnehaiḥ| taruṇīkaca iva nīcaḥ kauṭilyaṃ naiva vijahāti|| 29
vikasitavadanaḥ piśunaḥ protphullavilocano yadā bhramati| manye tadāsya jātaḥ sadahitakaraṇaśramaḥ saphalaḥ|| 30
ahameva guruḥ sudāruṇānāmiti hālāhala mā sma tāta dṛpyaḥ| nanu santi bhavādṛśāni bhūyo bhuvane 'sminvacanāni durjanānām|| 31 keṣāmapyete
samarpitāstena na kasya doṣā haṭhādguṇā vā na hṛtāḥ khalena| tathāpi doṣairna viyujyate 'sau santo 'pi naikena guṇena citram|| 32 vardhamānasya
te tāvatkṛtinaḥ parārthaghaṭakāḥ svārthānparityajya ye sāmānyāstu parārthamudyamabhṛtaḥ svārthāvirodhena ye| te 'mī mānuṣarākṣasāḥ parahitaṃ svārthāya nighnanti ye ye tu ghnanti nirarthakaṃ parahitaṃ te ke na jānīmahe|| 33 kasyāpi
jāḍyaṃ hrīmati gaṇyate dhṛtarucau dambhaḥ śucau kaitavaṃ śūre nirghṛṇatā munau vimatitā dainyaṃ priyālāpini| tejasvinyavaliptatā mukharatā vaktaryaśaktiḥ sthire tatko nāma guṇo bhavetsa viduṣāṃ yo durjanairnāṅkitaḥ|| 34
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ durjanapaddhatiḥ||
asambhogena sāmānyaṃ kṛpaṇasya dhanaṃ paraiḥ| asyedamiti sambandho hānau duḥkhena gamyate|| 1 vyāsasya
vīṇeva śrotrahīnasya lolākṣīva vicakṣuṣaḥ| vyasoḥ kusumamāleva śrīḥ kadaryasya niṣphalā|| 2
yatkarotyaruciṃ kleśaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ mohaṃ prajāgaram| na taddhanaṃ kadaryāṇāṃ hṛdayavyādhireva saḥ|| 3
uktaṃ parasyāmiṣatāmanuktaṃ yātyadṛśyatām| hṛdaye śalyatāṃ dhatte nidhane dhanināṃ dhanam|| 4
vyarthaṃ śrutamaśīlasya balaṃ kāpuruṣasya ca| vyutthānaṃ mandabhāgyasya dhanaṃ kṛpaṇajīvinaḥ|| 5
yadarjyate parakleśairarjitaṃ yanna bhujyate| vibhajyate yadante 'nyaiḥ kasyacinmāstu taddhanam|| kṣemendrasyaite
gṛhamadhyanikhātena dhanena ramate yadi| sa tu tenānusāreṇa ramate kiṃ na meruṇā|| 7
kṛpaṇena śaveneva mṛtenāpi na dīyate| māṃsaṃ vardhayatā tena kākasyopakṛtiḥ kṛtā|| 8
prāyeṇa dhanināmeva dhane tṛṣṇā garīyasi| paśya koṭidvayopetaṃ lakṣāya pravaṇaṃ dhanuḥ|| 9 keṣāmapyete
mṛtyuḥ śarīragoptāraṃ dhanarakṣaṃ vasundharā| duścāriṇīva hasati svapatiṃ putravatsalam|| 10
sādhunā dīnamanasā prārthito vibhave sati| dadāti yadi no tasmai pṛṣṭasyāsya kimuttaram|| 11 vyāsasyaitau
śaraṇaṃ kiṃ prapannāni viṣavanmārayanti kim| na tyajyante na bhujyante kṛpaṇena dhanāni yat|| 12 risukasya
dṛḍhataranibaddhamuṣṭeḥ kośaniṣaṇṇasya sahajamalinasya| kṛpaṇasya kṛpāṇasya ca kevalamākarato bhedaḥ|| 13 sūcigobhaṭasya
dhanamarthināmabhogyaṃ cirasaṃcayadūṣitaṃ kadaryāṇām| srotojalamiva ruciraṃ satatāgamanirgamaṃ mahatām|| 14
n paraṃ dhanāni dārāstanurapyanyopakaraṇatāṃ yāti| kṛpaṇasya nandanarapatiratrārthe spaṣṭadṛṣṭāntaḥ|| 15
nandanarendradraviṇairduṣkṛtamiva kimapi vihitamatighoram| vasudhātaloṣmapāko viramati nādyāpi yattebhyaḥ|| 16
[cā]iaṇakaraparaṃparaparivattaṇakheyavasaṇaparisantā| atthā kivaṇagharatthā satthāvatthā suvanti viya|| 17
abhyupayuktāḥ sadbhirgatāgatairaharahaḥ prakhindānāḥ| kṛpaṇajanasannikarṣaṃ prāpyārthāḥ prasvapantīva|| 18 vallabhadevasyaite
prāptānapi na labhante bhogānbhoktuṃ svakarmabhiḥ kṛpaṇāḥ| drākṣāprapākasamaye mukhapāko bhavati kākānām|| 19 raviguptasya
nidrācchedasakhedabāndhavajanaḥ sodvegavaidyojjhitaḥ pakvakvāthakadarthitaḥ parijanaistandrībhayātkṣobhitaḥ| bhagnasvāsthyamanorathaḥ priyatamāvaṣṭabdhapādadvayaḥ paryante kṛpaṇaḥ karoti vivaśaḥ kiṃ śalyatulyairdhanaiḥ|| 20 kṣemendrasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ kṛpaṇapaddhatiḥ
utpādya yatsvayamapi prabalānurāgabhājastathānusarato 'pi divākarasya| chāyā prasarpati sudūramanena manye kḷptaṃ tayā sadṛśameva kulīnatāyāḥ|| 1 śrībhojadevasya
devo harirvahatu vakṣasi kaustubhaṃ tamanyaiva kācana punardyumaṇeḥ pratiṣṭhā| yatpādasaṃgatitaraṅgitasaurabhāṇi dhatte sa eva śirasā sarasīruhāṇi|| 2 śrīrājapitāmahamahādevasya
tucchasyāpi sameṣyato 'sya tamaso dṛṣṭvāpi tejasvitāṃ unmucya tyajasi svamaṇḍalamaho yaḥ so 'pi bhāsāṃ patiḥ| śūraḥ śūra iti svatantravacasā lokeṣu yatkīrtyate khyātistatra garīyasī na balavadrūpaṃ punarvāstavam|| 3 śrībhojadevasya
yatpādāḥ śirasā na kena vidhṛtāḥ pṛthvībhṛtāṃ madhyataḥ tasminbhāsvati rāhuṇā kavalite lokatrayīcakṣuṣi| khadyotaiḥ sphuritaṃ tamobhiruditaṃ tārābhirujjṛmbhitaṃ ghūkairutthitamāḥ kimatra karavai kiṃ kena no ceṣṭitam|| 4 śrīmuñjasya
pātaḥ pūṣṇo bhavati mahato nopatāpāya yasmāt kāle prāpte ka iha na yayuryānti yāsyanti cāstam| etāvattu vyathayatitarāṃ lokabāhyaistamobhiḥ tasminneva prakṛtimahati vyomni labdho 'vakāśaḥ|| 5
gate tasminbhānau tribhuvanasamunmeṣavirahavyathāṃ candro neṣyatyanucitamato nāsti kimapi| idaṃ cetastāpaṃ janayatitarāmatra yadamī pradīpāḥ saṃjātāstimirahatibaddhoddhuraśikhāḥ|| 6 bhaṭṭabhallaṭasyaitau
āgatyaiva kutaścideva gaganābhogaṃ ca kṛtvātmasāt bhāvābhāvavilokanāspadamabhūnnītvendumukhyānapi| jājvalyaṃ jagato vidhāya kimapi prāptaḥ priyo 'hnāṃ patiḥ yātvastaṃ praviśatyathābdhimathavā merau paribhrāmyatu|| 7 śrīkalyāṇasya
nyāyyaṃ yattamasaḥ samūladalanaṃ bhāsvattayā tanyate naitaccāru paraṃ sajātisakalajyotīṃṣi muṣṇāsi yat| yuktaṃ vākhilalokamūrdhapadavīmādātumicchoryataḥ kiṃ tejaḥ kimu pūrṇatā kimudayastulye pare jīvati|| 8 vidyeśānasya
na tejastejasvī prasṛtamapareṣāṃ viṣahate sa tasya svo bhāvaḥ prakṛtiniyatatvādakṛtakaḥ| mayūkhairaśrāntastapati yadi devo dinakaraḥ kimāgneyo grāvā nikṛta iva tejo vikirati|| 9 bhavabhūteḥ
sāmyaṃ nimnonnatānāmabhavadapahatā netranirvāṇasampat mārgāloke na lokaḥ prabhavati vidadhe dhvāntamekātapatram| kālenāśeṣam=evāprakṛtimiti dinādhīśvarasyopakārāt asya dvīpāntare 'pi prasabhasarabhasaṃ kiṃ tu tejastadeva|| 10 vastupālasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ ravipaddhatiḥ
ālokavantaḥ santyeva bhūyāṃso bhāskarādayaḥ| kalāvāneva tu grāvadrāvakarmaṇi karmaṭhaḥ|| 1 prahlādanasya
daivādyadyapi tulyo 'bhūdbhūteśasya parigrahaḥ| tathāpi kiṃ kapālāni tulāṃ yānti kalānidheḥ|| 2 mālatīmādhavasya
rājaśabdaṃ sa evaikaḥ kāmamindurniṣevatām| kalaṅkakalpamapyeṇamāśritaṃ na jahāti yaḥ|| 3 kasyāpi
pīyūṣaṃ vapuṣo 'sya heturudayo viśvasya netrotsavaḥ pluṣṭaṃ bhānukarairayaṃ tribhuvanaṃ jyotsnājalaiḥ siñcati| sarvāśāpratirodhakāndhatamasadhvaṃsāya baddhodyamaḥ dhigdhātāramihāpi lakṣma likhituṃ yasya pravṛttaṃ manaḥ|| 4 kasyāpi
yadyapi śiro 'dhirohati raudraḥ krodhena siṃhikātanayaḥ| tadapi na śaraṇaṃ yātam=sāgarasūnurmṛgaṃ tyajati|| 6 madanasya
virama timira sāhasādamuṣmādyadi ravirastamitaḥ svatastataḥ kim| kalayasi na puro mahāmahormidyutinidhirabhyudayatyayaṃ śaśāṅkaḥ|| 6 ballālasenasya
ekaiva sāmṛtamayī sutarāmanarghyā kāpyastyasau himakarasya kalā yayaiva| āropito guṇavidā parameśvareṇa cūḍāmaṇau na gaṇito 'sya kalaṅkadoṣaḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
ratnākaro janayitā sahajaśca vargaḥ kiṃ kathyatāmamṛtakaustubhapārijātāḥ| kiṃ tairacintyamiha tatpunaranyadeva tattvāntaraṃ kumudabandhurasau yadinduḥ|| 8 śrīmurāreḥ
nānāvidhaṃ vidadhato 'pi jagadvidhātuḥ ekaṃ cirātkimapi saccaritaṃ babhūva| mitrodayadviṣi vikāsini tadvipattau doṣākare śaśini yannihitaḥ kalaṅkaḥ|| 9 kasyāpi
kimatrerno putraḥ kimu na haracūḍāmaṇirasau na kiṃ hanti dhvāntaṃ jagadupari kiṃ vā na vasati| yadetasyāntaḥ sā vilasati laghurlakṣmakaṇikā vidhāturdoṣo 'yaṃ na tu guṇanidhestasya kimapi|| 10 vallabhasya
āśāḥ pūrayati śriyaṃ vitarati trailokyatāpaṃ harati avyājāmṛtasecanaṃ vidadhati prītiṃ parāṃ tanvati| etena prasabhaṃ ciraṃ jalamucā kālena dūrīkṛte pūrṇe rājani jātamulbaṇatamastomāvaśeṣaṃ jagat|| 11 hariharasya
khedaṃ ye janayanti ye vidadhati kṣipraṃ jagannīrasaṃ ye rūkṣāḥ sthitibhedinaḥ sumanasāṃ tigmadyuteraṃśavaḥ| kṛtvā tānapi nirbharāmṛtamucastāpaṃ tvayā chindatā viśvasyāsya sudhāmayūkha mahatāmātmā dhuri sthāpitaḥ|| 12 śrībhojasya
pramlāniṃ dadhate diśaḥ parimalākṛṣṭāliguñjāravaiḥ krandante kumudāni somadṛṣadaḥ svedaṃ tyajantyākulāḥ| eko 'yaṃ hariṇastuṣārakiraṇa tvadgrāsakāle punaḥ svarbhānūtkaṭadantapīḍanabhavaṃ dhatte na citte bhayam|| 13 kasyāpi
uccaiḥsthānakṛtodayairbahuvidhairjyotirbhirudyatprabhaiḥ śukrādyaiḥ kimamībhiratra vitatāṃ prauḍhiṃ dadhānairapi| yāvallokatamopahena bhavatā lakṣmīrna vistāryate tāvaccandra kathaṃ prayāti paramāmṛddhiṃ sa ratnākaraḥ|| 14 trilocanasya
candrārkau
kaḥ paśyati kharamahasaḥ saṃmukhamapi tejasāṃ sahasrasya| kalitaṃ śaśabhṛddhāmno yo maṇḍalakhaṇḍanaṃ sahate|| 15 śrīvallabhadevasya
raviravikalaślāghāpātraṃ kimatra vicāryate sakalajagataḥ sattāmujjīvayanti yadaṃśavaḥ| punariatarathā tāpaḥ pāpaḥ sa kena vilupyatāṃ ayamapi sudhāraśmistasminna saṃrabhate yadi|| 16 prahlādanasya
\Colo iti candrapaddhatiḥ
varataruvighaṭanapaṭavaḥ kaṭavaścañcanti vāyavo bahavaḥ| tatkusumavahalaparimalaguṇavinyāse kṛtī tvekaḥ|| 1 vaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
paramo marutsakhāgnestejovṛddhiṃ tanoti saṃjvalataḥ| dīpaṃ harati tadasya jñātaṃ pratipannanirvahaṇam|| 2 kasyāpi
alipaṭalairanuyātāṃ sahṛdayahṛdayajvaraṃ vilumpantīm| mṛgapadaparimalalaharīṃ samīra pāmareṣu re kirasi|| 3 mālatīmādhavasya
svārthānapekṣaṃ janatāpaśāntyai nityoditāḥ santi payomuco 'mī| vivarṣiṇastānavagṛhṇate ye santyeva te ke 'pi mahānubhāvāḥ|| 4 kasyāpi
ye jātyā laghavaḥ sadaiva gaṇanāṃ prāptā na ye kutracit padbhyāmeva vimarditāḥ pratidinaṃ bhūmau vilīnāściram| utkṣiptāścapalāśayena marutā paśyāntarikṣe sakhe tuṅgānāmupari sthitiṃ kṣitibhṛtāṃ kurvantyamī pāṃsavaḥ|| bhallaṭasya
ko 'yaṃ bhrāntiprakārastava pavana padaṃ lokapādāhatīnāṃ tejasvivrātasevye nabhasi nayasi yatpuāṃsupūraṃ pratiṣṭhām| tasminnutthāpyamāne jananayanapadavyāpadaḥ santu tāvat kenopāyena sahyā vapuṣi malinatetyeṣa doṣastavaiva|| 6 amṛtadattasya
śākhābhiḥ parito diśaḥ kalayatācchrīsaṃvibhāgotsavaṃ tāṃ rolaṃbakuṭumbake prathayatātpānthātitheyīmasau| itthaṃ pānthamanorathaprathimabhiḥ sārdhaṃ pravṛddhe mudā hā durvāta kimātatāna tadidaṃ bāle rasāle bhavān|| 7 prahlādanasya
\Colo iti vāyupaddhatiḥ
cātakaḥ svāsyamānena jalaṃ prārthayate 'mbudam| sa tūdāratayā nityaṃ plāvayatyambunā mahīm|| 1
nabhasi niravalambe sīdatā dīrghakālaṃ tvadabhimukhaniṣaṇṇottānacañcūpuṭena| jaladhara jaladhārā dūratastāvadāstāṃ dhvanirapi madhuraste na śrutaścātakena|| 2 kayorapyetau
ekasya tasya manye dhanyāmabhyunnatiṃ jaladharasya| viśvaṃ saśailakānanamānanamālokate yasya|| 3 prahlādanasya
haladaḥ samudrasevāmācarati samagrabhuvanabharaṇāya| kurute tāmapi hatamatirātmambharitaniśamaurvāgniḥ|| 4 vallabhadevasya
samprati na kalpataravo na siddhayo nāpi devatā varadāḥ| jalada tvayi viśrāmyati sṛṣṭiriyaṃ bhuvanakośasya|| vastupālasya
jaladhara jalabharanikaraiḥ parihara paritāpamuddhuraṃ jagataḥ| no cedapasara dūraṃ himakarakaradarśanaṃ vitara|| 6 candrakaveḥ
ayi jalada yadi na dāsyasi katicittvaṃ cātakāya jalakaṇikāḥ| tadayamacireṇa bhavitā salilāñjalidānayogyaste|| 7 kasyāpi
yadbhūbhṛtāṃ laghutarairapi baddhamūlamāsāitāni sahasaiva tṛṇaiḥ śirāṃsi| ambhomucaḥ pracuravarṣaviśṛṅkhalasya tacceṣṭitaṃ duravadhāragaterjalasya|| 8 bhāgavatajayavardhanasya
etadatra pathikaikajīvitaṃ paśya śuṣyatitarāṃ mahatsaraḥ| re mudhāmbudhara ruddhasadgatirvardhitā kimiti ghaṭṭavāhinī|| 9 prakāśavarṣasya
sa kṣāro jaladhiḥ sarāṃsi vitarantyabhyāgatebhyo mitaṃ gṛhyante saritaḥ śrameṇa parito 'pyādhāya bandhaṃ balāt| prāpyaṃ kūpakataḥ kathaṃcana kimapyāropya kaṇṭhe padaṃ tattvāṃ tyāginamekameva bhagavanparjanya manyāmahe|| 10 prahlādanasya
hṛdyā nadyaḥ kamalasarasī rājahaṃsāvataṃsā puṇyaṃ sroto himagiribhuvastvatkṛte yena muktāḥ| samprāpte 'smiñjalada dahanoccaṇḍadāhe nidāghe parjanya svīkuru tamadhunā cātakaṃ pātakaṃ vā|| 11 dīpakasya
aye helāvelākulitakulaśaile jalanidhau kuto vārāmoghaṃ bata jalada moghaṃ vitarasi| samantāduttālajvaladanalakīlākabalanaklamopetānetānupacara payobhirviṭapinaḥ|| 12 kasyāpi
amuṃ kālakṣepaṃ tyaja jalada gambhīramadhuraiḥ kimebhirnirghoṣaiḥ sṛja jhagiti jhūtkāri salilam| aye paśyāvasthāmakaruṇa samīravyatikarajvaladdāvajvālāvalijaṭilamūrterviṭapinaḥ|| 13 acalasya
sadyaḥ kṣiptaṃ vrajati salilaṃ yatra muktāmayatvaṃ khyātaḥ so 'yaṃ jagati jaladhirvallabhastāmraparṇyāḥ| śuktivyājādvivṛtavadane 'pyatra vītādarastvaṃ kaṣṭaṃ svātījalada khadirāraṇyasekākulo 'si|| 14 bhallaṭasya
\Colo iti meghapaddhatiḥ
tadetadvāci mādhuryaṃ jāne kokila kṛtrimam| yaiḥ poṣito 'si tāneva jātapakṣo jahāsi yat|| 1 śrībhojadevasya
cūte samīpavartini madhukarakulakalitamañjarīnivahe| kokila vṛtimārūḍhaṃ mūḍhaṃ tvāṃ manyate lokaḥ|| 2 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
śrutvā karṇajvaradaṃ karaṭakadambasya karkaśaṃ virutam| susvaravaidagdhīmapi kokilapoto visasmāra|| 3 śrībhīmasiṃhapaṇḍitasya
malinātmanā virāgaḥ prakaṭīkṛta eva kokilakhalena| jīvanadānāmunnatisamaye vācaṃyamībhavatā|| 4
kvacijjhillīnādaḥ kvacidapi ca kālolakalahaḥ kvacitkākārāvaḥ kvacidapi kapīnāṃ kalakalaḥ| kvacidghoraḥ perudhvanirayamaho daivaghaṭanāt kathaṃkāraṃ tāraṃ kvaṇati cakitaḥ kokilayuvā|| 5 kayorapyetau
akekī kiṃ kekī vacasi caturaḥ kiṃ na kuraraḥ śukaḥ kiṃ vā mūkaḥ sa ca kalaravaḥ kiṃ kṣataravaḥ| tvayāgaṇyaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pika madhurimā dhīragarimā yato labdhaḥ stabdhaḥ kimasi ruciraṃ neha suciram|| 6
api svaiḥ sarvasvaiḥ punarapadhanaiḥ kairapi dhanaiḥ paritrāṇaiḥ prāṇairyadapi ca vidheyaṃ parahitam| tadadyaitacchabdātparabhṛta bhavatyeva bhavataḥ tataḥ śabdālasyaṃ kathamapi nirasyaṃ kṣaṇamapi|| 7 andhavaidyanāthasyaitau
amṛtavacanalīlāvibhramairannapānaṃ racaya catura kīra bhrāntacitteṣu teṣu| akalitaparasevātāpapāpaḥ piko 'sau bhajatu vipinavāṭīmeṣa pīyūṣakaṇṭhaḥ|| 8 kasyāpi
parabhṛtaśiśo maunaṃ tāvadvidhehi nabhasthalotpatanavidhaye pakṣau syātāṃ na yāvadimau kṣamau| dhruvamitarathā draṣṭavyo 'si svajātivilakṣaṇadhvanitakupitadhvāṃkṣatroṭīpuṭāhatijarjaraḥ|| 9 acalasya
re re kāka varāka sākamamunā puṃskokilena dhvanispardhābandhamupeyuṣastava kathaṃ vakṣo na yāti dvidhā| yasyākarṇya vacaḥ sudhākavacitaṃ vācaṃyamānāmapi vyagrāṇi grathayanti manmathakathāṃ cetāṃsi caitrotsave|| 10 bhallaṭasya
udyāne sahakārakorakarasapratyāśayā kokilaḥ sthātuṃ vāñchati cittajanmanṛpatermitraṃ ca mantrī yataḥ| kiṃ tu dhvāṃkṣavijṛmbhiteṣu ca pikaprārabdhagāneṣu ca kreṃkāreṣu ca pañcamadhvaniṣu ca śrotā na vettyantaram|| 11
utkūjantu vaṭe vaṭe vata vakāḥ kākā varākā api krāṃkurvantu sadā ninādapaṭavaste pippale pippale| so 'nyaḥ ko 'pi rasālapallavalavagrāsollasatpāṭavakrīḍatkokilakaṇṭhakūjanakalālīlāvilāsakramaḥ|| 12 kayorapyetau
yenānandamaye vasantasamaye saurabhyahelāmiladbhṛṅgālīmukhare rasālaśikhare nītāḥ purā vāsarāḥ| āḥ kālasya vaśena kokilayuvā so 'pyadya sarvā diśo bhrāmyadvāyasacañcughātavidalanmūrdhā muhurdhāvati|| 13 bherībhāṃkārasya
dātyūhāḥ sarasaṃ rasantu sarasaṃ gāyantu kekābhṛtaḥ kādambāḥ kalamālapantu madhuraṃ kūjantu koyaṣṭayaḥ| daivādyāvadasau rasālaviṭapicchāyāmanāsādayat nirviṇṇaḥ kuṭajeṣu kokilayuvā saṃjātamaunavrataḥ|| 14 kasyāpi
tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭha cakora saṃhara giraṃ tvam kīra pārāvata tvadvāco viramantu barhiṇa bhavatkaṇṭho 'pi viśrāmyatu| etannūtanacūtapallavalavagrāsollasanmañjulavyāhāraḥ kalakaṇṭha eṣa kirati śrotre sudhāśīkarān|| 15
\Colo iti kokilapaddhatiḥ
gāṅgamambu sitamambu yāmunaṃ kajjalābhamubhayatra majjataḥ| rājahaṃsa tava saiva śubhratā cīyate na ca na cāpacīyate|| 1
ambhojinīvananivāsavilāsameva haṃsasya hantu nitarāṃ kupito vidhātā| na tvasya dugdhajalabhedavidhau prasiddhāṃ vaidagdhyakīrtimapahartumasau samarthaḥ|| 2
tarau tīrodbhūte kvacidapi dalācchāditatanuḥ pataddhārāsārāṃ gamaya viṣamāṃ prāvṛṣamimām| nivṛttāyāṃ tvasyāṃ sarasi sarasotphullanaline sa eva tvaṃ haṃsaḥ punarapi vilāsāsta iha te|| 3 keṣāmapyete
yaḥ saṃtāpamapākaroti jagatāṃ yaścopakārakṣamaḥ sarveṣāmamṛtātmakena vapuṣā prīṇāti netrāṇi yaḥ| tasyāpyunnatimambudasya sahase yanna tvametāvatā varṇenaiva paraṃ marāla dhavalaḥ kṛṣṇaścaritrairasi|| 4 śrībhojadevasya
haṃsa tvaṃ śaradindudhāmadhavalaḥ pakṣadvayapronnataḥ dhātrīmaṇḍalamaṇḍanasthirapadaḥ ślāghyaṃ na vā kiṃ tava| kiṃ tvaikyaṃ gatayoryadaṅgaḥ kuruṣe bhedaṃ ca dugdhāmbhasoḥ nūnaṃ sarvaguṇonnatasya bhavatastannaiva yuktaṃ manāk|| 5
