anyā sā sarasī marāla munibhiryattīrasopānikāvinyastānbalitaṇḍulānkavalayandṛṣṭo 'si hṛdyairmukhaiḥ| eṣā pakvaṇavāpikā kamalinīkhaṇḍe 'tra guptātmabhirvyādhaistvadvidhamugdhabandhanavidhau kiṃ nāma nāsūtryate|| 6
pramlānā nalinī jalāni kiraṇaiḥ sūryasya śoṣaṃ yayuḥ nāśaṃ prāpa vihaṃgamāvaliriyaṃ tṛṣṇāviśīrṇekṣaṇā| ete tīramahīruhā api tatpatraśriyo 'dyāpi re ko 'yaṃ rājamarāla śuṣkasarasītīre ratiprakramaḥ|| 7
gataṃ tadgāmbhīryaṃ taṭamapi vṛtaṃ jālikaśataiḥ sakhe haṃsottiṣṭha prathamamamuto dhāva sarasaḥ| na yāvatpaṅkāmbhaḥkaluṣitavapurbhūriti lapanbako 'sau vācāṭaścaraṇayugalaṃ mūrdhni kurute|| 8
yo divyāmbujalīnamattamadhupaprodgītiramyaṃ saraḥ tyaktvā mānasamalpavāriṇi padaṃ badhnāti kedārake| tasyālīkasukhāśayā paribhavakṣetrīkṛtasyādhunā haṃsasyopari ṭiṭṭibho yadi padaṃ dhatte ko vismayaḥ|| 9
viśvābhīṣṭarasaṃ prabandhavidhṛti snehasya pātraṃ jaḍaiḥ yuktaṃ yadyapi kurvate hatadhiyo dugdhaṃ vimugdhāśayāḥ| tiṣṭhantyatra tathāpi kecana girā gatyā ca lokottarāḥ nīrakṣīravivekadhīradhiṣaṇāste rājahaṃsāḥ kutaḥ|| 10
kāke kārṣṇamalaukikaṃ dhavalimā haṃse nisargasthitaḥ gāmbhīrye mahadantaraṃ vacasi yo bhedaḥ sa kiṃ kathyate| etāvatsu viśeṣaṇeṣvapi sakhe yatredamālokyate ke kākāḥ khalu ke ca haṃsaśiśavo deśāya tasmai namaḥ|| 11
santyanyatrāpi vīcīcayacakitacalatkrauñcacañcuprabhinnapronnidrāmbhojareṇuprakaraviracanāhārivāriprabandhāḥ| kiṃ tu svacchāśayatvaṃ jagati na sulabhaṃ tena gatvā vidūraṃ baddhotkaṇṭhānurāgādanusarati saro mānasaṃ rājahaṃsaḥ|| 12
ākāraḥ kamanīyatākulagṛhaṃ līlālasā sā gatiḥ samparkaḥ kamalākaraiḥ kalatayā lokottaraṃ kūjitam| yasyeyaṃ guṇasampadasti mahatī tasyāpi bhavyasya te saṃrabdhatvamasadgumadgukalahe nāhaṃ sahe haṃsa he|| 13 keṣāmapyete
gatamanutaṭaṃ padme padme niveśitamānanaṃ pratikamalinīpatracchāyaṃ muhurmuhurāsitam| nayanasalilairuṣṇaiḥ koṣṇāḥ kṛtā jalavicayaḥ jaladamalināṃ haṃsenāśāṃ vilokya gamiṣyatā|| 14
\Colo iti haṃsapaddhatiḥ
vyajanairātapatraiśca bhūtvā picchaiḥ kalāpinām| sthānabhraṣṭairapi kṛtaṃ pareṣāṃ tāpvāraṇam|| 1
kramagalitaiḥ śikhipiñchairmaṇḍanamāstāṃ vadhena kiṃ śikhinaḥ| kutukini punarna lābho viṣadharagahanaṃ vanaṃ bhavitā|| 2 goyidoyikavirājayoḥ
re re mayūra śabarīkaratālikābhiḥ kiṃ mugdha nṛtyasi vṛthā vitatorubarhaḥ| tvadbarhavistṛtitirohitamūrtayo 'mī tvāṃ ghātayanti nibhṛtaṃ kitavāḥ kirātāḥ|| 3
bhrātarjīvanadāyinastu jagatāmete ghanāstvatpriyāḥ bandhuste haranandanaḥ sa ca sakhā kaṇṭhaśriyā śaṃkaraḥ| indraścāpi suhṛttavāṅganayanaireteṣu mitreṣvapi prāyo vāyubhujo mayūra bhavato grāsāya kiṃ kalpitāḥ|| 4
bhrātaḥ patraratheśvaro 'si kaṭake tvaṃ bhūbhṛto 'pyagraṇīḥ nāṭye netrasahasradarśanapaṭustvaṃ nīlakaṇṭho 'paraḥ| bhadra śrīśabhujaṅgavandighaṭanā gītaistvayā chidyate śuklāpāṅga tathāpi kālavaśato mānyāstavaite guṇāḥ|| 5 keṣāmapyete
etasminmalayācale bahuvidhaiḥ kiṃ tairakiṃcitkaraiḥ kākolūkakapotakokilakulaireko 'pi pārśvasthitaḥ| kekī kūjati cettadā vighaṭitavyālāvalībandhanaḥ sevyaḥ syādiha sarvalokamanasāmānandanaścandanaḥ|| 6 vasundharasya
asmānvicitravapuṣaścirapṛṣṭhalagnānko vā vimuñcati sakhe yadi vā vimuñca| hā hanta kekivara hāniriyaṃ tavaiva bhūpālamūrdhani punarbhavitā sthitirnaḥ|| 7
aye nīlagrīva kva kathaya sakhe te 'dya munayaḥ paraṃ toṣaṃ yeṣāṃ tava varavilāso vitanute| amī dūrātkrūrāḥ kvaṇitamidamākarṇya sahasā tvarante hantuṃ tvāmahaha śabarāḥ puṅkhitaśarāḥ|| 8 kasyāpi
\Colo iti mayūrapaddhatiḥ
aho moho varākasya kākasya yadasau rasāt| narīnarti sarīsarti samīpe śikhihaṃsayoḥ|| 1
ā maraṇādapi virutaṃ kurvāṇāḥ spardhayā saha mayūraiḥ| kiṃ jānanti varākāḥ kākāḥ kekāravaṃ kartum|| 2 kayorapyetau
śrutarājahaṃsavacaso yuktā tūṣṇīkataiva kākasya| ākarṇitakalakokilarutamapi mukharaṃ ca dhigdhvāṃkṣam|| 3 śrīvallabhadevasya
kāka tvaṃ phalanamramāmravipinaṃ daivātsamāsādayan kiṃ karṇau badhirīkaroṣi paruṣaiḥ kreṃkārakolāhalaiḥ| maunaṃ cedavalambase ratabharaprakrāntapuṃskokilabhrāntyāpi tvayi saṃcaranti na kathaṃ mugdhākaṭākṣacchaṭāḥ|| 4 haribhaṭṭasya
citraṃ citraṃ vata vata mahaccitrametadvicitraṃ jāto daivāducitaracanāsaṃvidhātā vidhātā| yannimbānāṃ pariṇataphalaspītirāsvādanīyā yaccaitasyāḥ kavalanakalākovidaḥ kākalokaḥ|| 5 kasyāpi
pathi nipatitāṃ śūnye dṛṣṭvā nirāvaraṇānanāṃ yadi dadhighaṭīṃ garvottabdhaḥ samuddhurakandharaḥ| nijasamucitāstāstāśceṣṭā vikāraśatākulaḥ yadi na kurute kāṇaḥ kākaḥ kadā nu vidhāsyati|| 6 bhallaṭasya
rathyāvaskaracatvarāvaṭabahirbhūmāvaṭannīkṣaṇaṃ saṃcāryaikamitastato bhramivaśātprāpyaikamākhuṃ mṛtam| kākaḥ paśyata koṭare kaṭu raṭansaṃgrāmabhagnāmarapratyakṣāpahṛtāmṛtena samatāṃ tārkṣyeṇa saṃślāghate|| 7 bhaṭṭarudranāthasya
kiṃ kekīva śikhaṇḍamaṇḍitatanuḥ kiṃ kīravatpāṭhakaḥ kiṃ vā haṃsa ivāṅganāgatiguruḥ śārīva kiṃ susvaraḥ| kiṃ vā hanta śakuntapālapikavatkarṇāmṛtasyandanaḥ kākaḥ kena guṇena kāñcanamaye vyāpāritaḥ pañjare|| 8
no cārū caraṇau na cāpi rucirā cañcurna vācyaṃ vacaḥ no līlālalitā gatirna ca śuciḥ pakṣagraho 'yaṃ tava| krūrakreṃkṛtadurbhagāṃ giramiha sthāne satāmudgiran mūrkha dhvāṃkṣa na lajjase visadṛśaṃ haṃsatvamunnāṭayan|| 9
\Colo iti kākapaddhatiḥ
jīvato 'pi gilanmatsyānmunivaddṛśyate bakaḥ| mṛtānapi na gṛdhro 'tti dhigākāradurantatām|| 1 kasyāpi
nijakulocitaceṣṭitamātmano yadapahāya yiyāsasi haṃsatām| baka bakavratameva tathāpi te calati cettadimāṃ tyaja yantraṇām|| 2 bhaṭṭagovindarājasya
kirati mukhagṛhītaṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ purīṣaṃ vilikhati caraṇāgrairdevatānāṃ śirāṃsi| viharati hatamānaḥ sādhumūrdhasvaśaṅkaṃ kimiva na kurute 'yaṃ prāpya khaṃ kaṅkapotaḥ|| 3
haṃho bakoṭa yadihoddhurakandharatvaṃ nāṭayanvahasi re dhavalatvametat| grāsātimātraghaṭanākulitodako 'si cañcvā na kiṃ muhuranena samo 'stu kaste|| 4
ādhāya drutamākṛterupaśamādviśvāsanaṃ sannidhau ekaikaṃ śapharaṃ bakoṭakapaṭācāryo jighṛkṣanmuhuḥ| audāsīnyanivedanāya nidadhaddikṣu kṣaṇaṃ cakṣuṣī cañcvā kiṃ ca parāmṛśanvapurayaṃ gāmbhīryamabhyasyati|| 5 śrībhojadevasyaitau
re re śiṣṭa bakoṭa nākataṭinītīre tapasvivrataṃ dhyānenānimiṣopabhogamanasā yuktaṃ karoṣīdṛśam| evaṃ yatkila mānasasya padavīṃ kāṅkṣasyayuktaṃ hi tat nīrakṣīravivekanirmaladhiyo haṃsasya nānyasya saḥ|| 6 kasyāpi
tadvaidagdhyaṃ samucitapayastoyatattvaṃ vivektuṃ sallāpāste sa ca ca mṛdupadanyāsahṛdyo vilāsaḥ| āstāṃ tāvadbaka yadi tathā vetsi kiṃcidvidhāṃśaṃ tūṣṇīmevāsitumapi sakhe tvaṃ kathaṃ me na haṃsaḥ|| 7 bhaṭṭabhallaṭasya
jātistasya na mānase na śucibhirvṛttirmṛṇālāṅkuraiḥ na brahmodvahanena nirmalayaśaḥprāptirna vācaḥ kalāḥ| jīvatsattvavadhena bāhyadhavalo bhrāmyansagarvaṃ punaḥ mithyaivonnatakandharaḥ śaṭhabako haṃsaiḥ saha spardhate|| 8
bakoṭa brūmastvāṃ laghuni sarasi kvāpi śapharaiḥ tava nyāyyā vṛttirna punaravagāḍhuṃ samucitaḥ| itaścetaścābhraṃlihalaharihelātaralitakṣitidhragrāsaikagrahilatimipotaḥ patirapām|| 9 kayorapyetau
\Colo iti bakapaddhatiḥ
gumphantu mālatīmālāṃ vicitrāṃ citrakārakāḥ| tadāmodaparicchedakovidaḥ ko 'pi ṣaṭpadaḥ|| 1
yadyapi vadanasaroruhasaurabhalobhena ṣaṭpado 'bhyeti| tadapi tamutpalanayanā daṃśāya samāgataṃ manute|| 2 madanasya
jātiṃ yathānusarasi tvamiha dvirepha tadvadvijātimiha yannibiḍānurāgaḥ| tadvedmi mūḍha na paraṃ vapureva kṛṣṇamitthaṃ caritramapi re tava kṛṣṇameva|| 3 śrībhojadevasya
mā gā viṣādamalipotaka ketakīnāmantarnigūḍhamanavāpya madhuprakarṣam| lābhaḥ sa eva bhavato yadi kaṇṭakānāṃ śreṇībhirakṣataśarīratayā prayāsi|| 4 bhaṭṭabhallaṭasya
rātrirgamiṣyati bhaviṣyati suprabhātaṃ bhāsvānudeṣyati bhaviṣyati paṅkajaśrīḥ| itthaṃ vicintayati kośagate dvirephe hā hanta hanta nalinīṃ gaja ujjahāra|| 5
śriyo vāsāmbhoje tridivasaridambhojakuhare harernābhīpadme madhu madhukaro yaḥ kila papau| sa daivādunmīlattapanakaratāpavyatikaravyathākampraḥ sampratyatarumarubhūmau vicarati|| 6
yadyapyāmrataroramuṣya taruṇīkarṇāvataṃsocitāṃ ājighrannavamañjarīṃ madhupa he jāto 'si pūrṇotsavaḥ| vismartuṃ bhavatastathāpyanucitaṃ tadvandyamindīvaraṃ yasyāsādya madhūn dhūnitaśiro mañju tvayā guñjitam|| 7 keṣāmapyete
nirānandaḥ kaunde madhuni vidhuro bālabakule na sāle sālambe lavamapi lavaṅge na ramate| priyaṅgau no saṅgaṃ racayati na cūte vicarati smara/llakṣmīlīlākamalamadhupānaṃ madhukaraḥ|| 8 chittapasya
yasyāḥ saṃgamavāñchayā na gaṇitā vāpyo vinidrotpalāḥ yāmāliṅga samutsukena manasā yātaḥ parāṃ nirvṛtim| bhagnāṃ tāmavalokya candanalatāṃ bhṛṅgeṇa yajjīvyate dhairyaṃ nāma tadastu tasya na punaḥ snehānurūpaṃ kṛtam|| 9
dūrādujjhati campakaṃ na ca bhajatyambhojarājīrajaḥ nājighratyapi pāṭalāparimalaṃ dhatte na cūte ratim| mandāre yadanādaro vicakilaprānte na saṃtṛpyate tanmanye kvacidaṅga bhṛṅgataruṇenāsvāditā mālatī|| 10 kayorapyetau
so 'pūrvo rasanāviparyayavidhistatkarṇayoścāpalaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ sā madavismṛtasvaparadikkiṃ bhūyasoktena vā| sarvaṃ vismṛtavānasi bhramara he yadvāraṇo 'dyāpyasau antaḥśūnyakaro niṣevyata iti bhrātaḥ ka eṣa grahaḥ|| 11 bhallaṭasya
\Colo iti bhṛṅgapaddhatiḥ
sūryādanyatra yaccandre 'pyarthāsaṃsparśi tatkṛtam| khadyota iti kīṭasya nāma duṣṭena kenacit|| 1 bhallaṭasya
kvāpi gataḥ patirahnāṃ jaladāntaritaḥ śaśī sanakṣatraḥ| śūnye nabhasi bhavānapi khadyota dyotatāṃ nāma|| 2
induḥ prayāsyati vinaṅkṣyati tārakaśrīḥ sthāsyanti līḍhatimirā na maṇipradīpāḥ| andhaṃ samagramapi kīṭamaṇe bhaviṣyatyunmeṣameṣyati bhavāniti dūrametat|| 3
yuṣmādṛśāḥ kṛpaṇakāḥ kṛmayo 'pi yatra bhānti sma santamasamayyagamanniśāsau| sūryāṃśudīpradaśadigdivaso 'dhunā tu bhātyatra nendurapi kīṭamaṇe kimu tvam|| 4 keṣāmapyete
bhrājiṣṇavo nabhasi meghakṛtāndhakāre svalpaprabhā api parairaniruddhabhāsaḥ| khadyotakāḥ prakaṭitorutaraprabhāvāstāvanna saptaturagaḥ samudeti yāvat|| 5 hevidhanesorasya
adṛṣṭivyāpāraṃ gatavati dinānāmadhipatau yaśaḥśeṣībhūte śaśini gatadhāmni grahagaṇe| tathāndhaṃ saṃjātaṃ jagadupanate meghasamaye yathāmī gaṇyante tamasi paṭavaḥ kīṭamaṇayaḥ|| 6 ānandavardhanasya
tejo darśayasi tvamīdṛśamapi kṣudra sphuranyāsu tāḥ khalvanyāḥ pratatātisāndratimiracchannāvakāśā niśāḥ| khadyoto 'tra sa ko 'pi tiṣṭhati punastejasvināmagraṇīḥ anyeṣāṃ bhuvane 'pi yasya purataḥ śāmyanti tejaḥkathāḥ|| 7 śrībhojadevasya
\Colo iti khadyotapaddhatiḥ
cātaka dhūmasamūhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mā dhāva vāridharabuddhyā| iha hi bhaviṣyati bhavato nayanayugādeva vāri param|| 1
tatsvonnateḥ samucitaṃ samayocitaṃ ca taccātakāya jaladena vitīrṇamambu| taccāntareṇa ca papau pavanaḥ sa ko 'pi yaścaiṣṭadeśamanu tasya cakarṣa varṣam|| 2
yasyodaye gurumanorathamantareṇa saṃcintitaṃ kimapi cetasi cātakena| hā kaṣṭamiṣṭaphaladānavidhānahetorambhodharātpatati samprati vajravahniḥ|| 3 keṣāmapyete
aye vāpīhaṃsā nijavasatisaṃkocapiśunaṃ kurudhvaṃ mā ceto viyati calato vīkṣya vigahān| amī te sāraṅgā bhuvanamahanīyavratabhṛtāṃ nirīhāṇāṃ yeṣāṃ tṛṇamiva bhavantyambunidhayaḥ|| 4 ākāśapoleḥ
kālātikramaṇaṃ kuruṣva taḍitāṃ visphūrjitaistrāsaya sphārairbhīṣaya garjitairatitarāṃ kārṣṇyaṃ mukhe darśaya| yasyānanyagateḥ payoda manaso jijñāsayā cātakasya ādhehi tvamihākhilaṃ tadapi na tvattaḥ paraṃ yācate||5
yaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kurute mukhaṃ janayati trāsaṃ taḍidbhiśca yaḥ yaśca prārthayataḥ paraṃ dalayati śrotraṃ nijairgarjitaiḥ| satyaṃ cātaka taṃ tathāvidhamapi bhrātastvayā yācatā jīmūtaṃ kṛtameva tulyamanayorarthitvatiryaktvayoḥ|| 6 śrībhojadevasyaitau
tyaktvā puṣkariṇīrvihāya saritaḥ saṃtyajya pāthonidhīn kūpaśreṇimapāsya sāmpratamaho tvāmekamevāśritaḥ| tadbho vārida muhyataḥ pralapataḥ saṃśuṣyatastṛṣyataḥ sāraṅgasya vimuñca cañcupuṭake dvitrānkaṇānambhasaḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
santi kūpāḥ sphuradrūpāḥ paritaḥ saritaḥ śubhāḥ| tathāpi cātakasyaikaḥ phalado jaladodayaḥ|| 8
tyaktvā tāpanivārivārinikarānpadmākarānsarvataḥ pīyūṣapratirūparūpanivahānujjāgarānsāgarān| bhrātaścātaka yaṃ samīkṣya nabhasi prāpnoṣi tṛṣṇākulaḥ so 'yaṃ kiṃ tvayi vajravahnimahahā sajjīkarotyambudaḥ|| 9 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
anusara sarastīraṃ vairaṃ kimatra sahātmanā katipayapayaḥpānaṃ māninsamācara cātaka| pralayapavanairastaṃ nītaḥ purātanavāridaḥ yadayamadayaṃ kīlājālaṃ vimuñcati nūtanaḥ|| 10
\Colo iti cātakapaddhatiḥ|
bhūcarāḥ
siṃhapaddhatiḥ (22)
udbandhanaṃ dṛḍhaṃ gāḍhaṃ siṃho 'pi sahate yadi| kathaṃ karaṭinastarhi nṛpacihnāni bibhrati|| 1 kasyāpi
kharanakharaśikharadāritamadakariraktāktakesarasyāsya| api bhūri bhūrimāyo janayati paruṣāṃ ruṣaṃ na hareḥ|| 2 andhanāthasya
kathamapyadhigatarandhrairadhyuṣitā yadi guhākhubhiḥ kṣudraiḥ| iyataiva kiṃ mṛgādhipa nijavikramanirvidaṃ vahasi|| 3 śrīvallabhadevasya
yadyapi vidhivaiguṇyātsiṃhaḥ patito 'tidustare kūpe| tadapi hi vāñchati satataṃ karikumbhavidāraṇaṃ manasā|| 4 kasyāpi
nāsyocchrāyavatī tanurna daśanau sthūlau na dīrghaḥ karaḥ satyaṃ vāraṇa naiṣa kesariśiśustvāṃ ḍambaraiḥ spardhate| tejobījamajayyameva hṛdaye nyastaṃ purā vedhasā tādṛktvādṛśameva yena sutarāṃ bhojyaṃ paśuṃ manyate|| 5 ānandavardhanasya
mātaṅgāḥ kimu valgitaiḥ kimaphalairāḍambarairjambukāḥ sāraṅgā mahiṣā madaṃ tyajata kiṃ śūnye 'tha śūrā na ke| kopāṭopasamudbhaṭotkaṭasaṭākoṭeribhāreḥ śanaiḥ sindhudhvānini huṃkṛte sphurati yattadgarjitaṃ garjitam|| 6 kasyāpi
smerāḥ santu sabhāsadaḥ karicamūdarpajvarotsāriṇā pārīndreṇa samaṃ sa jambujayuvā yuddhāya baddhādaraḥ| tatrāpi prathayanti tulyabalatāmeke tayoruccakaiḥ anye saṃśayaśaṃsinastadapare bāḍhaṃ viparyāsinaḥ|| 7 bhīmapaṇḍitasya
yenānargalaphālakelidalitapratyagrakādambinīdhārādhoraṇidhautadhātuṣu purā śaileṣu līlāyitam| so 'yaṃ śṛṅganipātabhagnacaraṇaḥ sphārspharatpheravīphetkāraiḥ kupito 'dya khādati punaḥ pāṇī mṛgagrāmaṇīḥ|| 8 bherībhāṅkārasya
grāmāṇāmupaśalyasīmani madodrekasphuratsauṣṭhavāḥ phetkāradhvanimudgirantu paritaḥ sambhūya gomāyavaḥ| anyaḥ ko 'pi ghanāghanadhvanighanaḥ pārīndraguñjāravaḥ śuṣyadgaṇḍamalokaśuṇḍamacalatkarṇaṃ gajairyaḥ śrutaḥ|| 9 ralhaṇasya
asminnambhodavṛndadhvanijanitaruṣi prekṣamāṇe 'ntarikṣaṃ mā kāka vyākulo bhūstaruśirasi śavakravyaleśānaśānaḥ| dhatte mattebhakumbhavyatikarakarajagrāmavajrāgrajāgradgrāsavyāsaktamuktādhavalitakavalo na spṛhāmatra siṃhaḥ|| 10 mahīpatimaṇḍalīkasya
\Colo iti siṃhapaddhatiḥ
gajapaddhatiḥ (23)
kaupe payasi laghīyasi tāpena karaḥ prasāritaḥ kariṇā| so 'pi na payasā lipto lāghavamātmā paraṃ nītaḥ|| 1 kasyāpi
yadi matto 'si mataṅgaja kimamībhirasārasaralatarudalanaiḥ| harimanusara kharanakharaṃ vyapanayati sa karaṭakaṇḍūtim|| 2 vallabhadevasya
bhadrāṃ jātiṃ vahato madakariṇaścenna ḍiṇḍimastatkim| madamuditamadhukarālījhaṃkṛtikolāhalenālam|| 3 mālatīmādhavasya
tyakto vindhyagiriḥ pitā bhagavatī māteva revā nadī tyaktāḥ snehanibandhabandhuradhiyastulyodayā dantinaḥ| tvallobhānnanu hastini pratidinaṃ bandhāya dattaṃ vapuḥ tvaṃ dūre dhriyase luṭhanti ca śiraḥpīṭhe kaṭhorāṅkuśāḥ|| 4
kvākāro girisannibhaḥ kva ca gatirvege 'pi līlālasā helākuḍmalitekṣaṇāḥ kva nu dṛśaḥ kiṃ vā kva te bṛṃhitam| vaprāghātarasaḥ kva te kva ca karaḥ kaṣṭaṃ yadevaṃvidhaṃ tvāmāruhya śiśuḥ padā paravaśaṃ saṃcārayatyājñayā|| 5 kayorapyetau
karṇe cāmaracārukambukalikā kaṇṭhe maṇīnāṃ gaṇaḥ sindūraprakaraḥ "Siraḥparisare pārśvāntike kiṅkiṇī| labdhaścennṛpavāhanena kariṇā baddhena bhūṣāvidhiḥ tatkiṃ bhūdharadhūlidhūsaratanurmānyo na vanyaḥ karī|| 6 ralhaṇasya
yatpratyagradalāvalīkavalanairjāto 'pi śailopamaḥ yacchāyāsu kadarthito 'su na kadāpyarkāṃśubhiḥ karkaśaiḥ| ghorāghātakirātapatripatane yairvāravāṇāyitaṃ tānmātaṅga madāndha pāṭayasi kiṃ vindhyāṭavīpādapān|| 7
pītaṃ yatra himaṃ payaḥ kavalitā yasminmṛṇālāṅkurāḥ tāpārtena nimajjya yasya saraso madhye vimuktaḥ śramaḥ| dhiktasyaiva jalāni paṅkilayataḥ pāthojinīrmathnataḥ kūlānyutkhanataḥ karīndra bhavato lajjāpi nojjāgaraḥ|| 8
dūre yūthakathā priyā sakalabhā sāpi kvacidvidrutā sā vindhyādrivanāvalī vidhivaśāddhyānāvaśeṣābhavat| prāpto bandhaparābhavastadapi re dantīndra dhanyo bhavān yaddantavyavasāyasaṃśrayavaśātsāmrājyabhājo nṛpāḥ|| 9 keṣāmapyete
tāpo nāpagatastṛṣāpi na kṛśā dhautā na dhūlī tanoḥ na svacchandamakāri kandakavalaḥ kā nāma kelīkathā| dūronmuktakareṇa hanta kariṇā spṛṣṭā na vā padminī prārabdho madhupairakāraṇamayaṃ jhaṃkārakolāhalaḥ|| 10 umāpatidharasya
iti gajapaddhati||
karabhapaddhatiḥ (24)
tubhyaṃ dāsera dāsīyaṃ badarī yadi rocate| etāvatyeva kiṃ drākṣā na sākṣādamṛtaprapā|| 1 karpūrakaveḥ
vapurviṣamasaṃsthānaṃ karṇajvarakaro ravaḥ| karabhasyāśugatyā sā chāditā doṣasaṃgatiḥ|| 2 bhallaṭasya
ākārālāpasambhogairyadīyairlajjate janaḥ| aho ajroddhuragrīvastaireva karabho 'dhamaḥ|| 3 dīpakasya
rūkṣaṃ vapurna ca vilocanahāri rūpaṃ na śrotrayoḥ sukhadamāraṭitaṃ kadāpi| itthaṃ na sādhu tava kiṃcididaṃ tu sādhu tulye ratiḥ karabha kaṇṭakini drume yat|| 4 śrībhojadevasya
asyānanasya bhavataḥ khalu koṭireṣā kaṇṭārikā yadi bhavedaviśīrṇaparṇā| yogyā kva te karabha kalpatarorlatāyāste pallavā vimalavidrumabhaṅgabhājaḥ|| 5
na bhavati mithunānāṃ prema lāvaṇyayogājjanayati sukhamantaḥ kasyacitko 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ| patati jhaṭiti dṛṣṭirdagdhadāśerakāṇāṃ jaraṭhabhuruṭavallīpiñjarāsu sthalīṣu|| 6 kayorapyetau
kumudaśabalaiḥ phullāmbhojaiḥ sarobhiralaṃkṛtā marakatamaṇiśyāmāśaṅkāṃ vihāya vanasthalīm| smarati karabho yadrūkṣāṇāṃ caranmaruvartmanāṃ paricayaratiḥ sā durvārā na sā guṇavairitā|| 7 jinanāgasya
karabhadayite yattatpītaṃ sudurlabhamekadā madhu vanagataṃ tasyālābhe virauṣi kimutsukā| kuru paricitaiḥ pīloḥ patrairdhṛtiṃ marugocarairjagati sakale kasyāvāptiḥ sukhasya nirantarā|| 8
karabha rabhasātkroṣṭuṃ vāñchasyaho śravaṇajvaraṃ śaraṇamathavānṛjvī dīrghā tavaiva śirodharā| bahugalabilāvṛttiśrāntoccaliṣyati vāṅmukhāt kiyati samaye ko jānīte bhaviṣyati kasya kim|| 9 bhallaṭasyaitau
yasyāḥ saṃbhṛtamālavālavalayaṃ bhūpālaśṛṅgāriṇībhṛṅgārodaravipralambhavidhurairnīraiḥ sudhābandhubhiḥ| tāmetāṃ mṛdulapravālalalitāṃ drākṣālatāmāraṭannudgrīvaḥ prakaṭīkṛtārdhadaśano dāśerakaḥ kṛntati|| 10 umāpatidharasya
\Colo iti karabhapaddhatiḥ
dhavalapaddhatiḥ (25
guṇānāmeva daurjanyāddhurīṇo yo niyujyate| asaṃjātakiṇaskandhaḥ sukhaṃ svapiti gaurgaliḥ|| 1 vyāsamuneḥ
adhvā na yadi niḥsaṅgapaṅkasaṃkulito bhavet| tataḥ kutaste dhaureya dhuryatā vyajyatāmiyam|| 2 vasupālasya
nāsya bhāragrahe śaktirna ca vāhaguṇaḥ kvacit| devāgārabalīvardastathāpyaśnāti śobhanam|| 3
dantāḥ sapta calaṃ viṣāṇayugalaṃ pucchāñcalaḥ karburaḥ kukṣiścandrakito vapuḥ kusumitaṃ sattvacyutaṃ ceṣṭitam| asminduṣṭavṛṣe vṛṣāgrimaguṇagrāmānabhijñātmanaḥ grāmīṇasya tathāpi cetasi ciraṃ dhuryabhramaḥ sphūrjati|| 4
gururnāyaṃ bhāraḥ kvacidapi na panthāḥ sthaphuṭitaḥ na te bhagnā śaktirvahanamapi nāṅgena vikalam| iha draṅge nānyastava guṇasamānastadadhunā dhunānena skandhaṃ dhavala kimu muktaḥ pathi bharaḥ|| 5
yathā bhagnaḥ panthāḥ paruṣaviṣamagrāvagahanaḥ galīnāṃ gātrāṇi spṛśati ca yathā sārathirayam| yathā caite dṛptāḥ khuralitabhuvo yānti vṛṣabhāḥ tathā dūrībhūtaḥ sa khalu dhavalo nūnamadhunā|| 6
yasyāsīdvrajamaṇḍanasya vahato durge 'pi gurvīṃ dhurāṃ dhaureyaiḥ praguṇīkṛto na yugapatskandhaḥ samastairapi| tasyaiva ślathakambalasya dhavalasyotthāpane sāmprataṃ draṅge 'traiva jarāvasāditatanorgopaṇyamudghuṣyate|| 7
pūtaḥ śrautasusaṃskriyābhiranadhībhāvāya yo dīkṣitaiḥ devena tripurāriṇā ca hariṇā yaḥ svīkṛto 'strāṅganaiḥ| yatkṣiptaiḥ padapāṃsubhiḥ pitṛgaṇā gīrvāṇalakṣmībhujaḥ dhigdaivaṃ sa turuṣkasadmani purā kaṇṭhālavāhī vṛṣaḥ|| 8 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti dhavalapaddhatiḥ|
hariṇapaddhatiḥ (26)
kāmaṃ vaneṣu hariṇāstṛṇena jīvantyayatnasulabhena| dhaniṣu na dainyaṃ vidadhati he kila paśavo vayaṃ sudhiyaḥ|| 1
tṛṇabāṇastṛṇadhanvā tṛṇaghaṭitaḥ kapaṭapuruṣo 'yam| tadapi ca kuraṅgaśāvaka kedāre kalamamañjarī tyajasi|| 2 kayorapyetau
svacchandaṃ hariṇena yā viharatā daivātsamāsāditā bhagnaprasrutadugdhabindumadhurā śālernavā mañjarī| niḥśvāsānaladagdhakomalatṛṇaprakhyāpitāntarvyathaḥ tāmenāṃ prativāsaraṃ muniriva dhyāyanvane śuṣyati|| 3 dharmakīrteḥ
kati kati na punaścaranti hanta pratiśikharaṃ pratikānanaṃ kuraṅgāḥ| tadapi janamanovinodaheturvilasati keṣvapi ko 'pi nābhigandhaḥ|| 4
romanthamāracaya mantharametya nidrāṃ muñca śramaṃ tadanu saṃcara re yatheccham| dūre sa pāmarajano munayaḥ kilāmī niṣkāraṇaṃ hariṇapota bibheṣi kasmāt|| 5 kayorapyetau
seyaṃ sthalī navatṛṇāṅkurajālametatseyaṃ mṛgīti hṛdi jātamadaḥ kuraṅgaḥ| nedaṃ tu vetti yadihāntarito latābhirāyāti sajjitakaṭhoraśaraḥ kirātaḥ|| 6 indrakaveḥ
pātakṣuṇṇakhurasya bāṇapatanapravyaktaraktacchaṭācchannāṅgasya davāgnidāhavikalasyāseduṣo 'pyāśramam| dhigdaivaṃ viṣamā mṛgasya divasāḥ sarvānukampāmayaḥ mā bhaiṣīriti bhāṣaṇe 'pi yadabhūdvācaṃyamo 'yaṃ muniḥ|| 7
vyomārdhe jvalito raviḥ kavalitaṃ dāvānalaiḥ kānanaṃ dhūmyābhirna diśaḥ sphuranti paritaḥ panthāḥ śilādanturaḥ| itthaṃ lohitasiktaskṛvaṇi yathāprāṇaṃ mṛge dhāvati vyādhenāpi śarāsane karuṇayā nāropitāḥ pattriṇaḥ|| 8
nirālambaṃ vyomāpyayamaśaraṇo hanta hariṇaḥ kva yātu kvāyātu kva ca viharatu kva praviśatu| diśo jājvalyante guṇigaṇaśūnyā ca vasudhā miṣākāṅkṣī kālaḥ praharati punaḥ pāmarapatiḥ|| 9
\Colo iti hariṇapaddhatiḥ||
samudrapaddhatiḥ (27)
jīvānāmapi jīvanasya mahatastvaṃ cāśrayaḥ sarvadā maryādāṃ na jahāsi santi bhavato garbhe maṇīnāṃ gaṇāḥ| evaṃ te mahimā mahāñjalanidhe madhye kimarthaṃ kṛtaḥ pāpīyāṃstava jīvanakṣayakarastvaurvaḥ svakukṣibhariḥ|| 1 caturmukhamahādevasya
nāvajñā nāpyavaidagdhyamudadhermahimaiva saḥ| yattīrapaṅkamagnāni mahāratnāni śerate|| 2 kasyāpi
na pālayati maryādāṃ velākhyāmambudhistathā| tṛṣyatāṃ nopakartavyamitīmāmaparāṃ yathā|| 3 bhāgavatāmṛtadattasya
yadyapi baddhaḥ śailairyadyapi girimathanamuṣitasarvasvaḥ| tadapi pavibhītabhūdhararakṣāyāṃ dīkṣito jaladhiḥ|| 4
ādāya vāri paritaḥ saritāṃ mukhebhyaḥ kiṃ tāvadarjitamanena durarṇavena| kṣārīkṛtaṃ ca bḍavāvadane hutaṃ ca pātālakukṣikuhare viniveśitaṃ ca|| 5 rīsukasya
svastyastu vidrumavanāya namo maṇibhyaḥ kalyāṇinī bhavatu mauktikaśuktimālā| prāptaṃ mayā sakalamapyamutaḥ payodheryaddāruṇairjalacarairna vidārito 'smi|| 6 indrakaveḥ
lajjāmahe bhṛśamaho vayamapyanena sāṃyātrikāḥ salilarāśimamī viśanti| skandhādhiropitatadīyataṭopakaṇṭhakaupeyakāmbudṛtayo yadudīrṇatṛṣṇāḥ|| 7
pāthonātha jagatyahaṃkṛtibhṛto lokatrayīghasmarāḥ santyanye 'pyapakāriṇaḥ kimu bhavāneko 'tra teṣāṃ dhuri| ākāṅkṣañjagataḥ kṣayāya samayaṃ doṣākaraikapriyaḥ yastaṃ hanta sadā vahasyagaṇitasvāṅgavyayo vāḍavam|| 8 śrībhojadevasya
yaccandrārdhavibhūṣaṇaḥ paśupatiryacca śriyālaṃkṛtaḥ viṣṇuryacca divaukasāṃ patirabhūdairāvatādhiṣṭhitaḥ| prāptaṃ prītivikāsitekṣaṇayugairyaccāmaratvaṃ suraiḥ tatsarvaṃ hi paropakāravasateḥ sindhoḥ prabhāvādbhutam|| 9 indrakaveḥ
lakṣmīkaustubhapārijātamadirānāgāśvakhaḍgāmṛtatyāginko bhuvaneśvaro 'tra bhavatā nārthī kṛtārthīkṛtaḥ| kiṃ tu kṣīranidhe yadindukusumenābhyarcya devaṃ śivaṃ pārśvasthaṃ pratipādito 'si garalaṃ tenaiva dūyāmahe|| 10
aye vārāṃ"rāśe kuliśakarakopapratibhayāt asau pakṣe premṇā girivarasutastvāmupagataḥ| tvadantarvāstavyo yadi punarayaṃ vāḍavaśikhī śikhābhiḥ pratyaṅgaṃ glapayati tadā ko 'sya śaraṇam|| 11
he helājitabodhisattva vacasā kiṃ vistaraistoyadhe nāsti tvatsadṛśaḥ paraḥ parahitādhāne gṛhītavrataḥ| tṛṣyatpānthajanopakāraghaṭanāvaumukhyalabdhāyaśobhāraprodvahane karoṣi kṛpayā sāhāyakaṃ yanmaroḥ|| 12
kiṃ vyāptākhiladiktaṭena visaradgarjalluṭhadvisphuratsaṃkṣubhyannamadunnamatparivahadvīcīvilāsena te| grīṣmoṣmaglapitādhvagasya bhavato jātaṃ na tṛṭśāntaye dhikte dharmavicāri vāri jaladhe kṣāraṃ mahatkevalam|| 13
yadvīcibhiḥ spṛśasi gaganaṃ yacca pātālamūlaṃ ratnairuddīpayasi payasā yatpidhatse dharitrīm| dhiksarvaṃ tattava jalanidhe yadvimucyāśrudhārāṃ tīre nīragrahaṇarasikairadhvagairujjhito 'si|| 14
dyāmārohati vā~chati sthagayituṃ tejo 'pi tejasvinām_ uccairgarjati pūrayannapi mahīmambhobhirambhodharaḥ| kāṃściddrāgupajīvya toyaculakānsindho bhavatsannidheḥ pānīyapracayeṣu satsvapi na te tejovikāraḥ kvacit|| 15
kāsāre 'pi payaḥ pibanti pathikā na kvāpi vāri tvayi kṣāratvādudadheḥ samudra iti te nāmaitadevocitam| na tvetāni nirarthakāni bhavato nāmānyanarthāntarāṇi ambodhirjaladhiḥ payodhirudadhirvārāṃnidhirvāridhiḥ|| 16 keṣāmapyete
vistāro yadi nedṛśo yadi na tadgāmbhīryamambhonidheḥ na syādvā yadi sarvasattvaviṣayastādṛgdayānugrahaḥ| antaḥ prajvalatā payāṃsi dahatā jvālāvalīṃ muñcatā ke na syurvaḍavānalena balinā bhasmāvaśeṣīkṛtāḥ|| 17 keṭasasya
ayaṃ vārāmeko nilaya iti ratnākara iti śrito 'smābhistṛṣṇātaralitamanobhirjalanidhiḥ| ka evaṃ jānīte nijakarapuṭīkoṭaragataṃ kṣaṇādenaṃ tāmyattiminivahamāpāsyati muniḥ|| 18 vararuceḥ
\Colo iti samudrapaddhatiḥ||
ratnapaddhatiḥ (28)
kācāḥ kāñcanabhūṣitāḥ kati na vā muṣṇanti ratnaśriyaṃ maulau vā kati nodvahantyapadhiyastāneva ratnabhramāt| akṣṇāṃ ye punarunmṛjanti timiraṃ yairnāma ratnākaraḥ sindhuste pṛthageva hanta maṇayasteṣvapyabhijñāḥ pṛthak|| 1
lākṣābhiḥ kuru kaṅkaṇaṃ racaya vā kācena cūḍāmaṇiṃ śilpinkaitavakovido 'si vipaṇī grāmyeyamajñaḥ prabhuḥ| nanvetattava sāhasikyamadhikaṃ niṣkampa yattattvataḥ dāhāropaṇaśāṇagharṣaṇavidāmagre 'pi garvāyase|| 2 etau vimalasarasvatyāḥ
viśuddhiḥ kīdṛśī tasya jaḍasya sphaṭikāśmanaḥ| bhidyate 'nu praviśyāntaryo yathārucyupādhinā|| 3 bhallaṭasya
somakānto maṇiḥ svacchaḥ sūryakāntastathā na kim| udgāre tu viśeṣo 'sti tayoramṛtavahnibhiḥ|| 4
samajani tadekameva hi ratnaṃ ratnākare 'pi jalarāśau| sthitamurasi yanmurārerna bhramati kunṛpatibhavaneṣu|| 5
amṛtāṃśoḥ kiraṇebhyo 'jāyata vṛddhirmahodadherudare| kathayanti hāramaṇayo hṛdi tāpamuṣaḥ spṛśanto 'pi|| 6 vallabhadevasyaitau
vapuḥparīṇāhaguṇena tebhyo yaśasvinaḥ kiṃ maṇayo bhavanti| tathāpi cūḍāsu mahīpatīnāṃ ta eva khelanti na gaṇḍaśailāḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
kiṃ mūḍha tāḍayasi tāpayase kimandha kiṃ vā hatāśa paripīḍayasīnduratnam| etasya kevalamanalparasaprasūtirbhrātaḥ sudhāmayakarapraṇayaikasādhyā|| 8 indrakaveḥ
aṅgīkṛtāḥ kṣatimimāmapi ye viṣahya goptuṃ guṇānkimiti vāñchasi tānmudhaiva| muktāmaṇe vimalarūpatayā nitāntamete tava svayamapi prakaṭībhavanti|| 9 kasyāpi
amīṣāṃ mohādvā dharaṇidharacūḍāñcalabhuvāmabhāgyādvā kaiścinmarakatamaṇiścenna gaṇitaḥ| tathāsau rathyāyāmapi nipatitaḥ kiṃ na kurute samunmīlannīladyutilahariliptā iva diśaḥ|| 10 jayadevasya
kenāsīnaḥ sukhamakaruṇenākarāduddhṛtastvaṃ vikretuṃ vā samabhilaṣitaḥ kena deśāntare 'smin| yasminvittavyayabharasaho grāhakastāvadāstāṃ nāsti bhrātarmarakatamaṇe tvatparīkṣākṣamo 'pi|| 11 sarvavarmaṇaḥ
yāmaste śubhamastu rohaṇagire mattaḥ sthitipracyutā vartiṣyanta ime kathaṃ kathamapi svapne 'pi maivaṃ kṛthāḥ| bhrātaste maṇayo vayaṃ yadi bhavannāmnā prasiddhāstataḥ| ke śṛṅgāraparāyaṇā nṛpatayo maulau na dhāsyanti naḥ|| 12 sihapeyasya
yatrānullikhitākhyameva nikhilaṃ nirmāṇametadvidheḥ utkarṣapratiyogikalpanamapi nyakkārakoṭiḥ parā| yātāḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ manorathagatīrullaṅghya yatsampadacchāyāmātramaṇīkṛtāśmasu maṇestasyāśmataivocitā|| 13
yasya vajramaṇerbhede bhidyante lohasūcayaḥ| karoti tatra kiṃ nāma nārīnakhavilekhanam|| 14
svacchasyāsya prathitamahasaḥ śuddhajāteratulyaṃ vajrasyaiva sphuratu bhuvane dārḍhyamekasya tasya| yasya cchidrapraṇayanavidhau saprayatno 'pi nityaṃ sarvaḥ kuṇṭhībhavati vikaṭaspaṣṭaṭaṅko 'pi lokaḥ|| 15
\Colo iti ratnapaddhatiḥ
śaṅkhapaddhatiḥ (29)
antaḥ kuṭilatāṃ bibhracchaṅkhaḥ sa khalu niṣṭhuraḥ| huṃkaroti yadā dhmātastadaiva bahu gaṇyatām|| 1
kiṃ cumbitena jaḍa śāṅkhika nīraso 'yaṃ kiṃ pāṇiyugmaparipīḍanalālanābhiḥ| prāṇairapi pratidinaṃ paripūryamāṇaḥ huṃkārameva hi paraṃ vidadhāti śaṅkhaḥ|| 2
sarvāśāparipūri huṃkṛtamaho janmāpi dugdhodadheḥ govindānanacumbi sundarataraṃ pūrṇendubimbādvapuḥ| śrīreṣā sahajā guṇāḥ kati paraṃ gaṇyanta ete hi yat kauṭilyaṃ hṛdi pāñcajanya bhavatastenātilajjāmahe|| 3 bhaṭṭendurājasyaitau
\ed\ p.\ 101 tātaḥ kṣīranidhiḥ svasā jaladhijā bhrātā sureśadrumaḥ saujanyaṃ saha kaustubhena śucitā yasya dvijeśādapi| dhikkarmāṇi sa eva kamburadhunā pāṣaṇḍakāntākare viśrāntaḥ prativāsaraṃ pratigṛhaṃ bhaikṣeṇa kukṣiṃbharaḥ|| 4
janmasthānaṃ maṇigaṇanidhirvāridhirbandhurinduḥ jāmiḥ padmā vapuṣi śucitā viśvavandyo ninādaḥ| bhrātaḥ kambo niravadhukuṭumbo 'pi jātyandhasaṅgāt gehaṃ gehaṃ bhramasi yadaho nāparādhastavāyam|| 5 kayorapyetau
prabalatarataraṅgairdūramutsārito 'pi prathayati tava kīrtiṃ dakṣiṇāvartaśaṅkhaḥ| parikalaya payodhe padmanābhārghyayogyaḥ tava nikaṭaniṣaṇṇaiḥ kṣullakaiḥ ślāghyatā kā|| 6 padmanābhasya
śaṅkhāḥ santi sahasraśo jalanidhervīcicchaṭāghaṭṭitāḥ paryanteṣu luṭhanti ye dalaśataiḥ kalmāṣitakṣmātalāḥ| ekasteṣu sa pāñcajanya udabhūdāścaryabhūtaḥ satāṃ yaḥ saṃvartabharakṣamairmadhuripoḥ śvāsānilaiḥ pūryate|| 7 kaviratnasya
\Colo iti śaṅkhapaddhatiḥ
nadīpaddhatiḥ (30)
kuru gambhīrāśayatāṃ dināni katicidbhavādhṛṣyā| vigatapayodharalakṣmīḥ kasya na caraṇairvilaṅghyāsi|| 1
katipayadivasasthāyī pūro dūrnonnato 'pi caṇḍaravaḥ| taṭini taṭadrumapātanapātakamekaṃ cirasthāyi|| 2
pāyaṃpāyaṃ piba piba payaḥ siñca siñcāṅgamaṅgaṃ bhūyo bhūyaḥ kuru kuru sakhe majjanonmajjanāni| eṣāśeṣaśramaśamapaṭurduḥkhitādhvanyabandhuḥ sindhurdūrībhavati bhavato māravaḥ pāntha pānthāḥ|| 3
praśāntāḥ kallolāḥ stimitamasṛṇaṃ vāri vimalaṃ vinīto 'yaṃ veṣaḥ śamamiva nadīnāṃ kathayati| tathāpyāsāṃ taistaistarubhirabhitastīrapatitaiḥ sa evāgre buddhau paripatati ruddho 'pyavinayaḥ|| 4
ājanmasthitayo mahīraha ime kāmaṃ samunmūlitāḥ kallolāḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgurāḥ punaramī nītāḥ parāmunnatim| antargrāhaparigraho bahirapi bhrāmyanti gandhadvipāḥ bhrātaḥ śoṇo na so 'sti yo na hasati tvatsampado viplavān|| 5 keṣāmapyete
nadītīre śākhinnabhinavataraṅgāgrasalilaiḥ muhurmūle siktaḥ kalayasi dalāḍambaramidam| na caivaṃ jānīṣe sarala yadalaṃ lūnadharaṇiḥ sukhasparśacchanno gurupatanaheturvyatikaraḥ|| 6 siṃhapaiyyasya
\Colo iti nadīpaddhati
saraḥpaddhatiḥ (31)
ayamavasaraḥ saraste salilairupakartumarthināmaniśam| idamapi ca sulabhamambho bhavati purā jaladharābhyudaye|| 1 vallabhadevasya
kasya tṛṣaṃ na kṣapayasi pibati na kastava payo nimajyaitat| yadi sanmārgasarovara nakro na kroḍamadhivasati|| 2 kasyāpi
āgacchantāṃ ca tucchānāmatucchānāṃ ca gacchatām| yadadhvani na saṃghaṭṭo ghaṭānāṃ tadvṛthā saraḥ|| 3 hariharasya
vīcīvimardaśītairyatsukhayatyanilairapi| sarasastasya mādhuryaṃ jñātamevāvagāhane|| 4
yadvalgasyabhito vṛthā taṭabhuvo vīcīśataistāḍayan labdhvā kāścidapi kṣaṇaṃ jaladharodvāntāḥ payovipluṣaḥ| tanmanye bhavatastaḍāga nibiḍakrīḍārkarociścayaspluṣṭāmbuprasaro manāgapi na sa grīṣmaḥ smṛtiṃ rohati|| 5 śrībhojadevasya
sauvarṇaḥ kamalākaraḥ śaśiśilāḥ sopānabaddhakramāḥ vāri kṣīrasahodaraṃ taṭataruśreṇīsukhāḥ koṇayaḥ| sarvaṃ te ruciraṃ sarovara paraṃ nidyaḥ kuto 'yaṃ vidhiḥ krūragrāhabhayātprayānti vimukhāḥ pānthā nidāghe 'pyamī|| 6 vaidyanāthapaṇḍitasya
vipannaṃ padminyā mṛtamanimiṣairyātamalibhiḥ khagairapyuḍḍīnaṃ rathacaraṇahaṃsaprabhṛtibhiḥ| daśāṃ dīnāṃ nīte sarasi viṣamagrīṣmadivasaiḥ kulīnatvādāste taṭaruhataruḥ ko 'pi tadapi|| 7 nāgapaiyyasya
re padmākara yāvadasti bhavato madhye payaḥ pūritaṃ tāvaccakracakorahaṃsakuraraśreṇīḥ samullāsaya| paścāttvaṃ samaṭadbakoṭacaṭulatroṭīpuṭavyāhatitruṭyatkarkaṭakarparavyatikarairnindāspadaṃ yāsyasi|| 8
balīyāṃso haṃsānprasabhamapahatya prabhutayā babhūvuryatkākāḥ kamalavanavāsavyasaninaḥ| taṭasthaḥ pāṭhīnaḥ pariluṭhati kaṅkānkavalayan na jāne kiṃ bhāvyaṃ sarasi viparītavyatikare|| 9 kayorapyetau
stokāmbhaḥparivartitāṅgaśapharagrāsārthinaḥ sarvataḥ lapsyante bakaṭiṭṭibhaprabhṛtayaḥ svalpe 'pi sādhusthitim| sadyaḥśoṣamupāgate 'dya sarasi śrīsadmapadmākare tasminpaṅkajinīvilāsarucayo haṃsāḥ kva yāsyantyamī|| 10 indrakaveḥ
mādyaddiggajadānadigdhakaraṭaprakṣālanātkṣobhitāḥ vyomnaḥ sīmni vicerurapratihatā yasyormayo nirmalāḥ| kaṣṭaṃ bhāgyaviparyayeṇa sarasaḥ kalpāntarasthāyinaḥ tasyāpyekabakapracārakaluṣaṃ kālena jātaṃ jalam|| 11 vijjākāyāḥ
upādhvaṃ tatpānthāḥ kathamapi saromārgatilakaṃ yadāsādya svacchaṃ vilasatha vilīnaklmabharāḥ| itastu kṣīrābdherjaraṭhamakarakṣuṇṇapayasaḥ nivṛttiḥ kalyāṇī na punaravatāraḥ kathamapi|| 12 yāyākasya
\Colo iti saraḥpaddhatiḥ
kamalapaddhatiḥ (32_
antaśchidrāṇi bhūyāṃsi kaṇṭakā bahavo bahiḥ| kathaṃ kamalanālasya mā bhūvanbhaṅgurā guṇāḥ|| 1 bhallaṭasya
lakṣmīsamparkarūpo 'yaṃ doṣaḥ padmasya niścitam| yadeṣa guṇasaṃdohadhāmanīndau parāṅmukhaḥ|| 2 prakāśavarṣasya
prasāritakare mitre jagaduddyotakāriṇi| kiṃ na kairava lajjā te kurvataḥ kośasaṃvṛtim|| 3
ete hi guṇāḥ paṅkaja santo 'pi na te prakāśamāyānti| yallakṣmīvasatestava madhupairupajīvyate kośaḥ|| 4
kiṃ kupyasi kasmaicitsaurabhasārāya kupya nijamadhune| yasya kṛte śatapatra pratipatraṃ mṛgyate madhupaiḥ|| 5
dahyeta nāmbugatamiti padminyā saṃśritaṃ sarastatra| dahatīmāṃ himamathavā kva nu yāti vidheravaskandaḥ|| 6
kiṃ varṇyate 'mbujasya śriyo nivāso yadanvahaṃ devyāḥ| yatsevyate 'rthibhṛṅgairvikasati mitrodaye yacca|| 7
yuktaṃ mitrābhyudaye prītiṃ dveṣaṃ samudvahantvaniśam| kamalāni kairavāṇi ca bhavanti saśrīṇyapaśrīṇi|| 8
makarandarasasyandini padmini manye tavaiva subhagatvam| puṣpavatīmapi bhavatīṃ tyajati na vṛddhaḥ śucirhaṃsaḥ|| 9
kāmaṃ bhavatu madhulampaṭaṣaṭpadāughasaṃghaṭṭaghuṅghumaghanadhvanayo 'bjasaṅghāḥ| gāyatyatiśrutisukhaṃ vidhireva yatra bhṛṅgaḥ sa ko 'pi dharaṇīdharaṇābhipadmaḥ|| 10 śrutadharasya
yanmātā viṣṇunābhiḥ patirapi ca suto yasya sākṣātprajānaṃ lakṣmīryatsaṃśrayābhūdyadapi karatale bhāratī sambabhāra| bhānuryasyāpi mitraṃ tadapi sarasijaṃ kṣīṇamindormayūkhaiḥ trātuṃ naivotsahante gatasukṛtaphalaṃ prāptakālaṃ sahāyāḥ|| 11 kasyāpi
na paṅkādudbhūtirna jaḍasahavāsavyasanitā vapurdigdhaṃ kāntyā sthalanalina ratnadyutimuṣā| vyadhāsyaddurvedhā hṛdayalaghimānaṃ yadi na te tvamevaikaṃ lakṣmyāḥ paramamabhaviṣyaḥ padamiha|| 12 jayavardhanasya
mitronmukhasya vimalasya guṇānvitasya lakṣmīpadasya puruṣottamavallabhasya| kenāśayena jaḍayogamayogyamasya dhātā karoti kamalasya vayaṃ na vidmaḥ|| 13
\Colo iti kamalapaddhatiḥ
vṛkṣapaddhatiḥ (33)
[tatra vṛkṣamātravarṇanam]
śākhāśatacitaviyataḥ santi kiyanto na kānane taravaḥ| parimalabharamiladalikuladalitadalāḥ śākhino viralāḥ|| 1 vaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
dīrgho nidāghasamayo bahupathikajanaśca māravaḥ panthāḥ| mārgasthastarurekaḥ kiyatāṃ saṃtāpamapaharatu|| 2
pānthādhāra iti dvijāśraya iti sthānaṃ guṇānāmiti snigdhacchāya iti priyo dṛśa iti ślāghyastarūṇāmiti| paryālocya mahātaro tava ghanacchāyāṃ vayaṃ saṃśritāḥ tattvatkotaravāsino dvirasanā dūrīkariṣyanti naḥ|| 3 kayorapyetau
kiṃ jāto 'si catuṣpathe ghanataraṃ channo 'si kiṃ chāyayā channaścetphalito 'si kiṃ phalabharairāḍhyo 'si kiṃ sannataḥ| he sadvṛkṣa sahasva samprati sakhe śākhāśikhākarṣaṇakṣobhāmoṭanabhañjanāni janataḥ svaireva duśceṣṭitaiḥ|| 4 bhadantajñānavarmaṇaḥ
gatāste vistīrṇastabakabharasaurabhyalaharīparītavyomānaḥ prakṛtiguravaḥ ke 'pi taravaḥ| ihodyāne sampratyahaha pariśiṣṭāḥ kramavaśāt amī valmīkādyā bhujagakulalīlāvasatayaḥ|| 5
kalyāṇaṃ naḥ kimadhikamito jīvanārthaṃ yadasmān lūtvā vṛkṣānahaha dahasi bhrātaraṅgārakāra| nanvetasminnaśanipiśunairātapairākulānāṃ adhvanyānāmaśaraṇamaruprāntare ko 'bhyupāyaḥ|| 6
āmodairmaruto mṛgāḥ kisalayairlambaistvacā tāpasāḥ puṣpaiḥ ṣaṭcaraṇāḥ phalaiḥ śakunayo gharmārditāśchāyayā| skandhairgandhagajāśca viśramarucaḥ śaśvadvibhaktāstvayā prāptastvaṃ druma bodhisattvapadavīṃ satyaṃ kujātāḥ pare|| 7 keṣāmapyetau
soḍhaprauḍhahimaklamāni śanakaiḥ patrāṇyadhaḥ kurvate sambhāvyacchadavāñchayā hi taravaḥ kecitkṛtaghnavratāḥ| nāmanyanta tadātanīmapi nijacchāyākṣatiṃ taiḥ punaḥ teṣāmeva tale kṛtajñacaritaiḥ śuṣyadbhirevāsyate|| 8 bilhaṇasya
bhuktāni yaistava phalāni pacelimāni kroḍasthitairahaha vītabhayaiḥ prasuptam| te pakṣiṇo jalarayeṇa vikṛsyamāṇaṃ paśyanti pādapa bhavantamamī taṭasthāḥ|| 9 rājapitāmahamahādevasya
\Colo iti vṛkṣamātravarṇanam
[vṛkṣaviśeṣavarṇanam]
kalpavṛkṣaḥ
ślāghyā dhvastādhvagaglāneḥ karīrasya marau sthitiḥ| dhiṅmerau kalpavṛkṣāṇāmavasannārthināṃ śriyaḥ|| 10 kasyāpi
svarṇaiḥ skandhaparigraho marakatairullāsitāḥ pallavāḥ muktābhiḥ stabakaśriyo madhulihāṃ vṛndāni nīlotpalaiḥ| saṃkalpānuvidhāyi yasya phalitaṃ kastasya dhatte tulāṃ dhigjātiṃ drumasaṃkathāsu yadayaṃ kalpadrumo 'pi drumaḥ|| 11 ralhaṇasya
pārijātaḥ
pare paraḥśatāḥ santi mahānto bhavyabhūruhāḥ| pārijāta tvayaikena nandanaṃ nandanaṃ punaḥ|| 12 prahlādanasya
parimalasurabhitanabhaso bahavaḥ kanakādriparisare taravaḥ| tadapi sumanasāṃ nandanamiti satyaṃ pārijātena|| 13 vallabhadevasya
cūtaḥ
gātā kokila eva jñātā ca rasāla eva niyatamidam| yaḥ pañcamamudgāyati yasyāsthiṣu pulakamukulāni|| 14
vahasi balibhujāṃ kulāni maulau yadi sahakāra tadatra ko niṣeddhā| paramudayati pallavāñcaleṣu sphuradalibhistava saurabhaprasiddhiḥ|| 15 kayorapyetau
uttaṃsakautukarasena vilāsinīnāṃ lūnāni yasya na nakhairapi pallavāni| udyānamaṇḍanataro sahakāra sa tvamaṅgārakārakaragocaratāṃ gato 'si|| 16
yo dṛṣṭaḥ sphuṭadasthisampuṭamukhānniryatpravālāṅkuraḥ daivātsa dvidalādikakramavaśādārūḍhaśākhāśataḥ| snigdhaṃ pallavito ghanaṃ mukulitaḥ sphāracchaṭaṃ puṣpitaḥ sotkarṣaṃ phalito bhṛśaṃ vinamitaḥ ko 'pyeṣa cūtadrumaḥ|| 17 harṣasya
mūrtirnetrarasāyanaṃ yadi kutaśchāyeyamacchetarā cakre sāpi tataḥ kutaḥ phalabharaḥ pīyūṣagañjāgṛham| evaṃ sarvaguṇādbhutaṃ yadi bhavānāmradrumaṃ nirmame sarvatra praguṇīkṛtaḥ kathamasau durdaiva dāvānalaḥ|| 18 prahlādanasya
arkāḥ kecana kecidakṣataravaḥ keciddalakṣmāruhāḥ nimbāḥ kecana kecidatra vipine krūrāḥ karīradrumāḥ| mākando makarandatundilamiladbhṛṅgāliśṛṅgāritaḥ ko 'pyatrāsti na mitra yatra tanute karṇāmṛtaṃ kokilaḥ|| 19 umāpatidharasya
etasminvanamārgabhūparisare saundaryamudrāṅkitaḥ prodyadbhiḥ phalapatrapuṣpanivahaiścūtaḥ sa ekaḥ param| yaṃ vīkṣya smitavaktramudgatamahāsaṃtoṣamullāsitasphārotkaṇṭhamakuṇṭhitakramamamī dhāvanti pānthavrajāḥ|| 20 bhaṭṭanāyakasya
viśālaḥ śākhābhiḥ kimapi kamanīyaḥ kisalayaiḥ phalairapyānamraḥ stabakamadhugandhaiḥ surabhitaḥ| tvamevaikaḥ kṣoṇīruhakuladhurīṇo 'si tadayaṃ rasāla prastāvādiha hṛdi nidheyaḥ pikayuvā|| 21 kasyāpi
candanaḥ
dhikceṣṭitāni paraśaḥ pariśocanīyabālapravālamalayādriruhadruhaste| nirbhidyamānahṛdayo 'pi mahāprabhāvaḥ sa tvanmukhaṃ punarabhīḥ surabhīkaroti|| 22
vāsaḥ śailaśilāntareṣu sahajaḥ saṅgo bhujaṅgaiḥ saha preṅkhatkṣārapayodhivīcibhirabhūdudbhūtisekakriyā| jānīmo na vayaṃ prasīdatu bhavāñchrīkhaṇḍa tatkathyatāṃ kasmātte paratāpakhaṇḍanamahāpāṇḍityamabhyāgatam|| 23
āmodaiste diśi diśi gatairdūramākṛṣyamāṇāḥ sākṣāllakṣmīṃ tava malayaja draṣṭumabhyāgatāḥ smaḥ| kiṃ paśyāmaḥ subhaga bhavataḥ krīḍati kroḍa eva vyālastubhyaṃ bhavatu kuśalaṃ muñca naḥ sādhayāmaḥ|| 24
bhrātaścandanapādapa pratidinaṃ paśyedamāceṣṭitaṃ yastvāṃ siñcati śītanīranikaraistasyāvakeśī sadā| evaṃ yastu paraśvadhaiḥ śakalayatyugreṣvatha grāvasu prauḍhaṃ cānupinaṣṭi tasya hi bhaveḥ sarvāṅgamāhlādakaḥ|| 25 keṣāmapyete
bhrātaścandana kiṃ bravīmi vikaṭasphūrjatphaṇābhīṣaṇā gandhasyāpi mahāvipāḥ phaṇabhṛto guptyai yadete kṛtāḥ| daivātpuṣpaphalānvito yadi bhavānagre 'bhaviṣyattadā no jāne kimakalpayiṣyadadhikaṃ rakṣārthamasyātmanaḥ|| 26 śrībhojadevasya
sā chāyā sa ca sundaraḥ parimalaste komalāḥ pallavāḥ bhrātaścandanapādapasya śataśaḥ santyeva kiṃ tairguṇaiḥ| sarpadruṣṭabhujaṅgasaṅgativaśādāpādamūlaṃ gataiḥ ānītaṃ phalamanyato 'pi pathikaiḥ sāśaṅkamāsvādyate|| 27 kasyāpi
campakaḥ
kunde kuṇṭhaya kautukaṃ tyaja ruciṃ nyagrodharoṣagrahe mā yatnaṃ karavīrarohaṇavidhau kārṣīḥ saparyocite| bhrātaḥ kānanapāla campakataruḥ kutrāpyasau mṛgyatāṃ yasyāmodavaśātsmarapriyatamā mādyanti caitraśriyaḥ|| 28 vaidyanāthapaṇḍitasya
kenāpi campakataro bata ropito 'si kugrāmapāmarajanāntikavāṭikāyām| yatra prarūḍhanavaśākavivṛddhalobhādgobhagnavāṭaghaṭanocitapallavo 'si|| 29 vijjākāyāḥ
sādhāraṇatarubuddhyā na mayā racitastavālavālo 'pi| lajjayasi māmidānīṃ campaka saurabhyanirbharaiḥ kusumaiḥ|| 30
aśokaḥ
avakeśino 'sya yuktaṃ jānāmi taroraśoka iti nāma| phalapākavidhuritātmā yato 'nyathāsau saśokaḥ syāt|| 31 kasyāpi
kiṃ te namratayā kimunnatatayā kiṃ vā ghanacchāyayā kiṃ vā pallavalīlayā kimanayā cāśoka puṣpaśriyā| yattvanmūlaniṣaṇṇakhinnapathikastomaḥ stuvannanvahaṃ na svādūni mṛdūni svādati phalānyākuṇṭhamutkaṇṭhitāḥ|| 32 śrībhojadevasya
panasaḥ
gariyaḥ saurabhyaṃ rasaparicaye nārhati sudhā mudhā mṛdvīkāpi prathimani nimagnaḥ phalabharaḥ| parārthe kośaśrīriti pulakitaḥ kaṇṭakamiṣāt aho te cāritraṃ panasa manasaḥ kasya na mude|| 33
nālikeraḥ
prathamavayasi pītaṃ toyamalpaṃ smarantaḥ śirasi nihitabhārā nālikerā narāṇāṃ salilamamṛtakalpaṃ dadyurājīvitāntaṃ na hi kṛtamupakāraṃ sādhavo vismaranti|| 34
kadalī
tālītaroranupakāri phalaṃ phalitvā lajjāvaśāducita eva vināśayogaḥ| etattu citramupakṛtya phalaiḥ parebhyaḥ prāṇānnijāñjhaṭiti yatkadalī jahāti|| 35
dāḍimaḥ
ā puṣpaprasavānmanoharatayā viśvāsya viśvaṃ janaṃ haṃho dāḍima tāvadeva sahase vṛddhiṃ svakīyāmiha| yāvannaiti paropabhogasahatāmeṣā tatastāṃ tathā jñātvā te hṛdayaṃ dvidhā dalati yattenaiva vandyo bhavān|| 36 śrībhojadevasya
bhūrjaḥ
kurvantu nāma janatopakṛtiṃ prasūnacchāyāphalairavikalaiḥ sulabhairdrumaughāḥ| soḍhāstu kartanarujaḥ pararakṣaṇārthameke na bhūrjataruṇā karuṇāpareṇa|| 37 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
aguruḥ
agururiti vadati loko gauravamatraiva punarahaṃ manye| darśitaguṇaiva vṛttiryasya jane janitadāhe 'pi|| 38 vallabhadevasya
mālatī
kusumastabakānamrāḥ santyeva parito latāḥ| athāpi bhramarabhrāntiṃ haratyekaiva mālatī|| 39 kasyāpi
kiṃ mālatīkusuma tāmyasi niṣṭhureṇa kenāpi yatkila vilūnamito latāgrāt| etena śuddhamadhurākṛtigauraveṇa ko nāma mūrdhani nijaṃ na kariṣyati tvām|| 40 nammaiyasya
ketaī
etāsu ketaki latāsu vikāsinīṣu saubhāgyamadbhutataraṃ bhavatī bibharti| yatkaṇṭakairvyathitamātmavapurna jānan tvāmeva sevitumupakramate dvirephaḥ|| 41 rājapitāmahamahādevasya
tālaḥ
adhvanyadhvani bhūruhaḥ phalabhṛto namrānupekṣyādarāt dūrādunnatasaṃśrayavyasaninaḥ pānthasya mugdhātmanaḥ| yanmūaṃ samupāgatasya sa vṛthāchāyaḥ phale kā kathā śīrṇenāpi hi nopayogam=agamatparṇena tāladrumaḥ|| 432 kasyāpi
aśvatthaḥ
vardhitaiḥ sevitaiḥ kiṃ taiḥ satyaśvatthe 'nyapādapaiḥ| vardhito narakādrakṣetspṛṣṭo riṣṭāni hanti yaḥ|| 43 mādhavamāgadhasya
nyagrodhaḥ
phalabharavitatasamunnataśākhāśatalīnaśakunisārthena| jananī kṣitiḥ prakāmaṃ nyagrodhenāstu sacchāyā|| 44 vallabhadevasya
madhūkaḥ
tattejastaraṇernidāghasamaye tadvāri meghāgame tajjāḍyaṃ śiśire madekaśaraṇaiḥ soḍhaṃ purā yairdalaiḥ| āyāto 'pyadhunā phalasya samayaḥ ko 'yaṃ vinā tairiti smṛtvā tāni śuceva roditi galatpuṣpairmadhūkadrumaḥ|| 45 kasyāpi
śālmaliḥ
kāyaḥ kaṇṭakadūṣito na ca ghanacchāyā kutaḥ pallavāḥ puṣpāṇi cyutasaurabhāṇi na daladroṇī manohāriṇī| kiṃ brūmaḥ phalapākamasya yadupanyāse 'pi lajjāmahe tadbhoḥ kena guṇena śālmalitaro jāto 'si sīmadrumaḥ|| 46
nirgandhaṃ kusumaṃ phalaṃ kṣudhi vṛthā patraṃ na kāryakṣamaṃ bāhyaiḥ kaṇṭakakarparaiḥ parivṛtaṃ niḥsārametadvapuḥ| vṛddhirgṛdhraparigrahāya kimaho vaktavyamasmātparaṃ bhrātaḥ śālmalivṛkṣa nāsti bhavataḥ kiṃcinmahattvocitam|| 47 kayorapyetau
babbulaḥ
svayamaphalavāṃśchedaṃ bhedaṃ kṣitau ca vikarṣaṇaṃ kuharapatanaṃ babbūlo 'yaṃ viṣahya vṛtībhavan| khala iva phalānyanyasyāpi prabhūtatarāṇyaho na diśati satāṃ bhoktuṃ dyumānvitaḥ paṭukaṇṭakaiḥ|| 48
nimbaḥ
nimba kiṃ bahunoktena phalāni viphalāni te| yāni saṃjātapākāni kākā niḥśeṣayantyamī|| 49
yaśca nimbaṃ paraśunā yaścainaṃ madhusarpiṣā| yaścainaṃ gandhamālyābhyāṃ sarvasya kaṭureva saḥ|| 50 k.esāmapyete
khadiraḥ
candane viṣadharānsahāmahe vastu sundaramaguptimatkutaḥ| rakṣituṃ vada kimātmasauṣṭhavaṃ kaṇṭakāḥ khadira saṃcitāstvayā|| 51 bhallaṭasya
padaṃ tadiha nāsti yanna khadiraiḥ kharairāvṛtaṃ na te 'pi khadirā na ye kuṭilakaṇṭakairāvṛtāḥ| na te kuṭilakaṇṭakāḥ kimapi ye na marmacchidaḥ tadujhata vṛthā śramaṃ bata sahadhvamadhvaśramam|| 52
śāliḥ
śākhāsantatisanniruddhanabhaso bhūyāsa evāvanau vidyante taravaḥ phalairavikalairārticchidaḥ prāṇinām| kiṃ tu dvitradalairalaṃkṛtatanoḥ śāleḥ stumastuṅgatāṃ dattvā yena nijaṃ śiraḥ sukṛtinā ko nāma na prīṇitaḥ|| 53 nammaiyasya
yena smo janitā vayaṃ pratidinaṃ snehena saṃvardhitāḥ yenāsmāṃstṛṇapīḍanādapi purā soḍhuṃ na śaktastu yaḥ| jñātvā so 'pyadhunā phalasya samayaṃ chettuṃ śiro vāñchati krandantīva tuṣārabāṣpavigaladbindūtkaraiḥ śālayaḥ|| 54
kārpāsaḥ
ślāghyaṃ kārpāsaphalaṃ yasya guṇaiḥ svīkṛtāni vimalāni| muktāphalāni taruṇīkucakalaśe suṣṭhu vilasanti|| 55
niṣpeṣo 'pi ca yasya duḥsahataraḥ kaṣṭaṃ tulārohaṇaṃ grāmyastrīnakhaluñchanavyatikarastantrīpraharavyathā| mātaṅgokṣitamaṇḍavārikaṇikāpānaṃ ca kūrcāhatiḥ kārpāsena parārthasādhanadhiyā kiṃ kiṃ na cāṅgīkṛtam|| 56 keṣāmapyete
śaṇaḥ
bhūrjaḥ paropakṛtaye nijakavacavikartanāṃ sahate| parabandhanāya tu śaṇaḥ prekṣadhvamihāntaraṃ kīdṛk|| 57
dhattūraḥ
maheśastvāṃ dhatte śirasi rasarājasya jayinī viśuddhistvatsaṅgātkanakamayametattribhuvanam| tanoti tvatsevā nanu kanakavṛkṣa tvadaparaḥ parastatko nu syādyadi na sulabhībhāvamabhajaḥ|| 58 prahlādanasya
unmatta kaṇṭakiphalapratiyogibuddhyā vairaṃ vṛthaiva kuruṣe panasena sārdham| santo hasanti na bhajanti bhajanti cettvāṃ bhrāntā bhavanti sahasā na punarbhajanti|| 59
tṛṇam
jātasya sindhutaṭamanu tasya tṛṇasyāpi janma ramaṇīyam| yatsalilamajjadākulajanahastālambanaṃ bhavati|| 60 vallabhadevasya
stambaḥ
uttuṅgaistarubhiḥ kimebhiraphalairākāśasaṃsparśibhiḥ dhanyo 'sau nitarāmulūṣaviṭapo nadyāstaṭe tiṣṭhati| evaṃ yaḥ kṛtabuddhirutthitajalavyālolavīcīvaśāt majjantaṃ janamuddharāmi yadi vā tenaiva majjāmyaham|| rāṇakasya
iti vṛkṣaviśeṣavarṇanam
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vṛkṣapaddhatiḥ
dāvānalapaddhatiḥ (34)
he dāvānala śailāgravāsinaḥ sādhuśākhinaḥ| mugdha vyarthaṃ tvayā dagdhāḥ preritena prabhañjanaiḥ|| 1
vanamanivāritasatraṃ dvijasārthānāṃ vibhinnajātīnām| dahataḥ kṛpīṭayonerjñātaṃ māhātmyametasya|| 2
yasyā mahattvabhājo bhavanti guṇino 'mitā dhanurdaṇḍāḥ| dahatastāṃ vaṃśāliṃ ko vanavahnerviveko 'sya|| 3
abhyunnate 'pi jalade jagadekasārasādhāraṇapraṇayahāriṇi| ullāsalāsyalalitaṃ taravo na yānti he dāvapāvaka sa tāvaka eva doṣaḥ|| 4
vidhvastā mṛgapakṣiṇo vidhuratāṃ nītāḥ sthalīdevatāḥ dhūmairantaritāḥ svabhāvamalinairāśā mahī tāpitā| bhasmīkṛtya sapuṣpapallavaphalānetānmahāpādapān udvṛttena davānalena vipinaṃ valmīkaśeṣaṃ kṛtam|| 5 keṣāmapyete
dikcakraṃ tṛṇabhasmanā malinitaṃ mūlānyapi kṣmāruhāṃ nirdagdhāni na cārbhako 'pi hariṇīyūthe 'vaśeṣīkṛtaḥ| hā kaṣṭaṃ vipinaukaso 'pi munayaḥ pluṣṭāḥ kṛtāntakriyāṃ kṛtvetthaṃ vanavahninā kimamunā śāntena dīptena vā|| 6 umāpatidharasya
ārohatyavanīruhaḥ praviśati śvabhraṃ nagaiḥ spardhate svaṃ vyāleḍhi viceṣṭate kṣititale kuñjodare līyate| antarbhrāmyati koṭarasya vivare vyālambate vīrudhaḥ kiṃ tadyanna karoti mārutavaśaṃ yātaḥ kṛśānurvane|| 7 vasundharasya
digdāhaikarate vanāntakara te jvālā na me rocate dagdhuṃ svāśrayamudyatasya bhavato necchanti vṛddhiṃ janāḥ| mūlānyasya mahībhṛto valayituṃ durvedhasā nirmite ko vā na tvayi śaṅkate sma jagataḥ khedāvahe dāva he|| 8
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyaṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ dāvānalapaddhatiḥ||
marupaddhatiḥ (35)
itaḥ kākānīkaṃ pratibhayamitaḥ kauśikarutāt ito gṛdhravyūhaḥ kulamidamitaḥ kaṅkavayasām| śmaśānāvasthe 'sminnakhilaguṇavandhye hatamarau api dvitrāḥ kecinna khalu kalavācaḥ śakunayaḥ|| 1
gatamatijavādbhrāntaṃ sarvaṃ samutsvanitā ca bhūḥ cirataramaho niḥśvāsāsraiḥ sadainyamavasthitam| kimiva na kṛtaṃ pānthenetthaṃ tathāpi śaṭho maruḥ prakṛtivirasaḥ kaṣṭaṃ yāto manāgapi nārdratām|| 2
kimasi vimanāḥ kiṃ conmādī kṣaṇādapi lakṣyase punarapi punaḥ prekṣāpūrvā na kāścana te kriyāḥ| svayamajaladāṃ jānāno 'pi praviśya marusthalīṃ śiśiramadhuraṃ vāri prāptuṃ yadadhvaga vāñchasi|| 3
dinamavasitaṃ viśrāntāḥ smastvayā marukūpa re paramupakṛtaṃ śeṣaṃ vaktuṃ hriyā na vayaṃ kṣamāḥ| bhavatu sukṛtairadhvanyānāmaśoṣajalo bhavān iyamapi ghanacchāyā bhūyāttavopataṭaṃ śamī|| 4 kasyāpi
parārthe yaḥ pīḍāmanubhavati bhaṅge 'pi madhuraḥ yadīyaḥ sarveṣāmiha khalu vikāro 'pyabhimataḥ| na samprāpto vṛddhiṃ yadi sa bhṛśamakṣetrapatitaḥ kimikṣordoṣo 'sai na punaraguṇāyā marubhuvaḥ|| 5 indurājasya
bho bhoḥ kiṃ kimakāṇḍeva patitastvaṃ pāntha kānyā gatiḥ tattādṛktṛṣitasya te khalamatiḥ so 'yaṃ jalaṃ gūhate| asthānopanatāmakālasulabhāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ prati krudhya bhoḥ trailokyaprathitaprabhāvamahimā panthāḥ punarmāravaḥ|| 6 abhinavaguptasya
āmrāḥ kiṃ phalabhāranamraśiraso ramyāḥ kimūṣmacchidaḥ sacchāyāḥ kadalīdrumāḥ surabhayaḥ kiṃ puṣpitāścampakāḥ| etāstā niravagrahograkarabhollīḍhāvarūḍhāḥ puraḥ śramyo bhrāmyasi mūḍha nirmaruti kiṃ mithyaiva martuṃ marau|| 7 prakāśavarṣasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ marupaddhatiḥ
saṃkīrṇavastuvarṇanapaddhatiḥ (36)
tvaṃ cetsaṃcarase vṛṣeṇa laghutā kā nāma digdantināṃ vyālaiḥ kaṅkaṇakuṇḍalāni kuruṣe hānirna hemnaḥ punaḥ| mūrdhnā cedvahase jaḍāṃśumayaśaḥ kiṃ nāma lokatrayīdīpasyāmbujabāndhavasya jagatāmīśo 'si kiṃ brūmahe|| 1 umāpatidharasya
viṣṇo tvayā dvijapatiṃ vimaladvipakṣaṃ hitvā mahān dvirasane nihitaḥ svabhāraḥ| prāyo vimohitadhiyo na vidanti lakṣmyā niḥśaṃśayaṃ kimiti kāryamakāryametat|| 2 caturmukhamahādevasya
udasyoccaiḥ pucchaṃ śirasi nihitaṃ jīrṇajaṭile yadṛcchāvyāpannadvipapiśitaleśāḥ kavalitāḥ| guhāgarbhe śūnye suciramuṣitaṃ jambuka sakhe tadetatkiṃ kurmo yadasi na gataḥ siṃhasamatām|| 3 bhaṭṭendurājasya
kāntāraṃ parito jvalatyatibale dāvānale daivataḥ gomāyorgahanāṃ guhāṃ paripatandarpoddhuraḥ kesarī| yadvyāpādayati sma taṃ na kṛpayā tenaiṣa tasminvane siṃhānāmabhayaprado 'hamadhunetyutpucchamuddhāvati|| 4 abhinavaguptasya
tatpañcānanakānane vilasitaṃ taddīrṇadantidravanmedaḥkardamakurdanaṃ kṛtamalaṃ tatpānalīlāsaraḥ| āyuḥśeṣatayā tvayā kaluṣitaṃ tatkola manye kṣaṇaṃ tasminkvāpi gate tadīyaśayane svāpaḥ punarnocitaḥ|| 5
niṣkandāmaravindinīṃ sthaphuṭitoddeśāṃ kaśerusthalīṃ jambālāvilamambu kartumitarā sūte varāhī sutān| daṃṣṭrāyāṃ caturarṇavormipaṭalairāplāvitāyāmiyaṃ yasyā eva śiśoḥ sthitā vasumatī sā putriṇī potriṇī|| 6
jambhārireva jānāti rambhāsambhogavibhramam| ghaṭaceṭīviṭaḥ kiṃ nu jānātyamarakāminīm|| 7 keṣāmapyete
dāmodaramudarāhitabhuvanaṃ yo vahati līlayā garuḍaḥ| kasya tarorupariṣṭātkhinno 'sau śrāntimapanayatu|| 8 mālatīmādhavasya
ratirasavardhananandanacandanatarudalanadurnayaśatāni| saṃsahate hariraniśaṃ kenāpi guṇena surakariṇaḥ|| 9
ahirahiriti sambhramapadamitarajanaḥ kimapi kātaro bhavatu| vihagapaterāhāraḥ sa tu sarasamṛṇāladalaruciraḥ|| 10
yadyapi vilasati vāsukiradhirūḍhaḥ śirasi nāma giriśasya| ślāghyataro bhuvanānāṃ tathāpi khalu bharasahaḥ śeṣaḥ|| 11 vallabhadevasya
rohaṇācala śaileṣu kastulāṃ kalayettava| yasya pāṣāṇakhaṇḍāni maṇḍanaṃ medinībhṛtām|| 12
ratnānāṃ na kimālayo jalanidhiḥ kiṃ na sthirā medinī kiṃ na vyoma mahatpadaṃ sukṛtināṃ kiṃ nāma naivonnatam| haṃho rohaṇa kiṃ tu yācakacamūniḥśaṅkaṭaṅkakṣatikṣāntisvīkaraṇena gotratilaka trailokyavandyo bhavān|| 13 kasyāpi
ye saṃtoṣasukhaprabuddhamanasasteṣāmabhinno mṛdaḥ kecidye dhanalobhasaṃkuladhiyasteṣāṃ tu dūre nṛṇām| itthaṃ kasya kṛte kṛtaḥ sa vidhinā tādṛkpadaṃ sampadāṃ svātmanyeva samāptahemamahimā merurna me rocate|| 14 vidyāpateḥ
=== śṛṅgārapaddhatayaḥ
dayitagamanapaddhatiḥ (37)
anaṅgenābalāsaṅgājjitā yena jagattrayī| sa citracaritaḥ kāmaḥ sarvakāmaprado 'stu vaḥ|| 1 kṣemendrasya
dṛśā dagdhaṃ manasijaṃ jīvayanti dṛśaiva yāḥ| virūpākṣasya jayinīstāḥ stuve vāmalocanāḥ|| 2 rājaśekharasya
ganturvivasvadudaye hṛdayeśvarasya pratyūṣapakṣininadaśravabaddhakampā| nidrāṃ jalairaśiśirairnayanāntavāntaiḥ kāntā tadaṃsaśikhare patitairjahāra|| 3
śaknomi nāsitumahaṃ virahābhitapte taptāyasīva vapuṣi kṣaṇamapyamuṣyāḥ| itthaṃ mano niṣadanākṣamavanmṛgākṣyāḥ prātiṣṭhata pravasatā saha vallabhena|| 4 sūktisahasrādetau
lagnā nāṃśukapallave bhujalatā na dvāradeśe 'rpitā no vā pādayuge tayā nipatitaṃ tiṣṭheti noktaṃ vacaḥ| kāle kevalamambudālimaline gantuṃ pravṛttaḥ śaṭhaḥ tanvyā bāṣpajalaughakalpitanadīpūreṇa ruddhaḥ priyaḥ|| 5
dṛṣṭaḥ kātaranetrayā cirataraṃ baddhvāñjaliṃ yācitaḥ paścādaṃśukapallavena vidhṛto nirvyājamāliṅgitaḥ| ityākṣipya yadā samastamaghṛṇo gantuṃ pravṛttaḥ śaṭhaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇaparigraho dayitayā muktastato vallabhaḥ|| 6 amarukasyaitau
praharaviratau madhye vāhnastato 'pi pare 'thavā kimuta sakale yāte vāhni priya tvamihaiṣyasi| iti dinaśataprāpyaṃ deśaṃ priyasya yiyāsato harati gamanaṃ bālā vākyaiḥ sabāṣpajhalajjhalaiḥ|| 7 jhallajjhalavāsudevasya
kānte kathaṃcitkathitaprayāṇe kṣaṇaṃ vinamrā virahārditāṅgī| tatastamālokya kadāgato 'sītyāliṅgya mugdhā mudamāsasāda|| 8
duḥkhāni me niravaśeṣamapaghnatīṃ tvāṃ duḥkhe nidhāya kimahaṃ kalayāmi gantum| pāto 'mbhasāmayamadṛṣṭacarastavākṣṇoḥ pātāya me niyatamadya bhavedasūnām|| 9
kurvāṇaḥ sukṛtāni rakṣyamakhilaṃ rakṣannigṛhṇandviṣaḥ tanvānaśca yaśaḥ sukhena viṣayānbhuṅkte pumānuttamaḥ| anyo jaṅgamakāṣṭhamatra niyataṃ tatsarvamutsāhataḥ labhyaṃ tatkaticiddināni virahaḥ sahyo bhavatyā mama|| 10 sūktisahasrādetau
smartavyā vayamindusundaramukhi prastāvato 'pi tvayā syādevaṃ yadi nātha dāsyati vidhirjātismaratvaṃ mama| ekasminnapi janmani priyatame jātismaratvaṃ kutaḥ prāṇāḥ pāntha saha tvayaiva calitāḥ kvādyāpi janmaikatā|| 11 kasyāpi
lolairlocanavāribhiḥ saśapathaiḥ pādapraṇāmaiḥ paraiḥ anyāstā vinivārayanti kṛpaṇāḥ prāṇeśvaraṃ prasthitam| puṇyāhaṃ vraja maṅgalaṃ sudivasaḥ prātaḥ prayātasya te yatsnehocitamīhitaṃ priya mayā tannirgataḥ śroṣyasi|| 12 amarukasya
etatsarvaṃ śṛṇuta vacanaṃ saṃgrahādatra sakhyaḥ prāṇānāṃ naḥ phalamavikalaṃ nūnameṣā sakhī vaḥ| viśleṣe 'sminpracalati bhṛśaṃ dīpikeva pravāte satyāmasyāṃ vayamatamasaḥ sarvathā rakṣatainām|| 13 sūktisahasrāt
asyāstrāṇamaho viyogaduritādasmāsu kṛtvā kṛtī svairaṃ gacchasi tattu kiṃ vimṛśasi trāsāvahaṃ hanta naḥ| vācāleṣu dineṣu kokilarutairutpañcamaprakramaiḥ sajyotsnāsu ca yāminīṣvaśaraṇāḥ kiṃ nāma kurmo vayam|| 14
kiṃ bhadraṃ pathi gacchatastava vayaṃ brūmaḥ kimasyāḥ svayaṃ prāṇānāmiha gacchatāmiti hi naḥ saṃdehamugdhā dhiyaḥ| kiṃ tu svastiphalapravāsamiha ca pratyāgataṃ naḥ śubhaiḥ tvāṃ paśyema gatāḥ punaḥ kathaya kiṃ prāṇāḥ parāvartinaḥ|| 15 sūktisahasrāt
yadbimboṣṭharuciḥ kva vidrumamaṇiḥ svapne 'pi tāṃ labdhavān hāsaśrīsadṛśaistapobhirapi kiṃ muktāphalairbhūyate| tatkāntiḥ śataśo 'pi vahnipatanairhemnaḥ kutaḥ setsyati tyaktvā ratnamayīṃ prayāsi dayitāṃ kasmai dhanāyādhvaga|| 16|| sūktisahasrāt
tvaṃ jīvitaṃ tvamasi me hṛdayaṃ dvitīyaṃ tvaṃ kaumudī nayanayoramṛtaṃ tvamaṅge| ityādibhiḥ priyaśatairanurudhya tanvīṃ tāmeva śāntamathavā kimataḥ pareṇa|| bhavabhūteḥ
na yāvadvisrambhaṃ ciraparicayādyāti hṛdayaṃ mukhaṃ hastoṣmāṇaṃ na ca niravaśeṣaṃ visṛjati| amī veṇībhaṅgāḥ priyasakhi na yāntyeva samatāṃ tathāpyadyaivāyaṃ mayi niranukampaḥ pravasati|| 18 kasyāpi
prasthānaṃ valayaiḥ kṛtaṃ priyasakhairasrairajasraṃ gataṃ dhṛtyā na kṣaṇamāsitaṃ vyavasitaṃ cittena gantuṃ punaḥ| yātuṃ niścitacetasi priyatame sarve samaṃ prasthitāḥ gantavye sati jīvita priyasuhṛtsārthaḥ kimutsṛjyate|| 19
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ dayitagamanapaddhatiḥ
nikṣipya kāpi śayane vivaśaṃ śarīraṃ saṃviśya tatra jhaṭiti svayameva yatnāt| utthāya saudhamadhiruhya gavākṣarandhraiḥ patyurvilokya padavīṃ bhajati pramoham|| 1||
śrutvā bahiḥ kvacana kaṃcana kāpi śabdaṃ matvā nivartanamaho dayitasya mugdhā| talpādudīya ca niyamya ca pārśvaśabdān dhatte tataḥ śrutimanalpakutūhalākṣī|| 2|| sūktisahasrādetau||
sā toraṇāntikamupetya diśo vilokya niḥśvasya dīrghamupadhāya karaṃ kapole| matvātha taṃ purata eva sasambhramābhūt jñātvā mṛṣā ca likhiteva na kiṃ kimāsīt|| 3|| pṛthvīdharasya||
tasyāḥ stanāntare nyastaṃ candanaṃ tāpaśoṣitam| manobhavāgnidagdhasya babhau bhasmeva cetasaḥ|| 4|| kasyāpi||
khaṇḍitā mā bhavantvetāḥ kadāpītyanukampayā| nadīrninīṣatīvābdhiṃ sāśrupūrairnirantaraiḥ|| 5 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya||
tāpāpanodadakṣāṇi mṛṇālāni natabhruvaḥ| nābhūvandīrghasūtrebhyo vāñchitaṃ prāpyate kutaḥ|| 6 bhaṭṭavṛddheḥ||
dahyamāne 'pi hṛdaye mṛgākṣyā manmathāgninā| snehastathaiva yattasthau tadāścaryamivābhavat|| 7 śakavṛddheḥ|
likhati na gaṇayati rekhā nirbharabāṣpāmbudhautamaṇḍatalā| avadhidivasāvasānaṃ mā bhūditi śaṅkitā bālā|| 8 morikāyāḥ||
duḥkhāni saṃdiśantyāstasyāḥ kaṇṭhaṃ muhurmuhurbāṣpaḥ| svalpāvaśeṣajīvitanirvāṇabhiyeva niruṇaddhi|| 9 bhaṭṭabāṇasya|
nalinīdalamāhitaṃ sakhībhiḥ paritāpopaśamāya yadyadaṅge| akṛtapratikāralajjayeva parito mlānimupaiti tattadasyāḥ|| 10 kasyāpi|
madakalakalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhanādavyatikarabhairavadiṅmukhāni tanvī| kathamiva gamayedvidagdhamalīparimalakañcukitāni vāsarāṇi|| 11 taruṇabāṇasya|
paricyutastatkucabhāramadhyātkiṃ śoṣamāyāsi mṛṇālahāra| na sūkṣmatantorapi tāvakasya tatrāvakāśo bhavataḥ kimu syāt|| 12 śrīharṣasya|
vivṛddhatāpopaśamārthamaṅge nyastaṃ yadindīvaradāma tasyāḥ| mukteṣuṇā pañcaśareṇa bhāti vyāpāritaṃ dhautamivāsipatram|| 13 devaguptasya|
parimṛditamṛṇālīmlānamaṅgaṃ pravṛttiḥ kathamapi parivāraprārthanābhiḥ kriyāsu| kalayati ca hiṃāṃśorniṣkalaṅkasya lakṣmīṃ abhinavakaridantacchedagauraḥ kapolaḥ|| 14 bhavabhūteḥ|
madanadahanaśuṣyatkāntakāntākucāntaḥ navamalayajapaṅke gāḍhabaddhākhilāṅghriḥ| upari vivṛtapakṣo lakṣyate 'lirnimagnaḥ śara iva kusumeṣoreṣa puṅkhāvaśeṣaḥ|| 15 kasyāpi
astraṃ vimucya sakalaṃ prathamaprayoge bhūyo 'pi hantumabalāṃ vihitodyamasya| puṣpāyudhasya vapureva tadīyamekaṃ lakṣaṃ ca hanta śaradhiśca tadā babhūva|| 16
sthitamurasi viśālaṃ padminīpattrametat kathayati na tathāntarmanmathotthāmavasthām| atiśayaparitāpamlāpitābhyāṃ yathāsyāḥ stanayugapariṇāhaṃ maṇḍalābhyāṃ bravīti|| 17
parimlānaṃ pīnastanajaghanasaṅgādubhayataḥ tanormadhyasyāntaḥ parimilanamaprāpya haritam| idaṃ vyastanyāsaṃ ślathabhujalatākṣepavalanaiḥ kṛśāṅgyāḥ saṃtāpaṃ vadati bisinīpattraśayanam|| 18 śrīharṣasyaitau|
yadetannetrāmbhaḥ patadapi samāsādya taruṇīkapole vyāsaṅgaṃ kucakalaśamasyāḥ kalayati| punaḥ śroṇībimbaṃ samucitavilāsaṃ taducitaṃ svabhāvasvacchānāṃ vipadapi sukhaṃ danturayati|| 19 kasyāpi
tanvaṅgyā gurusannidhau nayanayoryadvāri saṃstambhitaṃ tenāntargalitena manmathaśikhī sikto viyogodbhavaḥ| manye tasya nirasyamānakiraṇasyaiṣā mukhenodgatā śvāsāyāsasamāgatālisaraṇivyājena dhūmāvalī|| 20 amarukasya|
etasyā virahajvaraḥ karatalasparśaiḥ parīkṣyo na yaḥ snigdhenāpi sakhījanena bhayataḥ prasthampacaḥ pāthasām| niḥśaktīkṛtacandanauṣadhavidhau tasmiṃstaḍatkāriṇaḥ lājasphoṭamamī sphuṭanti maṇayo viśve 'pi hārasrajaḥ|| 21 rājaśekharasya
vaktre yāṃ mṛganābhipaṅkaracanāṃ khinneva dhatte paraṃ yasyāḥ sāndramuraḥsthale nipatitaṃ bhārāyate candanam| aṅgānyapyatilālasā vahati yā kleśena tasyāmapi nyastaḥ śokabharo 'paraḥ kathamaho nistriṃśatā vedhasaḥ|| 22 śrībhānuṣeṇasya
mugdhā svapnasamāgate priyatame tatpāṇisaṃsparśanaṃ romāñcāṅkitayā śarīralatayā sambhāvya roṣātkila| mā mā vallabha saṃspṛśeti sahasā śūnyaṃ vadantī muhuḥ sakhyā no hasitā sacintamasakṛtsaṃśocitā pratyuta|| 23 rudrasya
asminvarṣamahe na vartata idaṃ yatkāmadevotsave stheyaṃ putri nirannayā tadadhunā kiṃcinmukhe dīyatām| ityukte jaratījanena kathamapyadhvanyavadhvā tataḥ paryaste 'hani kalpitaśca kavalo dhautaśca dhārāśrubhiḥ|| 24 kasyāpi
viśrānto divasaḥ prapañcitarutairvācālitaḥ kokilaiḥ sakhyaḥ samprati nirbhayāsmi jahata prāṇeṣu me saṃśayam| ityante divasasya hanta vigatatrāsāmivābhāṣiṇīṃ jyotsnākairavabhairavo nayati tāṃ mohaṃ pradoṣo hataḥ|| 25 sūktisahasrāt
śīghraṃ bhūmigṛhe gṛhāṇa vasatiṃ prāṇaiḥ kimu krīḍasi prāptāṃ paśyasi naiva daivahatike jyotsnāṃ gavākṣodare| itthaṃ manmathatīvrasaṃjvarajuṣāṃ geheṣu vāmabhruvāṃ udgacchanti kuraṅgalāñchanabhayāddīnāḥ sakhīnāṃ giraḥ|| 26 bilhaṇasya
bhrātaḥ pāntha pathi tvayā tu pathikaḥ kaścitsamāsāditaḥ bāle naikaśatāni kīdṛśa iti prakhyāpyatāṃ vallabhaḥ| yaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramadājanasya bhavataḥ sphāre mudā locane sa jñeyo dayito mameti pathikāyāvedya mohaṃ gatā|| 27 kasyāpi
abhyarthya sapraṇati mandiramabhyupetā devī svayaṃ bhagavatī pṛthageva tāsām| āsannavallabhasamāgamasūcanāni saṃjīvanāni vacanānyapi vācitāni|| 28 sūktisahasrāt|
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ virahiṇyavasthāvarṇanapaddhatiḥ||
yatsambhāṣaṇalālaseva kuruṣe vaktrendumardhānataṃ dhatse bāhulatārgalānkucataṭe niṣkrāntabhītyeva yat| kiṃ vā mantrayate jano 'yamiti yatsarvatra śaṅkākulā tajjñātaṃ hṛdi ko 'pi tiṣṭhati yuvā prauḍhaśca gūḍhaśca te|| 1 bilhaṇasya
yattālīdalapākapāṇḍu vadanaṃ yannetrayordurdinaṃ gaṇḍaḥ pāṇiniṣevaṇācca yadayaṃ saṃkrāntapañcāṅguliḥ| gaurī krudhyatu vartate yadi na te tatko 'pi citte yuvā dhigdhiktvāṃ sahapāṃsukhelanasakhīloke 'pi yannihnavaḥ|| 2
āhāre viratiḥ samagraviṣayagrāme nivṛttiḥ parā nāsāgre nayanaṃ yadetadaparaṃ yaccaikaniṣṭhaṃ manaḥ| maunaṃ cedamidaṃ ca śūnyamakhilaṃ yadviśvamābhāṣase brūyāstvaṃ sakhi yoginī kimasi bhoḥ kiṃ vā viyoginyasi|| 3 rājaśekharasya
alasavalitaiḥ premārdrādrairmuhurmukulīkṛtaiḥ kṣaṇamabhimukhairlajjālolairnimeṣaparāṅmukhaiḥ| hṛdayanihitaṃ bhāvākūtaṃ vamadbhirivekṣaṇaiḥ kathaya sukṛtī ko 'yaṃ mugdhe tvayādya vilokyate|| amarukasya
ujjṛmbhānanamullasatkucataṭaṃ loladbhramadbhrūlataṃ svedāmbhasnapitāṅgayaṣṭi vigaladvrīḍaṃ saromāñcayā| dhanyaḥ ko 'pi yuvā sa yasya vadane vyāpāritāḥ sāmprataṃ mugdhe dugdhamahābdhiphenapaṭalaprakhyāḥ kaṭākṣacchaṭāḥ|| 5 dhanikasya
abhyaste 'pi nitambabhāraphalake svedālaseyaṃ gatiḥ kiṃcitsaṃvalitārdhapakṣmaviralālokā dṛśo 'ntargatāḥ| tanmanye nibhṛtaṃ tvayādya hṛdaye kaściddhṛto vallabhaḥ niśvāsāḥ kathamanyathā dviguṇatāmete tavaivaṃ gatāḥ|| 6 kasyāpi
bhagini madanaḥ śrīmāneṣa tvayā yadi likhyate kimapi sumukhi vyagrāsīti vrahāmi nijālayam| yadapi makaro 'dhastātpauṣpaṃ kare ca śarāsanaṃ tadapi parito dṛṣṭirdeyā janaḥ sakhi nāgaraḥ|| 7
bāle priyeṇa virahāttava karśitāyāḥ hastacyutaṃ valayametadalabdhadeśam| haste punaḥ sthitimagādidamaṅgulīyaṃ sthānacyutirmahata eva bhavatyanarthaḥ|| 8
mugdhe kaṃ hṛdaye nidhāya suciraṃ rogāñcitāṅgī muhuḥ jṛmbhāmantharatārakāṃ salalitāpāṅgāṃ dadhānā dṛśam| suptevālikhiteva śūnyahṛdayā lekhāvaśeṣībhavasyātmadrohiṇi kiṃ hriyā kathaya me gūḍho nihanti smaraḥ|| 9 kasyāpi
ko dhanyaḥ sakhi susthitena manasā ko vedhasā nirmitaḥ kaḥ preyānmadanasya kasya phalitaḥ prācīnapuṇyadrumaḥ| etadyasya kṛte divānaśamaviśrāntaḥ skhaladvāribhiḥ maunollocanagaḍḍugaiḥ snapayase vakṣojaliṅgadvayam|| 10
pakṣmāgragrathitāśrubindunikarairmuktāphalaspardhibhiḥ kurvantyā harahāsahāri hṛdaye hārāvalībhūṣaṇam| bāle bālamṛṇālanālavalayālaṃkārakānte kare vinyasyānanamāyatākṣi sukṛtī ko 'yaṃ tvayā smaryate|| 11
viśrānto divasastaṭīmayamaṭatyastācalasyāṃśumān sampratyaṅkuritāndhakārapaṭalairlambālakā dyaurabhūt| ehyantarviśa veśmanaḥ śaśimukhi dvārasthalītoraṇastambhālambitabāhuvalli rudatī kiṃ tvaṃ pathaḥ paśyasi|| 12 rudatibrāhmaṇasya
gopāyantī virahajanitaṃ duḥkhamagre gurūṇāṃ kiṃ tvaṃ mugdhe nayanavisṛtaṃ bāṣpapūraṃ ruṇatsi| naktaṃ naktaṃ nayanasalilaireṣa ārdrīkṛtaste śayyopāntaḥ kathayati daśāmātape śoṣyamāṇaḥ|| 13 mārulāyāḥ
mūkībhūtāḥ pikayuvatayaḥ kiṃ vasante 'pi tasmin kiṃ jāto 'sau malayamarutāṃ duṣpraveśaḥ pradeśaḥ| kiṃ vā tasminnamṛtamahaso na plavante mayūkhāḥ yatrāvāsaṃ kṛśatanu tava svāntacoraḥ karoti|| 14
bāle naite payodāḥ surapatikariṇo no bakāḥ kaṇṭhaśaṅkhāḥ saudāminyo 'pi naitāḥ kanakamayamidaṃ maṇḍanaṃ kumbhapīṭhe| naitattoyaṃ vikīrṇaṃ patati madajalaṃ śvāsavātāvadhūtaṃ tatkiṃ mugdhe vṛthaivaṃ malinayasi mukhaṃ prāvṛtītyaśrupātaiḥ|| 15 kayorapyetau
sphurati yadidamuccairlocanaṃ subhru vāmaṃ stanataṭamapi dhatte cāru romāñcamālam| kalayati ca yadantaḥkampitāmūrukāṇḍaṃ nanu vadati tadadya preyasā saṃgamaṃ te|| 16
\Colo iti śrīmadārohajabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ sakhīpraśnapaddhatiḥ|
śalyāni marmaṇyapi kīlitāni galantyayaskāntamaṇeḥ prabhāvāt| hṛdi praviṣṭasya punarjanasya na labhyate nirgamanābhyupāyaḥ|| 1 bilhāṇasya
svayamajñātaduḥkho yaḥ sa dunoti na vismayaḥ| tvaṃ smara prāptadāho 'pi dahasīti kimucyate|| 2
aratiriyamupaiti māṃ na nidrā gaṇayati tasya guṇānmano na doṣān| vigalati rajanī na saṃgamāśā vrajati tanustanutāṃ na cānurāgaḥ|| 3 kayorapyetau
idānīṃ tīvrābhirdahana iva bhābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ mamāścaryaṃ sūryaḥ kimu sakhi rajanyāmudayate| ayaṃ mugdhe candraḥ kimiti mayi tāpaṃ prakaṭayati anāthānāṃ bāle kimiva viparītaṃ na bhavati|| 4 puṣṭiṃkarasya|
kālaṃ purā garalamambunidherudasthāt adyendunāma dhavalaṃ viṣamabhyudeti| adyādidaṃ sa giriśo yadi hanta hanyāt kārṣṇyaṃ svakaṇṭhanihitaṃ sakhi madbhayaṃ ca|| utprekṣāvallabhasya
mugdhasya te vada vidhuntuda kiṃ bhaṇāmi kiṃ muktavānasi mukhe patitaṃ śaśāṅkam| asyaiva bimbagalitena sudhārasena sandhānameṣyati kathaṃ na jaratkabandhaḥ|| 6
kṣoṇībhṛtkaṭakaprayāṇasamaye premākulā preyasī hastanyastaviśuddhataṇḍulakaṇāndātuṃ śirasyāgatā| saṃsvedādvirahānalātkarayuge jātaṃ ca pakvodanaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā gurusannidhau kṛtavatī nīrājanaṃ lajjayā|| 7
candro na cedvrajati tatsakhi kiṃcideva cakraṃ kathaṃcidapasāraya tārakāṇām| etāḥ kadācidaśubhaiḥ patikhaṇḍitānāṃ piṇḍatvametya racayanti vidhuṃ dvitīyam|| 8
jyotsnāṃ pibeyuḥ kiyatīṃ kiṃ nātra dhātrā kariṇo niyuktāḥ| śīghraṃ yadeṣāṃ karapūraṇena jāyeta candraḥ prabhayā vihīnaḥ|| 9 bilhaṇasyaite
kiṃ te na santi girayaḥ śikhareṣu yeṣāṃ utsaṅgalolataḍito viharanti meghāḥ| kiṃ tasya vartmani na santi vanāni tāni prasthānasāhasarasaikaparāyaṇasya|| 10 ayaṃ jayatuṅgodayāt
niśvāsaiḥ saha sāmprataṃ sakhi gatā vṛddhiṃ dhruvaṃ rātrayaḥ sārdhaṃ locanavāriṇā vigalitaṃ tatprāktanaṃ me sukham| prāṇāśā tanutāmupaiti ca muhurnūnaṃ tanuspardhayā kandarpaḥ parameka eva vijayī yāte 'tra kānte sthitaḥ|| 11 rudrasya
śvāso bāṣpataraṅgitaḥ sakaruṇā mārge ca netrārpaṇā kenedaṃ na kṛtaṃ priyasya virahe kasyāsavo nirgatāḥ| sakhyevaṃ yadi tena nāsmi kathitā pānthaḥ kathaṃ proṣitaḥ prāṇāḥ samprati me kalaṅkamalināstiṣṭhantu vā yāntu vā|| 12
yāsyāmīti samudyatasya gaditaṃ visrabdhamākarṇitaṃ gacchandūramupekṣito muhurasau vyāvṛtya tiṣṭhannapi| tacchūnye punarāsthitāsmi bhavane prāṇasta ete dṛḍhāḥ sakhyastiṣṭhata jīvitavyasaninī dambhādahaṃ rodimi|| 13
yātrāmaṅgalasaṃvidhānaracanāvyagre sakhīnāṃ gaṇe bāṣpāmbhaḥpihitekṣaṇe gurujane tadvatsuhṛnmaṇḍale| prāṇeśasya madīkṣaṇārpitadṛśaḥ kṛcchrādatikrāmataḥ kiṃ vrīḍājaḍayā mayā bhujalatāpāśā na kaṇṭhe 'rpitaḥ|| 14
svapnenādya mayā puraḥ priyatamo dṛṣṭaścirādāgataḥ yatnenāpyanukūlayannapi mayā mānānna sambhāvitaḥ| paścādyāvadupaimi manmathapathārūḍhā tamāliṅgituṃ tāvanme sahasaiva mṛtyusadṛśaḥ prāptaḥ prabodhodayaḥ|| 15 keṣāmapyete
gato 'staṃ gharmāṃśurvraja sahacarīnīḍamadhunā sukhaṃ supyā bhrātaḥ svajanacaritaṃ vāyasa kṛtam| mayi snehādbāṣpasthagitanayanāyāṃ gataghṛṇaḥ rudantyāṃ yo yātastvayi sa vilapatyeṣyati katham|| 16 śivasvāminaḥ
durvārāḥ smarasāyakāḥ priyatamo dūre mano 'tyutsukaṃ gāḍhaṃ prema navaṃ vayo 'tikaṭhināḥ prāṇāḥ kulaṃ nirmalam| strītvaṃ dhairyavirodhi manmathasuhṛtkālaḥ kṛtānto 'kṣamī soḍhavyāḥ sakhi sāmprataṃ kathamamī sarve 'gnayo duḥsahāḥ|| 17 bhaṭṭamayūraśaṃkarasya
prasaraśiśirāmodaṃ mandaṃ samīra samīraya prakaṭaya śaśinnāśāḥ kāmaṃ manobhava jṛmbhatām| avadhidivasaḥ pūrṇaḥ sakhyo vimuñcata tatkathāṃ hṛdayamadhunā kiṃcitkartuṃ mamānyadihecchati|| 18 rudrasya
avadhidivasaḥ prāptaścāyaṃ tanorvirahasya vā ravirayamupaityastaṃ sakhyo mamāpi ca jīvitam| tadalamaphalairāśābandhaiḥ prasīda namo 'stu te hṛdaya sahasā pākotpīḍaṃ viḍambaya dāḍimam|| 19 kṣemendrasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ virahiṇīpralāpapaddhatiḥ||
durvārāṃ kusumaśaravyathāṃ vahantyā tanvaṅgyā yadabhihitaṃ puraḥ sakhīnām| tadbhūyaḥ śukaśuśusārikābhiruktaṃ dhanyānāṃ śravaṇapathātithitvameti|| 1|| śrīharṣasya
viraktamanyapramadānuraktaṃ vimuktadākṣiṇyalavaṃ śaṭhaṃ ca| yā saṃvṛṇīte khalu dūtikā sā ko 'syāḥ samapremṇi jane prakarṣaḥ|| 2
āpūjitaivāstu girīndrakanyā kiṃ pakṣapātena manobhavasya| yadyasti dūtī sarasoktidakṣā nāthaḥ patetpādatale vadhūnām|| 3
tasya tvayā karkarśavādino 'pi prakāśanīyaṃ masṛṇatvameva| premṇo 'sti bhagnasya na hi prarohaḥ puṣpasya vṛntādiva vicyutasya|| 4
sā dūti dhatte yadi roṣaṇatvaṃ taddūṣaṇatvena na śaṅkanīyam| sādhutvamāyāti rasāntareṇa karambitā puṇḍrakaśarkarāpi|| 5
vṛthā gāthāślokairalamalamalīkāṃ mama rujaṃ kadāciddhūrto 'yaṃ kavivacanamityākalayati| idaṃ pārśve tasya prahiṇu sakhi lagnāñjanalavasravadbāṣpotpīḍagrathitālipi tāṭaṅkayugalam|| 6 bilhaṇasyaite
prāṇeśa vijñaptiriyaṃ madīyā tatraiva neyā divasāḥ kiyantaḥ| sampratyayogyasthitireṣa deśaḥ karā yadindorapi tāpayanti|| 7 utprekṣāvallabhasya
ullaṅghyāpi sakhīvacaḥ samucitāmunmūlya lajjāmalaṃ bhittvā bhītibharaṃ mirasya(?) ca nijaṃ saubhāgyagarvaṃ manāk| ājñāṃ kevalameva manathagurorādāya nūnaṃ mayā tvaṃ niḥśeṣavilāsivargagaṇanācūḍāmaṇiḥ saṃśritaḥ|| 8 rudrasya
patraṃ na śravaṇe 'sti bāṣpaguruṇorno netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ rāgo nādharapallave caraṇayoryugme na cālaktakaḥ| vārtocchittiṣu niṣṭhureti bhavatā mithyaiva sambhāvyate sā lekhaṃ likhatu cyutopakaraṇā nyāyena kenādhunā|| 9 amarukasya
jīvāmīti viyoginī yadi likhettenaiva vṛthāḥ kathāḥ adya śvo 'tha mariṣyatīti maraṇe kālātyayaḥ kiṃ kṛtaḥ| āgantavyamiheti samprati punaḥ sambhāvanā niṣphalā dūti tvaṃ tamupaihi nāsti likhitaṃ tadbrūhi yattatkṣamam|| 10 lohitakasya
dūti tvaṃ taruṇī yuvā sa capalaḥ śyāmastamobhirdiśaḥ saṃdeśaḥ sa rahasya eva vijane saṃketakāvāsakaḥ| bhūyo bhūya ime vasantamarutaśceto nayantyanyataḥ gaccha kṣiprasamāgamāya nipuṇaṃ rakṣantu te devatāḥ|| 11 śilābhaṭṭārikāyāḥ
\Colo iti vipralambhe dūtīpreṣaṇapaddhatiḥ||
priyāvirahitasyāsya hṛdi cintā samāgatā| iti matvā gatā nidrā ke kṛtaghnamupāsate|| 1 kasyāpi
gamanamalasaṃ śūnyā dṛṣṭiḥ śarīramasauṣṭhavaṃ śvasitamadhikaṃ kiṃ nvetatsyātkimanyadato 'thavā| bhramati bhuvane kandarpājñā vikāri ca yauvanaṃ lalitamadhurāste te bhāvāḥ kṣipanti ca dhīratām|| 2
yadindāvānandaṃ praṇayini jane vā na bhajate vyanaktyantastāpaṃ tadayamatidhīro 'pi gahanam| priyaṅguśyāmāṅgaprakṛtirapi cāpāṇḍumadhuraṃ vapuḥ kṣāmaṃ kṣāmaṃ vahati ramaṇīyaśca bhavati|| 3
dhatte cakṣurmukulini raṇatkokile bālacūte mārge gātraṃ kṣipati bakulāmodagarbhasya vāyoḥ| dāvapremṇā sarasabisinīpatramātrāntarīyaḥ tāmyanmūrtiḥ śrayati bahuśo mṛtyave candrapādān|| 4 ete bhavabhūteḥ|
pratyādiṣṭaviśeṣamaṇḍanavidhirvāmaprakoṣṭhe ślathaṃ bibhratkāñcanamekameva valayaṃ śvāsāparaktādharaḥ| cintājāgaraṇapratāntanayanastejoguṇādātmanaḥ saṃskārollikhito mahāmaṇiriva kṣīṇo 'pi no lakṣyate|| 5
ramyaṃ dveṣṭi yathā purā prakṛtibhirna pratyahaṃ sevyate śayyopāntavivartanairvigamayatyunnidra eva kṣapāḥ| dākṣiṇyena dadāti vācamucitāmantaḥpurebhyo yathā gotrebhyaḥ skhalitastathā bhavati ca vrīḍāvanamraściram|| 6 kālidāsasyaitau
hṛdyodyānamaruttaraṅgitasarastīre tarūṇāmaghaḥ talpe 'nalpasarojinīnavadalaprāye 'pi khinnātmanaḥ| dhīrasyāpi manāṅmanastṛṇakuṭīkoṇāntarāle balāt lagno 'syeti vibhāvyate paravaśairaṅgairanaṅgānalaḥ|| 7
karpūrāmbuniṣekabhāji sarasairambhojinīnāṃ dalaiḥ āstīrṇe 'pi vivartamānavapuṣoḥ srastasraji srastare| mandonmeṣadṛśoḥ kimanyadabhavatsā kāpyavasthā tayoḥ yasyāṃ candanacandracampakadalaśreṇyādi vahnīyate|| 8 trivikramabhaṭṭasyaitau
sā tanvīti ghanastanīti vikasallīlābhanetreti ca svairaṃ saṃcaratīti vakti madhurāṃ vācaṃ vicitrāmapi| itthaṃ vidrumapāṭalādharapuṭāṃ sīmantinīṃ dhāyataḥ romāñco ruditaṃ smitaṃ pralapitaṃ pānthasya saṃjāyate|| 9
deśairantaritaḥ śataiśca saritāmurvīruhāṃ kānanaiḥ yatnenāpi na yāti locanapathaṃ kānteti jānannapi| idgrīvaścaraṇārdharuddhavasudhaḥ kṛtvāśrupūrṇe dṛśau tāmāśāṃ pathikastathāpi kimapi dhyāyanmuhurvīkṣate|| 10 amarukasya
\Colo iti vipralambhe viyogino 'vasthāpaddhatiḥ||
bāṇāḥ pañca manobhavasya niyatāsteṣāmasaṅkhyo janaḥ prāyo 'smadvidha eva lakṣyamiti yalloke prasiddhiṃ gatam| dṛṣṭaṃ tattvayi vipratīpamadhunā yasmādasaṅkhyairayaṃ viddhaḥ kāmijanaḥ śarairaśaraṇo nītastvayā pañcatām|| 1 śrīharṣasya
aho ahaṃ namo mahyaṃ yadahaṃ vīkṣito 'nayā| bālayā trastasāraṅgacapalāyatanetrayā|| 2 biyyākasya
sā dṛṣṭā yairna dṛṣṭā vā muṣitāḥ samameva te| hṛtaṃ hṛdayamekeṣāmanyeṣāṃ cakṣuṣaḥ phalam|| 3 prabhākaradevasya
divyacakṣurahaṃ jātaḥ sarāgeṇāpi cetasā| ihastho yena paśyāmi deśāntaragatāṃ priyām|| 4 dhairyamitrasya
strīti śrute gataṃ dhairyaṃ surūpeti kimucyate| kaṣṭaṃ sahṛdayā sā cetsaspṛhetyatiduḥsaham|| 5
sābhiprāyaṃ praṇayasarasaṃ prauḍhamārūḍharāgaṃ paśyantī māṃ vikacakamalaśrīmuṣā locanena| sakhyāḥ karṇe kimapi kimapi vyāharantī hasantī mandaṃ mandaṃ lalitalalitaṃ mandiraṃ sā jagāma|| 6 vaidyacakravartinaḥ
aviditaparavedano manobhūrdhruvamayamevamanaṅga eva nityam| yadi punarabhaviṣyadasya cāṅgaṃ na khalu tadāvyathayiṣyadanyadeham|| 7 kasyāpi
abhimukhe mayi saṃhṛtamīkṣitaṃ hasitamanyanimittakathodayam| vinayabādhitavṛttiratastayā na vivṛto madano na ca saṃvṛtaḥ|| 8
snigdhaṃ vīkṣitamanyato 'pi nayane yatprerayantyā tayā yātaṃ yacca nitambayorgurutayā mandaṃ vilāsādiva| mā gā ityavaruddhayā yadapi sā sāsūyamuktā sakhī sarvaṃ tatkila matparāyaṇamaho kāmī svatāṃ paśyati|| 9
kiṃ pakvaṃ sukṛtaṃ kimaṃha iti me nādyāpi saṃvedyate tanvyāścetasi kiṃsvidasmi kalitaḥ kiṃ neti naiva sphuṭam| etatkiṃcidabhūttadā mayi sakṛtkṛtvā kaṭākṣaṃ tataḥ snigdhavyākulalocanaṃ taralayā sakhyastayā vīkṣitāḥ|| 10 madālasakuvalayānnāṭakāt
līlātāṇḍavitabhru vibhramacaladvaktraṃ kuraṅgīdṛśā sākūtaṃ ca sakautukaṃ ca suciraṃ nyastāḥ kilāsmānprati| nīlābjavyatimiśraketakidaladrāghīyasīnāṃ srajāṃ sodaryaḥ suhṛdaḥ smarasya sudhayā digdhāḥ kaṭākṣacchaṭāḥ|| 11 kasyāpi
tarattāraṃ tāvatprathamamatha citrārpitamiva kramādevāpāṅge sahajamiva līlāmukulitam| tataḥ kiṃcitphullaṃ tadanu ghanabāṣpāmbulaharīparikṣāmaṃ cakṣuḥ patatu mayi tasyā mṛgadṛśaḥ|| 12 vīryamitrasya
premārdrāḥ praṇayaspṛśaḥ paricayādudgāḍharāgodayāḥ tāstā mugdhadṛśo nisargamadhurāśceṣṭā bhaveyurmayi| yāsvantaḥkaraṇasya bāhyakaraṇavyāpārarodhī kṣaṇāt āśaṃsāparikalpitāsvapi bhavatyānandasāndro layaḥ|| 13
sambhūyaiva sukhāni cetasi paraṃ bhūmānamātanvate yatrālokapathāvatāriṇi ratiṃ prastauti netrotsavaḥ| yadbālendukaloccayādapacitaiḥ sārairivotpāditaṃ tatpaśyeyamanaṅgamaṅgalagṛhaṃ bhūyo 'pi tasyā mukham|| 14 etau bhavabhūteḥ
yadaivārabhyāntaḥ padamupahitaṃ pakṣmaladṛśā tadaivedaṃ cetaḥ kvacidapi na ramye 'pi ramate| idaṃ cānyajjātaṃ smaraṇapunaruktavyasaninaḥ tadākārāḥ sarve mama khalu padārthāḥ pariṇatāḥ|| 15
yatsārairiva paṅkajasya ghaṭitaṃ yaccandragarbhādiva protkīrṇaṃ yadanaṅgasāyakaśikhābhāgena saṃvardhitam| yatsaṃsicya sudhārasairiva raterāsthānabhūmīkṛtaṃ tadbhūyo 'pi kadā saroruhadṛśaḥ paśyāmi tasyā mukham|| 16 rudrasya
taistaiścāṭubhirājñayā kila tadā vṛtte rativyatyaye lajjāmantharayā tayā nivasite bhrāntyā madīye 'ṃśuke| tatpaṭṭāṃśukamudvahannahamapi smitvā yadukto 'dhunā veṣo yujyata eṣa eva hi tavetyetanna vismaryate|| 17 amarukasya
priyāyāḥ pratyūṣagalitakabarībandhanavidhau udaṅcaddorvallīdaragalitacelāñcalamuraḥ| ghanākūtaṃ paśyatyatha mayi samandākṣahasitaṃ namantyāstadvaktraṃ yadi likhitumīśo manasijaḥ|| 18 umāpatidharasya
pādāṅguṣṭhena bhūmiṃ kisalayarucinā sāpadeśaṃ likhantī bhūyo bhūyaḥ kṣipantī mayi sitaśabale locane lolatāre| vaktraṃ hrīnamramīṣatsphuradharapuṭaṃ vākyagarbhaṃ dadhānā yanmāṃ novāca kiṃcitsthitamapi hṛdaye mānasaṃ taddunoti|| 19 kasyāpi
yātāḥ kiṃ na milanti sundari punaścintā tvayā matkṛte no kāryā nitarāṃ kṛśāsi kathayatyevaṃ sabāṣpe mayi| lajjāmantharatārakeṇa nipatatsphītāśruṇā cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā māṃ hasitena bhāvimaraṇotsāhastayā sūcitaḥ|| 20 amarukasya
vrīḍāyogānnatavadanayā sannidhāne gurūṇāṃ baddhotkampaṃ stanakalaśayormanyumantarnirudhya| tiṣṭhetyuktaṃ kimiva na tayā yatsamutsṛjya bāṣpaṃ mayyāsaktaścakitahariṇīhārinetratribhāgaḥ|| 21 kasyāpi
bāṇānsaṃhara muñca kārmukalatāṃ lakṣyaṃ tava tryambakaḥ ke nāmātra vayaṃ śirīṣakalikākalpaṃ yadīyaṃ manaḥ| tatkāruṇyaparigrahātkuru dayāmasminvidheye jane svāminmanmatha tādṛśaṃ punarapi svapnāmṛtaṃ darśaya|| 22 rājaśekharasya
asthāne janasaṃkaṭe mayi manākkāñcīṃ samāskandati vyālole rajanāṃśuke vigalite nīte ca nābheradhaḥ| dhanyo 'yaṃ sa karaḥ kuraṅgakadṛśā tasminnavasthāntare kampātaṅkakarambitāṅgalatayā yasyāvakāśaḥ kṛtaḥ|| 23
nikārakaṇikā kṛtā jhariṇalocane no mayā mudhaiva karasampuṭe mukhavidhuḥ kimāvāsitaḥ| itīyati mayodite taralitāṅgulīkoṭaraiḥ vilokya vihitastayā rabhasahāsakaṇṭhagrahaḥ|| 24 bhaṭṭavāmanasya
jāne kopaparāṅmukhī priyatamā svapne 'dya dṛṣṭā mayā mā mā saṃspṛśya pāṇineti rudatī gantuṃ pravṛttā tataḥ| no yāvatparirabhya cāṭuśatakairāśvāsayāmi kṣaṇaṃ bhrātastāvadahaṃ śaṭhena vidhinā nidrādaridrīkṛtaḥ|| 25 nidrādaridrasya
nidrārdhamīlitadṛśo madamantharāṇi nātyarthavanti na ca yāni nirarthakāni| adyāpi me mṛgadṛśo madhurāṇi tasyāstānyakṣarāṇi hṛdaye kimapi dhvananti|| 26 kalaśasya
purastanvyā gotraskhalanacakito 'haṃ natamukhaḥ pravṛtto vailakṣyātkimapi likhituṃ daivahatakaḥ| sphuṭo rekhānyāsaḥ kathamapi sa tādṛkpariṇataḥ gatā yena vyaktiṃ punaravayavaiḥ saiva taruṇī|| 27 ḍimbhokasya
prathamavirahakhedavyāpinī yatra bālā vasati nayanavāntairaśrubhirdhautagaṇḍā| prahatamurajavṛndadhvānavadbhiḥ payodaiḥ kathamalikulanīlaiḥ sāpi diksaṃniruddhā|| 28 biyākasya
saṃtāpo hṛdaya smarānalakṛtaḥ sa pratyahaṃ sahyatāṃ nāstyevopaśamo 'sya samprati punaḥ kiṃ tvaṃ mudhā tāmyasi| yanmūḍhena mayā tathā kathamapi prāpto gṛhītvā paraṃ vinyastastvayi sāndracandanarasasparśo na tasyāḥ karaḥ|| 29 śrīharṣasya
kvākāryaṃ śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ kva ca kulaṃ bhūyo 'pi dṛśyeta sā doṣāṇāṃ praśamāya me śrutamaho kope 'pi kāntaṃ mukham| kiṃ vakṣyantyapakalmaṣāḥ kṛtadhiyaḥ svapne 'pi sā durlabhā cetaḥ svāsthyamupaihi kaḥ khalu yuvā dhanyo 'dharaṃ pāsyati|| 30 kālidāsasya
he yāminīśa jaḍimā katamastavaiṣa saṃgharṣamāvahasi yena mukhena tasyāḥ| tvaṃ vahnimudgirasi tadvirahe karoti pīyūṣavarṣamiha tadbhavatā vināpi|| 31 gotrānandanasya
pañcatvaṃ tanuretu bhūtanivahāḥ svāṃśaṃ viśantu prabho tvāṃ yāce druhiṇa praṇamya śirasā bhūyo 'pi me santviti| tadvāpīṣu payastadīyamukure jyotistadīyālayavyomni vyoma tadīyavartmani dharā tattālavṛndo 'nilaḥ|| 32 ākāśapoleḥ
ākrandāḥ stanitairvilocanajalānyaśrāntadhārāmbubhiḥ tadvicchedabhavāśca śokaśikhinastulyāstaḍidvibhramaiḥ| antarme dayitāmukhaṃ tava śaśī vṛttiḥ samaivāvayoḥ tatkiṃ māmaniśaṃ sakhe jaladhara tvaṃ dagdhumevodyataḥ|| 33 yaśovarmaṇaḥ
bhramaya jaladānambhogarbhānpramodaya cātakān kalaya śikhinaḥ kekāgarbhānkaṭhoraya ketakān| virahiṇi jane mūrchāṃ labdhvā vinodayati vyathāṃ akaruṇa punaḥ saṃjñāvyādhiṃ vidhāya kimīhase|| 34 bhavabhūteḥ
raktāśoka kṛśodarī kva nu gatā tyaktvānuraktaṃ janaṃ no dṛṣṭeti mudhaiva kampayasi kiṃ vātāvadhūtaṃ śiraḥ| utkaṇṭhāghaṭamānaṣaṭpadaghaṭāsaṃghaṭṭadaṣṭacchadaḥ tatpādāhatimantareṇa bhavataḥ puṣpodgamo 'yaṃ kutaḥ|| 35 vasunāgasya
mṛṇālīhāro 'yaṃ na bhujagapatiścandanarasaḥ na bhasmedaṃ kaṇṭhe kuvalayadalālī na garalam| sitāmbhojaṃ pāṇau lasati na kapālaṃ mayi mudhā purārātikrodhātsmara kimanabhijñaḥ praharasi|| 36 umāpatidharasya
jyotsnāṃ śyāmalimānamānayata bhoḥ sāndrairmaṣīkūrcakaiḥ mantraṃ tantramatha prayujya harata śvetotpalānāṃ smitam| candraṃ cūrṇayata kṣaṇācca kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā śilāpaṭṭake tena draṣṭumahaṃ kṣame daśadiśastadvaktramudrāṅkitāḥ|| 37 rājaśekharasya
sa saṃtāpaḥ krūraḥ kusumasubhagā sāṅgagalatikā vipakṣāttattāvadbhayamatanu lajjāsahacaram| kathaṃ tanna prāṇānahaha dayitā śāntamathavā śivaṃ śilpāścarye niyatamiha nidhyāsyati vidhiḥ|| 38 gotrānandanasya
dalati hṛdayaṃ gāḍhodvegaṃ dvidhā tu na bhidyate vahati vikalaḥ kāyo mohaṃ na muñcati cetanām| jvalayati tanūmantardāhaḥ karoti na bhasmasāt praharati vidhirmarmacchedī na kṛntati jīvitam|| 39
paricchedātītaḥ sa kila vacanānāmaviṣayaḥ punarjanmanyasminnanu bhavapathaṃ yo na gatavān| vivekapradhvaṃsādupacitamahāmohagahanaḥ vikāraḥ ko 'pyantarjaḍayati ca tāpaṃ ca kurute|| 40 etau bhavabhūteḥ
gharmāṃśurbhagavānasūta yamunāṃ tāpyā (?)kṛtaṃ gaṅgayā pātho 'syāḥ kvathitaṃ purārimukuṭe netrānalajvālayā| syandaiścandanaśākhināṃ śatamukhaiḥ kimbhīranīrormayaḥ sevāyai malayācalendrasaritaḥ sambhūya tiṣṭhantu me|| 41
prāleyādristvaritamurasi kṣipyatāṃ śaityahetoḥ āstāṃ yadvā sa khalu nikhilaḥ syādvilīyāśmaśeṣaḥ| tyaktvā kṣāraṃ jaladhisalilaṃ jāhvanītoyapūrṇāḥ tūrṇaṃ gātre mama jalamucaḥ kañcukatvaṃ prayāntu|| 42 bilhaṇasyaitau
śītāṃśoramṛtacchaṭā yadi karāḥ kasmānmano me dṛśaṃ | sampluṣyantyatha kālakūṭapaṭalīsaṃvāsasaṃdūṣitāḥ| kiṃ prāṇānna harantyuta priyatamāsaṃkalpamantrākṣaraiḥ rakṣyante kimu mohamemi hahahā no vedmi keyaṃ gatiḥ|| 43 śrīmadabhinavaguptasya
ilīyenduḥ sākṣādamṛtamayavāpī yadi bhavet kalaṅkastatratyo yadi ca vikacendīvaravanam| tataḥ snānakrīḍājanitajaḍabhāvairavayavaiḥ kadācinmuñceyaṃ madanaśikhipīḍāparibhavam|| 44 rājaśekharasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ viyogipralāpaprakaraṇam
smaradavathunimittaṃ gūḍhamunnetumasyāḥ subhaga tava kathāyāṃ prastutāyāṃ sakhībhiḥ| vadati vitatapṛṣṭhodastapīnastanāgrā bata valayitabāhūjjṛmbhitaiḥ sāṅgabhaṅgaiḥ|| 1 kasyāpi
mā gaccha pramadāpriya priyaśatairabhyarthitastvaṃ mayā bālā prāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā prāpnotyavasthāṃ parām| kiṃ cāsyāḥ kucakumbhapīḍanaparairaṅgairananṅgāturaiḥ truṭyatkañcukajālakairanudinaṃ niḥsūtramasmadgṛham|| 2 morikāyāḥ
gantuṃ prāṅgaṇato dadāti na muhuḥ stambhaḥ kuraṅgīdṛśaḥ sākūtaṃ svarabhaṅgavibhramakalā datte na vaktuṃ kiyat| mārge yāntamavekṣituṃ na sahate tvāṃ bāṣpavāriplavaḥ tasyāḥ kañcukino bhavanti subhaga tvaddarśane sāttvikāḥ|| 3 hariharasya
śvāsaistruṭyati vegibhirnayanayoruṣṇāmbubhiḥ klāmyati svedāmbholavavāhinā karatalenāvarjitā mlāyati| ityālokya tayā caladvadanayā tiryakpattannetrayā dūrotsāritahastayā tava sakhe krīḍālatā sicyate|| 4 ratnacandrasya
tvaddeśāgatamārutena mṛdunā saṃjātaromāñcayā tvadrūpāṅkitacārucitraphalakenāvarjayantyā dṛśam| tvannāmāmṛtasiktakarṇapuṭayā tvanmārgavātāyane nīcaiḥ pañcamagītigarbhitagirā naktaṃ divaṃ sthīyate|| 5 trivikramasya
aṅge 'naṅgajvarahutavahaścakṣuṣi dhyānamudrā kaṇṭhe jīvaḥ karakisalaye dīrghaśāyī kapolaḥ| aṃse veṇī kucaparisare candanaṃ vāci maunaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaṃ sthitamiti na tu tvāṃ vinā kvāpi cetaḥ|| 6 rājaśekharasya
vilimpatyetasminmalayajarasadroṇamahasā diśāṃ cakraṃ candre sukṛtamatha tasyā mṛgadṛśaḥ| dṛśorbāṣpaḥ pāṇau vadanamasavaḥ kaṇṭhakuhare hṛdi tvaṃ hrīḥ pṛṣṭhe vacasi ca guṇā eva bhavataḥ|| 7 rājaśekharasya
śvāseṣu prathimā mukhaṃ karatale gaṇḍasthale pāṇḍimā mudrā vāci vilocane 'śrupaṭalaṃ dehe ca dāhodayaḥ| etāvatkathitaṃ yadasti hṛdaye tasyāḥ kṛśāṅgyāḥ punaḥ tajjānāsi nanu tvameva subhaga ślāghyā sthitistatra sā|| 8 gotrānandanasya
candraṃ candanakardamena likhitaṃ sā mārṣṭi daṣṭādharā kāmaḥ puṣpaśaraḥ kileti sumanovargā/llunīte ca yat| vandyaṃ nindati yacca manmathamasau bhaṅktvā bhaṅktvāgrahastāṅgulīn tatkāmaṃ subhaga tvayā varatanurvātūlatāṃ śikṣitā|| 9 nandanasya
asmiṃścandramasi prasannamahasi vyākocakundatviṣi prācītaṃ khamupeyuṣi tvayi gate dūraṃ nijapreyasi| śvāsaḥ kairavakorakīyati mukhaṃ tasyāḥ sarojīyati kṣīrodīyati manmatho dṛgapi ca drākcandrakāntīyati|| 10 bhīmaṭasya
