nivasati yadi tava hṛdaye sā bālā subhaga vajraghaṭite 'smin| tatkhalu kuśalaṃ tasyā madanaśaraistāḍyamānāyāḥ|| 11
tasyāḥ smarantyāḥ subhaga tvadīyaṃ muhurmuhurmanmathaceṣṭitaṃ tat| babhūva dṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇamāttajhampā kṣaṇaṃ praphullā kṣaṇamaśrumiśrā|| 12 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasyaitau
unmīlanti nakhairlunīhi vahati kṣaumāñcalenāvṛṇu krīḍākānanamāśrayanti valayakvāṇaiḥ samuttrāsaya| itthaṃ vañjuladakṣiṇānilakuhūkaṇṭhīṣu sāṅketikavyāhārāḥ subhaga tvadīyavirahe tasyāḥ sakhīnāṃ mithaḥ|| 13 kasyāpi
vācastāvadapekṣate pikayuvā lambālakānāṃ śriyaḥ bhṛṅgālī viruṇaddhi cūtakalikā saubhāgyamāśaṃsati| kiṃ cānyatkathayāmi nirdaya daśā tasyāstathā vartate niśvāsānapi hantumicchati yathā krūro vasantānilaḥ|| 14 paraśurāmasya
dhatte dṛṣṭimadhītavibhramalavāṃ sā puṣpalāvījane caitrasya kṣaṇamādareṇa mahatā mauhīrtikānpṛcchati| śyenāttuṣyati kokiladhvaniruṣā saṃtyajya līlāśukān niḥśoka tvayi durlabhe kimaparaṃ śakyaṃ varākyā tayā|| 15
nīrāgā mṛgalāñchane mukhamapi svaṃ nekṣate darpaṇe trastā kokilakūjitādapi giraṃ nonmudrayatyātmanaḥ| citraṃ duḥsahadāhadāyini dhṛtadveṣāpi puṣpāyudhe mugdhā sā subhaga tvayi pratipadaṃ premādhikaṃ puṣyati|| 16
spṛśantyāḥ kṣāmatvaṃ madanaśaraṭaṅkavyatikarāt karaṅgākṣyāstasyāḥ śṛṇu subhaga kautūhalamidam| apūrveti trāsātpariharati tāṃ kelihariṇī na viśve 'pyāśvāsaṃ dadhati gṛhalīlāśakunayaḥ|| 17
gṛhītaṃ tāmbūlaṃ parijanavacobhiḥ kathamapi smaratyantaḥ śūnyā subhaga vigatāyāmapi niśi| tathaivāste hastaḥ kalitaphaṇivallīkisalayaḥ tathaivāsyaṃ tasyāḥ kramukaphalapālīparicitam|| 18
tīvraḥ ko 'pi vijṛmbhate varatanostvadviprayogajvaraḥ kiṃ brūmaḥ subhaga tvayā parijanaḥ kautūhalāddṛśyatām| kaṇṭhe śeṣamadhairyagadgadagirā kṛtvā sakhīnāṃ tayā gaurāṅgitvamanaṅgatāpasuhṛdaḥ sarvāḥ parityājitāḥ (?)|| 19
galatyekā mūrchā bhavati punaranyā yadanayoḥ kimapyāsīnmadhyaṃ subhaga nikhilāyāmapi niśi| likhantyāstatrāsyāḥ kusumaśaralekhaṃ tava kṛte samāptiṃ svastīti prathamapadabhāgo 'pi na gataḥ|| 20 bilhaṇasyaite
citrāya tvayi cintite tanubhuvā sajyaṃ vitene dhanuḥ vartiṃ dhartumupāgate 'ṅguliyuge bāṇā guṇe yojitāḥ| ārabdhe tava citrakarmaṇi dhanurmuktāstrakhinnā bhṛśaṃ bhittiṃ drāgavalambya nirdaya ciraṃ sā tatra citrāyate|| 21 siṃhalapateḥ
tvāmantaḥ sthirabhāvanāpariṇataṃ matvā puro 'vasthitaṃ yāvaddorvalayaṃ karoti rabhasānmugdhā samāliṅgitum| tāvattāṃ nijameva dehamacirādāliṅgya bādhāturāṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣṭijalacchalena ruditaṃ manye payodairapi|| 22
tvāṃ cintāparikalpitaṃ subhaga sā sambhāvya romāñcitā śūnyāliṅganasaṃcaladbhujayugenātmānamāliṅgati| kiṃ cānyadvirahavyathāpraśamanīṃ samprāpya mūrchāṃ cirāt pratyujjīvati karṇamūlapatitaistvannāmamantrākṣaraiḥ|| 23
tanvaṅgyāstvamiti prasādaviśadaṃ nāsīti khedālasaṃ cakṣurdvārapathāvatāriṇi jane vyāpārayantyā muhuḥ| harṣārtiprabhavāḥ pratikṣaṇabhuvaḥ svedāmbudāhajvare netrāmbhaḥkaṇikāḥ payodharataṭe puṣyanti śuṣyanti ca|| 24 keṣāmapyete
tasyāstāpaharaṃ nṛśaṃsa kathayāmyeṇīdṛśaste kathaṃ padminyāḥ sarasaṃ dalaṃ vinihitaṃ yasyāḥ satāporasi| ādau śuṣyati saṃkucatyanu tataścūrṇatvamāpadyate paścānmurmuratāṃ dadhaddahati ca śvāsāvadhūtaṃ sakhīm|| 25
gehādaṅgaṇamaṅgaṇādapi bahirbāhyāccalantī gṛhaṃ tāmārtiṃ yadi vetti saiva sumukhī kiṃ cānyadācakṣmahe| paryaṅko 'pi tavāṅgasaṅgasubhagaḥ svedāmbhasāṃ nirjharaiḥ dhārāmaṇḍātāmanīyata tayā tasmi/lluṭhantyā muhuḥ|| 26
tasyāḥ sadā virahavahniśikhākalāpatapte sthito 'si hṛdaye satataṃ priyāyāḥ| prāleyaśīkarasame hṛdi sā kṛpālo bālā kṣaṇaṃ vasati naiva khalu tvadīye|| 27
sakhībhikṣāṃ yāce bata nataśirāstvāmiyamahaṃ na cedasti premā kuru tadapi kāruṇyakaṇikām| avasthā sā tasyāḥ sukṛtamaya yasyāḥ kimaparaṃ pramohe viśrāmastvamatha maraṇaṃ vā pratikṛtiḥ|| 28 keṣāmapyete
acchinnaṃ nayanāśru bandhuṣu kṛtaṃ tāpaḥ sakhīṣvāhitaḥ nyastaṃ dainyamaśeṣataḥ parijane cintā gurubhyo 'rpitā| adya śvaḥ kila nirvṛtiṃ vrajati sā śvāsaiḥ paraṃ khidyate visrabdho bhava viprayogajanitaṃ duḥkhaṃ vibhaktaṃ tayā|| 29 amarukasya
samprāpte 'vadhivāsare kṣaṇamasau tvadvartmavātāyanaṃ vāraṃ vāramupetya niṣkṛpa tayā niścitya kiṃcicciram| sampratyeva nivedya kelikurarīḥ sāsraṃ sakhībhyaḥ śiśoḥ mādhavyāḥ sahakārakeṇa karuṇaṃ pāṇigraho nirmitaḥ|| 30 kasyāpi
vilāsinnāsīne prativasatimadhyaṃ tvayi tadā daśāṃ dīptāṃ kṛtvā gṛhamanu padānyetya katicit| maruttvantarvāti drutamiti bhavaddarśanadhiyā pradīpo dvārāṇāṃ śatamiti tayā kiṃ na śamitaḥ|| 31 pradīpavasundharasya
tanvī saṃketaveśmanyatanutarutale sā tvadarthaṃ śayānā jānīte nopadhānīkṛtamapi bhujagaṃ kuṇḍalībhūtamantaḥ| tasyā dhammillavāntaprasavaparimalaśvāsasaurabhyalobhāt so 'pi śrīkhaṇḍalīlāṃ suciramanubhavannāvirāsīdakampaḥ|| 32
citrotkīrṇādapi viṣadharādbhītibhājo niśāyāṃ kiṃ tadbrūmastvadabhisaraṇe sāhasaṃ nātha tasyāḥ| dhvānte yāntyā yadatinibhṛtaṃ mugdhayātmaprakāśatrāsātpāṇiḥ pathi phaṇiphaṇāratnarodhī vyadhāyi|| 33 hariharasyaitau
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vipralambhe dūtyuktiḥ
jīmūtaprathamāmbuśīkaravahaḥ śītaḥ puro mārutaḥ pṛthvīṃ prauḍhanidāghacaṇḍakiraṇaploṣāvasannāmiva| tāmāśvāsamalambhayatkṛśatanuṃ prasthāpitaḥ preyasā saṃdeśaḥ paripīḍitaḥ praṇatibhistasyāḥ sakhīnāmapi|| 1
veṇībandhanaśeṣitairvilulitairuttaṃsitaḥ kuntalaiḥ vinyastaḥ kucakumbhayoraśiśirairbāṣpāmbubhistaptayoḥ| akṣṇoḥ saṃtatarodanādaruṇayorāśleṣitaḥ ślāghitaḥ lekhaḥ kiṃ tadakāri yanna sadṛśaṃ premṇo 'tisīmnastayā|| 2
udveṣṭya svayameva lekhamuditapresvedakalpāṅguliḥ tasminsekaviluptaśeṣaśithilaṃ dṛṣṭvā lipiprakramam| etatkiṃ tu hatāsmi samprati daśā tayaivamāsīdayaṃ bāṣpo hanta karasya kampitamidaṃ hanteti sā roditi|| 3
bāṣpastasya na jāyate kimu na kiṃ lekhe karaḥ kampate jānīṣe kimu sāmprataṃ tvayi tathā nighnaṃ tadīyaṃ manaḥ| itthaṃ tāmabhidhāya tatkaratalādādāya patraṃ sakhī kācidvācayati pragalbhavacanā kautūhale 'pi kramāt|| 4
mārge me nirapāyatāṃ pariṇatiṃ kāryasya bhadrottarāṃ śrutvā lekhaharānanānmama parāvṛttiṃ ca nedīyasīm| svasthaivāsva tava klame mama daśā yā pūrvamuktā mayā bhūyaḥ saṃsmara tāṃ ca mānini paro mā bhūddviṣāmutsavaḥ|| 5 śṛṅgārakinnarānnāṭakādete
sthānānnirgatya dūraṃ vrajati mayi ciraṃ muktakaṇṭhaṃ ruditvā paścādunmṛjya netre praṇatimupagatā vepamānāṅgayaṣṭiḥ| kānte yanmāmavocaḥ pralayaghanaghaṭāṭopabaddhāndhakāre kāle kāpāliko 'pi pravasati na gṛhāttanmano me dunoti|| 6
tvadrūpāmṛtapānadurlalitayā dṛṣṭyā kva viśramyatāṃ tvadvākyaśravaṇābhiyogaparayoḥ śrāvyaṃ kutaḥ śrotrayoḥ| ebhistvatparirambhanirbhararasairaṅgaiḥ kathaṃ sthīyatāṃ kaṣṭaṃ tvadviraheṇa samprati vayaṃ kaṣṭāmavasthāṃ gatāḥ|| 7 kayorapyetau
yattvannetrasamānakānti salile magnaṃ tadindīvaraṃ meghairantaritaḥ priye tava mukhacchāyānukārī śaśī| ye 'pi tvadgamanānukārigatayaste rājahaṃsā gatāḥ tvatsādṛśyavinodamātramapi me daivena na kṣamyate|| 8 śrīyaśovarmaṇaḥ
nityaṃ tvadguṇakīrtanena nibiḍaṃ romāñcitairaṅgakaiḥ tvadvaktrenduvilokanaikamanasaḥ kānte sukhenāsmahe| kiṃ tu tvadvirahotthitoddhuraśikhijvālāvṛtāṅge mayi prasthāpyaḥ kṛpayā nijāṅghrikamalodantāmbudaḥ śāntaye|| 9
saṃkṣipyante kṣaṇamiva kathaṃ dīrghayāmāstriyāmāḥ sarvāvasthāsvaharapi kathaṃ mandamandātapaṃ syāt| itthaṃ cetaścaṭulanayane durlabhaprārthanaṃ me gāḍhoṣmābhiḥ kṛtamaśaraṇaṃ tvadviyogavyathābhiḥ|| 10
etasmānmāṃ kuśalinamabhijñānadānādviditvā mā kaulīnādasitanayane mayyaviśvāsinī bhūḥ| snehānāhuḥ kimapi virahe dhvaṃsinaste hyayogāt iṣṭe vastunyupacitarasāḥ premarāśībhavanti|| 11 kālidāsasyaitau
\Colo iti bhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ virahisaṃdeśapaddhatiḥ
pṛṣṭo lekhaharaḥ sa nirgamadinādārabhya yaṃ preyasaḥ vṛttāntaṃ tamakhaṇḍitaṃ mṛgadṛśo nirvyājamāha kramāt| kurvāṇaḥ kathayaiva tasya karuṇātaṅkapramohottarāṃ tasyāstasya sakhījanasya ca daśāṃ premaprakarṣocitām|| 1
saṃsakteṣu dṛḍhaṃ mithastarulatādvandveṣu cintāmayīṃ prāyo bāṣpamayīṃ śakuntamithunakrīḍāsu kurvandṛśam| paśyanduḥkhadaśāmiva praṇayinībandhopakaṇṭhānmṛgān kurvāṇaḥ karuṇavyathābhayamayānasmānsa mārgānagāt|| 2
brūmaḥ kiṃ paramatyagāttava patistāstā niśāścandrikāmallīkairavagandhamandamarutāṃ madhye 'pi śāntavyathaḥ| tvāṃ saṃkalpapathe samakṣayati yaddrāghīyasī jāgarā yaccāhanti durantaduḥsahatarāṃ moho manovedanām|| 3
tatraikaṃ kariṇīviyuktamataṭāghātakriyākautukaṃ cintādīnamasallakīkisalayagrāsābhilāṣaṃ gajam| dṛṣṭvā locanavāri bhūri visṛjanbrūte sma te vallabhaḥ prācīnaṃ gajarāja pātakamaho nau tulyamāsīditi|| 4
śṛṇu paramidamantye yāminīnāṃ sa yāme kathamapi sukṛtairnaḥ kiṃcidāyātanidraḥ| sutanu kimidamasyāstvaddṛśaḥ kvāpi nāntaḥ kimiti valitabāhurvyāharanbodhameti|| 5 sūktisahasrādete
padaśabdalīnahṛdayo rūpālaṃkārabhāvanānipuṇaḥ| kaviriva vañcitanidrastaruṇi tavārthe bhṛśaṃ sa yuvā|| 6
\Colo iti bhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ virahiṇo 'vasthākathanam|
kiṃ tvaṃ dūti gatā gatāsmi subhage tasyāntikaṃ kāminaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ suciraṃ karoti kimasau vīṇāvinodakriyām| saubhāgyodayagarvitaḥ kimavadannaivottaraṃ dattavān kiṃ garvānna hi bāṣpagadgadatayā dhūrtasya māyā hi sā|| 1
kathaya nipuṇe kasmindṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ nu kiyacciraṃ kimabhilikhitaṃ kiṃ tenoktaṃ kadā sa ihaiṣyati| iti bahuvidhapremollāsaprakalpitavistarāḥ priyatamakathāḥ svalpe 'pyarthe prayānti na naṣṭatām|| 2 kayorapyetau
alamalamaghṛṇasya tasya nāmnā punarapi saiva kathā gataḥ sa kālaḥ| kathaya kathaya vā tathāpi dūti prativacanaṃ dviṣato 'pi mānanīyam|| 3
\Colo iti bhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ dūtīṃ prati nāyikāpraśnāḥ||
anena vītarāgeṇa buddhenevādhareṇa te| dūti nirvyājamākhyātā sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā|| 1
niḥśeṣacyutacandanaṃ stanataṭaṃ nirmṛṣṭarāgo 'dharaḥ netre dūramanañjane pulakitā tanvī taveyaṃ tanuḥ| mithyāvādini dūti bāndhavajanasyājñātapīḍāgame vāpīṃ snātumito gatāsi na punastasyādhamasyāntikam|| 2 kayorapyetau
adhareṇonnatibhājā bhujaṅgaparipīḍitena te dūti| saṃkṣobhitaṃ mano me jalanidhiriva mandarāgeṇa|| 3 viśalyasya
bahunātra kimuktena dūti matkāryasiddhaye| svamāṃsānyapi dattāni vastuṣvanyeṣu kā kathā|| 4 vararuceḥ
śvāsaḥ kiṃ tvaritāgatātpulakitā kasmātprasādaḥ kṛtaḥ srastā veṇyapi pādayornipatanānnīvī gamādāgamāt| svedārdraṃ mukhamātapākulatayā kṣāmā kimatyuktibhiḥ dūti mlānasaroruhadyutidharasyauṣṭhasya kiṃ vakṣyasi|| 5 śilābhaṭṭārikāyāḥ
nāyāto yadi tādṛśaṃ sa śapathaṃ kṛtvāpi dūti priyaḥ tatkiṃ kopanayā tvayā svadaśanairagrādharaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ| svedāmbhaḥkaṇadāyi vepanamidaṃ tyaktvā bhaja svacchatāṃ ko lokasya sakhi svabhāvakuṭilasyāntargataṃ jñāsyati|| 6 ḍiṃbokasya
rajanyāmanyasyāṃ surataparivartādanucitaṃ madīyaṃ yadvāsaḥ kathamapi hṛtaṃ tena suhṛdā| tvayā pratyānītaṃ nijavasanadānātpunaridaṃ kutastvādṛgdūti skhalitaśamanopāyanipuṇā|| 7
\Colo iti bhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vipralambhe dūtyupahāsaḥ||
tatra nāyikāvalokanam
nāmāpi strīti saṃhlādi vikarotyeva mānasam| kiṃ punardarśanaṃ tasyā vilāsollasitabhruvaḥ|| 1 kāmandakasya
priyādarśanamevāstu kimanyairdarśanāntaraiḥ| prāpyate tena nirvāṇaṃ sarāgeṇāpi cetasā|| 2
asyāṃ netrapathaṃ manye gatāyāṃ lolacakṣuṣi| bhavanti pañcabāṇasya svabāṇā eva vairiṇaḥ|| 3 kayorapyetau
yanniṣpīḍya viriñcena syanditaiṣā madhusrutiḥ| manye tatkṣaudrapaṭalaṃ tyaktaṃ tenendumaṇḍalam|| 4
tāpakāṭhinyacalatāparimlānīrakalpayat| dīparatnataḍitpuṣpeṣvasyāḥ pravyaktaye vidhiḥ|| 5
kaiḥ suraiḥ kena śailena kuto 'bdhermathanādiyam| ajāyata navā lakṣmīramṛtendukalāmayī|| 6
na tvarā śreyase puṃsāṃ kimadya kriyatāṃ hariḥ| imāmajānanneṣyantīṃ jagrāha sahasā śriyam|| 7
hanta mohādimāmalpaṃ kālamapratipālayan| smaraḥ sambhau vicakrāma gaurīmātrāvalambanaḥ|| 8 ete pañcendulekhāyām
kṣīrasāgarakallolalolalocanayānayā| asāro 'pi hi saṃsāraḥ sāravāniva lakṣyate|| 9 ākāśapoleḥ
līlāvadhūtapadmā kathayantī pakṣapātamadhikaṃ naḥ| mānasamupaiti keyaṃ citragatā rājahaṃsīva|| 10 śrīharṣasya
aye keyaṃ līlādhavalagṛhavātāyanatale tulākoṭikvāṇaiskusumadhanuṣaṃ jāgarayati| aho netradvandvaṃ vilasati vilaṅghya śrutipathaṃ kathaṃ na trailokyaṃ jayati madanaḥ smeravadanaḥ|| 11
puraḥ sthitvā kiṃcidvalitamukhamālokaya sakhe sakhedāḥ sthāsyanti dhruvamidamadṛṣṭāstava dṛśaḥ| itaścañcatkāñcīraṇitamukharānsaudhaśikharān arākāyāṃ keyaṃ kavacayati cāndreṇa mahasā|| 12 bilhaṇasyaitau
upaprākārāgraṃ prahiṇu nayane tarkaya manāk anākāśe ko 'yaṃ galitahariṇaḥ śītakiraṇaḥ| sudhābaddhagrāsairupavanacakorairanusṛtāṃ kirañjyotsnāmacchāṃ navalavalipākapraṇayinīm|| 13 rājaśekharasya
vinaivāmbhovāhaṃ bahalaruciliptāmbaratalāt taḍillekhā hemadyutivitatiramyā vilasati| vinaiva svargaṅgāṃ nabhasi rabhasavyagraśapharīparīvartaiḥ sārdhaṃ sphurati vikacendīvaravanam|| 14 jayadevasya
amṛtamamṛtaṃ candraścandrastathāmbujamambujaṃ ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyapi| iti na bhajate vastu prāyaḥ parasparasaṃkathāṃ tadiyamabalā lakṣmīṃ dhatte kutaḥ sakalātmikām|| 15 rājaputravijayapālasya
kamalamanambhasi kamale kuvalayametāni kanakalatikāyām| sā ca sukumārasubhagetyutpātaparamparā keyam|| 16 śrīśaṃkaragaṇasya
lāvaṇyasindhuraparaiva hi keyamatra yatrotpalāni śaśinā saha samplavante| unmajjati dviradakumbhataṭī ca yatra yatrāpare kamalakāṇḍamṛṇāladaṇḍāḥ|| 17 vikramādityasya
ubhau rambhāstambhāvupari viparītau kamalayoḥ tadūrdhvaṃ ratnāśmasthalamatha durūhaṃ kimapi tat| tataḥ kumbhau paścādbisakisalaye kandalamatho tadanvindāvindīvaramadhukarāḥ kiṃ punaridam|| 18 kasyāpi
tamastomaḥ pūrvaṃ tadanu sakalaḥ śītalaruciḥ tataḥ kokadvandvaṃ tadanu na ca kiṃcitpunarabhūt| anambhasyāvartastadanu kadalīkāṇḍayugalaṃ tato 'vāñcau padmau kimidamaticitraiva racanā|| 19 devabodheḥ
manye pārvaṇacandramadhyaśakalenāsūtritaiṣā cirāt aṅgairadbhutabhaṅgibhiḥ pariṇatavyutpattinā vedhasā| yoṣitsargavilakṣaṇākṛtiriyaṃ yaddṛśyate bhāti ca chidradvāravilokyamānagaganavādyāpi cāndrī tanuḥ|| 20 bilhaṇasya
sarasyāmetasyāmudaravalivīcīvilulitaṃ yathā lāvaṇyāmbho jaghanapulinollaṅghanaparam| yathā lakṣyaścāyaṃ calanayanamīnavyatikaraḥ tathā manye magnaḥ prakaṭakucakumbhaḥ smaragajaḥ|| 21
kṛcchreṇoruyugaṃ vilaṅghya suciraṃ bhrāntvā nitambasthale madhye 'syāstrivalītaraṅgaviṣame niṣpandatāmāgatā| maddṛṣṭistṛṣiteva samprati śanairāruhya tuṅgau stanau sākāṅkṣaṃ muhurīkṣate jalalavaprasyandinī locane|| 22 śrīharṣasya
ānandormivyatikaradarasmerasaṃsaktapakṣma premodgārapravaṇamasṛṇārecitasnigdhatāram| antaścintābharaparicayākuñcitabhrūlatāntaṃ cakṣuśceto harati hariṇīlocanāyāstadetat|| 23 kasyāpi
jagati jayinaste te bhāvā navendukalādayaḥ prakṛtimadhurāḥ santyevānye mano madayanti ye| mama tu yadiyaṃ yātā loke vilocanacandrikā nayanaviṣayaṃ janmanyekaḥ sa eva mahotsavaḥ|| 24 bhavabhūteḥ
\Colo iti nāyikāvalokanam
atha nāyakasyāvalokanam
kṛcchreṇa kāpi guruṇaiva janena rodhādullaṅghya nāyakasamīpabhuvaṃ pratasthe| hā hanta śīghragamanapratirodhahetustasyā ghanastanataṭo 'pi gururbabhūva|| 25
kācinnivāritabahirgamanā jananyā draṣṭuṃ priyaṃ bhavanajālakamāsasāda| tasyā vilocanamadṛśyata dāśadattayantroparuddhaśapharopamitaṃ kṣaṇena|| 26
kācidvihṛtya kila kandukakeliraṅgādbhrūreṇabhūṣitatanurniragānmṛgākṣī| utphullapaṅkajavane suciraṃ vihṛtya kiñjalkareṇuparighūsariteva lakṣmīḥ|| 27 utprekṣāvallabhasyaite
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ nāyikānāyakayoravalokanaprakaraṇam|
strīvarṇane bālyāvasthā (50)
amandānandaniṣpandamapāstānyakriyākramam| jagajjanmotsave tasyāḥ pītāmṛtamivābhavat|| 1
sargavyāpārakhinnasya bahoḥ kālādvidherapi| āsīdimāṃ vinirmāya ślāghyaḥ śilpapariśramaḥ|| 2
dagdho vidhirvidhatte na sarvaguṇasundaraṃ janaṃ kamapi| ityapavādabhayādiva hariṇākṣī vedhasā vihitā|| 3
lāvaṇyapuṇyaparamāṇudalaṃ tadanyadanyaḥ sa cāpi nipuṇaḥ khalu ko 'pi vedhāḥ| yenādbhutā kṛtiriyaṃ vihitā viśiṣṭakāryeṣu kāraṇaviśeṣaguṇo 'numeyaḥ|| 4 trivikramasyaite
ghuṇākṣaranyāyatayā vidhātrā vinirmiteyaṃ mṛgaśābakākṣī| jāne punaḥ kauśalametadīyametādṛśīṃ yadyaparāṃ vidhatte|| 5 kasyāpi
citre niveśya parikalpitasattvayogā rūpoccayena vidhinā manasā kṛtā nu| strīratnasṛṣṭiraparā pratibhāti sā me dhāturvibhutvamanucintya vapuśca tasyāḥ|| 6 kālidāsasya
vaktraṃ nirmalamunnatā kucataṭī madhyapradeśaḥ kṛśaḥ śroṇīmaṇḍalamaṅgaṇākulagurordevasya siṃhāsanam| kṛtvā cārud.śaścatuṣṭayamidaṃ tuṣṭāva manye vidhiḥ harṣādgadgadagadyapadyaracanāgarbhaiścaturbhirmukhaiḥ|| 7 bilhaṇasya
dṛśaḥ pṛthutarīkṛtā jitanijābjapatratviṣaḥ caturbhirapi sādhu sādhviti mukhaiḥ samaṃ vyāhṛtam| śirāṃsi calitāni vismayavaśāddhruvaṃ vedhasā vidhāya lalanāṃ jagattrayalalāmabhūtāmimām|| 8
lāvaṇyadraviṇavyayo na gaṇitaḥ kleśo mahānsvīkṛtaḥ svacchandasya sukhaṃ janasya vasataścintājvaro nirmitaḥ| eṣāpi svayameva tulyaramaṇābhāvādvarākī hatā ko 'rthaścetasi vedhasā vinihitastanvyāstanuṃ tanvatā|| 9 bhadantadharmakīrteḥ
āsyaprojjhitapārvaṇenduyaśasaṃ netrāvadhūtotpalaśrīgarvāṃ daśanacchadavyavahitāśokapravāladyutim| etāṃ dṛṣṭisudhāprapāṃ trijagataḥ śilpī vidhāya svayaṃ manye harṣavaśādajāyata nijastotrapracaṇḍaḥ kaviḥ|| 10
ekāntasundaravidhānajaḍaḥ kva vedhāḥ sarvāṅgakānticaturaṃ kva ca rūpamasyāḥ| manye maheśvarabhayānmakaradhvajena prāṇārthinā yuvatirūpamidaṃ gṛhītam|| 11
lāvaṇyāmṛtadīrghikā kulagṛhaṃ saubhāgyasaundaryayoḥ trailokyākararatnakandaliriyaṃ jīyātsahasraṃ samāḥ| lokālokanakautukāya bahunā śilpaśrameṇādarāt manye yāṃ vidhinā vidhāya vihitaṃ sṛṣṭidhvajārohaṇam|| 12 keṣāmapyete
bhajannāsīnnidrāparicayamupendraḥ khalu tadā yadā nābhīpaṅkeruhavasatināsarji vidhinā| iyaṃ yadyāyātā kṣaṇamapi bhavellocanapathaṃ kathaṃ tasya svānte nivasati tadadyāpi kamalā|| 13 trivikramasya
nirmālyaṃ nayanaśriyaḥ kvalayaṃ valkasya dāsaḥ śaśī bhrūyugmasya sanābhi manmathadhanurjyotsnā smitasyāñcalaḥ| saṃgītasya ca mattakokilarutānyucchiṣṭameṇīdṛśaḥ sarvāṅgīṇamaho vidheḥ pariṇataṃ vijñānacitraṃ cirāt|| 14 rājaśekharasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ strībālyaprakaraṇam|
vayaḥsandhipaddhatiḥ (51)
anākūtaireva priyasahacarīṇāṃ śiśutayā vacobhiḥ pāñcālīmithunamadhunā saṃgamayitum| upādatte no vā viramati na vā kevalamiyaṃ kapolau kalyāṇī pulakamukulairdanturayati|| 1 murāreḥ
samaṃ vilāso 'ṅkuritaḥ stanābhyāṃ trapā vilāsena sahāvatīrṇā| avartatāsyāstrapayaiva sārdhaṃ kāntaḥ prakāro vacasāṃ kṛśāṅgyāḥ|| 2 jayatuṅgodayāt
pariharati vayo yathā yathāsyāḥ sphuradurukandalaśāli bālabhāvam| draḍhayati dhanuṣastathā tathā jyāṃ spṛ'sati śarānapi sajjayanmanobhūs|| 3 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
līlātāṇḍavitabhru cāruvadanaṃ kiṃcitpragalbhe dṛśau stokodbhedaniveditastanamuro madhyaṃ daridrāti ca| asyā yajjaghanaṃ ghanaṃ ca kalayā pratyaṅgameṇīdṛśaḥ satyaṃ cāra iva smaraikasuhṛdā tadyauvanenārpitaḥ|| 4
ākaṇṭhārpitakañcukāñcitamuro hastāṅgulīmudraṇātmātrāsūtritahāsyamāsyamalasāḥ pāñcālikākelayaḥ| tiryaglocanavalgitāni vacasāṃ chekoktisaṃkrāntayastasyāḥ sīdati śaiśave pratikalaṃ ko 'pyeṣa kelikramaḥ|| 5
dṛṣṭiḥ śaiśavamaṇḍanā pratikalaṃ prāgalbhyamabhyasyate pūrvākāramurastathāpi kucayoḥ śobhāṃ navāmīhate| no dhatte gurutāṃ tathāpyupacitābhogā nitambasthalī tanvyāḥ svīkṛtamanmathaṃ vijayate netraikapeyaṃ vayaḥ|| 6
bhruvoḥ kācillīlā pariṇatirapūrvā nayanayoḥ stanābhogo vyaktastaruṇimani saṃrambhasamaye| idānīṃ bālāyāḥ kimamṛtamayaḥ kiṃ viṣamayaḥ kimānandaḥ sākṣāddhvanitamadhuraḥ pañcamaravaḥ|| 7
labdhvā maṇḍalamunnataṃ kucataṭaṃ sphītā jaghanyaśriyaḥ tāḥ krāntā valibhiśca madhyamabhuvo bhrūbhyāṃ dhṛto vakrimā| pañceṣurvijigīṣate trijagatīṃ tadbālyatāruṇyayoḥ vairājye samupasthite mṛgadṛśaḥ kiṃ kena nārabhyate|| 8
premāśaṅki ca bhaṅgi ca prativaco 'pyuktaṃ ca guptaṃ tathā yatnādyācitamānanaṃ prati samādhāne ca hāne ca dhīḥ| ityanyo madhuraḥ sa ko 'pi śiśutātāruṇyayorantare vartiṣṇurmṛgacakṣuṣo vijayate dvaividhyamugdho rasaḥ|| 9
darottānaṃ cakṣuḥ kalitaviralāpāṅgacapalaṃ bhaviṣyadvistāristanayugalagarbhālasamuraḥ| nitambaṃ saṃkrāntāḥ katipayakalā gauravapuṣaḥ vapurmuñcadbālyaṃ kimapi kamanīyaṃ mṛgadṛśaḥ|| 10
kalitagarimā śroṇirmadhyaṃ vivṛddhavalitrayaṃ hṛdayamudayallajjaṃ majjaccirantanacāpalam| mukulitakucaṃ vakṣaścakṣurmanāgdhṛtavikramaṃ kramaparigaladbālyaṃ tasyā vapustanute śriyam|| 11 keṣāmapyete
gaṇḍe maṇḍanamātmanaiva kurute vaidagdhyagarvādasau tyaktvā hemavibhūṣaṇāni tanute tālīdaleṣvāgraham| mandā kandukakhelanāya bhajate śārīṣu śikṣārasaṃ tanvyā citramakāṇḍa eva laṭabhābhāve nibaddho bharaḥ|| 12
lāsyābhyāsamiṣeṇa citramanayā gātrārpaṇaṃ śikṣitaṃ līlāpañcamaḍolanena dalitā kaṇṭhasya kuṇṭhā gatiḥ| kiṃ vyāvarṇanayā samastalaṭabhālaṃkāratāmeṣyati svalpenaiva pariśrameṇa ramaṇī devasya rāmāguroḥ|| 13
dolāyāṃ jaghanasthalena calatā lolekṣaṇā lajjate dhatte dikṣu nirīkṣaṇaṃ smitamukhī pārāvatānāṃ rutaiḥ| sparśaḥ kaṇṭakakoṭibhiḥ kuṭilayā līlāvane neṣyate sajjaṃ maughyavisarjanāya sutanoḥ śṛṅgāramitraṃ vayaḥ|| 14 bilhaṇasyaite
kuraṅgīvāṅgāni stimitayati gītadhvaniṣu yat sakhīṃ kāntodantaṃ śrutamapi punaḥ praśnayati yat| anidrā yaccāntaḥ svapiti tadaho vedmyabhinavāṃ pravṛtto 'syāḥ sektuṃ hṛdi manasijaḥ premalatikām|| 15 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
pāñcālīmithuneṣu nātirasikā lolā vibhūṣāvidhau sotkaṇṭhā kalagītiṣu priyatamālāpeṣu lajjālasā| smāraṃsmāramaharniśaṃ priyasakhīsambhogavārtāṃ punaḥ saṃdiṣṭā madanena tatra viduṣā bālā ciraṃ līyate|| ākāśapoleḥ
prāyo dāsyati no payodharataṭī gantuṃ purastāditi dhyānenaiva cakāsti sācigamane śikṣārasaścakṣuṣoḥ| antaḥsthānamiva pradātumadhunā kasyāpi puṇyātmanaḥ nirgantuṃ bahirunnataṃ stanataṭaṃ vistāri sannahyate|| 17
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vayaḥsandhipaddhatiḥ||
tāruṇyapaddhatiḥ (52)
dṛśoḥ sīmāvādaḥ śravaṇayugalena pratikalaṃ stanābhyāṃ saṃruddhe hṛdi manasijastiṣṭhati balāt| nitambaḥ sākrandaṃ kṣipati raśanādāma paritaḥ praveśastanvaṅgyā vapuṣi taruṇimno vijayate|| 1 bilhaṇasya
paryāptastanabhārapīḍitamurastenaiva madhyo hataḥ puṃsāṃ citravadhaṃ dhṛtervidadhate kāściddṛśorvṛttayaḥ| kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathitena pakṣmaladṛśaḥ pūrṇe tathā yauvane kandarpaḥ paripūrṇaviśvavijayaḥ kiṃ darpato nācaret|| 2 kasyāpi
mukhaṃ vikasitasmitaṃ valitavakrima prekṣaṇaṃ samucchvasitavibhramā gatirapāstasaṃsthā matiḥ| uro mukulitastanaṃ jaghanamaṇḍalaṃ bandhuraṃ batenduvadanātanau taruṇimodgamo modate|| 3 rumasya
padbhyāṃ muktāstaralagatayaḥ saṃśritā locanābhyāṃ śroṇībimbastyajati tanutāṃ sevate madhyabhāgaḥ| dhatte vakṣaḥ kucasacivatāmadvitīyaṃ ca vaktraṃ tadgātrāṇāṃ guṇavinimayaḥ kalpito yauvanena|| 4
śārīdyūtakalākutūhali manaśchekoktiśikṣāratiḥ hṛdyaṃ darpaṇapāṇinā svakabarībandhena cācāryakam| prauḍhastrīcaritānuvṛttiṣu raso bālye ca ca lajjā manāk stokārohiṇi yauvane mṛgadṛśaḥ ko 'pyeṣa kelikramaḥ|| 5 rājaśekharasyaitau
tarantīvāṅgāni skhaladamalalāvaṇyajaladhau prathimnaḥ prāgalbhyaṃ stanajaghanamunmudrayati ca| dṛśorlīlārambhāḥ sphuṭamapavadante saralatāṃ aho sāraṅgākṣyāstaruṇimani gāḍhaḥ parikaraḥ|| 6 kumbhakasya
gataṃ karṇābhyarṇaṃ prasarati tathāpyaṣiyugalaṃ kucau kumbhārambhau tadapi cimbukottambhanarucī| nitambaprāgbhāro gururapi gurutvaṃ mṛgayate kathaṃcinno tṛptistaruṇimani manye mṛgadṛśaḥ|| 7 rudrasya
ūrudvandvamaninditaṃ prathayatā śroṇīṃ samātanvatā romālīṃ sṛjatā samāgamayatā nābhiṃ gabhīraśriyā| madhyaṃ kṣāmayatā stanau ghanayatā kāntyā mukhaṃ limpatā tanvaṅgyā navayauvanena kimapi pratyaṅgamunmīlitam|| 8
tarattāraṃ cakṣuḥ kṣapayati munīnāmapi dṛśaḥ kucadvandvākrāntaṃ hṛdayamahṛdaḥ kānna kurute| gatirmandībhūtā harati gamanaṃ manmathavatāṃ aho tulyaṃ tanvyāstaruṇimani sarvaṃ vijayate|| 9 rudrasya
bhrūbhaṅgaḥ kuṭilaḥ stane ca garimā dṛṣṭergatirmantharā visrabdhaṃ hasitaṃ kapolaphalake vaidagdhyavakraṃ vacaḥ| noddiṣṭaṃ guruṇā na bandhukathitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na śāstre kvacit bālāyāḥ svayameva manmathakalāpāṇḍityamunmīlati|| 10
smitaparivṛtā vṛttirvācamapāṅgataraṅgitaṃ nayanacaritaṃ pādanyāso nitambabharālasaḥ| hahaha sutanorlīlāsūtraiḥ kṛtaṃ padamaṅgake vahatu madanaḥ śobhāmātraṃ dhanurnanu samprati|| 11 ghorakasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ tāruṇyavarṇanapaddhatiḥ||
strīṇāmaṅgavarṇanapaddhatiḥ (53)
tatra prathamaṃ keśapāśaḥ
snehaṃ parityajya nipīya dhūmaṃ tanvyāḥ kacā mokṣapathaṃ prapannāḥ| nitambasaṅgātpunareva baddhā aho durantā viṣayeṣu saktiḥ|| 1 kasyāpi
snānārdramukteṣvanu dhūpavāsaṃ vinyastasāyatnanamallikeṣu| kāmo vasantātyayamandavīryaḥ keśeṣu lebhe padamaṅganānām|| 2
unmīladvadanendukāntivisarairdūraṃ samutsāritaṃ bhagnaṃ pīnakucasthalasya ca rucā hastaprabhābhirhatam| etasyāḥ kalaviṅkakaṇṭhakadalīkalpaṃ milatkautukāt aprāptābhimukhaṃ ruṣeva sahasā keśeṣu lagnaṃ tamaḥ|| 3 kasyāpi
hṛtaṃ yadyapi nīlābjaṃ hṛtā madamaṣī gajāt| alakānāṃ tathāpyasyāḥ prāpuḥ kāntiṃ na ṣaṭpadāḥ|| 4 vaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
kauṭilyācchannamāhātmyastadīyo 'lakasaṃcayaḥ| kṛṣṇadyutiḥ purastiṣṭhannādadhe kaṃ samākulam|| 5 śakavṛddheḥ
lalāṭam
asyā lalāṭe racitā sakhībhirvibhāvyate candanapatralekhā| āpāṇḍurakṣāmakapolabhittāvanaṅgabāṇavraṇapaṭṭikeva|| 6 bhāsasya
bhruvau bhrūlekhāyugalaṃ bhāti tasyāścaṭulacakṣuṣaḥ| patradvayīva haritā nāsāvaṃśīvinirgatā|| 7 bilhaṇasya
jaḍasyendorlakṣmīṃ gatamapi madāndhasya kariṇaḥ kiśorasya chāyāṃ haratu hariṇasyekṣaṇagatām| idaṃ tu śyāmāṅgyāḥ kimapi lalitaṃ yanmadanataḥ samakṣaṃ bhrūkṣepairdhanurapi vidagdhādapahṛtam|| 8
yatraitā laharīcalāñcaladṛśo vyāpārayanti bhruvaṃ yattatraiva patanti santatamamī marmaspṛśo mārgaṇāḥ| taccakrīkṛtacāpasaṃcitaśarapreṅkhatkaraḥ krodhanaḥ dhāvatyagrata eva śāsanadharaḥ sajyaṃ yadāsāṃ smaraḥ|| 9
netre nūnamājñākarastasyāḥ subhruvo makaradhvajaḥ| yatastannetrasaṃcārasūciteṣu pravartate|| 10
yathā yathāsyāḥ stanayoḥ samunnatistathā tathā locanameti vakratrām| aho sahante bata nāparodayaṃ nisargato 'ntarmalinā manāgapi|| 11 kayorapyetau
sanmārge tāvadāste prabhavati puruṣastāvadevendriyāṇāṃ lajjāṃ tāvadvidhatte vinayamapi samālambate tāvadeva| bhrūcāpākṛṣṭamuktāḥ śravaṇapathajuṣo nīlapakṣmāṇa ete yāvallīlāvatīnāṃ na hṛdi dhṛtimuṣo dṛṣṭibāṇāḥ patanti|| 12 bāṇasya
nāsā purāṇabāṇatyāgāya nūnatāstrakutūhalāt| tannāsā bhāti kāmena tūṇīvādhomukhīkṛtā|| 13 bilhaṇasya
puṇḍarīkamivābhāti nāsāvaṃśagatamauktikam| kucasiṃhāsanasthasya smarabhūpasya subhruvaḥ|| 14 kṣemendrasya
nāsādasīyā tilapuṣpatūṇaṃ jagattrayanyastaśaratrayasya| śvāsānilāmodabharānumeyāṃ dadhattribāṇīṃ kusumāyudhasya|| 15 śrīharṣapaṇḍitasya
lalāṭe lolākṣyāstilakamiṣadhārī vidhurayaṃ svamāpūrṇaṃ vāñchannadharasudhayā devahitakṛt| ato nāsāgre 'sau tadupahataye mauktikamiṣāt sphuṭaṃ daityāmātyo 'dharaśaśabhṛtorantaragataḥ|| 16
karṇapāśaḥ saundaryapātre vaktrendau kuraṅgāsaṅgabhītayā| sūcitau śrotrapāśābhyāṃ pāśāviva mṛgīdṛśā|| 17 bilhaṇasya
kapolau ābadhnanpariveṣamaṇḍalamalaṃ vaktrendubimbādbahiḥ kurvaccampakajṛmbhamāṇakalikākarṇāvataṃsakriyām| tanvaṅgyāḥ parinṛtyatīva hasatīvotsarpatīvolbaṇaṃ lāvaṇyaṃ lalatīva kāñcanaśilākānte kapolasthale|| 18 trivikramasya
vetratvacā tulyarucāṃ vadhūnāṃ karṇāgrato gaṇḍatalāgatāni| bhṛṅgāḥ sahelaṃ yadi nāpatiṣyanko 'vedayiṣyannavacampakāni|| 19
adharaḥ dvijasaṅgatimāsādya sarvo rāgādvimucyate| raktastathāpi tanvaṅgyā bimboṣṭhaḥ kena hetunā|| 20 lakṣmaṇasya
rasavadamṛtaṃ kaḥ saṃdeho madhūni madhūnyatho madhuramadhikaṃ cūtasyāpi prasannarasaṃ phalam| sakṛdapi punarmadhyasthaḥ sanrasāntaravijjanaḥ vadatu yadihānyatsvādu syātpriyāradanacchadāt|| 21 kasyāpi
adharakṣatam sarvasyaiva hi ratnasya vraṇe 'rghaḥ parihīyate| dayitādhararatnaṃ tu vraṇitaṃ yātyanarghatām|| 22
ayi mṛgākṣi tavādharapallave dayitadantapadaṃ na bhavatyadaḥ| bhuvanamohanamantrapadāṅkitaṃ kimuta yantramidaṃ smarayoginaḥ|| 23 kayorapyetau
dantāḥ bhāti dantacchadenāsyāḥ svacchā daśanamallikā| sarasvatyakṣamāleva pūjāpadmadalāñcitā|| 24 bilhaṇasya
dvidhā vidhāya śītāṃśuṃ kapolau kṛtavānvidhiḥ| tanvyāstadrasaniṣyandabindavo radanāvalī|| 25 kapolakaveḥ
kapolau lolākṣyā madhumukulalīlāvijayinau urojau rejāte kanakakalaśābhogasubhagau| dṛśau vātotkhelattaralataranīlotpalarucau vaco no jānīmaḥ kimamṛtamayaṃ kiṃ viṣayamayam|| 26
mukham tasyā vacanacandrasya kāntiranyaiva jāyate| kalaṅkatulanāṃ dhatte yatra nāsāgramauktikam|| 27 bhānupaṇḍitasya
vidhāyāpūrvapūrṇenduṃ mukhamasyā abhūddhruvam| dhātā nijāsanāmbhojavinimīlitaduḥsthitaḥ|| 28 śrīharṣasya
ārabdhe dayitāmukhapratisame nirmātumasminnapi vyaktaṃ janmasamānakālamilitāmaṃśucchaṭāṃ varṣati| ātmadrohiṇi rohiṇīparivṛḍhe paryaṅkapaṅkeruhaḥ saṃkocādatiduḥsthitasya na vidhestacchilpamunmīlitam|| 29 murāreḥ
bibhrāṇo mṛgasakhyameva kimapi prauḍhaṃ tapastapyatāṃ ārādhnotu nirantaraṃ diviṣadaḥ pīyūṣasatreṇa ca| dehārdhena punaḥ karotu yadi vā bhūteśvarasyārcanaṃ tadvaktreṇa samastathāpi bhavitā śaṅke na śītadyutiḥ|| 30 gotrānandanasya
yadapi vibudhaiḥ sindhorantaḥ kathaṃcidupārjitaṃ tadapi sakalaṃ cāru strīṇāṃ mukheṣu vibhāvyate| surasumanasaḥ śvāsāmode śaśī ca kapolayoḥ amṛtamadhare tiryagbhūte viṣaṃ ca vilocane|| 31 bhāsasya
anākāśe candraḥ sarasijadaladvandvasahitaḥ gṛhītaḥ paścārdhe kuṭilakuṭilaiḥ so 'pi timiraiḥ| sudhāṃ muñcatyuccairaniśamatha saṃmohajananīṃ kimutpātālīyaṃ vadata jagataḥ kartumuditā|| 32
janānandaścandro bhavati na kathaṃ nāma sukṛtī prayāto 'vasthābhistisṛbhirapi yaḥ koṭimiyatīm| bhruvorlīlāṃ bālaḥ śriyamalikapaṭṭasya taruṇaḥ mukhendoḥ sarvasvaṃ harati hariṇākṣyāḥ pariṇataḥ|| 33
sādhu candramasi puṣkaraiḥ kṛtaṃ mīlitaṃ yadabhirāmatādhike| udyatā jayini kāminīmukhe tena sāhasamanuṣṭhitaṃ punaḥ|| 35 abhinandasya
maikaṃ tamastabakamūrdhvamapākṛthāstvameṇaṃ tyajāsya vimale nayane gṛhāṇa| lolālakaṃ taralavīkṣitamāyatākṣyāḥ sākṣānmukhaṃ yadi bhavānanukartukāmaḥ|| 36 keṣāmapyete
kaṇṭhaḥ
kaṇṭhasya vidadhe kāntiṃ muktābharaṇatā yathā| tasyāḥ svabhāvaramyasya muktābharaṇatā tathā|| 37 śakavṛddheḥ
mātaṅgakumbhasaṃsparśajātapātakaśaṅkayā| snātīva muktāhāro 'syāḥ sphuratkāntijale gale|| 38 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
ayaṃ trayāṇāṃ grāmāṇāṃ nidhānaṃ madhuradhvaniḥ| rekhātrayamitīvāsyāḥ sūtritaṃ kaṇṭhakandale|| 39 bilhaṇasya
bāhu
dayitābāhupāśasya kuto 'yamaparo vidhiḥ| jīvayatyarpitaḥ kaṇṭhe mārayatyapavarjitaḥ|| 40
śabdavadbhiralaṃkārairupetamatikomalam| suvṛttaṃ kāvyavadreje tadbāhulatikādvayam|| 41 śakavṛddheretau
sarale api dorlekhe citraṃ cañcalacakṣuṣaḥ| amugdhābhyo mṛṇālībhyaḥ kathamājahvatuḥ śriyam|| 42 bilhaṇasya
hastatalam
kāntiprakarṣaṃ daśanacchadena sandhyāghane baddhapadaṃ harantyāḥ| tasyā gṛhodyānasarogatasya hastastha evāmburuhasya rāgaḥ|| 43 kumāradāsasya
aṅgulyaḥ
aṅgulībhiḥ kuraṅgākṣyāḥ śobhate mudrikāvalī| proteva bāṇaiḥ pañceṣoḥ sūkṣmā lakṣyaparamparā|| 44 bilhaṇasya
sudīrghā rāgaśālinyo bahuparvamanoharāḥ| tasyā virejuraṅgulyaḥ kāmināṃ saṃkathā iva|| 45 śakavṛddheḥ
stanau
mukhenducandrikāpūraplāvyamānau punaḥ punaḥ| śītabhītāvivānyonyaṃ tasyāḥ pīḍayataḥ stanau|| 46
tatkucau carataḥ kiṃcinnyūnaṃ manasijavratam| nityonmukhau yadāsāte mauliratnasya bhāsvataḥ|| 47 bilhaṇasyaitau
tasyāḥ smitapraṇayipūrṇamukhendubimbānnirgacchadacchadaśanāṃśusudhāṃ nidhātum| pīnastanadvayamiṣāttapanīyakumbhau lobhādadhaḥ praguṇitāviva padmajena|| 48 nācirājasya
nāyaṃ śaśī tatpratirūpamanyadyasmānna viśleṣayati dvayaṃ nau| iti sma tarkādiva paśyatastau tasyā mukhenduṃ kucacakravākau|| 49 kumāradāsasya
paṅkodbhavatvaparivādabhayānmṛgākṣyā jātaṃ sarojayugalaṃ kucaveṣadhāri| śakyaṃ na dhātṛvihitaṃ parihartumasya bhūyo 'pi yena ghanacandanapaṅkayogaḥ|| 50 utprekṣāvallabhasya
tadātvapronmīlanmradimaramaṇīyātkaṭhinatāṃ vicitya pratyaṅgādiva taruṇabhāvena ghaṭitau| stanāvābibhrāṇāḥ kṣaṇvinayavaiyātyamasṛṇasmaronmeṣāḥ keṣāmupari na rasānāṃ yuvatayaḥ|| 51 śrīmurāreḥ
nikhilairnirastamaṅgairaṅgīkṛtyāpi bhāviparimardam| śaraṇāgatamiva rakṣati kāṭhinyaṃ kucayugaṃ tanvyāḥ|| 52 mālatīmādhavasya
dhṛtaghanaruciradyutinā vilasaddhāreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa| dalayati kaṃ nābhimukhaṃ bālā kucamaṇḍalāgreṇa|| 53 vijayaśarmaṇaḥ
stanarājau tathānyonyaṃ maṇḍalākramaṇodyatau| kartuṃ yathaitayoḥ sandhirvidhātrāpi na śakyate|| 54
tanvaṅgyāḥ stanayugmena mukhaṃ na prakaṭīkṛtam| hārāya guṇine sthānaṃ na dattamiti lajjayā|| 55
kāṭhinyamaṅgairnikhilairnirastaṃ stanau kṛśāṅgyāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagāma| adhaḥ patiṣyāva itīva bhītyā na śaknutastāvapi hātumetat|| 56 keṣāmapyete
nirṇetuṃ śakyamastīti madhyaṃ tava nitambini| anyathā nopapadyeta payodharabharasthitiḥ|| 57 kasyāpi
aṃśukena jaghanaṃ tirodadhe kañcukena ca kucau mṛgīdṛśām| pīyamānamaniśaṃ priyekṣaṇaiḥ kṣāmatāmia jagāma madhyamam|| 58
vapuḥprakarṣādupacīyamānastanadvayasyodvahanaśrameṇa| atyantakārśyaṃ vanajāyatākṣyā madhyo jagāmeti mamaiṣa tarkaḥ|| 59 kumāradāsasya
suhṛttamāvekata unnatau stanau gururnitambo 'pyayamanyataḥ sthitaḥ| kathaṃ bhaje kāntamitīva cintayā tatāna tanmadhyamatīva tānavam|| 60 candrasūreḥ
madhyena tasyā vijitaḥ kṛśāṅgyāḥ pañcānanaḥ kānanalabdhavāsaḥ| tasyāḥ stanadvandvataṭīdhiyeva kumbhīndrakumbhau kupito bhinatti|| 61 arasiṭhakkurasya
tantriviṣṭapamākhyātaṃ tanvaṅgyā yadvalitrayam| yenānimiṣadṛṣṭitvaṃ nṛṇāmapyupajāyate|| 62 viśākhadevasya
daridramudaraṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre lāvaṇyapūrṇayoḥ| panthānaṃ stanayostanvyāstrivalīviṣamaṃ vidhiḥ|| 63 bilhaṇasya
tanutvaramaṇīyasya madhyasya ca bhujasya ca| abhavannitarāmasyā valayaḥ kāntivṛddhaye|| 64 (vacanaśleṣaḥ ) kasyāpi
madhyetrivalitripathaṃ pīvarakucacatvare ca dhavaladṛśām| dalayati madanapiśācaḥ puruṣaṃ hi manāgapi skhalitam|| 65 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
bhāti romāvalī tasyāḥ payodharabharonnatau| jātā ratnaśalākeva śroṇīvaiḍūryabhūmitaḥ|| bilhaṇasya
ānīlacūcukaśilīmukhamunnataikaromāvalīvipulanālamidaṃ priyāyāḥ| uttuṅgasaṅgatapayodharapadmayugmaṃ nābheradhaḥ kathayatīva mahānidhānam|| 67 kasyāpi
gambhīranābhihradasanniveśe rarāja tanvyā navaromarājiḥ| mukhendubhītastanacakravākadvandvojjhitā śaivalamañjarīva|| 68 lakṣmīdharasya
amuṣmi/llāvaṇyāmṛtasarasi nūnaṃ mṛgadṛśaḥ smaraḥ śarvapluṣṭaḥ pṛthujaghanabhāge nipatitaḥ| yadaṅgāṅgārāṇāṃ praśamapiśunā nābhikuhare śikhā dhūmasyeyaṃ pariṇamati romāvalivapuḥ|| 69 rāmasya
manye samāpte lāvaṇyasārasarge mṛgīdṛśaḥ| apūrayitveva gato nābhirandhraṃ caturmukhaḥ|| 70 bilhaṇasya
kucakumbhau samālambya tarantī kāntinimnagām| pramādatastato bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭirnābhau nimajjati|| 71
nāyaṃ hārasya madhye taralamarakato nābhideśe kṛśāṅgyāḥ naiṣāpyatra triyāmāramaṇaśuciruciḥ paddhatirmauktikānām| nābhīlāvaṇyavāpyāmayamasamaśarastryakṣakopāgnidagdhaḥ
===
pade vākye pramāṇe ca parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāgatā| ato vidvajjanasyāpi spṛhaṇīyā mṛgekṣaṇā|| 93||
guruṇā stanabhāreṇa mukhacandreṇa bhāsvatā| śanaiścarābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ reje grahamayīva sā|| 94||
prāṇānāṃ ca priyāyāśca mūḍhāḥ sādṛśyakāriṇaḥ| priyā kaṇṭhagatā ratyai prāṇā maraṇahetavaḥ|| 95||
stanataṭamatīva tuṅgaṃ madhyo nimnaḥ samunnataṃ jaghanam| viṣame mṛgaśāvākṣyā vapuṣi nave ka iva na skhalati|| 96|| keṣāmapyete
mukhena candrakāntena mahānīlaiḥ śiroruhaiḥ| pādābhyāṃ padmarāgābhyāṃ reje ratnamayīva sā|| 97||
gatirveṇī ca nāgena vapūrūrū ca rambhayā| pāṇī pravālairoṣṭhau ca tasyāstulyatvamāyayuḥ|| 98||
svabhyastarūpāpi navaiva nityaṃ vināpi hāsaṃ hasatīva kāntyā| madādṛte 'pi skhalatīva bhāvairvācaṃ vinā vyāharatīva dṛṣṭyā|| 99 bhagavato vyāsasya
tadvaktraṃ yadi mudritā śaśikathā taccetsmitaṃ kā sudhā taccakṣuryadi hāritaṃ kuvalayaistāścedgiro dhiṅmadhu| dhikkandarpadhanurbhruvau yadi ca te kiṃ vā bahu brūmahe yatsatyaṃ punaruktavastuviṣayaḥ sargakramo vedhasaḥ|| 100 rājaśekharasya
tadvaktrasya kalaṅka eva tulanā pīyūṣadhāmno 'pi yat kandarpasya dhanurnidarśanamidaṃ nindāspadaṃ tadbhruvoḥ| sā tallocanayostrapā kuvalayaiḥ sādharmyacintāpi yā tasyāstatpratibimbameva niyataṃ mātrāvisaṃvādinī|| 101 gotrānandanasya
saurabhyaṃ mṛgalāñchane yadi bhavedindīvare vakratā mādhuryaṃ yadi vidrume taralatā kandarpacāpe yadi| rambhāyāṃ yadi vipratīpavalanaṃ prāptopamānaṃ tadā tadvaktraṃ tadudīkṣaṇaṃ tadadharastadbhrūstadūrudvayam|| 102 kasyāpi
kamalaśaradhirambhāsaikatānukramāḍhyaṃ kanakakalaśabhārākrāntasaudāminīkam| kisalayitamṛṇālaṃ hāragarbhapravālaṃ kuvalayitaśaśāṅkaṃ kauśalaṃ sā vidhātus|| 103 sūktisahasrāt
yato yato 'ṅgādapayāti kañcukastatastataḥ svarṇamarīcivīcayaḥ| yato yato 'syā nipatanti dṛṣṭayastatastataḥ śyāmasarojavṛṣṭayaḥ|| 104
\Colo iti sāmānyataḥ strīsvarūpavarṇanam|
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāmakhilāṅgavarṇanapaddhatiḥ||
sphurasi bāhulate kimanarthakaṃ tvamapi locana vāma bhava sthiram| tamahamāgatamapyaparādhinaṃ na parirabdhumalaṃ na ca vīkṣitum|| 1 kasyāpi
śrutvā garjitamambare jalamucaḥ sadyo bhayādunmukhī yāvanmuñcati nāśru muñcati tathā yāvanna megho jalam| tāvadvāhanapāṃsusūcitapatipratyāgatiḥ svāṃ tanuṃ romodbhedavatīṃ niṣiñcati vadhūrānandabāṣpormibhiḥ|| 2 sūktisahasrāt
bālā vandanamālikākisalayagranthīnadhaḥ kurvatī śrutvā śabdamabhīṣṭavāhanavibhordāśerakasyāṅgaṇe| ākrandātsuhṛdo vanādgurujanaṃ nāsāgrasaṅgādasūn kāntaṃ strīvadhapātakātsmaramasatkīrteḥ parāvartayat|| 3 kasyāpi
āyāte dayite marusthalabhuvāmutprekṣya durlaṅghyatāṃ gehinyā paritoṣabāṣpataralāmāsajya dṛṣṭiṃ mukhe| dattvā pīluśamīkarīrakavalānsvenāñcalenādarāt unmṛṣṭaṃ karabhasya kesarasaṭābhārāvalagnaṃ rajaḥ|| 4 adbhutapuṇyasya
āgacchansūcito yena yenānīto gṛhaṃ prati| prathamaṃ sakhi kaḥ pūjyaḥ kiṃ kākaḥ kiṃ kramelakaḥ|| 5 somakaveḥ
dīrghā vandanamālikā viracitā dṛṣṭyaiva nendīvaraiḥ puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraḥ smitena racito no kundajātyādibhiḥ| dattaṃ svedamucā payodharabhareṇārghyaṃ na kumbhāmbhasā svairevāvayavaiḥ priyasya viśatastanvyā kṛtaṃ maṅgalam|| 6 amarukasya
kiṃcitkampitapāṇikaṅkaṇaravaiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ nanu svāgataṃ vrīḍānamramukhābjayā caraṇayornyaste ca netrotpale| dvārasthastanayugmamaṅgalaghaṭe dattaḥ praveśo hṛdi svāminkiṃ na tavātitheḥ samucitaṃ sakhyānayānuṣṭhitam|| 7 trivikramabhaṭṭasya
yenaiva sūcitanavābhyudayaprasaṅgā mīnāhatisphuritatāmarasopamena| anyaṃ nimīlya nayanaṃ muditaiva subhrūrvāmena tena nayanena dadarśa kāntam|| 8 utprekṣāvallabhasya
ānandodgatabāṣpapūrapihitaṃ cakṣuḥ kṣamaṃ nekṣituṃ bāhū sveditayaiva kampavidhurau śaktau na kaṇṭhagrahe| vāṇī sādhvasagadgadākṣarapadā saṃkṣobhalolaṃ manaḥ satyaṃ yatpriyasaṃgamo 'pi sucirājjāto viyogāyate|| 9 kasyāpi
keyūrīkṛtakaṅkaṇāvalirasau karṇāvataṃsīkṛtavyālolālakapaddhatiḥ pathi puro baddhāñjaliḥ pṛcchati| yāvatkaṃcidudantamātmakamitustāvatsa evetyatha vrīḍāvakritakaṇṭhakāṇḍamabalā bhinnā na kaiḥ kai rasaiḥ|| 10 rājaśekharasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vipralambhe nāyakātithyaprakaraṇam
sphuṭatu hṛdayaṃ kāmaḥ kāmaṃ karotu tanuṃ tanuṃ na sakhi caṭulapremṇā kāryaṃ punardayitena me| iti sarabhasaṃ mānāveśādudīrya vacastayā ramaṇapadavī sāraṅgākṣyā nirantaramīkṣitā|| 1
calatu taralā dṛṣṭirbhraṣṭā khalā sakhi mekhalā skhalatu kucayorutkampānme vidīryatu kañcukam| tadapi na mayā sambhāvyo 'sau punardayitaḥ śaṭhaḥ sphuṭati hṛdayaṃ maunenāntarna me yadi tatkṣaṇāt|| 2
dūrādutsukamāgate vivalitaṃ sambhāṣiṇi sphāritaṃ saṃśliṣyatyaruṇaṃ gṛhītavasane kopāñcitabhrūlatam| māninyāścaraṇānativyatikare bāṣpāmbupūrṇaṃ kṣaṇāt cakṣurjātamaho prapañcacaturaṃ jātāgasi preyasi|| 3
bhrūbhedo guṇitaściraṃ nayanayorabhyastamāmīlitaṃ roddhuṃ śikṣitamādareṇa hasitaṃ maune 'bhiyogaḥ kṛtaḥ| dhairyaṃ kartumapi sthirīkṛtamidaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃcinmayā baddho mānaparigrahe parikaraḥ siddhistu daive sthitā|| 4
tadvaktrābhimukhaṃ mukhaṃ vinamitaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā pādayoḥ tatsallāpakutūhalākulatare śrotre niruddhe mayā| pāṇibhyāṃ ca tiraskṛtaḥ sapulakaḥ svedodgamo gaṇḍayoḥ sakhyaḥ kiṃ karavāṇi yānti śatadhā matkañcukīsandhayaḥ|| 5 amarukasya
ekatrāsanasaṅgatiḥ parihṛtā pratyudgamāddūrataḥ tāmbūlānayanacchalena rabhasāśleṣo 'pi saṃvighnitaḥ| ālāpo 'pi na miśritaḥ parijanaṃ vyāpārayantyāntike kāntaṃ pratyupacārataścaturayā kopaḥ kṛtārthīkṛtaḥ|| 6 amarānandasya (vḷ.\ pulindasya)
bhrūbhaṅge sahasodgate 'pi vadanaṃ nītaṃ parāṅnamratāṃ īṣattaṃ prati bhedakāri hasitaṃ noktaṃ vaco niṣṭhuram| antarbāṣpajaḍīkṛtaṃ prabhutayā cakṣurna viṣphāritaṃ kopaśca prakaṭīkṛto dayitayā muktaśca na praśrayaḥ|| 7 śrīharṣasya
bhrūbhaṅge racite 'pi dṛṣṭiradhikaṃ sotkaṇṭhamudvīkṣyate ruddhāyāmapi vāci sasmitamidaṃ dagdhānanaṃ jāyate| kārkaśyaṃ gamite 'pi cetasi tanū romāñcamālambate dṛṣṭe nirvahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati kathaṃ mānasya tasmiñjane|| 8 bhadantārogyasya
kiṃcidbāṣpajalāvaliptalalite netre manākkuñcite rāgo visphuraṇānubandharuciraḥ saṃdarśito gaṇḍayoḥ| kampaścādharapallave viracitaḥ kāmaṃ kuraṅgīdṛśā no jāne kimayaṃ priyaṃ prati kṛtaḥ kopo 'bhilāṣo 'thavā|| 9
yāvanno sakhi gocaraṃ nayanayorāyāti tāvadbhruvaṃ gatvā brūhi yathādya te dayitayā mānaḥ samālambitaḥ| dṛṣṭe dhūrtaviceṣṭite tu dayite tasminnavaśyaṃ mama svedāmbhaḥplitarodhanirbharatanoḥ smeraṃ mukhaṃ jāyate|| 10 vardhakasya
āśaṅkya praṇatiṃ paṭāntapihitau pādau karotyādarāt vyājenāgatamāvṛṇoti hasitaṃ na spaṣṭamudvīkṣate| mayyālāpavati pratīpavacanā sakhyā samaṃ bhāṣate tasyāstiṣṭhatu nirbharapraṇayitā māno 'pi ramyodayaḥ|| 11 bhīmasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ māninyavasthāpaddhatiḥ||
yatpādaṃ praṇataḥ priyaḥ paruṣayā vācā sa nirjhāṭitaḥ yatsakhyānna kṛtaṃ vaco jaḍatayā yanmanyureko dhṛtaḥ| pāpasyāsya phalaṃ tadetadadhunā yaccandanendudyutiprāleyāmbusamīrapaṅkajabisairgātraṃ muhurdahyate|| 1 rudrasya
smitajyotsnābhiste dhavalayati viśvaṃ mukhaśaśī dṛśaste pīyūṣadrutamiva vimuñcati paritaḥ| vapuste lāvaṇyaṃ kirati madhuraṃ dikṣu tadidaṃ kutaste pāruṣyaṃ sutanu hṛdayenādya guṇitam|| 2
pādānate praṇayapeśalavāci kānte tyaktastvayā yadatikopanayā namanyuḥ| tīvrānutāpagalitaḥ svayameva manye niryāti te tadayamaśrujalacchalena|| 3 kayorapyetau
vimuñcāmuṃ mānaṃ saphalasya vacaḥ sādhu suhṛdāṃ mudhā saṃtāpena glapayasi kimaṅgaṃ smarabhuvā| priyaṃ pādaprāntapraṇatamadhunā mānaya bhṛśaṃ na mugdhe pratyetuṃ prabhavati gataḥ kālahariṇaḥ|| 4 rudrasya
likhannāste bhūmiṃ bahiravanataḥ prāṇadayitaḥ nirāhārāḥ sakhyaḥ satataruditocchūnanayanāḥ| parityaktaṃ sarvaṃ hasitapaṭhitaṃ pañjaraśukaiḥ tavāvasthā ceyaṃ visṛja kaṭhine mānamadhunā|| 5
santyevātra gṛhe gṛhe yuvatayastāḥ pṛccha gatvādhunā preyāṃsaḥ praṇamanti kiṃ tava punardāso yathā vartate| ātmadrohiṇi durjanaiḥ pralapitaṃ karṇe vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ chinnasneharaso bhavanti puruṣā duḥkhānuvṛttyā punaḥ|| 6
aṅgulyagranakhena bāṣpasalilaṃ vikṣipya vikṣipya kiṃ tūṣṇīṃ rodiṣi kopane bahutaraṃ phūtkṛtya rodiṣyasi| yasyāste piśunopadeśavacanairmāne 'tibhūmiṃ gate nirviṇṇo 'nunayaṃ prati priyatamo madhyasthatāmeṣyati|| 7
pādāsakte suciramiha te vāmatā kaiva mugdhe mandārambhe praṇayini jane ko 'parādhoparodhaḥ| itthaṃ tasyāḥ parijanakathākomalālāpavege bāṣpodbhedastadanu sahasā na sthito na pravṛttaḥ|| 8 amarukasya
anālocya premṇaḥ pariṇatimanādṛtya suhṛdaḥ tvayā kānte mānaḥ kimiti sarale samprati kṛtaḥ| samākṛṣṭā eva pralayadahanodbhāsuraśikhāḥ svahastenāṅgārāstadalamadhunāraṇyaruditaiḥ|| 9 vākūṭasya
asadvṛtto nāyaṃ na ca khalu guṇaireṣa rahitaḥ priyo muktāhārastava caraṇamūle nipatitaḥ| gṛhāṇainaṃ mugdhe vrajatu tava kaṇṭhapraṇayitāṃ upāyo nāstyanyastava hṛdayasaṃtāpaśamane|| 10
puraścakṣūrāgastadanu manaso 'nanyaparatā tanormlāniryasya tvayi samabhavadyatra ca tava| yuvā so 'yaṃ preyāniha suvadane muñca jaḍatāṃ vidhāturvaidagdhyaṃ vilasatu sakāmo 'stu madanaḥ|| 11 bhavabhūteḥ
prakāro mānasya priyasakhi yadīdṛkkvacidapi śruto vā dṛṣṭo vā kathayatu tadāyaṃ parijanaḥ| priyaṃ pādaprāntapraṇatamavadhūya tvamadhunā vṛicchidraiḥ paśyantyapasara hasiṣyantyasuhṛdaḥ|| 12
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitasūktimuktāvalyāṃ sakhyanunayaḥ
bāle nātha vimuñca mānini ruṣaṃ kopānmayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ khedo 'smāsu na me 'parādhyati bhavānsarve 'parādhā mayi| tatkiṃ rodiṣu gadgadena vacasā kasyāgrato rudyate nanvetanmama kā tavāsmi dayitā nāsmītyato rudyate|| 1 śrīkumāradāsasya
nayananipāte 'ṅkuritaḥ pallavito vacasi puṣpito hasite| phalatu kṛśāṅgi tavāṅgasparśena manoratho 'smākam|| 2
yadvācaḥ pracuropacāracaturā yatsāgrahaṃ dūrataḥ pratyutthānamidaṃ svahastanihitaṃ yadbhinnamapyāsanam| utpaśyāmi yadevameva ca muhurdṛṣṭiḥ sakhīsaṃmukhaṃ tacchaṅke tava paṅkajākṣi balavānkopaprasādodayaḥ|| 3 rudrasya
tathābhūdasmākaṃ prathamamavibhaktā tanuriyaṃ tato 'nu tvaṃ preyānvayamapi hatāśāḥ priyatamāḥ| idānīṃ nāthastvaṃ vayamapi kalatraṃ kimaparaṃ mayāptaṃ prāṇānāṃ kuliśakaṭhinānāṃ phalamidam|| 4 amarukasya
yena śrotrarasāyanaṃ mama haṭhādvācastavāmīlitāḥ bhagnaṃ yena tava bhruvorvilasitaṃ netrotsavārambhi me| maccetonilayaśca yastvadadharaḥ śvāsānilairbādhyate pratyarthī sa mama priye kathamayaṃ mānastvayā svīkṛtaḥ|| 5 gotrānandanasya
bhavatu viditaṃ vyarthālāpairalaṃ priya gamyatāṃ tanurapi na te doṣo 'smākaṃ vidhistu parāṅmukhaḥ| tava yadi tathā rūḍhaṃ prema prapannamimāṃ daśāṃ prakṛtitarale kā naḥ pīḍā gate hatajīvite|| 6 dharmakīrteḥ
vyāvṛttaṃ khalu sarvato viṣayatastvayyeva līnaṃ manaḥ nityaṃ ca tvadadhīnameva niyataṃ majjīvanaṃ mānini| matvaivaṃ mayi nūnamanyaviṣayāśaṅkā tvayā tyajyatāṃ kiṃ vānyatra niśākaro 'bhiramate tyaktvā kṣaṇaṃ kaumudīm|| 7
kṛtaṃ mithyāvādairvirama viditaḥ kāmuka cirāt priyāṃ tāmevoccairabhisara yadīyairnakhapadaiḥ| vilāsaiśca prāptaṃ tava hṛdi padaṃ rāgabahulaiḥ mayā kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ dhruvamakuṭilācāraparayā|| 8 rudrasya
akaravamadhimauli pādapadmāvapanaya mānini mānitāmakāṇḍe| yadi pararamaṇīṃ gatastadātha stanayugaliṅgayugaṃ spṛśāmi tanvi|| 9 kasyāpi
kopo yatra bhrukuṭiracanā vigraho yatra maunaṃ yatrānyonyasmitamanunayo dṛṣṭipātaḥ prasādaḥ| tasya premṇastadidamadhunā vaiśasaṃ paśya jātaṃ tvaṃ pādānte luṭhasi na ca me manyumokṣaḥ khalāyāḥ|| 10 vāmanasya
dāse kṛtāgasi bhaveducitaḥ prabhūṇāṃ pādaprahara iti sundari nāsmi dūye| udyatkaṭhorapulakāṅkurakaṇṭhakāgrairyatkhidyate tava padaṃ nanu sā vyathā me|| 11 śrīmuñjasya
vadhūnāṃ sarvāsāṃ caraṇaharaṇairdūṣitamidaṃ śiraste sparśārhaṃ sakṛdapi na pādasya hi mama| prahāraḥ pādaistvāṃ ramayati sa matto na sulabhaḥ taduttiṣṭha svāminbhavatu tava saubhāgyamatulam|| 12 sarvadāsasya
ātāmratāmapanayāmi vilakṣa eṣa lākṣākṛtāṃ caraṇayostava tanvi mūrdhnā| kopoparāgajanitāṃ tu mukhendubimbe hartuṃ kṣamā yadi paraṃ karuṇā mayi syāt|| 13 śrīharṣasya
kiṃ pādānte patasi vimanāḥ svāmino hi svatantrāḥ kaṃcitkālaṃ kvacidabhiratastena kaste 'parādhaḥ| āgaskāriṇyahamiha yayā jīvitaṃ tvadviyoge bhartṛprāṇāḥ striya iti nanu tvaṃ mayaivānuneyaḥ|| 14 kasyāpi
kāmasyāpi śarāhatirna gaṇitā tvaṃ jīvanaṃ saṃsmṛtā no dagdho virahānalena jhaṭiti tvatsaṃgamāśāmṛtaiḥ| nīto 'yaṃ divaso vicitralikhitaiḥ saṃkalparūpairmayā kiṃ cānyanmanasi sthitāsi bhavatī tatra svayaṃ sākṣiṇī|| 15 rājaputrayaśovarmaṇaḥ
sārdhaṃ manorathaśataistava dhūrta kāntā saiva sthitā manasi kṛtrimabhāvaramyā| asmākamasti na kathaṃcidihāvakāśastasmātkṛtaṃ caraṇapātaviḍambanābhiḥ|| 16 rudrasya
subhru tvaṃ kupitetyapāstamaśanaṃ tyaktāḥ kathā yoṣitāṃ dūrādeva mayojjhitāḥ surabhayaḥ sraggandhadhūpādayaḥ| kopaṃ rāgiṇi muñca mayyavanate dṛṣṭe prasīdādhunā sadyastvadvirahe bhavanti subhage sarvā mamāndhā diśaḥ|| 17 kasyāpi
prātaḥ prātarupāgatena janitā nirnidratā cakṣuṣoḥ mandāyā mama gauravavyapanayādutpāditaṃ lāghavam| kiṃ tadyanna kṛtaṃ tvayā maraṇabhīrmuktā mayā gamyatāṃ duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhasi yacca pathyamadhunā kartāsmi tacchroṣyasi|| 18 amarukasya
śītāṃśurmukhamutpale tava dṛśau padmānukārau karau rambhāstambhanibhaṃ tadūruyugalaṃ bāhū mṛṇālopamau| ityāhlādakarākhilāṅgi rabhasānniḥśaṅkamāliṅga māṃ aṅgāni tvamanaṅgatāpavidhurāṇyehyehi nirvāpaya|| 19 śrīharṣasya
yadā tvaṃ candro 'bhūrhimakarakalāpeśalavapuḥ tadāhaṃ jātā drākśaśadharamaṇīnāṃ pratikṛtiḥ| idānīmarkastvaṃ khararucisamutsāritarasaḥ kirantī kopāgnīnahamapi ravigrāvaghaṭitā|| 20 acalasya
kaṭhinahṛdaye muñca bhrāntiṃ vyalīkakathāśritāṃ piśunavacanairduḥkhaṃ netuṃ na yuktamimaṃ janam| kimidamathavā satyaṃ mugdhe tvayādya viniścitaṃ yadabhirucitaṃ tanme kṛtvā priye sukhamāsyatām|| 21|| amarukasya
tvaṃ tāvadbahuvallabho navavayāḥ kāntaḥ sukhī nirghṛṇaḥ no jānāsi paravyathāṃ śaṭhāte naivāsi duḥkhī yataḥ| kiṃ tvanyāḥ paripṛccha manmathaśaraiḥ pīḍāmasahyāmimāṃ kiṃ vā no bhava yena sajjanajanaiḥ kāpāliko nocyase|| 22 kasyāpi
prasāde vartasva prakaṭaya mudaṃ saṃtyaja ruṣaṃ priye śuṣyantyaṅgānyamṛtamiva te siñcatu vapuḥ| nidhānaṃ saukhyānāṃ kṣaṇamabhimukhaṃ sthāpaya mukhaṃ na mugdhe pratyetuṃ prabhavati gataḥ kālahariṇaḥ|| 23 candrakasya
kṛtakakṛtakairmāyāśāṭhyaistvayāpyativartitaṃ nibhṛtanibhṛtaiḥ kāryālāpairmayāpyupalakṣitam| bhavatu viditaṃ neṣṭā te 'haṃ vṛthā parikhidyase tvahamasahanā tvaṃ niḥsnehaḥ samena samaṃ gatam|| 24
kiṃ kaṇṭhe śithilīkṛto bhujalatāpāśaḥ pramādānmayā nidrācchedavivartaneṣvabhimukhaṃ nādyāpi sambhāvitam| anyastrījanasaṃkathālaghurahaṃ svapne tvayā lakṣitaḥ doṣaṃ paśyasi kiṃ priye parijanopālambhayogye mayi|| 25 niśānārāyaṇasya
ardhokte bhayamāgato 'si kimidaṃ kaṇṭhaśca kiṃ gadgadaḥ cāṭorasya na ca kṣaṇo 'yamamipakṣipteyamāstāṃ kathā| brūhi prastutamastu samprati mahatkarṇe sakhīnāṃ mukhaiḥ tṛptirnirbharamebhirakṣarapadaiḥ prāgeva me sambhṛtā|| 26 kasyāpi
viniścetuṃ śakyo na sukhamiti vā duḥkhamiti vā pramodo nidrā vā kimu viṣavisarpaḥ kimu mudaḥ| tava sparśe sparśe mama hi parimūḍhendriyagaṇaḥ vikāraḥ ko 'pyantarjaḍayati ca tāpaṃ ca kurute|| 27 bhavabhūteḥ
yatrārkāyitamindunā sarasijairaṅgārapuñjāyitaṃ kruddhāyāṃ mayi nātha te kadalikākhaṇḍairalātāyitam| kālo 'nyaḥ khalu ko 'pi so 'mṛtamayo jāto viṣākto 'dhunā dhikprāṇāniti niryadaśrurabalā mohaṃ vadantī gatā|| 28 rudrasya
dṛṣṭiṃ ruṣā kṣipasī bhāmini yadyapīmāṃ snigdheyameṣyati tathāpi na rūkṣabhāvam| tyaktvā tvarāṃ vraja tava skhalitairayaṃ tu khedaṃ kariṣyati gururniyataṃ nitambaḥ|| 29
yadgamyaṃ gurugauravasya suhṛdo yasmi/llabhante 'nyataraṃ yaddākṣiṇyavaśādbhayācca sahate mandopacārānapi| yallajjā niruṇaddhi yatra śapathairutpādyate pratyayaḥ tatkiṃ prema sa ucyate paricayastatrāpi mānena kim|| 30 amarukasya
evaṃ yathāha bhavatī mama sarvadoṣāḥ kaḥ svāminā kuvalayākṣi sahānubandhaḥ| eṣo 'ñjalirviracitaḥ kuru nigrahaṃ me dāse 'parādhavati ko 'vasaraḥ kṣamāyāḥ|| 31
māna nirādhāraḥ (?)tvaṃ gacchāstu śivastu panthāste| amunā baddhāñjalinā hṛdayamaśeṣaṃ nipītaṃ me|| 32 kayorapyetau
sutanu jahihi kopaṃ paśya padānataṃ mām| na khalu tava kadācitkopa evaṃvidho 'bhūt| iti nigadati nāthe tiryagāmīlitākṣyā nayanajalamanalpaṃ muktamuktaṃ na kiṃcit|| 33 amarukasya
\Colo iti vipralambha uktapratyuktivarṇanapaddhatiḥ
parimlāne māne mukhaśaśini tasyāḥ karadhṛte mayi kṣīṇopāye praṇipatanamātraikaśaraṇe| tayā pakṣmaprāntadhvajapaṭaniruddhena sahasā prasādo bāṣpeṇa stanataṭaviśīrṇena kathitaḥ|| 1 amarukasya
dṛṣṭe locanavanmanāṅmukulitaṃ pārśvasthite vaktravat nyagbhūtaṃ bahirāsitaṃ pulakavatsparśaṃ samātanvati| nīvībandhavadāgataṃ śithilatāṃ sambhāṣamāṇe kṣaṇāt mānenāpasṛtaṃ hriyeva sudṛśaḥ pādaspṛśi preyasi|| 2 kasyāpi
satyaṃ durlabha eṣa vallabhatamo rāgo mamāsminpunaḥ kopo 'syātigururna cātinipuṇāḥ sakhyo 'pi sambodhane| saṃcintyeti mṛgīdṛśāpriyatame dṛṣṭe ślathāṃ mekhalāṃ bandhantyā na gataṃ sthitaṃ na ca caladvāso na vā saṃvṛtam|| 3
satyaṃ bhāmini durjano 'smi dayite pālyastathāpi tvayā taddoṣaḥ śataśo mṛgākṣi niyataṃ dīne mayi kṣamyatām| itthaṃ jalpati vallabhe mṛgadṛśā cakṣurlasatsambhṛtaṃ raktatvaṃ viralīkṛtaṃ ca vadane dattaṃ na kiṃcidvacaḥ|| 4 rudrasyaitau
āgatya praṇipātasāntvitasakhīdattāntare sāgasi svairaṃ kurvati talpapārśvanibhṛte dhūrte 'ṅgasaṃvāhanam| jñātvā sparśavaśāttayā kila sakhībhrāntyā svavakṣaḥ śanaiḥ khinnāsītyabhidhāya mīlitadṛśā sānandamāropitaḥ|| 5 kasyāpi
vāco vāgmini kiṃ tavādya paruṣāḥ subhru bhruvorvibhramaḥ apyudbhrāntaḥ kuta eṣa lolanayane kiṃ lohite locane| nāstyāgo mayi kiṃ mudhaiva kupitetyukte puraḥ preyasā māninyā jalabindudanturapuṭā dṛṣṭiḥ sakhiṣvāhitā|| 6 rudrasya
cakṣurluptamaṣīkaṇaṃ kavalitastāmbūlarāgo 'dhare viśrāntā kabarī kapolaphalake dhvastā ca gātrāddyutiḥ| jāne samprati bhāmini praṇayinā kairapyupāyakramaiḥ bhagno mānamahātarustaruṇi te cetaḥsthalīvardhitaḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
sā yāvanti padānyalīkavacanairālījanaiḥ pāṭhitā tāvantyeva kṛtāgasī drutataraṃ saṃlapya patyuḥ puraḥ| prārebhe parato yathā manasijasyecchā tathā vartituṃ premṇo maugdhyavibhūṣaṇasya sahajaḥ ko 'pyeṣa kāntaḥ kramaḥ|| 8 bhaṭṭendurājasya
\Colo iti prasādavarṇanapaddhatiḥ
sambhogapaddhatayaḥ| tatrarṭuṣaṭkam|
vasantavarṇanapaddhatiḥ (59)
tatra ṛtusvabhāvaḥ
ātāmrāḥ kiraṇā ravernavadalatvakpallavāḥ pādapāḥ vallyastārakatulyakāntisumanaḥsaurabhyasambhāvitāḥ| vātyasminmadhumattaṣaṭpadapadavyādhūtacūtadrumaprāgbhāraprapatatparāgapaṭalāmodī maruddākṣiṇaḥ|| 1
viṣphūrjatphālanetrānalabahalaśikhāsaṃcayaiḥ
===
tatra ṛtusvabhāvaḥ
varṣatyagnikaṇānivoṣṇakiraṇaḥ kāṣṭhāstu dāvānalajvālājālajaṭālabhūdharamiladdhūmyāndhakārāvilāḥ| vṛkṣā jīrṇaviśīrṇaparṇapaṭalāḥ śuṣyallatāliṅgitā nadyastaptakarīndrakelikaluṣā grīṣme marunnaiṛtaḥ|| 1
tataḥ prāvirabhūdgrīṣmastapanvasumatīmimām| sapiṇḍaḥ kālakūṭasya saptajihvasya sodaraḥ|| 2
tapanaṃ bibhradākāśo jagatkvāthaviśṛṅkhalam| sphurallalāṭanayanaṃ haraṃ nāṭayati sphuṭam|| 3
kvāpi kvāpi digante kṛśadhavalaḥ ko 'pi ko 'pi ghanaleśaḥ| tigmadyutidagdhānāṃ tārāṇāṃ bhasmavadbhāti|| 4 sūktiratnākarādete
pratigatamarthijanānāṃ vicchinnāṃśaṃ samūhamavalokya|
===
vidyutpaṅkajaṣaṇḍapaṅkapaṭalī vyomasthalīśādvalaḥ kedāraḥ kalamāṅkurapratibhuvāṃ dhārātalānāmayam| śaivālāvaliradrimūrdhni saritāṃ sūrendukārāgṛhaṃ kandarpotsavavaijayanti bhavatu prītyai tavāmbhodharaḥ|| 1 bilhaṇasya
vyāptaṃ bhinnendranīladyutibhiriva ghanairmeghajālairviśālaiḥ udyadividyudvilāsaiḥ suradhanuranugairvyoma velladbalākaiḥ| urvī gurvī śilīndrārjunakuṭajatṛṇairbhāti sasyaiḥ praśasyaiḥ kādambāmodavāhī jaladharasamaye vāruṇo vāti vātaḥ|| 2 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
atha manasijadigjayābhiśaṃsī jaladharadundubhirātatāna śabdam| tadanu tadanujīvibhiḥ kadambaiḥ kavacitamunmadaṣaṭpadacchalena|| 3
śītalādiva saṃtrastaṃ prāvṛṣeṇyānnabhasvataḥ| nabho babhāra nīrandhraṃ jīmūtakulakambalam|| 4
ardhena jaladaśyāmamardhenātapapiṅgalam| ardhanārīśvarākāraṃ na ko manyeta vāsaram|| 5
kaśābhiriva haimībhirvidyudbhiriva tāḍitam| antastanitanirghoṣaṃ savedanamivāmbaram|| 6
meghakṛṣṇājinadharā dhārāyajñopavītinaḥ| mārutāpūritaguhāḥ prādhītā iva parvatāḥ|| 7 śrīvālmīkeretau
===
prāṃśuḥ prāleyapūrāḥ prasarati gagane prāvṛtāśārkacandraḥ toyādhārāḥ sabāṣpāstuhinaghanaghaṭālīnamīnadvijaughāḥ|
=== himadhavaladantakeśī
=== śiśiravarṇanapaddhatiḥ (64)
ṛtusvabhāvaḥ
vahneḥ śaktirjalamiva gatā darśanāddāhavṛtteḥ nityodgandhe navamaruvake vartate puṣpakāryam| śītatrāsaṃ dadhadiva raviryāti pārśvaṃ kṛśānoḥ nīhārārtā iva ca divasāḥ sāmprataṃ saṃkucanti|| 1 rājaśekharasya
śiśiramāsamapāsya guṇo 'sya naḥ ka iva śītaharasya kucoṣmaṇaḥ| iti dhiyāstaruṣaḥ parirebhire ghanamato namato 'numatānpriyāḥ|| 2 māghasya
===
uccitya prathamamadhaḥ sthitaṃ mṛgākṣī puṣpaughaṃ śritaviṭapaṃ grahītukāmā| āroḍhuṃ caraṇamadādaśokayaṣṭerāmūlaṃ punarapi tena puṣpito 'sau|| 1 jayamādhavasya
āskandito bhujalatācalitāgraśākhamāliṅgito yuvatibhiḥ kalikārthinībhiḥ| dhanyo 'si campakataro kusumānurūpairāsāṃ ghanastanaphalaiḥ phalito 'si yacca|| 2
santu drumāḥ kisalayottarapuṣpabhārāḥ prāpte vasantasamaye kathamitthametat| nyāsairnakhadyutimatoḥ padayostadeyaṃ bhūḥ puṣpitā tadanu pallavitā ca bhāti|| 3
eṣā jigīṣati pṛthustabakā latā tvāṃ paryāptapīnanibiḍastanabhārakhinnām| asyāḥ priye vicinumaḥ stabakāṃstathānyāḥ kartuṃ yathā na hi tathāpi latāḥ smareyuḥ|| 4
ārādasau taruvarastava kutalānāmākalpamātmakusumairabhiyācamānaḥ| bhūyaḥ samāhvayati yā kalakaṇṭanādairārohabhāramṛdugāmini tatra yāmaḥ|| 5 sūktisahasrādete
atāḍayatpallavapāṇinaikāṃ puṣpoccaye rājavadhūmaśokaḥ| tacchedahetoralipaṅktibhaṅgyā vyākṛṣyatevāsilatā smareṇa|| 6
asaṃkhyapuṣpo 'pi manobhavasya pañcaiva bāṇārthamayaṃ dadāti| evaṃ kadaryatvamivāvadhārya sarvasvamagrāhi madhorvadhūbhiḥ|| 7 bilhaṇasyaitau
calāpāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛśasi bahuśo vepathumatīṃ rahasyākhyāyīva svanasi mṛdu karṇāntikacaraḥ| karau vyādhūnvantyāḥ pibasi ratisarvasvamadharaṃ vayaṃ tattvānveṣānmadhukra hatāstvaṃ khalu kṛtī|| 8
akliṣṭabālatarupallavalobhanīyaṃ pītaṃ mayā sadayameva ratotsaveṣu| bimbādharaṃ daśasi cedbhramara priyāyāstvāṃ kārayāmi kamalodarabandhanastham|| 9 kālidāsasyaitau
pāṇau padmadhiyā madhūkakusumabhrāntyā tathā gaṇḍayoḥ nīlendīvaraśaṅkayā nayanayorbandhūkabuddhyādhare| līyante kabarīṣu bāndhavajanavyāmohajātaspṛhā durvārā madhupāḥ kiyanti sutanu sthānāni rakṣiṣyasi|| 10 kasyāpi
karṇotpalānnayanamāpa gaitcyutātte tanmīlane mukhamayaṃ na jahāti bhṛṅgaḥ| yenaivamadya vinivārayasi pramatte tasminkare 'pi na kimambujasāmyadoṣaḥ|| 11
pūrvaṃ dvirephaparibhūtibhayādbhavatyā yatkeśapuṣpabharaṇaṃ hariṇākṣi muktam| vyarthaṃ tadadya punarapyalakeṣu bhṛṅgāḥ puñjībhavannijakulabhramataḥ patanti|| 12 utprekṣāvallabhasyaitau
yato yataḥ ṣaṭcaraṇo vivartate tatastataḥ preritalolalocanā| vivartitabhrūriyamadya śikṣate balādakāmāpi hi dṛṣṭivibhramam|| 13
lolāṃ dṛṣṭimitastato vitanute sabhrūlatāvibhramāṃ ābhugnena vivartate balimatā madhyena kamprastanī| hastāgraṃ vidhunoti pallavanibhaṃ sītkāradhūtādharā jāteyaṃ bhramarālilaṅghanabhayādvādyairvinā nartakī|| 14 kālidāsasyaitau
ākarṣanti na keṣāmantaḥkaraṇaṃ pravālaśālinyaḥ| lalanā ivātra latikāḥ kusumeṣu śilīmukhairnicitāḥ|| 15
atrāsminsutanu latāgṛhe 'sti ramyaṃ mālatyāḥ kusumamanuccitaṃ pareṇa| ityuktvā mṛdukarapallavaṃ gṛhītvā mugdhākṣīṃ rahasi nināya ko 'pi dhūrtaḥ|| 16 bhūtimādhavasya
apacitakusumā vihāya vallīryuvatiṣu komalamālyabhāriṇīṣu| padamupadadhire kulānyalīnāṃ na paricayo malinātmanāṃ pradhānam|| 17
muhurupahasitāmivālinādairvitarasi naḥ kalikāṃ kimarthametām| vasatimupagate na dhāmni tasyāḥ śaṭha kalireṣa mahāṃstvayādya dattaḥ|| 18 māghasyaitau
subhru tvanmukhapaṅkajena śaśinaḥ śobhātiraskāriṇā paśyābjāni vinirjitāni sahasā gacchanti vicchāyatām| śrutvā te parivāravāravanitāgītāni bhṛṅgāṅganāḥ līyante mukulāntareṣu śanakaiḥ saṃjātalajjā iva|| 19 śrīharṣasya
iti kusumāpacayaḥ
madanapūjā---
pratyagramajjanaviśeṣaviviktakāntiḥ kausumbharāgarucirasphuradaṃśukāntā| vibhrājate makaraketanamarcayantī bālā pravālaviṭapiprabhavā lateva|| 20
kusumasukumāramūrtirdadhatī niyamena tanutaraṃ madhyam| ābhāti makaraketoḥ pārśvasthā cāpayaṣṭiriva|| 21
spṛṣṭastvayaiva dayite smarapūjāvyāpṛtena hastena| udbhinnāparamṛdutarakisalaya iva lakṣyate 'śokaḥ|| 22
anaṅgo 'yamanaṅgatvamadya nindiṣyati dhruvam| yadanena na samprāptaḥ pāṇisparśotsavastava|| 23 śrīharṣasyaitau
vicalitamaṇihāraṃ kiṃcidunnamramadhyaṃ kvaṇitavalayamīṣaddṛṣṭasīmantarekham| alasanayanamardhasrastakarṇāvataṃsaṃ yugapadurasi baddhaṃ manmanaścāñjaliśca|| 24 śrīharṣasya
iti madanapūjā
=== andhakāravarṇanam (69)
avijñātaviśeṣasya sarvatejopahāriṇaḥ| svāmino nirviśeṣasya tamasaśca kimantaram|| 1 śrimadavantivarmaṇaḥ
śuddhamāvilamavasthitaṃ calaṃ vakramārjavaguṇānvitaṃ ca yat| sarvameva tamasā samīkṛtaṃ dhiṅmahattvamasatāṃ hatāntaram|| 2 kālidāsasya
limpatīva tamo 'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ| asatpuruṣaseveva dṛṣṭirniṣphalatāṃ gatā|| 3 vikramādityasya
nītāḥ kvāpyabhisārikā iva diśo 'pyudgāḍharāgodayāḥ yenotplāvitamanmathena tadidaṃ niḥśaṅkamujjṛmbhate| sambhogāntaśayāluśailatanayādoḥpāśanirbhartsitonmīlannīlimanīlakandharagalaspardhāvaliptaṃ tamaḥ|| 4 madanasya
unmuktābhirdivasamadhunā sarvatastābhireva svacchāyābhirniculitamiva prekṣyate viśvametat| paryanteṣu jvalati jaladhau ratnasānau ca madhye citrāṅgīyaṃ ramayati tamaḥstomanīlā dharitrī|| 5 murāreḥ
idaṃ nabhasi bhīṣaṇabhramadulūkakolāhale niśācaravilāsinīnivahadattanetrotsave| parisphurati nirbharapracurapaṅkamagnollasadvarāhakulamāṃsalaṃ prabalabandhamandhaṃ tamaḥ|| 6 sarvajñavāsudevasya
cinvaccoracikīrṣitāni ghaṭayadvetālagoṣṭhīsukhaṃ tanvānaṃ śavasādhanotsavarasaṃ nirvyājadhīrātmanām| kurvatkāmakṛśānutaptamanasāṃ guptāṅganāsaṃgamaṃ śarvaryāstimiraṃ paropakṛtaye baddhakramaṃ dhāvati|| 7
kiṃ bhūmau paritaḥ sphuranti kariṇaḥ kastūrikāyā rasaiḥ siktāḥ kiṃ nikhilā diśaḥ kimakhilaṃ liptaṃ maṣībhirnabhaḥ| kiṃ vyāptaṃ bhuvanaṃ samastamapi ca śrīkaṇṭhakaṇṭhatviṣā kālindījalakāntibhāji nibiḍe jāte 'ndhakāre 'dhunā|| 8 kayorapyetau
yaccedambudhimāmananti kavayastadbindutāṃ bibhrate vaikuṇṭhāntakakālakāyajaladaśrīkaṇṭhakaṇṭhādayaḥ|
===
yadyallokavirodhi yacca bahuśaḥ kleśāvahaṃ sarvathā yaccātyantasudurlabhaṃ yadapi vā pāpapradhānaṃ sadā| tattatkāmijanasya vāñchati manaḥ svairapracārotsukaṃ yuktāyuktavicārarodhi tadaho vāmaṃ manaḥ kāminām|| 1||
madhurmāso ramyo vipinamajanaṃ tvaṃ ca taruṇī sphuratkāmāveśe vayasi vayamapyāhitabharāḥ| vraja tvaṃ vā mugdhe kṣaṇamiha vilambasva yadi vā punastāvajjātaḥ piśunavacasāmeṣa viṣayaḥ|| 2|| bilhaṇasya
kimu kuvalayanetrāḥ santi no nākanāryaḥ tridaśapatirahalyāṃ tāpasīṃ yatsiṣeve| hṛdayatṛṇakuṭīre dīpyamāne smarāgnau ucitamanucitaṃ vā vettikaḥ paṇḍito 'pi|| 3||
vikalayati kalākuśalaṃ hasati śuciṃ paṇḍitaṃ viḍambayati| adharayati dhīrapuruṣaṃ kṣaṇena makaradhvajo devaḥ|| 4||
na gamyo mantrāṇāṃ na ca bhavati bhaṣajyaviṣayaḥ na cāpi pradhvaṃsaṃ vrajati vihitaiḥ śāntikaśataiḥ| bhramāveśādaṅge kamapi vidadhadbhaṅgamasamaṃ smarāpasmāro 'yaṃ bhramayati dṛśaṃ ghūrṇayati ca|| 5||
pauṣpāḥ pañca śarāḥ śarāsanamapi jyāśūnyamikṣorlatā jetavyaṃ jagatāṃ trayaṃ pratidinaṃ jetāpyanaṅgaḥ kila| ityāścaryaparamparāghaṇṭanayā cetaścamatkārayan vyāpāraḥ sutarāṃ vicārapadavīvandhyo vidhervardhatām|| 6|| trivikramabhaṭṭasyaitau
paṅkaḥ kuṅkumakardamaḥ kisalayaśreṇī sphuratkaṇṭakāḥ pāṣāṇā viṣamā mṛṇālavalayānyandhaṃ tamaścandrikā| bhūmirgokhurakarkaśā pravitatā śayyā tathā komalā saṃketotsavakāmināṃ punaraho vāmā hi kāmasthitiḥ|| 7 kasyāpi
cetaḥ kātaratāṃ jahīhi hṛdaya sthairyaṃ dadhīthāḥ kṣaṇaṃ prāptā sā smaramārgaṇavraṇagaṇatrāṇauṣadhiḥ preyasī| yena śvāsataraṅgasaurabhamiladbhṛṅgāvalīvāraṇakrīḍāndolitabāhukaṅkaṇaraṇatkāro muhurmūrchati|| 8 gotrānandasya
samārūḍhaprītiḥ praṇayabahumānādanudinaṃ vyalīkaṃ vīkṣyedaṃ kṛtamakṛtapūrvaṃ khalu mayā| priyā muñcatyadya sphuṭamasahanā jīvitamaho prakṛṣṭasya premṇaḥ skhalitamaviṣahyaṃ hi bhavati|| 9 śrīharṣasya
praṇayaviśadāṃ vaktre dṛṣṭiṃ dadhāti na śaṅkitā ghaṭayati ghanaṃ kaṇṭhāśleṣe balānna payodharau| vadati bahuśo gacchāmīti prayatnadhṛtāpyaho ramayatitarāṃ saṃketasthā tadāpi ca kāminī|| 10 amarukasya
āyātāsi vimuñca vepathubharaṃ dṛṣṭāsi kiṃ kenacit nīlaṃ colamamuṃ vimuñca haratu svedaṃ niśīthānilaḥ| ityantarbhayasannakaṇṭhamasakṛdyāmīti talpātithiḥ jalpantī parirabhyate sukṛtinā svairaṃ navasvairiṇī|| 11 ākāśapoleḥ
taḍidvā paṅko vā timiramathavā garjirathavā niśā vā vṛṣṭirvābhinavasaritāṃ śreṇirathavā| yatheṣṭaṃ ceṣṭantāṃ yadi na dayitaḥ premavimukhaḥ pradīpaḥ snehāḍhyo na khalu pavanādyairviramati|| 12 śrīṭhakkurasya
kṛtvā nūpuramūkatāṃ caraṇayoḥ saṃyamya nīvīmaṇīḥ uddāmadhvanipaṇḍitānparijane kiṃcicca nidrāyite| kasmātkupyasi yāvadasmi calitā tāvadvidhipreritaḥ kāśmīrīkucakumbhavibhramadharaḥ śubhrāṃśurabhyudyataḥ|| 13 kāśmīrībilhaṇasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāmabhisāre kāmijanapralāpapaddhatiḥ
hṛdaye dayitena hṛte vapuṣi savepathuni pathi nirālambe| ayi kathaya kathamanaṅga priyagṛhamabhisārikāṃ nayasi|| 1||
mārge paṅkacite ghanāndhatamase niḥśabdasaṃcārayā gantavyādya mayā priyasya vasatirmugdheti kṛtvā matim| ājānūddhṛtanūpurā karatalenācchādya netre bhṛśaṃ kṛcchreṇāttapadasthitiḥ svabhavane panthānamabhyasyati|| 2||
mūrtirnīladukūlinī mṛgamadaiḥ pratyaṅgapatrakriyā bāhū mecakaratnakaṅkaṇabhṛtau kaṇṭhe 'mbusārāvalī| vyālambālakamañjarīkamalikaṃ kāntābhisārotsave yatsatyaṃ tamasā mṛgākṣi vihitaṃ veṣe tavācāryakam|| 3
jano durvañcyo 'yaṃ kulamamalinaṃ vartma viṣamaṃ patiśchidrānveṣī praṇayivacanaṃ duṣpariharam| ataḥ kācittanvī rativihitasaṃketagataye gṛhādvāraṃ vāraṃ nirasaradatha prāviśadatha|| 4
chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ priyasakhi prāyeṇa loko 'dhunā rātriścāpi ghanāndhakārabahulā gantuṃ na te yujyate| mā maivaṃ sakhi vallabhaḥ priyatamastasyotsukā darśane yuktāyuktavicāraṇā yadi bhavetsnehāya dattaṃ jalam|| 5
tamaḥ śāntaṃ śāmyatvayamudita evendurudiyāt mayā gamyaṃ tatra priyasakhi sa yatra priyatamaḥ| gṛhagrāhotsaṅge śatamiva yugānāṃ gatamaho niśā cedevaṃ syādayi kathaya ko mṛtyuraparaḥ|| 6
nirīkṣya vidyunnayanaiḥ payodo mukhaṃ niśāyāmabhisārikāyāḥ| dhārānipātaiḥ saha kiṃ nu vāntaścandro 'yamityārtataraṃ rarāsa|| 7
mandaṃ nidhehi caraṇau paridhehi vāso nīlaṃ pidhehi valayāvalimaṃśukena| mā jalpa sahasini śāradacandrakāntadantāṃśavastava tamāṃsi samāpayanti|| 8
abhisaraṇarasaḥ kṛśāṅgayaṣṭerayamaparatra na vīkṣitaḥ śruto vā| ahimapi yadiyaṃ nirāsa nāṅghrernibiḍitanūpuramātmanīnabuddhyā|| 9 kasyāpi
nayasva pāraṃ pulinadvayānugāṃ taraṅgaḍolāmadhiropya māmitaḥ| prasīda yāvanna niśā pradīryate yaśāṃsi te gāyatu pāṃsulājanaḥ|| 10 bilhaṇasya
agre dhanuḥśarakaraḥ svayamasti kāmaḥ paścāttvarā śaśadharodayasaṃśayotthā| dhvāntaṃ dināntavikasadvibhavaṃ samantātkiṃ kevalā pathi vadhūrdayitābhisāre|| 11 sūktiratnākarāt
vātoddhūtamukhapraṇaṣṭatilakā toyārdranīlāṃśukā meghānāṃ ninadena bhītahṛdayā gatvā priyasyālayam| dvāraṃ necchati lajjayā pralapituṃ dehīti varṣāhatā pādau nūpurakardamapratihatau saṃśabdayantī sthitā|| 12
ambhojākṣyāḥ puravanalatādhāmni saṃketabhājaḥ cetonāthe cirayati bhṛśaṃ mohanidrāṃ gatāyāḥ| svacchaṃ nābhihradavalayitaṃ kāntaratnāṃśujālaṃ toyabhrāntyā pibati hariṇī vismayaṃ ca prayāti|| 13
jñātaṃ jñātijanaiḥ praghuṣṭamayaśo dūraṃ gatādhīratā tyaktā dhīḥ pratipādito 'pyavinayaḥ sādhvīpadaṃ projjhitam| luptā cobhayasādhulokapadavī dattaḥ kalaṅkaḥ kule bhūyo dūti kimanyadasti yadasāvadyāpi nāgacchati|| 14
uttiṣṭha dūti yāmo yāmo yātastathāpi nāyātaḥ| yātaḥ paramapi tiṣṭhejjīvitanāśo bhavettasyāḥ|| 15 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāmabhisārikāpaddhatiḥ||
śete 'dyāpi na padminī kumudinī sāntaḥsmitā vartate rāgāt
===
yathā bahiḥ kaṇṭhakitaṃ vapustava nitambini| tathā niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ vartate 'ntarmanobhuvaḥ|| 1 laghuvallabhavāsudevasya
===
yatra na madanavikāraḥ sadbhāvasamarpaṇaṃ ca gātrāṇām| tasminnuddhṛtabhāve paśukarmaṇi paśava eva rajyante|| 1||
yatra svedajalairalaṃ vilulitairvyāluptaye candanaṃ sacchedairmaṇitaiśca yatra raṇitaṃ nihnūyate naupuram| yatrāyāntyacireṇa sarvaviṣayāḥ kāmaṃ tadekāgratāṃ sakhyastatsurataṃ bhaṇāmi dhṛtaye śeṣā tu lokasthitiḥ|| 2|| rudrasyaitau
giro yatrādhīrā bhujayugalamāśleṣacaturaṃ luṭhadbāṣpāpīḍaṃ prasarati ca cakṣuḥ sarabhasam| na tanmanye prema praṇayini cirāddṛṣṭipathage kṣaṇaṃ mūko 'ndho vā bhavati na jaḍo yatpriyajanaḥ|| 3|| kasyāpi
induryatra na nindyate na ca kalaṃ dūtīvacaḥ śrūyate nocchvāsā hṛdayaṃ dahantyaśiśirā no yāti kārśyaṃ vapuḥ| svādhīnāmanukūlinīṃ priyatamāmāliṅgya yatsupyate tatkiṃ prema hṛhāśramavratamaho kaṣṭaṃ hi taccaryate|| 4||
āśleṣe prathamaṃ krameṇa vijite hṛdye 'dharasyārpaṇe kelidyūtavidhau paṇaṃ priyatame kāntāṃ punaḥ pṛcchati| sāntarhāsaniruddhasambhṛtarasodbhedasphuradgaṇḍayā svairaṃ sārivisāraṇāya nihitaḥ svedāmbugarbhaḥ karaḥ|| 5
akṣadyūtajitādharagrahavidhāvīśo 'pi tatkhaṇḍanāt ādhikye vada ko bhavāniti mṛṣā kopāñcitabhrūlatam| svidyatsvinnakarāgrakuḍmalaparāyattīkṛtāsyasya me mugdhākṣī pratikṛtya tatkṛtavatī dyūte 'pi yannārjitam|| 6 gopādityasya
āśleṣacumbanaratotsavabhūṣaṇāni krīḍādurodarapaṇaḥ pratibhūranaṅgaḥ| bhogaḥ sa yadyapi jaye ca parājaye ca yūnormanastadapi vāñchati jetumeva|| 7 śrīmurāreḥ
akṣadevanapaṇīkṛte 'dhare kāntayorjayaparājaye sati| atra vaktuṃ yadi vetti manmathaḥ kastayorjayati jīyate 'pi vā|| 8 bhāgavatajayavardhanasya
gāḍhāliṅganapūrvamekamanayā dyūte jitaṃ cumbanaṃ tatkiṃcitparirabhya dattamamunā pratyarpitaṃ cānayā| naitattādṛgidaṃ na tādṛśamiti pratyarpaṇaprakramaiḥ yūnoścumbanamekameva bahudhā rātrirgatā tanvatoḥ|| 9 uḍḍīyakaveḥ
cakṣuḥprītyā prasakte manasi paricaye cintyamā
===
ṭaṃkāraḥ smarakārmukasya suratakrīḍāpikīnāṃ ravaḥ jhaṃkāro ratimañjarīmadhulihāṃ kelīcakorīsvanaḥ| tanvyāḥ kañculikāpasāraṇabhujākṣepasphuratkaṅkaṇakvāṇaḥ prema tanotu vo navavayolāsyāya veṇudhvaniḥ|| 1 kasyāpi
pratikṣaṇasamullasannavakalākalāpānvitakṣapākaravilokane yadi tavāsti kautūhalam| vilokaya tadā sakhe suratasaṃgarāsūtraṇaprahṛṣṭadayitāmukhaṃ nibiḍakañcukottāraṇe|| 2 bhaṭṭasomeśvarasya
tṛṣitaḥ spṛśati preyānyadyadaṅgaṃ mṛgīdṛśaḥ| tattatsaṃkucati svairaṃ manmathaḥ prasaratyaho|| 3 vasundharasya
nāndīpadāni ratināṭakavighnaśāntāvājñākṣarāṇi paramāṇyathavā smarasya| daṣṭe 'dhare praṇayinā vidhutāgrapāṇeḥ sītkāravanti raṇitāni jayanti tanvyāḥ|| 4
samādiṣṭaṃ śiṣṭaiḥ paramamiha yannivṛtipadaṃ punardagdho 'pyāśu prabhavati yato manmathataruḥ| śrute yasminkāmī bhavati kṛtakṛtyo ratimukhaṃ sa sītkāraḥ pāyādamṛtavijayī sundaradṛśām|| 5 sītkāratnasya
āyāte dayite manorathaśatairnītvā kathaṃciddinaṃ vaidagdhyāpagamājjaḍe parijane dīrghāṃ kathāṃ kurvati| daṣṭāsmītyabhidhāya satvarapadaṃ vyādhūya cīnāṃśukaṃ tanvaṅgyā ratikātareṇa manasā nītaḥ pradīpaḥ śamam|| 6 adbhutapuṇyasya
kacagrahamanugramadaśanakhaṇḍanaṃ maṇḍanaṃ
===
kṣīṇāṃśuḥ śaśalāñchanaḥ śaśimukhi kṣīṇo na kopastava smeraṃ padmavanaṃ manāgapi na te smeraṃ mukhāmbhoruham| pītaṃ śrotrapuṭena ṣaṭpadarutaṃ pītaṃ na te jalpitaṃ raktā śakradigaṅganā ravikarairnādyāpi raktāsi kim|| 1
prahiṇu ramaṇi mānaṃ maunamunmucya sācīkṛtaśirasi mamāsminnarpayasvāṅghriyugmam| ayi sumukhi mayūkhāḥ paśya pīyūṣabhānoḥ varṇanagaranārīnetrapātrībhavanti|| 2
gataprāyā rātriḥ kṛśatanu śaśī śīryata iva pradīpo 'yaṃ nidrāvaśamupagato ghūrṇata iva| praṇāmānto mānastyajasi na tathāpi krudhamaho kucapratyāsattyā hṛdayamapi te caṇḍi kaṭhinam|| 3
māṇikyairdaśanaśriyaṃ ghaṭayatā bimbādharaṃ vidrumaiḥ muktābhiḥ smitamindranīlaśakalakṣodaiśca keśoccayān| itthaṃ ratnamayaṃ vidhātumakhilaṃ durmedhasā vedhasā tenaivāvanatāṅgavalli vihitaṃ vajreṇa cetastava|| 4
astaṃ yāti śaśī śaśāṅkavadane mānaṃ vimuñcādhunā kiṃ mānena mudhā natabhru gaganādbhraśyantyamūstārakāḥ| itthaṃ tvāmanuśikṣayankṣititalādunnamya pādaṃ śanaiḥ kṣīṇāṃ vīkṣya niśāṃ nisargasubhagaṃ gāyatyasau kukkuṭaḥ|| 5
jāte kelikalākṛte kamitari
===
dvitrairvyomni purāṇamauktikamaṇicchāyaiḥ sthitaṃ tārakaiḥ jyotsnāpānabharālasena vapuṣā suptāścakorāṅganāḥ| yāto 'stācalacūlamudvasamadhucchattracchaviścandramāḥ prācī bālaviḍālalocanarucāṃ jātā ca pātraṃ tataḥ|| 1 rājaśekharasya
yaḥ sainye smarapārthivasya virahipratyarthināmagraṇīḥ jyotsnānirjharamujjhati sma jagatāṃ yastāpanirvāpaṇam|
===
gate premābandhe praṇayabahumāne vigalite nivṛtte sadbhāve jana iva jane gacchati puraḥ| tadutprekṣyotprekṣya priyasakhi gatāṃstāṃśca divasān na jāne ko heturdalati śatadhā yanna hṛdayam|| 1
kathamapi sakhi krīḍākopādvrajeti mayodite kaṭhinahṛdayastyaktvā śayyāṃ balādgata eva saḥ| iti sarabhasadhvastapremṇi vyapetaghṛṇe spṛhāṃ punarapi hatavrīḍaṃ cetaḥ karoti karomi kim|| 2
idaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ priyatama nanu śvetamatha kiṃ gamiṣyāmo yāmo bhavatu bhavane nātha bhavatu| purā yenaivaṃ me ciramanusṛtā cittapadavī sa evānyo jātaḥ sakhi paricitāḥ kasya puruṣāḥ|| 3
mayā tāvadgotraskhalitahatakopāntaritayā na ruddho nirgacchannayamativilakṣaḥ priyatamaḥ| ayaṃ tvākūtajñaḥ pariṇatiparāmarśakuśalaḥ sakhīloko 'pyāsīllikhita iva citreṇa kimidam|| 4
padopānte kānte luṭhati tamanādṛtya bhavanāt mayā niṣkrāmantyā sakhi kimapi nālocitamabhūt| ayaṃ śroṇībhāraḥ stanayugamimau nirbharagurū tadānīmetābhyāṃ kathamiva vilambo na vihitaḥ|| 5
mānonnatetyasahanetyatipaṇḍiteti mayyyeva dhikkṛtiranekamukhī sakhīnām| dākṣiṇyamātramasṛṇena viceṣṭitena dhūrtasya tasya hi guṇānupavarṇayanti|| 6
kopo yatra bhrukuṭiracanā nigraho yatra maunaṃ yatrānyonyasmitamanunayo dṛṣṭipātaḥ prasādaḥ| tasya premṇastadidamadhunā vaiśasaṃ paśya jātaṃ tvaṃ pādānte luṭhasi na ca me manyumokṣaḥ khalāyāḥ|| 7 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ kalahāntaritāpralāpapaddhatiḥ
sālaktakena navapallavakomalena pādena nūpuravatā madalālasena| yastāḍyate dayitayā praṇayāttakopānnopekṣito bhagavatā makaradhvajena|| 1 amarukasya
kopātkiṃcidupānato 'pi rabhasādākṛṣya keśeṣvalaṃ nītvā mohanamandiraṃ dayitayā hāreṇa baddhvā dṛḍham| bhūyo yāsyasi tadgṛhāniti mukuḥ kaṇṭhārdharuddhākṣaraṃ jalpantyā śravaṇotpalena sukṛtī kaścidrahastāḍyate|| 2 rudrasya
kopātkomalalolabāhulatikāpāśena baddhvā dṛḍhaṃ nītvā mohanamandiraṃ dayitayā svairaṃ sakhīnāṃ puraḥ| bhūyo naivamiti skhalanmṛdugirā saṃsūcya duśceṣṭitaṃ dhanyo hanyata eva nihnutiparaḥ preyānrudantyā hasan|| 3 amarukasya
sā bāḍhaṃ bhavatekṣiteti nibiḍaṃ saṃyamya bāhvoḥ srajā bhūyo drakṣyasi tāṃ śaṭheti nibiḍaṃ saṃtarjya saṃtarjya ca| ālīnāṃ pura eva nihnutiparaḥ kopādraṇannūpuraṃ māninyā caraṇaprahāravidhinā preyannaśokīkṛtaḥ|| 4 (rudrasya)
chinne hāralatāguṇe karatale sampātajātavraṇe| aprāptapriyatāḍanavyatikarā hantuṃ puraścetasā vāñchantī muhureṇaśāvanayanā paryākulā roditi|| 4 kasyāpi
adhirajani jagāma dhāma tasyāḥ priyahaws
===
darpaṇeṣu paribhogadarśinī pṛṣṭhataḥ praṇayino niṣeduṣaḥ| vīkṣya bimbamanubimbamātmanaḥ kāni kāni na cakāra lajjayā|| 1 kālidāsasya
tāḍīdalaṃ kācana karṇapāśe niveśayantī sutanuḥ karābhyām| rarāja karṇāntavisarpidṛṣṭiḥ śāṇe dadāneva kaṭākṣabāṇān|| 2 bilhaṇasya
===
ucchvāsaḥ khaṇḍakhaṇḍastaralitahṛdaye mūkatāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ uktipratyuktibandho 'pyabhinayavihitaḥ pāṃsulā bhūḥ suśayyā| tūṣṇīmeva prasādānunayanakalahāścumbanaṃ śabdaśūnyaṃ yatraitatsvasti tasmai nibhṛtanidhuvanāyeti nāndī namo 'sti|| 1
aye ko jānīte nijapuruṣasaṅgo hi na tathā yathā cetaḥ strīṇāṃ parapuruṣasaṅgo ramayate| api svairaṃ bhuktā divasamakhilaṃ vāsarakṛtā karasparśādindormukulayati netrāṇi nalinī|| 2 devarājasya
bhrūbhedaiḥ katicidgirā kuṭilayā kāścitkiyatyaḥ smitaiḥ svairiṇyaḥ prathayanti manmathaśaravyāpāravaśyaṃ manaḥ| kāsāṃcitpunaraṅgakeṣu masṛṇacchāyeṣu garbhasthitaḥ bhāvaḥ kācapuṭeṣu puṣkaramiva pravyaktamālokyate|| 3 abhinandanasya
aye ko 'yaṃ vṛddho gṛhaparivṛḍhaḥ kiṃ tava pitā na me bhartā kiṃ tu vyapagatadṛganyacca badhiraḥ| huhuṃ śrānto 'dyāhaṃ śiśayiṣurihaivāpavarake kva yāminyāṃ yāmi svapimi nanu nirdaśamaśake|| 4 śrībhojadevasya
śūnyaṃ veśma cirādgato gṛhapatirjātādhunā śarvarī sthātuṃ nocitamatra gaccha nipuṇaṃ lokairanālokitaḥ| itthaṃ loladṛśā hyasāvabhihito dāsīmukhenādhvagaḥ smitvā kiṃcidiva kva yāmi rajanī yātetyudīrya sthitaḥ|| 5 kasyāpi
ākārairna vindati vakraphaṇitīrboddhuṃ na medhāvinaśabdākhyeyanijāśayaṃ kulavadhūvargasya naitadvratam| grāme 'sminnṛjuvācyavācakahatātmāno yuvāno jaḍāḥ tattvajñopagatādhvagāvadhirayaṃ kāmajvaraḥ sahyatām|| 6 hariharasya
dṛṣṭiṃ he prativeśini kṣaṇamihāpyasmadgṛhe dāsyasi prāyeṇāsya śiśoḥ pitā na virasāḥ kaupīrapaḥ pāsyati| ekākinyapi yāmi tadvanamitaḥ srotastamālākulaṃ nīrandhrāstanumālikhantu jaraṭhacchedā nalagranthayaḥ|| 7 vijjākāyāḥ
eṣāṃ gopavadhūvilāsasuhṛdāṃ rādhārahaḥsākṣiṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadrakalindaśailatanayātīre latāśākhinām| vicchinne smaratalpakalpanavidhicchedāya yoge 'dhunā te jāte jaraṭhībhavanti vilasannīlatviṣaḥ pallavaiḥ|| 8 kasyāpi
yaḥ kaumāraharaḥ sa eva hi varastāścandragarbhā niśāḥ pronmīlannavamālatīsurabhayaḥ prauḍhāḥ kadambānilāḥ| sā caivāsmi tathāpi tatra cauryasuratavyāpāralīlāvidhau revārodhasi vetasītarutale cetaḥ samutkaṇṭhate|| 9 śilābhaṭṭārikāyāḥ
vyapetavyāhāraṃ gatavividhaśilpavyatikaraṃ
===
ādāya māṃsamakhilaṃ stanavarjamaṅge māṃ muñca vāgurika yāmi kuru prasādam| sīdanti śaṣpakavalagrahaṇānabhijñāḥ manmārgavīkṣaṇaparāḥ śiśavo madīyāḥ|| 1|| naradevavarmaṇaḥ
hṛdayānnāpayāto 'si dikṣu sarvāsu dṛśyase| ahamaśrūṇi muñcāmi paśyatāntaramāvayoḥ|| 2|| abhinandasyaitau(?)|
mātastātaḥ kva yātaḥ surapatibhavanaṃ hā kutaḥ putraśokāt ko 'sau putraścaturṇāṃ tvamavarajatayā yasya jātaḥ kimasya| prāpto 'sau kānanāntaṃ kimiti nṛpagirā kiṃ tathāsau babhāṣe madvāgbaddhaḥ phalaṃ te kimiha tava dharādhīśatā hā hato 'smi|| 4||
kṛtakakupitairbāṣpāmbhobhiḥ sadainyavilokitaiḥ vanamasi gatā yasya prītyā dhṛtāpi tathāmbayā| navajaladharaśyāmāḥ paśyandiśo bhavatīṃ vinā kaṭhinahṛdayo jīvatyeva priye sa tava priyaḥ|| 5||
snigdhaśyāmalakāntiliptaviyato velladbalākā ghanāḥ| vātāḥ śīkariṇaḥ payodasuhṛdāmānandakekā ravāḥ| kāmaṃ santu dṛḍhaṃ kaṭhorahṛdayo rāmo 'smi sarvaṃsahaḥ vaidehī tu kathaṃ bhaviṣyati hahā hā devi dhīrā bhava|| kayorapyetau
ko 'haṃ brūhi sakhe sa eva hi bhavānāryaḥ sa ko rāghavaḥ ke yūyaṃ bata nātha nātha kimidaṃ dāso 'smi te lakṣmaṇaḥ| kāntāre kimihāsmahe vada vṛthā devyā gatirmṛgyate kā devī janakādhirājatanayā hā jānaki kvāsi hā|| 7 mahānāṭakāt
saumitre nanu sevyatāṃ tarutalaṃ caṇḍāṃśurujjṛmbhate
===
prāyeṇa sukaraṃ dānaṃ prāyeṇa sukaraṃ tapaḥ| prāṇānapekṣavyāpāraḥ punarvīrasya duṣkaraḥ|| 1|| kasyāpi
kṣudrāḥ saṃtrāsamenaṃ vijahata harayo bhinnaśakrebhakumbhāḥ yuṣmadgātreṣu lajjāṃ dadhati paramamī sāyakāḥ sampatantaḥ| saumitre tiṣṭha pātraṃ tvamasi na hi ruṣo nanvahaṃ meghanādaḥ kiṃcidbhrūbhaṅgalīlāniyamitajaladhiṃ rāmamanveṣayāmi|| 2||
kapole jānakyāḥ karikalabhadantadyutimuṣī smarasmeraṃ gaṇḍoḍḍamarapulakaṃ vaktramamalam|
===
boddhā yuvā rakṣitamantratantraḥ satvena saṃvarmitacittavṛttiḥ| deśaṃ balaṃ kālamavetya kartā tasyendravajrāhatirapyapārthā|| 1|| śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
śreyaḥ prasūte vipado ruṇaddhi yaśāṃsi dugdhe malinaṃ pramārṣṭi| saṃskāraśaucena paraṃ punīte śuddhā hi buddhiḥ kila kāmadhenuḥ|| 2 rājaśekharasya
nātinīcairna cāpyuccairbhavitavyaṃ phalārthibhiḥ| stokaṃ natvā pibannambhaḥ kumbhaḥ prāpnoti pūrṇatām|| 3
mā sma sandhiṃ vijānantu mā sma jānantu vigraham| ākhyātaṃ yadi śṛṇvanti bhūpāstenaiva paṇḍitāḥ|| 4 lakṣmīdharasyaitau
ātmanāśāya nonnatyai chidreṇa paripūrṇatā| bhūyo bhūyo ghaṭīpātraṃ nimajjatkiṃ na paśyasi|| 5 joyikasya
varaṃ dāridryamanyāyaprabhavādvibhavādapi| kṛśatābhimatā dehe pīnatā tu na doṣataḥ|| 6 bhāskarasya
viruddhairapi vastavyaṃ sādhubhirdharmadarśibhiḥ| na hi doṣāśca sādhūnāmasatāṃ ca guṇaiḥ samāḥ|| 7
asatyātmaguṇe śastraṃ hastābhyāṃ vinivāryate| eṣāpi na gatiḥ kṣemyā na cānyā vidyate kvacit|| 8
bahūnāmalpasārāṇāṃ samavāyo hi dāruṇaḥ| tṛṇairāveṣṭyate rajjuryadi nāgo 'pi badhyate|| 9
bahūnāmapyamitrāṇāṃ ya icchetkartumapriyam| ātmā tena guṇairyojyastatteṣāṃ mahadapriyam|| 10
priyaṃ brūyādakṛpaṇaḥ śūraḥ syādavikatthanaḥ| dātā nāpātravarṣī syātpragalbhaḥ syādaniṣṭhuraḥ|| 11
careddharmānakapaṭo muñcetsnehamanāturaḥ| anṛśaṃsaścaredarthāṃścaretkāmamanuddhataḥ|| 12 bhagavato vyāsasyaite
cittaratnamasaṃkliṣṭamāntaraṃ dhanamucyate| yasya taddūṣitaṃ doṣaistasya sarvā vipattayaḥ|| 13 raviguptasya
yadṛcchāsiddhiṣu prema gurupūjāsvanādaraḥ| vyādhidvayamidaṃ lakṣmyāḥ kṣitau khyātamanauṣadham|| 14
suhṛdbhirāptairasakṛtparīkṣitaṃ svayaṃ ca buddhyā paricintitātyayam(?)| karotikāryaṃ khalu yaḥ sa buddhimānsa eva lakṣmyā yaśasaśca bhājanam|| 15 bhartṛmeṇṭhasyaitau
sati puṇyaprakarṣe 'pi śrīnibandhaḥ samudyamaḥ| kiṃ vaṇigvipaṇikṣiptā hantyajīrṇaṃ harītakī|| 16 kasyāpi
lajjeva madhumattasya kadaryasyeva dharmadhīḥ| avaliptasya vidyeva naśyati śrīḥ pramādinaḥ|| 17
āpadyapi durantāyāṃ naiva gantavyamakrame| rāhurapyakrameṇaiva pibannapyamṛtaṃ mṛtaḥ|| 18 kṣemendrasyaitau
abhidroheṇa bhūtānāmarjayangatvarīḥ śriyaḥ| udanvāniva sindhūnāmāpadāmeti pātratām|| 19 bhāraveḥ
sampadā susthitaṃmanyo bhavati svalpayāpi yaḥ| kṛtakṛtyo vidhirmanye na vardhayati tasya tām|| 20 māghasya
nayāntareṇa sādhye 'rthe daṇḍaṃ nārabhate sudhīḥ| sarajjukumbhastoyārthī kūpe jhampāṃ karoti kaḥ|| 21
āpadaḥ santi mahatāṃ mahatāmeva sampadaḥ| itareṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ nāpado na ca sampadaḥ|| 22 kayorapyetau
patati vyasane daivāddāruṇe dāruṇātmani| saṃvarmayati vajreṇa dhairyaṃ hi mahatāṃ manaḥ|| 23
ariṣaḍvarga evāyamasyāstāta padāni ṣaṭ| teṣāmekamapi cchindankhañjayedbhramarīṃ śriyam|| 24 etau śrīmurāreḥ
jvalati calitendhano 'gnirviprakṛtaḥ pannagaḥ phaṇāṃ kurute| prāyaḥ svaṃ mahimānaṃ kṣobhātpratipadyate jantuḥ|| 25 kālidāsasya
ālasyātsusahāyo 'pi na gacchatyudayaṃ janaḥ| hastāgrāsphālito bhūmau toyārdra iva kandukaḥ|| 26 haribhaṭṭasya
draviṇasya nāparādhastiṣṭhati na ciraṃ yadalpasattveṣu| na hi salilasya sa doṣo vigalati yadviguṇapātrastham|| 27 ratnākarasya
apratikṛtyātmānaṃ sahasānartheṣu na pravarteta| śirasi dhṛte 'mṛtakiraṇe viṣamaghasadviṣamanetro 'pi|| 28
nijavargo 'pyativṛddhiṃ gamitaḥ kālātprabhāvamapaharati| himakāle himadhāmno dhāma tirodadhati tuhināni|| 29
durgatirapi racitāñjalirupasarpati ko na dṛṣṭasāmarthyam| ahipatirābharaṇamabhūtkaṇṭhāhitakālakūṭasya|| 30
kleśasyāṅgamadattvā sukhamiha hi sukhāni nopalabhyante| madhubhinmathanāyastairāśliṣyati bāhubhirlakṣmīm|| 31
alamapriyāṇuditvā
===
ardhāṅgulapariṇāhajihvāgrāyāsabhīravaḥ| sarvāṅgakleśajananamabudhāḥ karma kurvate|| 1|| halāyudhasya
vidyāṃ prāpya kṛtaṃ yena vidveṣakaluṣaṃ manaḥ| tenātmā hanta mūrkheṇa snātvā pāṃsūtkarairvṛtaḥ|| 2||
rasāyanī jarājīrṇaścirarogī ca yo bhiṣak| dhātuvādī daridraśca kiṃ tayā hyasya vidyayā|| 3||
spṛhaṇīyā satī tāvadvidyā saṃtoṣaśālinī| yāvanna pārthivāsthānapaṇyasthāne prasāritā|| 4||
śīlaṃ parahitāsaktiranutsekaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ| alobhaśceti vidyāyāḥ paripākojjvalaṃ phalam|| 5|| kṣemendrasyaite|
dattaṃ samastamapi tiṣṭhati yattathaiva jñātirna yadvibhajate hriyate na coraiḥ| janmāntare 'pi yadupaiti nareṇa sārdhaṃ vidyādhanaṃ yadi tadasti dhanaiḥ kimanyaiḥ|| 6||
nānudyogavatā na cāpravasatā mānaṃ na cālambatā nālasyopahatena nānyamanasā nācāryavidveṣiṇā| na bhrūbhaṅgavilāsasusmitamukhīṃ sīmantinīṃ dhyāyatā loke khyātikaraḥ satāmabhimato vidyāguṇo labhyate|| 7|| kayorapyetau
varaṃ śarāvahastasya caṇḍālāgāravīthiṣu| bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ rāma na maurkhyahatajīvitam|| 8|| vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇāt
śīlaṃ naiva bibharti kīrtimamalāṃ dhatte na dharme dhiyaṃ mātsaryeṇa manīṣiṇāṃ pratanute pāruṣyadoṣaṃ girā| tarkoktyā paralokakarma nayati prāyeṇa saṃdigdhatāṃ yastasyāphalaśāstrapāṭhanapaṭormūḍhasya kiṃ vidyayā|| 9|| kṣemendrasya
\Colo iti śrīmadārohakabhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vidyāpaddhatiḥ||
ambhodhiḥ sthalatāṃ sthalaṃ jaladhitāṃ dhūlīlavaḥ śailatāṃ merurmṛtkaṇatāṃ tṛṇaṃ kuliśatāṃ vajraṃ tṛṇaklībatām| vahniḥ śītalatāṃ himaṃ dahanatāmāyāti yasyecchayā līlādurlalitādbhutavyasanine tasmai namaḥ karmaṇe|| 1||
yatsevyo vikalaḥ kalāśatavidāṃ nālokayatyānanaṃ yanmaurkhyeṇa manīṣiṇāṃ vihasatā na stotramākarṇyate| yacca svāsthyamapathyabhojanajuṣāṃ yatsampadaḥ pāpināṃ tatsarvaṃ puruṣārthapāṭanapaṭordhāturvilāsāyitam|| 2||
māṇḍavyastapasi sthitaḥ kila muniḥ śūle 'rpitaścoravat kāpaṭhyātsa ca cakricoranṛpatiḥ sarvaṃ gataḥ kīrtyate(?)| caṇḍālatvamavāpa daivavihitaṃ devo 'pi dharmaḥ svayaṃ vandhyaṃ sarvaviparyayeṇa kurute daivī gatiḥ pauruṣam|| 3||
lakṣmīkaustubhapārijatasahajaḥ sūnuḥ sudhāmbhonidheḥ daivena praṇayaprasādavidhinā mūrdhnā dhṛtaḥ śambhunā| adyāpyujjhati naiva daivavihitaṃ kṣaiṇyaṃ kṣapāvallabhaḥ kenānyena vilaṅghyate vidhigatiḥ pāṣāṇalekhāsakhī|| 4||
grīvābharaṇatāṃ lebhe kālakūṭaḥ pinākinaḥ| kaṇṭhocchityai sudhā rāhorbhavitavyatayābhavat|| 5|| kṣemendrasya
dhaniṣu mudhā kimu dhāvata tūṣṇīmādhvaṃ na sādhvidaṃ calitam| vidhilikhitākṣaramālaṃ phalati kapālaṃ na bhūpālaḥ|| 6||
