naśyati janādbhujaṅgo vidravati jano 'pi dūrataramuragāt| paśya vidhestātparyaṃ yena tayorapi ca saṃgamaṃ kurute|| 7||
dvīpādanyasmādapi matyedapi(?) jalanidherdiśo 'pyantāt| ānīya jhaṭiti ghaṭayati vidhirabhimatamabhimukhībhūtaḥ|| 8||
deśāddeśāntaraṃ yātu pāpapuṇyamayaḥ pumān| punastatra pratīkṣante sampado vipado 'pi ca|| 9|| prahlādanasya
karotu nāma nītijño vyavasāyamudāradhīḥ| phalaṃ punastadevāsya yadvidhermanasi sthitam|| 10||
yanmanorathaśatairagocaro yatspṛśanti na giraḥ kave 'pi| svapnavṛttirapi yatra durlabhā līlayaiva vidadhāti tadvidhiḥ|| 11||
ālaṃkāraḥ śaṅkhākaranarakapālaṃ parijano viśīrṇāṅgo bhṛṅgī vasu ca vṛṣa eko bahuyavāḥ| avastheyaṃ sthāṇorapi bhavati sarvāmaragurorvidhau vakre mūrdhni sthitavati vayaṃ ke punaramī|| 12 kayorapyetau
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ daivapaddhatiḥ|
dalantyuditacetasāṃ riputamaḥsamūhāḥ samaṃ bhavantyapi ca yadvaśādaniśamarthasārthodayāḥ| tamadbhutaparākramaṃ kramanamatkulakṣmādharaṃ jagajjitarasorjitaṃ puruṣakārameva stumaḥ|| 1
śāntisvastyayanena śāmyati nṛṇāṃ yatsarvamautpātikaṃ yatpathyāśanamāśu roganicayānunmūlayatyutkaṭān| sadyaḥ siddharasāyanena puruṣastāruṇyamāpnoti yat tenārthaḥ puruṣārtha eva jagatāmekātapatrāyate|| 2
ātmā janmaśatairdhanārjanadhiyā mithyā kimāyāsyate paṅgoḥ śrīgṛhameti laṅghitabhuvo daivecchayā nirdhanāḥ| ityetāḥ puruṣārthamūlahatayaḥ kaiścitsamutsāritāḥ mugdhānāmalasotkaṭāḥ pratipadaṃ kurvanti cittabhramam|| 3
pāṇḍityaṃ yadi nāma daivavihitaṃ tatkiṃ vṛdhādhyāpanaḥ āyuścennihitaṃ vidhātṛlikhitaṃ tatkiṃ prayatnāśanaiḥ| rājyaṃ cedvidhinirmitaṃ tadaniśaṃ kiṃ mantratantrodyamaiḥ dhātā cetsugatipradastadaphalaiḥ kiṃ tīrthasārthabhramaiḥ|| 4
vadantyaviditotsāhaṃ daivaṃ daivaṃ sadaiva ye| teṣāṃ vinaṣṭaceṣṭānāṃ dūre dharmārthasampadaḥ|| 5
hatvā nandaṃ svajanasahitaṃ saptabhirvāsarairyat cāṇakyena pratatamatinā candragupto 'bhiṣiktaḥ| āścaryeṇa prasṛtayaśasā kīrtyamānena śāstraṃ tena nyastā kimapi vadato daivavādasya mudrā|| 6
haṭhoddalananiścalaiḥ kaṭhinakaṇṭhapīṭhoddhṛtaiḥ sravadrudhirasarpiṣā parivṛtairmukhaśrīphalaiḥ| śriyaṃ hutahutāśanaḥ kila daśānanaḥ prāptavān na pauruṣadhṛtiṃ vinā bhavati vāñchitāptiḥ kvacit|| 7 kṣemendrasyaite
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ puruṣakārapaddhatiḥ||
upaśobhaiva sahāyāḥ siddhirvīrasya sāhase vasati| dalayati kulāni kariṇāṃ kila hariṇaparigrahaḥ siṃhaḥ|| 1
nityāni naśvarībhirlabhyante nirmalāni malinābhiḥ| tanubhiryaśāṃsi dhīrairavasaratulitābhiratulāni|| 2 vallabhadevasyaitau
sāhasī bhavati yaḥ pumānkṣitau tasya daivavaśataḥ śriyo na cet| sambhavanti vipulāstathāpyaho kiṃ nu kīrtiramalā vihanyate|| 3
svargastasya gṛhāṅgatyahipuraṃ bhūmīgṛhatyambudāḥ ullocanti jagannivāsatiśirogehanti dhātrībhṛtaḥ| dvīpāni praghaṇanti vārinidhayaḥ krīḍātaṭākantyaho yasya syādasamānapauruṣanidherlokottaraṃ sāhasam|| 4
pṛthvī tāvadiyaṃ samudraparikhā tāvannirālambanaṃ vyomaitannanu tāvadeva viṣamaḥ pātālayātrāgamaḥ| dattvā mūrdhni padaṃ samudyamabhido daivasya kīrtipriyaiḥ vīrairyāvadaho na saṃśayatulāmāropyate jīvitam|| 5 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ sāhasapaddhatiḥ|
śrīvarṇanapaddhatiḥ (115)
tāvacchītamṛdusparśaḥ pare sve ca jane janaḥ| vātyayeva himaṃ yāvanna śriyā paruṣīkṛtaḥ|| 1
śrīmānajananindyaśca śūraścāpyavikatthanaḥ| samadṛṣṭiḥ prabhuśceti durlabhāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ|| 2 vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇādetau
śrīparicayājjaḍā api bhavantyabhijñā vidagdhacaritānām| upadiśati kāminīnāṃ yauvanamada eva lalitāni|| 3
kākatālīyayogena yadanātmavati kṣaṇam| karoti praṇayaṃ lakṣmīstadasyāḥ strītvacāpalam|| 4 raviguptasyaitau
kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍitavāngobhiriti gotulyabuddhiṣu| pakṣapātavatī lakṣmīraho devī pativratā|| 5
śrīḥ sapatnīmiva dveṣṭi dṛṣṭiṃ satpathadarśinīm| tāṃ vinā yatra tatraiva patantyandhā iveśvarāḥ|| 6
ayaṃ prabhurayaṃ bhṛtya iti yā jagataḥ sthitiḥ| phalaṃ vijayate tatra śrīprasādāprasādayoḥ|| 7
sarvāsāmapi devīnāṃ madhye śrīrdevadevatā| yāṃ vinā na bhavantyeva tāsāṃ pūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ|| 8
sarvāsāmeva nārīṇāṃ madhye śrīḥ subhagā khalu| spṛhayanti mahānto 'pi yāṃ svecchācāriṇīmapi|| 9
prāṇebhyo na priyaṃ vastu jagatītyanṛtaṃ khalu| lakṣmīkṛte yataḥ prāṇāngaṇayanti tṛṇaṃ narāḥ|| 10
nirdayatvamahaṃkārastṛṣṇā kārkaśyabhāṣaṇam| nīcapātrapriyatvaṃ ca pañca śrīsahacāriṇaḥ|| 11
lakṣmīrnirlakṣaṇasyeti yuktamuktaṃ na sūribhiḥ| lakṣmīsamāgamādanyallakṣaṇaṃ syātparaṃ hi kim|| 12
somāśvāmṛtakālakūṭamadire airāvata śrūyatām| gacchantyā prasabhaṃ khalānanudinaṃ sādhūṃstyajantyānayā dagdho 'haṃ vaḍavānalena na tathā lakṣmyā duhitrā yathā|| 13
ālasyaṃ sthiratāmupaiti bhajate cāpalyamudyogitāṃ mūrkhatvaṃ mitabhāṣitāṃ vitanute maugdhyaṃ bhavedārjavam| pātrāpātravicāramātraviraho gacchatyudārātmatāṃ mātarlakṣmi tava prasādavaśato doṣā api syurguṇāḥ|| 14
padmānāmiva sāsanāṃśaguṇatā(?) yā saṃśrayārhā śriyaḥ sā śrīrbhadragajendramūrtiriva yā dānena vibhrājate| dānaṃ tannavacandravadyadaniśaṃ mānena saṃvardhate mānaḥ sau tṛṇavanna yaḥ paricayamlānaḥ śanaiḥ śuṣyati|| 15
lakṣmīḥ sarpati nīcamarṇavapayaḥ saṅgādivāmbhojinīsaṃsargādiva kaṇṭakākulapadā na kvāpi dhatte padam| caitanyaṃ viṣasannidheriva nṛṇāmuccāṭayatyañjasā dharmādānaniyojanena guṇibhirgrāhyaṃ tadasyāḥ phalam|| 16
kopasteja iti sthitirgṛhamiti krīḍeti duśceṣṭitaṃ māyā ca vyavahārakauśalamiti svacchatvamityajñatā| daurjanyaṃ sphuṭavāditeti dhanināmagre budhairyadvaśāt doṣo 'pi vyapadiśyate guṇatayā tasyai namo 'stu śriyai|| 17
tīkṣṇādudvijate mṛdau paribhavatrāsānna saṃtiṣṭhate mūrkhaṃ dveṣṭi na gacchati praṇayitāmatyantavidvatsvapi| śūrebhyo 'bhyadhikaṃ bibhetyupahasatyekāntabhīrūnaho śrīrlabdhaprasareva veśavanitā duḥkhopacaryā bhṛśam|| 18 viśākhadevasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ śrīvarṇanapaddhatiḥ
dānapaddhatiḥ (116)
bhittvāpi bhūmimadhirohati ratnarā'sirākāśato 'pi namadambudharāḥ sravanti| vāñchāphalaṃ phalati vāñchitakāla eva kālapradhānaguṇaratnadhanasya dātā|| 1 candragominaḥ
merormūrdhni rathena mārgapatitānratnopalānkhaṇḍayan
===
proṣitāyāḥ prayāntyastaṃ prajā dharmo yaśaḥ sukham| nivṛttāyā nivartante aho badhnan(?)kulāṅganāḥ|| 1 bhagavato vyāsasya
ābhogabhūṣaṇavatī kucakumbhasampat antarvikāramadhurāṇi vilokitāni| aṅgānyanaṅgapiśunāni kulāṅganānāṃ dhīrātmanāmapi manaḥ paritāpayanti|| 2
lajjāvaśāvanatamantharadṛṣṭipātaṃ yaiścumbitaṃ kulavadhūvadanāravindam| teṣāmanekapuruṣavraṇitādhareṣu saktiḥ kathaṃ bhavati veśyavadhūmukheṣu|| 3
nātaḥ paraṃ kulamataḥ parato na śīlaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ ca karaṇasya padaṃ mṛgākṣyāḥ| yadbāṣpabinduraparādhavato 'pi patyurutsaṅgitena caraṇena tayāpaninye|| 4
caturthe 'hni
===
upanamitaṃ puṇyacayaiḥ sampūrṇaṃ rakṣitaṃ ca yatnena| sampadi vipadi trāṇaṃ bhavati nidhānaṃ ca mitraṃ ca|| 1|| kasyāpi
kimiha kapālakamaṇḍaluvalkalasitaraktapaṭajaṭāpaṭalaiḥ| vratamidamujjvalamanasāṃ pratipannārthasya nirvahaṇam|| 2|| vallabhadevasya
tasya puraḥ kathanīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhānvitena puruṣeṇa| yo vā śamayati duḥkhaṃ yo vā paritapyate tena|| 3||
svāmini guṇāntarajñe guṇavati bhṛtye suvartini kalatre| mitre cānupacarye nivedya duḥkhaṃ sukhī bhavati|| 4||
hrepayati prativacanairādaramupadarśayankhalīkurute| utkarṣayaṃśca laghayati mūrkhasuhṛtsarvadā varjyaḥ|| 5||
ahite pratiṣedhaśca hite cānupravartanam| vyasane cāparityāgastrividhaṃ mitralakṣaṇam|| keṣāmapyete|
darśitāni kalatrāṇi gṛhe bhuktamaśaṅkitam| kathitāni rahasyāni sauhārdaṃ kimataḥ param|| 7|| bhagavato vyāsasya
śokāratibhayatrāṇaṃ prītivisrambhabhājanam| kena ratnamidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ mitramityakṣaradvayam|| 8||
mādhuryādatiśaityataḥ śucitayā saṃtāpaśāntyā tṛṣaḥ sthāne mitramidaṃ paraṃ paya iti kṣīrasya nīrasya ca| tatrāpyarṇasi varṇanā sphurati me yatsaṃgatau vardhate kṣīraṃ yena puraiva cāsya suhṛdaḥ kvāthe svayaṃ kṣīyate|| 9|| kayorapyetau
ko 'pi kvāpi kuto 'pi kasyacidaho cetasyakasmājjanaḥ kenāpi praviśatyudumbaraphalaprāṇikrameṇa kramāt| etasminnapi pāṭite vighaṭite visphoṭite troṭite niṣpiṣṭe parigālite vidalite niryātyasau vā na vā|| 10|| māhilasya|
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ mitrapaddhatiḥ|
guṇeṣu yatnaḥ kriyatāṃ kimāṭopaiḥ prayojanam| vikrīyante na ghaṇṭābhirbhāvaḥ kṣīravivarjitāḥ|| 1|| kṣemendrasya
paṅkānvayamapi sarasijamārohati nīlakaṇṭhamūrdhānam| paśyata guṇamahimānaṃ caraṇādapi mṛjyate paṅkaḥ|| 2
svalpenaiva hi kaścidguṇena jagati prasiddhimupayāti| ekena kareṇa jagaḥ karī na sūryaḥ sahasreṇa|| 3 prakāśavarṣasya
guṇe kurvādaraṃ bhrātarna vitteṣu kadācana| sulabhaṃ guṇināṃ vittaṃ durlabhā dhanināṃ guṇāḥ|| 4
guṇeṣu yatnasādhyeṣu yatne cātmani saṃsthite| paro 'pi guṇināṃ dhurya iti jīvansaheta kaḥ|| 5
nirgalānāṃ kuto randhraṃ kadācidapi jāyate| vidhīyate guṇaireva tacca muktāmaṇeriva|| 6
guṇeṣvanādaraṃ bhrātarbhūriśrīrapi mā kṛthāḥ| guṇacchedātsa pūrṇo 'pi ghaṭaḥ kūpe patatyadhaḥ|| 7
guṇayukto 'pyadho yāti riktaḥ kūpaghaṭo yathā| nirguṇo 'pyabbhṛtaḥ paśya janaiḥ śirasi dhāryate|| 8
ye kecidguṇareṇurūṣitadhiyo dhanyāḥ sukhaṃ śerate te vijñātapariśramāḥ śiśubhirapyajñātalipyakṣaraiḥ| asmākaṃ tu karasthitāmalakavallokatrayaṃ paśyatāṃ ebhirdagdhaguṇairghuṇairiva tanuḥ śambhostamutkīryate|| 9
ko jānāti guṇānpareṣu nihitāñjānātu ko vakti tān vaktuṃ vyaktamamūnkathaṃcidathavā ko nāma nāsūyati| naivāsūyati kaścideva yadi vā jāyeta kastādṛśaḥ yastairhṛṣyati so 'sti cetkathamasau martyeṣvaho gaṇyate|| 10
kālindyā dalitendranīlaśakalaśyāmābhaso 'ntarjale magnasyāñjanapuñjamecakanibhasyāheḥ kuto 'nveṣaṇam| tārābhāḥ phaṇacakravālamaṇayo na syuryadi dyotinaḥ yairevonnatimāpnuvanti guṇinastaireva yāntyāpadam|| 11
paṅkāttāmarasaṃ śaśāṅka udadherindīvaraṃ gomayāt kāṣṭhādagniraheḥ phaṇādapi maṇirgopittato rocanā| kauśeyaṃ kṛmitaḥ suvarṇamupalāddūrvāpi goromataḥ prākāśyaṃ svaguṇodayena guṇino gacchanti no janmanā|| 12
ye kākiṇīmapi mahāpaṇahiṇḍamānaraṇḍākaraṇḍaśaraṇā na guṇā labhante| te tantukovidakuvindakarāravindamaitrīmavāpya nṛpatīnapi lobhayanti|| 13 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇadevaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ guṇapaddhatiḥ||
nīcāpi sā prakāśyaiva jīvyate kalayā yayā| vartamānaḥ satāṃ sthityā bhaṇḍakairnopahasyate|| 1
dharmasya kalā jyeṣṭhā
===
śilāmaye 'pi prāsāde śilaikā kila devatā| pūjyaḥ puṇyamahimnaiva jaḍeṣvapi jaḍandharaḥ|| 1 ādityabhaṭṭasya
ekasminnapyatikrānte dine dharmavivarjite| dasyubhirmuṣitasyeva hṛdayaṃ dahyate ciram|| 2
vyāpṛtenāpi manasā dharmaḥ kāryo nirantaram| medhibaddho 'pi hi bhrāmyanghāsagrāmaṃ karoti gauḥ|| 3
arāvapyucitaṃ kāryamātithyaṃ gṛhamāgate| chettumapyāgate chāyāṃ nopasaṃharate taruḥ|| 4 bhagavato vyāsasyaite
saṃvartasalilodvṛttaniraṅkuśavisarpiṇā| puṇyaṃ na kleśamāyāti catuḥsāgaravāriṇā|| 5
===
patanti khaḍgadhārāsu viśanti makarākare| kiṃ na kurvanti bhuvane kaṣṭamarthārthino narāḥ|| 1
etadevātra sāmarthyaṃ
===
tṛṣṇe devi namastubhyaṃ catuḥsthāneṣu rajyase| vyādhiteṣvanapatyeṣu tapasviṣu jaratsu ca|| 1 bhaṭṭadevaviḍaṅgasya
tṛṣṇākhaniragādheyaṃ duṣpūrā kena pūryate| yā mahadbhirapi kṣiptaiḥ pūraṇaireva khanyate|| 2
akṛtasyāgamo nāsti kṛte nāśo na vidyate| akasmādeva loko 'yaṃ tṛṣṇe dāsīkṛtastvayā|| 3
manasaḥ satatotthānamaṇornairāśyayantritam| āśāsparśairaduṣpūramaho brahmāṇḍakoṭibhiḥ|| 4 bhagavato vyāsasyaite
dvārapālakarāghātakiṇīkṛtagalo 'pi san| tathāpi kurute sevāmaho tṛṣṇā garīyasī|| 5
piśācīva viśatyantaśchāyeva na calatyalam| veśyeva bhramayatyāśāḥ śokaṃ kanyeva varṣati(?)|| 6
dhatte vandhyāpi putrāśāṃ lubdho 'pyāśāṃ dhanonmukhaḥ| viyogārtaḥ saveṣvāśāṃ (?)jānātyāśā na yogyatām|| 7 kṣemendrasya
āśāvalambopacitā na kasya tṛṣṇālatā nārthaphalaṃ prasūte| dine dine labdharucirvivasvānmīnaṃ na meṣaṃ ca vṛṣaṃ ca bhuṅkte|| 8 ratnākarasya
dhanyānāṃ girikandarodarabhuvi jyotiḥparaṃ dhyāyatāṃ ānandāśrujalaṃ pibanti śakunā niḥśaṅkamaṅke sthitāḥ| asmākaṃ tu manorathoparacitaprāsādavāpītaṭakrīḍākānanakelimandirasadāmāyuḥ paraṃ kṣīyate|| 9 (bhartṛhareḥ )
stuvantyaśrāntāsyāḥ kṣitipatimabhūtairapi guṇaiḥ pravācaḥ kārpaṇyādyadi vitathavāco 'pi puruṣāḥ| prabhāvastṛṣṇāyāḥ sa khalu sakalaḥ syāditarathā nirīhāṇāmīśastṛṇamiva tiraskāraviṣayaḥ|| 10 viśākhadevasya
padaṃ karotyalaṅghye 'pi tṛṣṇāpi phalamīhate| ciraṃ tiṣṭhati naikatra tṛṣṇācāpalamarkaṭī|| 11
anāvarjitacittāpi dhruvaṃ sarvānpradhāvati| phalaṃ na labhate kiṃcittṛṣṇā jīrṇeva kāminī|| 12
bhīṣayatyapi dhīrehamandhayatyapi sekṣaṇam| khedayatyapi śāntehaṃ tṛṣṇā kṛṣṇeva śarvarī|| 13
kṣaṇamāyāti pātālaṃ kṣaṇaṃ yāti nabhastalam| kṣaṇaṃ bhramati dikkuñje tṛṣṇā hṛtpadmaṣaṭpadī|| 14
rogārtiraṅganā tṛṣṇā gabhīramapi mānasam| uttānatāṃ nayatyāśu sūryāṃśava ivāmbujam|| 15
nāsidhārā na vajrārcirna taptāyaḥkaṇārciṣaḥ| tathā tīkṣṇā yathā brahmaṃstṛṣṇeyaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitā|| 16 vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇāt
ātmajñānavivekanirmaladhiyaḥ kurvantyaho duṣkaraṃ yanmuñcantyupabhogabhāñjyapi dhanānyekāntato niḥspṛhāḥ| na prāptāni purā na samprati na ca prāptau dṛḍhapratyayaḥ vāñchāmātraparigrahāṇyapi vayaṃ tyaktuṃ na tāni kṣamāḥ|| 17 kasyāpi
vartate yena na vinā naro vāñchatu nāma tat| tato 'dhikārthapraṇayī pṛṣṭo dadyātkimuttaram|| 18
labhyaṃ labhyamidaṃ ca labhyamadhikaṃ tanmūlalabhyaṃ tataḥ labhyaṃ cāparamityanāratamaho labhyaṃ dhanaṃ dhyāyasi| naitadvetsi punarbhavaṃ na tu cirādāśāpiśācī balāt sarvagrāsamidaṃ kariṣyati mahālobhāndhakārāvṛtam|| 19 kṛṣṇamiśrasya
yaddurgāmaṭavīmaṭanti vikaṭaṃ krāmanti deśāntaraṃ gāhante gahanaṃ samudramanukleśāṃ kṛṣiṃ kurvate| sevante
===
sahodayavyayāḥ pañca daridrasyānujīvinaḥ| ṛṇaṃ daurbhāgyamālasyaṃ bubhukṣāpatyasantatiḥ|| 1|| hemacandrasūreḥ|
ato garīyaḥ kiṃ nu syādaśarma narakeṣvapi| yatpriyasya priyaṃ kartumadhamena na śakyate|| 2|| bhagavato vyāsasya
mahābdhayo yānti nidāghatallatāṃ bhajanti vallītaruhīnatāṃ nagāḥ| vrajanti cintāmaṇayo 'pi loṣṭatāṃ jagatyabhāgyena janena yācitāḥ|| 3|| śrīharṣapaṇḍitasya
pṛthukārtasvarapātraṃ bhūṣitaniḥśeṣaparijanaṃ deva| vilasatkareṇugahanaṃ samprati samamāvayoḥ sadanam|| 4|| kasyāpi
janasthāne bhrāntaṃ kanakamṛgatṛṣṇāndhitadhiyā vaco vaidehīti pratijanamudaśru pralapitam| kṛtā laṅkābharturvadanaparipāṭīṣu ghaṭanā mayāptaṃ rāmatvaṃ kuśalavasutā na tvadhigatā|| 5|| bhaṭṭavācaspateḥ
ayaṃ śūnyo grāmaḥ surasadanametannu patitaṃ puraḥ śuṣkā vāpī tarurayamitaḥ śīrṇaviṭapaḥ| vayaṃ caite pānthāḥ parikṛśadaśābhāgyagatayaḥ samānaḥ saṃyogaḥ kaṭurapi mano me ramayati|| 6||
===
ekaḥ kṣamāvatāṃ doṣo dvitīyo nopapadyate| yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ|| 1
kṣamāvatāmayaṃ lokaḥ paraścaiva kṣamāvatām| iha saṃmānamarhanti paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim|| 2 bhagavato vyāsasyaitau
alaṃkriyā śaktisamanvitānāṃ tapodhanānāṃ balaśaktiragryā| vyāpādadānāvalavāridhārā pretyeha ca kṣāntiranarthaśāntiḥ|| 3 kasyāpi
mannindayā yadi janaḥ paritoṣameti nanvaprayāsajanito 'yamanugraho me| śreyorthino hi puruṣāḥ pratuṣṭihetorduḥkhārjitānyapi dhanāni parityajanti|| 4
ahaṃ na cetsyāṃ mayi duṣṭabhāvanāmime vrajeyurna nirāśrayā janāḥ| tadenasā yojayataḥ parānsvayaṃ mamaiva yuktā khalu nanvapatrapā|| 5
yathā mamātmapriyasampadudyamastathā pareṣāmapi vā viśeṣataḥ| avāpnuyuścenmadabhīṣṭamapriyaṃ na te careyuḥ kathamātmanaḥ priyam|| 6 jñānāṅkuśasyaitau
aśakto yaḥ kṣāntiṃ satatamapajāriṇyapi jane vidhatte so 'vaśyaṃ bhujaga iva daṃṣṭrāvirahitaḥ| prabhuḥ satyāṃ śaktau kṣamata iha yasmātsucaritaḥ sa tejasvī lokadvitayavijigīṣurvijayate|| 7 ācāryakṣemasiṃhasya
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ kṣamāpaddhatiḥ||
krīḍābhūḥ sukṛtasya duṣkṛtarajaḥsaṃhāravātyā bhavodanvannaurvyasanāgnimeghapaṭalī saṃketadūtī śriyām| niḥśreṇī tridivaukasaḥ priyasakhī mukteḥ kugatyargalā sattveṣu kriyatāṃ dayaiva vividhaiḥ kiṃ taistapaḥprakramaiḥ|| 1||
yadi grāvā toye tarati taraṇiryadyudyate pratīcyāṃ saptārciryadi bhajati śaityaṃ kathamapi| yadi kṣmāpīṭhaṃ syādupari sakalasyāpi jagataḥ prasūte sattvānāṃ tadapi na vadhaḥ kvāpi sukṛtam|| 2 somaprabhasūreretau
navanītopamā vāṇī karuṇākomalaṃ manaḥ| ekabījapravṛttānāmetatpratyakṣalakṣaṇam|| 3 kṣemendrasya
parātmasamatāmādau bhāvayedevamādarāt| samaduḥkhasukhāḥ sarve pālanīyā mamātmavat|| 4
parasya duḥkhaṃ hantavyaṃ duḥkhatvādātmaduḥkhavat| anugrāhyā mayānye 'pi sattvatvādātmasattvavat|| 5 bodhicaryāvatārāt
śuddhātmanaḥ satpuruṣasya loke dayā ca satyaṃ ca vibhūṣaṇaṃ hi| yeṣāṃ dayā prāṇiṣu te manuṣyā ye nirdayāstānviduratra sarpān|| 6
na satyavacanaṃ satyaṃ nāsatyavacanaṃ mṛṣā| yadbhūtahitamatyantaṃ tatsatyamitaranmṛṣā|| 7
sarvasattveṣu yaddānamekā sattveṣu yā dayā| sarvasattvapradānāddhi yadekāpi viśiṣyate|| 8
dānaṃ daridrasya vibhoḥ kṣamitvaṃ yūnāṃ tapo jñānavatāṃ ca maunam| icchānivṛttiśca sukhocitānāṃ dayā ca bhūteṣu divaṃ nayanti|| 9 keṣāmapyete
\Colo iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ dayāpaddhatiḥ
vairāgyaṃ kasya na preyo virāgo yadi jāyate| sukhamuttānaśayanaṃ kubjasya na hi yujyate|| 1 kṣemendrasya
dīnoddharaṇasamucitairanupacitairvañcito 'si yadi vibhavaiḥ| calitaṃ vanāya tapase sa ripuryastvāṃ nidhārayati|| 2 vallabhadevasya
ahameko na me kaścinnāhamanyasya kasyacit| na taṃ paśyāmi yasyāhaṃ na hi so 'sti na yo mama|| 3
janmāntarasahasrāṇi viyogaḥ saṃgamaḥ kṣaṇam| tathāpi nirghṛṇaṃ cetaḥ priyasaṃgamamicchati|| 4
kasyānityeṣvanityasya sneho bhavitumarhati| yena janmasahasrāṇi draṣṭavyo na punaḥ priyaḥ|| 5
tattatsmaraṇatāṃ yāti yadyadvastvanubhūyate| svapnānubhūtavatsarvaṃ gataṃ na punarīhate|| 6
bahavo lābhino 'bhūvanbahavaśca yaśasvinaḥ| saha lābhayaśobhiste na jñātāḥ kva gatā iti|| 7
asyaikasyāpi kāyasya sahajā asthikhaṇḍakāḥ| pṛthakpṛthaggamiṣyanti kimutānyaḥ priyo janaḥ|| 8
bālye nārjanasāmarthyaṃ yenāsau yauvane sukhī| yātyarjanena tāruṇyaṃ vṛddhaḥ kāmaiḥ karoti kim|| 9
śarīrasya kimāyātaṃ sugandhi yadi candanam| anyadīyena gandhena kasmādanyatra rajyate|| 10
iha śayyāgatenāpi bandhumadhyasthitena vā| mayaivaikena soḍhavyā marmacchedādivedanā|| 11
kroḍīkaroti prathamaṃ yadā jātamanityatā| dhātrīva jananī paścāttadā śokasya kaḥ klamaḥ|| 12 śrīharṣasya
ajñānaṃ kāraṇaṃ na syādviyogo yadi kāraṇam| śoko dineṣu gacchatsu vartatāmatha yāti kim|| 13 kṛṣṇamiśrasya
ito mṛtyurito vyādhirito vipadito jarā| caturaṅgā tulyabalā hanti lokamanityatā|| 14 bhagavato vyasasya
kālo 'yaṃ bhūtamaśakaghu.ghumānāṃ prapātinām| brahmāṇḍodumbarotthānāṃ bṛhatpādapatāṃ gataḥ|| 15 kasyāpi
kṛtaste kālakākena kulāyaḥ śirasi dhruvam| yadbhāti palitavyājāttatpurīṣasya śuklimā|| 16
nūnaṃ candramasā vyāpto vṛddho 'yamiti me matiḥ| tadraśmijālamaṅge 'sya cakāsti palitacchalāt|| 17 śrīvaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
paripakvaṃ samālokya jarākṣārāvadhūsaram| śiraḥkūśmāṇḍakaṃ bhuṅkte puṃsāṃ kālaḥ kileśvaraḥ|| 17
jarāsudhālepasite śarīrāntaḥpurāntare| aśaktirārtirāpacca tiṣṭhantu sukhamaṅganāḥ|| 18
āpadaḥ kṣaṇamāyānti sampadaḥ kṣaṇameva ca| kṣaṇaṃ janmātha maraṇaṃ mune kimiva na kṣaṇam|| 19
yujyate veṣṭanaṃ vāyorākāśasya ca khaṇḍanam| grathanaṃ ca taraṅgānāmāsthā kāye na yujyate|| 20
vidrāvite śatrujane samagre samāgatāyāmabhitaśca lakṣmyām| sevyanta etāni sukhāni yāvattāvatsamāyāti kuto 'pi mṛtyuḥ|| 21
meruśṛṅgataṭollāsigaṅgājalarayopamā| dṛṣṭā yasminmune muktāhārasyollāsaśālinī(?)|| 22
śmaśāne ca digante ca sa eva lalanāstanaḥ| śvabhirāsvādyate kāle laghupiṇḍa ivāndhasaḥ|| 23
janmapalvalamatsyānāṃ cittakardamacāriṇām| puṃsāṃ durvāsanā rajjurnārī baḍiśapiṇḍikā|| 24
yasya strī tasya bhogecchā nistrīkasya kva bhogabhūḥ| striyaṃ tyaktvā jagattyaktaṃ jagattyaktvā sukhī bhavet|| 25
viṣaṃ viṣayavaiṣamyaṃ na viṣaṃ viṣamucyate| janmāntaraghnā viṣayā ekadehaharaṃ viṣam|| 26 vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇāt
kūjatkaṇṭhadalīmakāṇḍahasitāmunmuktakeśīṃ striyaṃ svādantīṃ daśanairnakhaiśca madirāpānapragalbhīkṛtām| uddāmavraṇakandharāṃ niśi kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bibhyatyamī bālāṃ pītavasāsthimajjamadhukakṣībāṃ piśācīmiva|| 27 bhāskaravarmaṇaḥ
yajñairyeṣāṃ pratipadamiyaṃ maṇḍitā bhūtadhātrī nirjityaitadbhuvanavalayaṃ yaiḥ pradattaṃ dvijebhyaḥ| saṃsāre 'sminsarasi vilasadbudbudastambalīlāṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā sapadi vilayaṃ te 'pi bhūyaḥ prapannāḥ|| 43
itaḥ krodho gṛdhraḥ prakaṭayati pakṣaṃ nijamitaḥ sṛgālī tṛṣṇeyaṃ vivṛtavadanā dhāvati puraḥ| itaḥ krūraḥ kāmo vicarati piśācaraściramaho śmaśānaṃ saṃsāraḥ ka iha patitaḥ sthāsyati sukham|| 44
āyurnīrataraṅgabhaṅguramiti jñātvā sukhenāsitaṃ lakṣmīḥ svapnavinaśvareti satataṃ bhogeṣu baddhā ratiḥ| abhrastambhaviḍambi yauvanamiti premṇāvagūḍhāḥ striyaḥ yairevātra vimucyate bhavaratsāttaireva baddho janaḥ|| 45
nibaddhā sthairyāśā jalaśaśini kallolacaṭule kṣaṇadhvaṃsisvapnaḥ suciramavināśīti kalitaḥ| yadetasminvātapratihatapatākāgratarale kṛtā kāye prītiḥ paramapuruṣārthakṣayakarī|| 46
kaiḥ kairnāmaramaulivanditapadairbhuktā narendraśriyaḥ ko vāsminnarakodare na kuthitaḥ kīṭībhavankoṭiśaḥ| itthaṃ tatsukhaduḥkhayorapi gataḥ sarvaprakarṣaṃ tathā apyajñānāvṛtacetasāṃ na hṛdayaṃ vyāvartate sarvataḥ|| 47
sā buddhirvilayaṃ prayātu kuliśaṃ tatrāpi sampātyatāṃ valgantaḥ praviśantu te hutabhuji jvālākarāle guṇāḥ| yaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaradindukundaviśadaiḥ prāptairapi prāpyate bhūyo 'pyatra purandhrigarbhanarakakroḍādhivāsavyathā|| 48
śūnye sadmani śūlinaḥ kvacidapi prāpyopaśanaterdaśāṃ āsīnasya visaṃsthulāvanitale dhanyasya te kasyacit| dhyānānniścalacetasaḥ svavivarānnirgatya gātropari bhrāmyantaḥ phaṇino bhavanti nibiḍaṃ paryaṅkikābandhanam|| 49 daśaita indrakaveḥ
nijā guheyaṃ tarumūlametadeṣā sarittīraśilātalāni| vanasthitasyāpyanubandha eṣa sambandhabuddhyā bhavabandhahetuḥ|| 50
ramyaṃ harmyatalaṃ na kiṃ vasataye śravyaṃ na geyādikaṃ kiṃ vā prāṇasamāsamāgamasukhaṃ naivādhikaṃ prītaye| kiṃ tu bhrāntapatatpataṅgapavanavyāloladīpāṅkuracchāyācañcalamākalayya sakalaṃ santo vanāntaṃ gatāḥ|| 51
āyāti phullakusumaḥ kusumāgamo 'yameṣā śaśāṅkatilakā śaradāgateti| bāḍhaṃ prahṛṣyati jano na punarmamaitadāyuḥ prahīṇamiti yāti manoviṣādam|| 52 candragominaḥ
dharmātmajena caraṇāviha vanditau me bhīmena sārdhamiha saṃkathitāḥ kathāśca| atrārjunaśca yamalau ca sahānuyātāḥ sthānāni tāni khalu santi na te manuṣyāḥ|| 53
yatrāneke kvacidapi gṛhe tatra tiṣṭhatyathaikaḥ yatrāpyekastadanu bahavastatra cānte na caikaḥ| itthaṃ cemau rajanidivasau dolayandvāvivākṣau kālaḥ kālyā saha bahu kila krīḍati prāṇiśāraiḥ|| 54 candrikasya
kiṃcinniṣpādyamānaṃ kimapi ca vilayaṃ yāti niṣpannamātraṃ śuṣkaṃ sadyo vinaśyatyaparamāpākamāropyamāṇaṃ (?)| yadvadbhāṇḍaṃ tathāsmiñjagati bahuvidhāṃ prāpya janmādyavasthāṃ naśyanti prāṇino 'mī na hi khalu niyatā kvāpi mṛtyorvyavasthā|| 55
adyedaṃ śva idaṃ tathā paruridaṃ kṛtyaṃ parāri tvadaḥ cetaścintayasītthameva satataṃ nirvyākulaṃ re kutaḥ| tatkālaṃ vilasanmanorathakalākāntāradāvānalaḥ yasmindaṇḍadharaṃ smariṣyasi sakhe so 'pyasti kaścitkṣaṇaḥ|| 56
mṛtyo muñca jare kareṇa paruṣaṃ keśeṣu māṃ mā grahīḥ| saṃsārādapalāyanapratibhuvo rāgādayo me sthitāḥ| tṛṣṇābandhanabadhyamānasaśikhaṃ kiṃ vetsi nedaṃ jagat ehītyādarajalpitena bhavataḥ kiṃ nāgamiṣyāmyaham|| 57
taistaiḥ kastūrikādyaiḥ stabakitamapi yadyāti daurgandhyamārāt dṛṣṭā yasyeha niṣṭhā kṛmikulamathavā bhūribhasmāthavāpi| kṛtvā dharmasya bādhāmanudivasamare vañcanātkiṃ pareṣāṃ ātmanko 'yaṃ vimohastava tadapi vapuḥ pālyate yattvayettham|| 58
svārthārambhapraṇataśirasāṃ pakṣapātātsurāṇāṃ dṛptātmānaṃ karajakuliśairdānavendraṃ nihantum| siṃhībhūtastribhuvanaguruḥ so 'pi nārāyaṇo 'smin rāgadveṣapratihatamateḥ kasya na syātpaśutvam|| 59
vartamānakṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ sthitau kāyasya kā pramā| tathāpi jīvanāyāho cintā kalpāntavartinī|| 60
ucchvāsāvadhayaḥ prāṇāḥ sa cocchvāsaḥ samīraṇaḥ| samīraṇāccalaṃ nāsti yatprāṇiti tadadbhutam|| 61 keṣāmapyete
tanmanyate vicitraṃ bahuvivare yā sthitirmarutaḥ| na tathāpi mūḍhahṛdayāḥ kathamapi vimṛśanti niryāṇam|| 62 vallabhadevasya
rātrau vā yadi vā divānavarataṃ vṛddho 'tha vā bālakas sarpatyekaka eva naiva viditaḥ prakrāntarūpe 'dhvani| tasminnudvahanaśramojjhitamahatsatkarmapātheyavān lokaḥ śokamanekarūpamahaha prāpnoti gacchannuta|| 63 vaidyabhānupaṇḍitasya
saṃsāre patitānāṃ kuśalaṃ kiṃ pṛcchyate śarīrabhṛtām| patitasya dahanarāśau dagdho 'si na veti kaḥ praśnaḥ|| 64
yatra yatra ratiṃ yāti manaḥ sukhavimohitam| tattatsahasraguṇitaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhūtvopatiṣṭhate|| 65 bhagavato vyāsasyaitau
svarṇakāratulevāpi yasya buddhirmanīṣiṇaḥ| aśmakāñcanayoḥ sāmye nirdolatvamupeyuṣī|| 66
ānīyate śarīreṇa kṣīṇo 'pi vibhavaḥ punaḥ| vibhavaḥ punarānetuṃ śarīraṃ kṣīṇamakṣamaḥ|| 67
sāhāyyopanamadvivekapavanā dīpiṣyate naḥ kadā vairāgyāgniranekabhedaviṣayakrīḍākarīṣaṃkaṣaḥ| yadbhūtyā parimārjite nirupamaṃ vaimalyamāseduṣi jñānādarśatale svamekamaniśaṃ paśyanti yogīśvarāḥ|| 68 mdanasyaitau
arthibhyaḥ kanakasya dīpakapiśā viśrāṇitā rāśayaḥ vāde vādiviṣāṇināṃ pratihatāḥ śāstroktigarvā giraḥ| utkhātapratiropitairnṛpatibhiḥ śārairiva krīḍitaṃ kartavyaṃ kṛtamarthitā yadi vidhestatrāpi sajjā vayam|| 69 vikramādityasya
upacaritā hariṇadṛśaḥ sajjanagoṣṭhīṣu miśritā vācaḥ| caritaṃ klamanamadavanaṃ na vidheḥ kuṭilādapi trāsaḥ|| 70 vallabhadevasya
ātmannicchasi hanta śāśvatapurīmārge vihartuṃ yadi bhrātaḥ saṃyamavarmaṇā kuru tadā rakṣāvidhiṃ sarvataḥ| no cedindriyataskaraistava haṭhāttīkṣṇāgrabhūrisphuraccintābhallaśatairvibhidya manaso grāhyo viveko maṇiḥ|| 71 kasyāpi
tṛṣā śuṣyatyāsye pibati salilaṃ svādusurabhi kṣudhārtaḥ sañchālīnkavalayati māṃsyākavalitān| pradīpte rāgāgnau sudṛḍhataramāśliṣyati vadhūṃ pratīkāro vyādheḥ sukhamiti viparyasyati janaḥ|| 72 bhaṭṭajayantasya
ajānandāhitvaṃ patati śalabhastatra dahane sa mīno 'pyajñātvā bata baḍiśamaśnāti piśitam| vijānanto hyete vayamiha vipajjālalaṭilān na muñcāmaḥ kāmānahaha gahano mohamahimā|| 73 gobhaṭṭasya [bhartṛhareḥ ]
iti śrībhagadattajalhaṇaviracitāyāṃ sūktimuktāvalyāṃ vairāgyapaddhatiḥ
ajñātamahimā vāṇī śivaṃ stauti rasonmadā| rasātirekādaucityabhaṅgaḥ strīṇāṃ kva labhyate|| 1|| kavidarpaṇasya
yātu cañcalaśīlatvādyatra kvacana me manaḥ| sarvavyāpinmahādeva tvāṃ vihāya kva yāsyati|| 2||
yadyahaṃ stutipade tavākṣamaḥ kiṃ tataḥ kamalajo 'pi yattathā majjato jalanidhau kimantaraṃ mṛtkaṇasya ca kulācalasya ca|| 3||
kaṇṭhakoṇaviniviṣṭamīśa te kālakūṭamapi me mahāmṛtam| apyupāttamamṛtaṃ bhavadvapurbhedavṛtti yadi rocate na me|| 4|| utpaladevasyaitau
tvāṃ pātho 'pi na me rajo harasi kiṃ tejo 'pi no kiṃ tamaḥ candrārkāvapi nekṣase spṛśasi kiṃ na tvaṃ nabhasvānapi| ādhāro 'pi kathaṃ dharāṃ na tanuṣe vyomāpi śabdaṃ na kiṃ kasmāttvaṃ yajamāna eva karuṇādānāya mandāyase|| 5 marottamasya
apūrvo 'yaṃ panthāḥ śiva tava vibhutvasya katamaḥ jagadbandho yatte padayugamakāmaṃ praṇamatām| prayāti pradhvaṃsaṃ na khalu duritaṃ kevalamidaṃ ciropāttaṃ sadyaḥ sukṛtamapi sarvaṃ vigalati|| 6 kasyāpi
ye svapne 'pi ciraṃ na bhānti viṣayāḥ sīdanti ye 'ntaḥ paraṃ yānaprāpya kathaṃcidakṣamatayā tūṣṇīṃ paraṃ khidyate| te 'pi tvatkaruṇāñcalaiḥ kabalitāḥ sidhyanti vidyādhipāḥ kiṃ vā tuṣyati yasya tasya bhavati stambho 'pi kalpadrumaḥ|| 7
ramye puṇyataraṅgiṇīparisare kutrāpi putrādibhiḥ liṅgākāratayā sthitaṃ smarahara tvāmarcayanti sma ye| svargaṅgātaṭakalpapādapalatāhindolakelikramāḥ preṅkhannākavadhūbhujārgalalatāḥ khelantyamī khecarāḥ|| 8
kharjūjarjaragātragharṣaṇaghanavyāpāraśīryannakhaiḥ yo dṛṣṭaḥ śatapātakairapi mahādeva prasaṅgādbhavān| te kandarparasālasāmaravadhūnīrandhrapīnastanadvandvollekhavilāsabhaṅguranakhāḥ khelanti khe khecarasa|| 9
gaurīkānta kṛtāntasūdana jagannātha trayīvigraha tvaccintāsu vicakṣaṇāḥ kṣaṇamapi brahmādayo mānavāḥ| buddhirnaḥ kiyatī na sāpyakaluṣā tatrāpi tāpormayaḥ kastvā cintayituṃ kṣamo na hi kṛpāmātrasya pātraṃ vayam|| 10
katipayapurasvāmī kāyavyayairapi durgrahaḥ mitavitaritā mohenāho mayānusṛtaḥ purā| tribhuvanapatirbuddhyārādhyo 'dhunā svapadapradaḥ punaradhigatastatprācīno dunoti dinavyayaḥ|| 11 bherībhāṅkārasyaite
vapuḥprādurbhāvādanumitamidaṃ janmani purā purāre na prāyaḥ kvacidapi bhavantaṃ praṇatavān| namanmuktaḥ sampratyahamatanuragre 'pyanatimān maheśa kṣantavyaṃ tadidamaparādhadvayamapi|| 12 aparādhasundarasya
tvadīyaṃ tvatkāryaṃ rasakusumagandhādisakalaṃ tavaivāhaṃ bhaktyā pratidinamayacchaṃ nijatayā| tayā bhaktyā ślāghī viditacaritastvaṃ na manuṣe madajñānaṃ yattatkimu śiva tavaivārjavamiti|| 13 sāraṅgadevasya
haṃho mādhava kiṃ vayasya sumate kiṃcidrahasyaṃ bruve huṃkṛtyantamṛjuḥ prakīrṇavibhavaḥ śailātmajāvallabhaḥ| dvitraistaṃ vijane pratārya kusumairarkasya darbhasya vā gṛhṇīmaḥ suramaulilālitapadāṃ trailokyarājyaśriyam|| 14 mādhavasya
bhasmoddhūlana bhadramastu bhavato rudrākṣamāle śubhaṃ hā sopānaparampare girisutākāntālayālaṃkṛte| adyārādhanatoṣitena vibhunā yuṣmatsaparyāsukhālokocchedini mokṣanāmani mahāmohe nidhīyāmahe|| 15 kasyāpi
dharmaṃ brahmaśiroharāddhanabharaṃ bhaikṣeṇa kukṣiṃbhareḥ kāmaṃ kāmatanordavādbhavasamucchedaṃ ca vāñchanbhavāt| āśācchedanatatparācca bhavataḥ sampretsurāśodgamān unmatto 'smi hara prasīdatu bhavānnonmattamapyujjhati|| 16 umāpatidharasya
valgadgaṅgottamāṅge tava kimabhiṣavairnaiva naivedyamāsīt pañcagrāsī yadīyā nijatanuvihitaiḥ pañcabhūtairmahadbhiḥ| kiṃ mantrairmantrakartuḥ kimu kusumacayairvyomakeśasya te syāt pūjābhāve tavaivaṃ bhava bhavatu bhavadbhāvanaivābhavāya|| 17 śrīharṣasya
sthāṇuḥ svayaṃ tvamasi te dayitāpyaparṇā putrastava triṇayana prathito viśākhaḥ| chāyā tathāpi bhavataḥ sakuṭumbakasya tāpatrayavyatikaraṃ jagatāṃ hinasti|| 18 jayadevasya
muktasya vā mama svāminguṇaughagrathitasya vā| astu puṣpacayasyeva viniyogastavārcane|| 19
sattvaṃ mameṣṭaṃ patitaṃ puraste tvadaṅghrisaṃmardarajaḥ priyaṃ ca| adṛṣṭamanyadracitaṃ tamo 'pi traiguṇyahāniṃ kathamīśa yāce|| 20 kayorapyetau
